hero.sub: Discovery & verification controller na Vortex hatiwo ƒe kadodo. Ʋu. Wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔe. Womate ŋu atɔ te wo o.

network.label: NETWORK ƒe .
network.body: Hati ɖesiaɖe léa dzesidegbalẽvi si wode asi na. Asitsalawo ɖoa kpe edzi hafi doa ka, nodes ɖoa kpe etɔ dzi le ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ me. Dziɖuɖumegã aɖeke mate ŋu awɔ aʋatso nusi dzi nya ɣaɣlawo ƒe nyatakakawo ɖo kpee xoxo o.
network.dual_body: Woŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe dziɖula AND si wotre ɖe kɔsɔkɔsɔ dzi to Solana dzi. Ðasefo eve siwo le wo ɖokui si ɖo kpe code hash kple pubkey dzi. Dedie na ɣeyiɣi siwo me woate ŋu awɔ nuvevi ame.
network.ctrl_body: Asidede agbalẽ te ɖo kpe edzi be node la tɔe nye eƒe safui ɣaɣla, gake code ƒe blibonyenye meɖo seke ɖe kɔsɔkɔsɔ dzi o. Enyo na kpekpe akpa gãtɔ; afɔku = kaka ɖe dziɖula ƒe dɔwɔla dzi.
network.unverif_body: Wonyae tso config alo nyatoƒoetoto me. Nya ɣaɣlawo ƒe kpeɖodzi aɖeke meli haɖe o. Zãe ko be nàtsɔ adze hatiwo ƒe xexlẽdzesi gɔme — gbeɖe abe asiɖeɖe le nu ŋu ƒe taɖodzinu na ɣeyiɣi siwo le agbe ene o.

security.label: SECURITY ƒe .
security.body: Ed25519 keypairs ene siwo le wo ɖokui si, siwo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe si dɔ kpui ɖeka le. Safui ɖeka ɖesiaɖe ƒe asiɖeɖe le nu ŋu megbãa bubuawo o.
security.controller_verified: Asitsalawo — tso SNS alo tu pin
security.node_key: Node ƒe asidede agbalẽ te ƒe safui
security.step1_d: Xlẽ vortexx.sol le kɔsɔkɔsɔ dzi. Nuŋlɔɖi siwo te Solana gakotoku de asi — manya wɔ be DNS-adzoe o.
security.step2_d: Asitsalawo yɔa /v1/integrity. Gbea ŋuɖoɖo ɖesiaɖe negbe status: verified tso asiɖeɖe le safui si wotsɔ pin ɖo la me.
security.step3_d: API yɔyɔ ɖesiaɖe trɔna {payload, sig, signed_by}. Asitsaha la ɖoa kpe Ed25519 ƒe asidede agbalẽ te dzi hafi ka ɖe edzi.
security.step4_d: Nodes siwo wotre nu: asisi xlẽa code_hash tso Solana ƒe ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ me. Divergence from controller = woŋlɔe ɖe ŋkɔ yibɔ me tegbee.
security.check_auth: Ŋuɖoɖo ƒe nyateƒenyenye — manya wɔ be woawɔ aʋatso /v1/nodes dziɖula ƒe safui ɣaɣla manɔmee o.
security.check_integrity: Code integrity — dziɖula ƒe faɛlwo hashed kple cross-checked le gɔmedzedze ɖesiaɖe me. Tampering trɔna 503 hafi woɖoa ʋu ɖesiaɖe.
security.check_identity: Node identity — ele be nodewo nade asi ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ te kple woawo ŋutɔ ƒe safui. Amedzidzela mateŋu aŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe node bubu ƒe pubkey teƒe o.
security.check_dns: DNS ameléle sesẽe takpɔkpɔ — .sol nuŋlɔɖiwo le agbe le Solana. Ele be futɔ naɖe asi le gakotokua ŋu, ke menye DNS ƒe agbalẽŋlɔla ɖeɖeko o.
security.check_handoff: Handoff security — session transfers tsɔa Ed25519-de asi dzesiwo kple anti-replay, si wɔa dɔ miniti 5 ko. Target gbea dzɔtsoƒe siwo womenya o.
security.check_transport: Ʋuɖoɖo ƒe adzamenyawo — kadodo URL si dzena na wò ISP / Cloudflare. Zã Tor ahuhɔ̃e ne metadata le vevie.
security.check_content: Gbedasi me nyawo — NOT si dziɖula la ka asi eŋu. Wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ɣla tso nuwuwu vaseɖe nuwuwu le ezãlawo dome. Controller mate ŋu axlẽ naneke ne woɖe asi le eŋu bliboe gɔ̃ hã o.
security.check_host: Host OS / kernel — ne VPS nye ke la, woateŋu afi safuiwo. Zã asidede agbalẽ te si wotu ɖe hardware dzi na paranoid deployments.

access.label: ACCESS ƒe .
access.body: Teƒe geɖe siwo nàge ɖo fia be dɔwɔƒe ɖeka aɖeke mate ŋu axe mɔ na wò mɔɖeɖe o. Ahuhɔ̃e ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒewo subɔa nyatakaka mawo ke siwo wode asi ete tso xɔtuɖoɖo siwo le wo ɖokui si me.
access.tunnel_body: *.trycloudflare.com ƒe adrɛs femaxee. Akɔntabubu aɖeke mehiã o. URL trɔna ne mɔ̃a gadze egɔme ake — bu eŋu abe ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe nuwɔna ene.
access.tor_body: .onion adrɛs, si gbɔ woate ŋu aɖo to Tor dzi ko. Censor-proof kple metadata-private, gake blewu wu. Hiã Tor ƒe asisi aɖe.
access.ipfs_body: Static frontend ƒe kɔpi si me nyawo ƒe adrɛs le. IPFS agbo ɖesiaɖe ateŋu asubɔe — server ɖeka aɖeke meli si woaxe mɔ na o.
access.direct_body: Domenyinyi si wozãna edziedzi + TLS. Tiatia si le kabakaba wu. Blockable at DNS/IP level — dze anyi ɖe ame bubuwo gbɔ ne woɖe mɔ ɖe eŋu.
access.mirrors_body: Host bubu siwo subɔa nyatakaka siwo wode asi na la tututu abe dziɖula sia ene. Wodzroa ahuhɔ̃e ɖesiaɖe me ɣeaɖewoɣi — dometsotso dama fia be woate ŋu aɖoe le miniti 5 mamlɛawo me. Womateŋu alé ŋku ɖe Tor .onion ahuhɔ̃ewo ƒe lãmesẽ ŋu ne menye nutoa me Tor teƒenɔla o.

start.label: GET STARTED .
start.step1: De Vortex ɖe wò mɔ̃ dzi — asitelefon alo kɔmpiuta dzi.
start.step2: Tia Global network mode le ɖoɖowɔwɔ ƒe aɖaŋuwɔla me.
start.step3: Kpe dziɖunu URL (si wokpɔa egbɔ le eɖokui si to SNS dzi) alo nya ɖesiaɖe URL tso Nyawo ƒe axa dzi.
start.step4: Kpɔ egbɔ be pubkey si le wò app me sɔ kple controller fingerprint si le ete. Masɔmasɔ fia be woatrɔ asi le ame ŋu.
start.step5: Mie do ƒome kplikplikpli. Wokpɔa node ƒe xexlẽdzesi, asidede agbalẽ te, kple mɔfiamewo gbɔ le eɖokui si.
start.fingerprint_note: Tsɔ safui sia de wò asisi me hafi nàka ɖe ŋuɖoɖo ɖesiaɖe dzi.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS .
treasury.transparency_body: Protocol fewo katã — node register fewo kple premium subscriptions dzi ɖeɖe kpɔtɔ 20% — sina yia gakotokua me le Solana. Ame sia ame ate ŋu aɖo kpe asitsatsa ɖesiaɖe dzi le dutoƒo.
treasury.rewards_body: 70% le premium sub ɖesiaɖe me yia teƒeɖoɖowo ƒe ta la me, womae pro-rata na active node operators. 20% naa ga core ŋgɔyiyi. 10% fiã alo nɔa anyi abe nugblẽfexeɖoɖo ene.

gravitixDocs.title: Gravitix Gbegbɔgblɔ Ŋuti Nyatakaka
gravitixDocs.subtitle: Scripting gbegbɔgblɔ si wɔa dɔ nyuie hena bots tutu. 96 ƒe nɔnɔmewo. Rust megbenyawo.
gravitixDocs.introDesc: Gravitix nye gbegbɔgblɔ si ku ɖe domenyinyi tɔxɛ aɖe ŋu (DSL) si wowɔ tso gɔmedzedzea me ke hena Vortex bots ŋɔŋlɔ. Le afisi gbe bubuwo hiã agbalẽdzraɖoƒewo, yɔyɔwo, kple boilerplate le la, Gravitix naa nudzɔdzɔwo dzikpɔla siwo le ɖoƒe gbãtɔ, dzeɖoɖo ƒe sisi, kple nɔnɔme si wotu ɖe eme — wo katã le nyagɔmeɖegbalẽ dzadzɛ si woate ŋu axlẽ si Rust ʋã me.
gravitixDocs.goalReadable: Readable — code xlẽa abe tameɖoɖo ene, ke menye mɔ̃wo o
gravitixDocs.goalSafe: Dedienɔnɔ — static ƒomeviwo léa vodadawo hafi runtime
gravitixDocs.goalExpressive: Nyagbɔgblɔ — sisiwo, dzɔlawo, kple kpɔɖeŋu ƒe sɔsɔ nye esiwo wotu ɖe eme
gravitixDocs.goalMinimal: Minimal — klass aɖeke meli o, domenyinu aɖeke meli o, ɖoɖo aɖeke meli si woasrɔ̃ o
gravitixDocs.whoDesc: Gravitix nye na amesiame si di be yeatu Vortex bot kaba — eɖanye be mèŋlɔ kɔpi kpɔ o, alo ènye dɔwɔla bibi si ti kɔ na Python boilerplate. Numekugbalẽ sia fia Gravitix tso gɔmeɖose gbãtɔwo me: nuteƒekpɔkpɔ aɖeke mehiã do ŋgɔ o.
gravitixDocs.howToReadDesc: Akpa ɖesiaɖe tua esiwo do ŋgɔ ɖo. Ne ènye ame yeye le ɖoɖowɔɖiwo me la, xlẽe tso dzi va anyi. Ne ènya gbe bubu xoxo la, zã emenyawo tsɔ ti kpo yi nusi do dzidzɔ na wò gbɔ tẽ.
gravitixDocs.quickStartDesc: Mɔ si le kabakaba wu tso zero dzi yi bot si le du dzi.
gravitixDocs.whatHappened: Nukae dzɔ teti koe nye ema?
gravitixDocs.whatHappenedDesc: on /start { ... } — ɖea handler si zɔna ne zãla ɖo /start ɖa. emit "..." — ɖoa gbedasi ɖe zãla la ake. {ctx.first_name} — tsɔa zãla ƒe ŋkɔ gbãtɔ dea ka la me.
gravitixDocs.runningDesc: Le Gravitix IDE me la, zi Run ƒe dzesi si le etame ƒe akpaa dzi. Ŋlɔ wò Vortex Bot Token ne wobia tso asiwò. Bot la dzea egɔme enumake — xɔtutu ƒe afɔɖeɖe aɖeke mehiã o.
gravitixDocs.syntaxAtGlance: Nyagɔmeɖegbalẽ ƒe Ðoɖowɔɖi le Kpekpeɖeŋu Me
gravitixDocs.syntaxDesc: Wotu Gravitix ɖoɖowɔɖi ɖesiaɖe tso xɔtunu vevi etɔ̃ me: handlers, emit statements, kple logic.
gravitixDocs.anatomyOfHandler: Amesi tsɔa nu ɖe asi ƒe ŋutilã ƒe wɔwɔme
gravitixDocs.whatGoesAfterEmit: Nusi yia edzi le emit megbe
gravitixDocs.declaringDesc: Zã nya vevi si nye let.
gravitixDocs.explicitTypes: Ƒomevi ƒe nuŋlɔɖi siwo me kɔ
gravitixDocs.typesDesc: Asixɔxɔ ɖesiaɖe si le Gravitix me ƒe ƒomevi aɖe le esi. Type system la le teƒe ɖeka: wokpɔa types le compile time, hafi wò bot nawɔ dɔ.
gravitixDocs.optionalTypes: Ƒomevi siwo woate ŋu atia T?
gravitixDocs.operatorsDesc: Dɔwɔlawo ƒoa asixɔxɔwo nu ƒu tsɔ wɔa asixɔxɔ yeyewo.
gravitixDocs.comparisonOps: Dɔwɔla siwo tsɔa nu sɔna kple wo nɔewo
gravitixDocs.stringsDesc: Ka siwo le Gravitix me nye nuŋɔŋlɔ si woŋlɔ ɖe UTF-8 me. Wodoa alɔ nusiwo wotsɔ dea nyawo me si me kesinɔnuwo le kple dɔwɔwɔ siwo wotu ɖe eme ƒe hatsotso aɖe.
gravitixDocs.stringInterpolation: Ka ƒe nyawo tsɔtsɔ de eme
gravitixDocs.escapeSequences: Sisi ƒe ɖoɖo siwo kplɔ wo nɔewo ɖo
gravitixDocs.multilineStrings: Ka siwo le fli geɖe me
gravitixDocs.ifElifElse: ne / elif / ne menye nenema o
gravitixDocs.matchDesc: Kpɔɖeŋu-tsɔ asixɔxɔ aɖe sɔ kple kpɔɖeŋu geɖe. Bu eŋu be enye switch nyagbɔgblɔ sẽŋu aɖe.
gravitixDocs.functionsDesc: Dɔwɔwɔwo nye kɔpi ƒe ƒuƒoƒo siwo woate ŋu azã ake. Wokpena ɖe ŋuwò nèƒoa asa na nyawo gbugbɔgagblɔ eye wonaa kɔpiwo gɔmesese nɔa bɔbɔe.
gravitixDocs.eventHandlersDesc: Handlers nye Gravitix bot ƒe dzi. Dɔdzikpɔla ɖesiaɖe ɖoa to nudzɔdzɔ ƒomevi aɖe koŋ eye wòƒua du ne nudzɔdzɔ ma dzɔ.
gravitixDocs.guardDesc: Dzɔlawo ɖea mɔ na wò be nàtsɔ nɔnɔme aɖe akpe ɖe asiléla aɖe ŋu. Ne dzɔla la da asɔ be enye nyateƒe ko hafi amesi tsɔa nuawo ƒua du la ƒua du.
gravitixDocs.contextDesc: ctx nu la le eɖokui si le handler ɖesiaɖe me. Nyatakaka siwo ku ɖe gbedasi si li fifia kple ezãla si ɖoe ɖa ŋu le eme.
gravitixDocs.stateDesc: State na wò bot ɖoa ŋku nuwo dzi le gbedasiwo dome. Dukɔ manɔmee la, gbedasi ɖesiaɖe le eɖokui si eye ŋkuɖodzinu aɖeke mele bot la si o.
gravitixDocs.flowsDesc: Sisiwo nana nèŋlɔa dzeɖoɖo siwo me afɔɖeɖe geɖe le le atsyã si le fli me, si woate ŋu axlẽ me. Sisi ate ŋu atɔ vie ahalala zãla ƒe gbedasi si kplɔe ɖo.

gravitixDocs.emitDesc: Gbedasiwo ɖoɖo ɖa nye nu vevitɔ si bot wɔna.
gravitixDocs.emitTo: emit_to — ɖoe ɖe zãla aɖe koŋ
gravitixDocs.schedulingDesc: Ƒu du code le ɖokuiwò si le ɖoɖowɔɖi aɖe dzi — cron dɔ aɖeke meli o, gotagome dɔwɔna aɖeke mehiã o.
gravitixDocs.everyRepeat: ɖesiaɖe — gbugbɔ le dometsotso aɖe dzi
gravitixDocs.atSpecificTime: at — du le ŋkekea ƒe ɣeyiɣi aɖe koŋ dzi
gravitixDocs.pipeDesc: Pipe operator |> tsɔa asixɔxɔ aɖe abe nyaʋiʋli gbãtɔ ene yia dɔwɔwɔ si kplɔe ɖo gbɔ. Enaa woxlẽa kɔsɔkɔsɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo, tso miame yi ɖusime.
gravitixDocs.errorDesc: Gravitix naa vodadawo gbɔ kpɔkpɔ si woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu kple try / catch / finally blocks.
gravitixDocs.structsDesc: Structs na be nàƒo nyatakaka siwo do ƒome kplii nu ƒu ɖe ƒomevi si ŋkɔe nye te. Enums ɖea vovototodedeameme ƒe hatsotso si wotu la gɔme.
gravitixDocs.mathDesc: Gravitix ɖoa akɔntabubu ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe si me nyawo katã le si me dɔwɔwɔ ~180 le.
gravitixDocs.mathConstants: Akɔntabubu ƒe nusiwo nɔa anyi ɖaa

gravitixDocs.calculusDesc: Gravitix lɔ xexlẽdzesiwo ƒe akɔntabubu ɖe eme: derivatives kple integrals siwo wobu ɖe dɔwɔwɔ siwo wodi dzi.

gravitixDocs.linearAlgebraDesc: Linear algebra nye vektor kple matriki ƒe akɔntabubu.
gravitixDocs.numberTheoryDesc: Xexlẽdzesiwo ŋuti nufiafia srɔ̃a nu tso xexlẽdzesi blibowo ƒe nɔnɔmewo ŋu. Egbegbe nya ɣaɣlawo ƒe gɔmeɖoanyi.

bestpractices.p6: Mɔ nyuitɔ si dzi nàto asrɔ̃ Gravitix enye be nàtu. Dze egɔme kple simple echo bot, emegbe nàtsɔ state akpe ɖe eŋu, emegbe nàtsɔ flows akpe ɖe eŋu. Nukpɔsusu yeye ɖesiaɖe si nèsrɔ̃ la ʋua mɔnukpɔkpɔ geɖe ɖi na wò.

bestpractices.h1_b: Implementation overview for "1. Kpɔ nusiwo mènya o gbɔ ɣesiaɣi". The mechanism is implemented in the corresponding module under `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, or `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. The module README calls out exact file paths.
bestpractices.h1_c: The "1. Kpɔ nusiwo mènya o gbɔ ɣesiaɣi" mechanism evolved across Vortex releases. The design traces back to published research and production practices of prior messengers. Version history in `CHANGELOG.md` records when each piece landed and what motivated it.

intro.p1: Gravitix nye gbegbɔgblɔ si ku ɖe domenyinyi tɔxɛ aɖe ŋu (DSL) si wowɔ tso gɔmedzedzea me ke hena Vortex bots ŋɔŋlɔ. Le afisi gbe bubuwo hiã agbalẽdzraɖoƒewo, yɔyɔwo, kple boilerplate le la, Gravitix naa nudzɔdzɔwo dzikpɔla siwo le ɖoƒe gbãtɔ, dzeɖoɖo flows, kple state siwo wotu ɖe eme — wo katã le nyagɔmeɖegbalẽ dzadzɛ, si woate ŋu axlẽ si tso Rust gbɔ me.
intro.p2: Gravitix nye na amesiame si di be yeatu Vortex bot kaba — eɖanye mèŋlɔ kɔpi kpɔ o, alo ènye dɔwɔla bibi si Python boilerplate ti kɔ na wò o. Numekugbalẽ sia fiaa nu Gravitix tso gɔmeɖose gbãtɔwo me: nuteƒekpɔkpɔ aɖeke mehiã do ŋgɔ o.
intro.p3: Akpa ɖesiaɖe tua esiwo do ŋgɔ ɖo. Ne ènye ame yeye le ɖoɖowɔɖiwo me la, xlẽe tso dzi va anyi. Ne ènya gbe bubu xoxo la, zã emenyawo tsɔ ti kpo yi nusi do dzidzɔ na wò gbɔ tẽ.
intro.p4: Le nufiame sia katã me la, → gɔmee nye "da asɔ na" alo "ewɔa", eye // ... fia nya siwo dzi nuƒoƒoƒula ŋe aɖaba ƒu.

math_special.h1: Gamma & dɔ siwo do ƒome kplii
math_special.h7: Elliptic integrals (nu vevi siwo le abe elliptic ene).
math_special.p1: Gamma dɔwɔwɔ Γ(n) nye factorial ƒe generalization si yia edzi: Γ(n) = (n−1)! na xexlẽdzesi blibo nyuiwo. Ekekea xexlẽdzesi siwo nye factorial ɖe enu va ɖoa xexlẽdzesi ŋutɔŋutɔwo kple esiwo gɔme sese sesẽ dzi.
math_special.p2: Vodada ƒe dɔwɔwɔ erf(x) = (2/√π)∫₀ˣ e^(−t2)dt nye Gauss ƒe integral. Edo ƒome tẽ kple CDF si sɔ eye wòdzena le dzoxɔxɔ ƒe sɔsɔ kple nusiwo ate ŋu adzɔ ƒe nufiafia me.
math_special.p3: ζ(wo) = Σ 1/nˢ na n=1,2,3,... (ne Re(wo)>1). Do ƒome kple prime mama to Euler ƒe nuwɔna dzi. Riemann ƒe Nukpɔsusu (si gbɔ womekpɔ o!) ku ɖe ζ ƒe zero siwo le yameʋu si me kɔ la me ŋu.
math_special.p4: Bessel ƒe dɔwɔwɔ Jₙ(x) kple Y3(x) nye Bessel ƒe vovototodedeameme ƒe sɔsɔŋuɖoɖo ƒe egbɔkpɔnuwo: x2y'' + xy' + (x2−n2)y = 0. Wodzena le ƒutsotsoewo ƒe kaka, dzoxɔxɔ ƒe tsɔtsɔ le tsilindowo me, kple quantum mechanics me.
math_special.p5: Ai(x) kple Bi(x) nye y'' = xy ƒe egbɔkpɔnuwo. Wodzena le quantum tunneling (WKB approximation) kple optics (diffraction) me.
math_special.p6: Polynomial ƒome siawo dona abe eigenfunctions of important operators eye wozãa wo le spectral mɔnuwo, quadrature, kple quantum mechanics me.
math_special.p7: K(k) kple E(k) nye elliptic integrals blibo siwo le ƒomevi gbãtɔ kple evelia me. Wobua ɣeyiɣi si pendulum si mele fli me o kple ellipse ƒe gotagome.
math_special.td1: Γ(x) = ∫₀^∞ tˣ−1e−dt. Lanczos ƒe akɔntabubu. Γ(n+1)=n, ʋeʋeʋe!
math_special.td2: ln|Γ(x)|. Avoids wuflow na x gã.
math_special.td5: P3(x): dzogoe si le tsiatrenu le [−1,1] dzi. Haidrodzin ƒe ƒutsotsoewo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe akpa si le dzogoe ene me.
math_special.td6: H3(x): dzogoe si le tsiatrenu w.r.t. e^(−x2) ƒe ŋkɔ. Quantum harmonic ƒe ʋuʋudedi.
math_special.td7: T3 (x) = cos (n·acos (x)): xexlẽdzesi geɖe ƒe tsɔtsɔ sɔ kple wo nɔewo si sɔ nyuie wu.
math_special.td8: L3(x): le dzogoe ene me le [0,∞) dzi w.r.t. e^(−x) ƒe nɔnɔme. Hydrogen radial wavefunctions ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo.

variables.li3: Nu suesuesuewo ƒe vovototo: count kple Count to vovo
variables.li4: Mate ŋu anye nya vevi o: let, fn, on, if...
variables.p1: Trɔtrɔwo dzraa asixɔxɔ siwo nàte ŋu azã ahatrɔ le wò ɖoɖowɔɖi bliboa me ɖo.
variables.p3: Nuƒoƒoƒula la ƒoa nya ta le ƒomevi la ŋu tso asixɔxɔ si le ɖusime. Mehiã gbeɖe be nàŋlɔ ƒomevi la tẽ o — gake àte ŋu ate ŋu.
variables.p4: Tsɔ : TypeName kpe ɖe tɔtrɔ ƒe ŋkɔ ŋu:
variables.p5: Nuŋlɔɖiwo nye tiatia — zã wo ne ƒomevi la medze ƒã tso asixɔxɔa gbɔ o, alo ne èdi be kɔda la nanye self-nuŋlɔɖi.
variables.p6: Trɔtrɔwo nye esiwo woate ŋu atrɔ le gɔmedzedzea me. De asixɔxɔ yeye asi na =:
variables.p8: Trɔtrɔwo li le block { } si me woɖe gbeƒãe le la me.Womedzena le block ma godo o:

architexDocs.title: Architex Gbegbɔgblɔ Ŋuti Nyatakaka
architexDocs.subtitle: Gbegbɔgblɔ si woɖe gbeƒãe UI na Vortex Mini Apps. Reactive nɔnɔme, composable ɖoɖowo, zero tu afɔɖeɖe.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex nye gbeƒãɖeɖe DSL sue aɖe si wowɔ be wòaɖo UI ɖe Vortex dɔla la me. Èɖɔ alesi wòle be screen la nanɔ; runtime la naa pixels nɔa ɖekawɔwɔ me kple nɔnɔme le eɖokui si. Virtual DOM aɖeke meli o, bundler aɖeke meli o, JSX aɖeke meli o — `.arx` faɛl lae nye dɔwɔnua.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Gbeƒãɖeɖe — wòe ŋlɔa UI si nèdi, ke menye afɔɖeɖe siwo nàtsɔ atue o
architexDocs.goalReactive: Reactive — `~count += 1` eye label ɖesiaɖe si xlẽe la wɔa yeye le teƒea
architexDocs.goalPortable: Portable — `.arx` ma ke zɔna le web, iOS, kple Android ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣiwo dzi ɖɔɖɔɖo aɖeke manɔmee
architexDocs.goalTiny: Susu sue — parser + renderer meli le le 30 KB teti me, eyata Mini Apps ʋu enumake
architexDocs.goalReadable: Woate ŋu axlẽe — indentation nye structure; wotsɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ blaa tɔtrɔwɔlawo kple `::`; nuŋɔŋlɔmedzesiwo ƒe adzɔ aɖeke meli o
architexDocs.whoDesc: Ame sia ame si di be yeaɖo interactive screen ɖe Vortex — asisiwo ƒe agbalẽviwo, dashboardwo, akɔdada ƒe axawo, Telegram-style Mini Apps. Ne èŋlɔ HTML+CSS+JS kpɔ la, Architex ase le eɖokui me be yenyae gake eŋɔŋlɔ kabakaba wu. Ne mèkpɔe o la, Architex hã nye ŋgɔdonya fafɛ aɖe na reactive programming elabena gbea nana afɔtoƒea nɔa sue.
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Akpa ɖesiaɖe tua esi do ŋgɔ dzi. Dze egɔme tso Gɔmedzedze Kaba dzi, emegbe nàxlẽ Nyagɔmeɖegbalẽ, Nɔnɔme, Ðoɖo, Trɔtrɔlawo, Nuwɔnawo, eye nàxlẽ akpa si de ŋgɔ la mamlɛtɔ. Ti kpo to emenyawo ƒe kplɔ̃a dzi ne ènya React alo Svelte xoxo — nukpɔsusuawo ƒe nɔnɔmetata dzadzɛ.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: Mɔ kpuitɔ kekeake tso faɛl ƒuƒlu dzi yi Mini App si le du dzi.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@screen Mido gbe nam

  ~ŋkɔ = "xexeame".

  col :: pad(24) dometsotso(12) titina

    tanya "Mido gbe na wò, {~ŋkɔ}!" :: bold ƒe lolome(28)

    nyawo tsɔtsɔ de eme ~ ŋkɔ :: pad (8) radius (6) liƒo (# ccc)

    text "Ŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe etame — nuŋɔŋlɔ sia trɔna ne èle eŋlɔm."
      :: lolome(12) amadede (# 888)
architexDocs.whatHappened: Nukae dzɔ teti koe nye ema?
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Hello` ɖe gbeƒã ke la. `~ŋkɔ = "xexeame"` wɔa tɔtrɔ si wɔa nu. `col`, `tanya`, `nuŋɔŋlɔ`, `nuŋɔŋlɔ` nye akpa siwo wotu ɖe eme. `::` tsɔa tɔtrɔɖenuŋulawo (padding, amadedewo, lolome) kpena ɖe eŋu. Ne zãla ŋlɔ ɖe nyawo me la, `{~ŋkɔ}` ƒe nyawo tsɔtsɔ de eme ɖesiaɖe trɔna — ka aɖeke meli o, nudɔdɔ aɖeke meli o, gɔmeɖeɖe aɖeke meli kple asi o.
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Ʋu Architex tab le Vortex bot studio, tsɔ kɔda la de eme, te Run. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia ɖea egɔme yia ŋgɔdonya ƒe akpaa dzi eye wògbugbɔa agba dzodzoe le save dzi. Ne ètae la, wò zãlawo ʋua dɔwɔnua tso dzeɖoɖo ɖesiaɖe me — womeɖoa dɔwɔnua ɖe eme o.
architexDocs.syntaxAtGlance: Nyagɔmeɖegbalẽ ƒe Ðoɖowɔɖi le Kpekpeɖeŋu Me
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Architex ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi ɖesiaɖe nye nu ene: gbeƒãɖeɖe siwo dzea egɔme kple `@`, reactive variables siwo wotsɔ `~` do ŋgɔ, akpa siwo woŋlɔ abe bare identifiers ene, kple modifiers siwo kpe ɖe `::` megbe.
architexDocs.anatomyDecl: Gbeƒãɖeɖe aɖe ƒe ŋutilã ƒe wɔwɔme
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: `@screen Name`, `@theme`, `@import "./lib.arx"`, kple `@for item in ~list` katã dze egɔme tso kɔlam 0. Nusianu si woŋlɔ ɖe wo te la nye block ma tɔ.
architexDocs.anatomyComp: Akpa aɖe ƒe ŋutilã ƒe wɔwɔme
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Kpeɖodzinuwo bɔbɔ nɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe fli dzi: `nuŋɔŋlɔ`, `bɔt`, `nɔnɔmetata`, `tanya`, `dzesi`, `kɔtagbalẽvi`, `mamãla`, `col`, `fli`. Woƒe nɔƒe ŋuti nyaʋiʋli va le ŋkɔa megbe tututu: `text ~message`, `button "Save"`, `image "/logo.png"`.
architexDocs.anatomyModifier: Kɔsɔkɔsɔ si trɔa asi le nu ŋu ƒe ŋutilã ƒe wɔwɔme
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: Le `::` megbe la, àteŋu atsɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ aɖo tɔtrɔɖenu geɖe alesi nèdi. Wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe xɔa nyaʋiʋli zero alo esi wu nenema le fli me: `:: pad(24) gap(16) titina bold size(20) color(#4f8ef7)`. Trɔtrɔlawo nye ɖoƒe, menye nya vevi o — ɖoɖo mehiã o negbe esiwo nye mamlɛtɔ-nuŋlɔla-ɖu dzi abe `amadede` ene.
architexDocs.anatomyAction: Nuwɔna aɖe ƒe ŋutilã ƒe wɔwɔme
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: `=>` le abɔta (alo nuwɔwɔ ƒe akpa ɖesiaɖe) dzi wɔa dɔdasi alo dɔwɔwɔ yɔyɔ si kplɔe ɖo. Geɖe `=>` kɔsɔkɔsɔ axa-ɖe-axa: `bɔt "Ðe ɖa" => ~ vovomanɔameŋu = nyateƒe => ɖo (nuwɔna: "dzra", nyatakaka: ~ nɔnɔme)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Ŋkɔ ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ `~` ɖo ŋgɔe nye lãmenugbagbevi si wɔa dɔ. Ŋlɔ `~xexlẽme = 0` be nàɖe gbeƒãe, `~xexlẽme = 5` be nàgbugbɔ ade dɔ asi na ame, `~xexlẽme += 1` be nàwɔ yeyee. UI node ɖesiaɖe si xlẽa lãmenugbagbevi la — tẽ alo to interpolation dzi — gbugbɔna ne lãmenugbagbevi la trɔ.
architexDocs.computedVars: Trɔtrɔ siwo ŋu wobu akɔnta le
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Zã `:=` ɖe `=` teƒe tsɔ ɖe gbeƒã akɔntabubu nyagbɔgblɔ: `~total := ~count * ~step`. Nuɖusi ƒe akpaa gbugbɔa ŋku léna ɖe eŋu ɣesiaɣi si nusiwo dzi woanɔ te ɖo ɖesiaɖe trɔ. Asi ƒe nudɔdɔ aɖeke meli o eye stale-value bug aɖeke meli o — ne èxlẽ `~a` le nyagbɔgblɔa ƒe teƒe aɖe la, ànɔ te ɖe edzi le ɖokuiwò si.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Numeɖeɖewo nye tiatia gake kpena ɖe ame ŋu le ɖokuitɔdidi kple vodada ƒe gbedasiwo me: `~xexlẽme: xexlẽdzesi = 0`, `~ŋkɔ: ka = ""`, `~ok: boolean = alakpa`, `~nuwo: ƒuƒoƒo = []`, `~zãla: nu = {}`. Ne èdzo le wo dzi la, woƒoa nya ta be ƒomevi la tso gɔmedzedzea gbɔ.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: `xexlẽdzesi`, `ka`, `boolean`, `ɖoɖo`, `nu`, `null`. Wotoa ŋkekewo kple blobwo me abe ka kple nuwo ene. Duƒuƒu ƒe ɣeyiɣia zãa JavaScript ƒe dzizizi sewo le ʋuƒoa te, eyata `~xexlẽme + 1` wɔa dɔ ne `~xexlẽdzesi` dze agbe gɔme abe ka ene gɔ̃ hã.
architexDocs.stringInterpolation: Ka ƒe nyawo tsɔtsɔ de eme
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Ka ɖesiaɖe ateŋu atsɔ nyagbɔgblɔwo ade eme kple `{...}`: `"Hello, {~user.name}!"`, `"Total: {~count * ~price}"`. Interpolation nye nusi wɔa nu ɣesiaɣi.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Nugoe eve siwo woate ŋu aƒo ƒu kple aŋgba ƒe akpa wuieve le Architex si. Nest wo kple indentation — no closing tags.
architexDocs.containersDesc: `col` ƒoa ɖeviwo nu ƒu ɖe tsitrenu, `row` le tsia dzi. Wo ame evea siaa xɔa `gap(n)`, `pad(n)`, `center`, `grow`, kple kekeme/kɔkɔme ƒe tɔtrɔ. Indent ɖeviwo dzidzenu ɖeka goglo wu be woawɔ atɔ.
architexDocs.containerExample:
fli :: dometsotso(8) pad(16) titina
  nɔnɔmetata "/avatar.png" :: w (40) h (40) ƒe didime (20)
  col :: tsi dometsotso(2) .
    nuŋɔŋlɔ ~ŋkɔ :: nuŋɔŋlɔ dzẽ
    nuŋɔŋlɔ ~ bio :: lolome (12) amadede (# 888)
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: `text` — ŋutilã ƒe kɔpi ɖesiaɖe. `ta` — le gɔmesese nu la, tanya. `label` — nuŋɔŋlɔ sue si woŋlɔ ɖe edzi. `button` — tap-ate ŋu akpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe edzi. `input` — nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe agble si wobla ɖe reactive var. `nɔnɔmetata` — nɔnɔmetata tso URL aɖe me. `badge` — dzesi si le abe atikekui ene. `mamãla` — fli tsɛ si ma nu. `toast` — ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe numeɖenudzraƒe. `tabs` / `tab` — tab ƒe tɔtrɔ.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: `text "Hello"` ɖea ka si meʋãna o gɔme. `text ~message` wɔa nusi wɔa nu ɖe ​​ame ŋu. Tsɔe ƒo ƒu kple nyawo tsɔtsɔ de eme: `text "Total: {~count}"`.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Tanya ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ. Defaults na lolo, bold wu `text`. Teƒe ƒe nyaʋiʋli ma ke: `tanya "Nɔnɔmewo"`. Agbɔsɔsɔme dzidzenuwo kple screen — tsɔ `lolome (n)` ɖɔ li.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Tap-ate ŋu ƒe akpa aɖe. Teƒe ƒe ka lae nye dzesideŋkɔa; `=>` nuwɔna la zɔna le tap dzi. `button "Dzra ɖo" => ~draft = null`. Dzo `=>` geɖe le ɖoɖo nu.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe akpa si wobla ɖe mɔ eve nu. Reactive variable si le ŋkɔa megbe la léa asixɔxɔ si li fifia: `input ~email`. Trɔlawo: `teƒe("...")`, `debounce (300)` na throttled yeyewɔwɔwo.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Agbawo tso HTTPS URL alo `/uploads/...` mɔ dzi. Trɔtrɔlawo `w (px)`, `h (px)`, `radius (px)` lã aɖaka la. Edze anyi trɔ yi teƒenɔƒe ƒe nɔnɔmetata ne URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Hairline separator, 1px, dea bubu tanya ƒe amadede si li fifia ŋu. Nyaʋiʋli aɖeke meli o.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Atikekui si kpla asi kɔ na eƒe emenyawo: `badge ~count`, `badge "yeye"`. Zãe na xexlẽdzesi siwo womexlẽ o kple tag chips.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Caption/helper text — wotsɔ nukpɔkpɔ bɔbɔ ɖe anyi. Good na agbalẽvi ƒe agble ŋkɔwo.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Nyatakaka si mexe mɔ ɖe enu o. `toast ~visible "Woɖee ɖa!" :: duration(2000)` ɖee fia hena s 2 ɣesiaɣi si `~visible` nye nyateƒe, emegbe auto-dismisses. Modal stacking aɖeke meli o, z-index aʋawɔwɔ aɖeke meli o.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Tab nugoe si wobla ɖe ka si wɔa nu ŋu: `tabs ~activeTab`. Le eme la, `tab "Label" "key"` ɖesiaɖe ɖea gbeƒã tab ɖeka; woɖea ŋutilã si wotsɔ de ete la fiana ne safuia sɔ.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Modifiers koe nye mɔ si dzi woato awɔ akpa aɖe ƒe atsyã. Kɔsɔkɔsɔ wo le `::` megbe. Wole ƒome atɔ̃ me: dometsotso, lolome, amadede, agbalẽtata, kple nuwɔna.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` — nutsyɔnu le axawo katã dzi. `pad(x, y)` — le tsia dzi + tsitrenu. `pad(tame, ɖusime, ete, miame)` — CSS-ɖoɖo. `gap(n)` — teƒe si le viwo dome le `col` / `row` me. `margin(n)` — gotagome dometsotso tso nɔviwo gbɔ.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w(px)` — kekeme si woɖo ɖi. `h(px)` — kɔkɔme si woɖo ɖi. `grow` — yɔ teƒe si susɔ ɖe fli/col. `titina` — titina le atitsoga ƒe axadzi; le `col` me la, eƒe titina le tsia dzi, le `fli` me la, eƒe titina le tsitrenu.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `amadede (# rrggbb)` — ŋgɔgbe. `bg (# rrggbb)` — megbenyawo. Wo ame evea siaa xɔa tanya ƒe dzesiwo: `color(~primary)` xlẽa tso `@theme` block si li fifia me. Opacity toa xexlẽdzesi 8 ƒe hex me: `#00000080` nye 50 %% yevu.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `size(px)` — ŋɔŋlɔdzesi ƒe lolome. `bold` / `italic` — kpekpeme kple atsyã. `align(miame|titina|ɖusime)` — nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `hidden(~flag)` — ɖea node la ɖa ne aflaga la nye nyateƒe. `si wokpɔna (~ aflaga)` — inverse. Node siwo womeɖo o la ƒua woƒe DOM, eyata nɔnɔme UI ƒe asi bɔbɔ.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: `debounce (ms)` le `input` throttles ƒe yeyewo. `placeholder("...")` fia aɖaŋuɖoɖo ƒe ka. `format(ƒomevi, arg)` le `nuŋɔŋlɔ` dzi ɖoa xexlẽdzesi aɖe: `format("ga", "USD")`, `format("alafa memamã")`, `format("compact")`.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: `radius(px)` ƒoa xlã dzogoewo. `border(#rrggbb)` ta 1 px ƒe ʋuʋudedi. `border(px, #rrggbb)` ɖoa titrime hã.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Nuwɔnawo trɔa nɔnɔme alo ƒoa nu kple gotagome xexeame. Woƒua du ɖekae le tap/keypress handler la me.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~xexlẽme = 0`, `=> ~ vovomanɔameŋu = nyateƒe`, `=> ~ŋlɔɖi = []`. Reactive variable ɖesiaɖe nye nusi woateŋu aŋlɔ.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. `=> ~xexlẽme += 1` nye nyagbɔgblɔ na xexlẽdzesiwo.
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: `=>` geɖe le fli ɖeka dzi doa dzo tso dzi va anyi le tick ɖeka me, eyata UI la trɔa asi le eŋu zi ɖeka le nuwuwu: `button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false`. Le async dɔwɔwɔ gome la, lɔ̃ akɔntabubu `@reaction`.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `send(action: "name", ...args)` nye tɔdzisasrã si trɔ yi bot la gbɔ. Host (Vortex runtime) xɔae abe JSON RPC gbedasi ene eye ateŋu ayɔ wò bot ƒe code. Zãe na gege ɖe eme, API xɔ, fexexe — nusianu si DSL ŋutɔ mateŋu aɖe afia o.
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto ("ScreenName", arg: asixɔxɔ, ...)` tu `@screen` bubu ɖe stack la dzi; `megbe ()` dzena. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia naa agbe le gɔmedzedzea me.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `copy(~text)`, `share(~text)`, `haptic("light" | "medium" | "heavy")`, `vibrate(ms)`, `alert("...")`, `confirm("...") => ~ok = it` — `it` kpukpui la nye nyagbɔgblɔ si do ŋgɔ ƒe tɔtrɔgbɔ ƒe asixɔxɔ.
architexDocs.themeDesc: Ðe gbeƒã palette zi ɖeka, gbugbɔ zãe le afisiafi. Tokens zua edziedzi reactive variables ale be wò app ateŋu aɖo viviti-mode toggle ɖe fli etɔ̃ me.
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"` he `@component` kple `@screen` ɖesiaɖe tso faɛl ma me yi ɖe kekeme si li fifia me. Mɔwo le ƒomedodo me kple faɛl si tsɔe vɛ; wokpɔa nusiwo wotsɔ tso duta vɛ le gotagome eye wogblɔa wo le parse ɣeyiɣi me.
architexDocs.components: @component — akpa siwo wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu
architexDocs.componentsDesc: Ðe egɔme zi ɖeka, zãe zi geɖe: `@component Avatar url ƒe lolome\n nɔnɔmetata url :: w(lolome) h(lolome) radius(lolome / 2)`. Le akpa ƒe ŋutilã me la, nɔnɔmetata siwo ŋkɔ woyɔ la le kekeme me abe dzesidenu gbadzawo ene (`~` manɔmee).
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@for item le ~list` ɖea fli ɖeka ɖe element ɖesiaɖe me. `@for item, idx le ~list` hã blaa zero-si wotu ɖe index dzi. Duƒuƒu ƒe ɣeyiɣia léa ŋku ɖe dzesidede ame ŋu to element la ŋutɔ dzi, eyata nusiwo tsɔtsɔ kpe ɖe fli 10 000 ƒe xexlẽdzesi ƒe tame bia O(1) DOM dɔwɔwɔ.
architexDocs.forExample:
@na nusi, idx le ~nuawo me
  fli :: dometsotso(8) pad(4) .
    akɔtagbalẽvi ~idx
    text ~item :: tsi
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: `cond ? a : b` wɔa dɔ le afisiafi si woxɔ nyagbɔgblɔ aɖe le. Atɔ na enums: `~nɔnɔme >= 10 ? "kɔkɔ" : ~nɔnɔme >= 5 ? "mid" : "bɔbɔe"`.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: Le akpa aɖe ƒe gbeƒãɖeɖe me la, `slot` dea dzesi afisi yɔla ƒe ŋutilã gena ɖo.Bu eŋu be enye React children / Vue default slot.
architexDocs.reactivity: Alesi nuwɔna ƒe dɔwɔwɔ wɔa dɔe
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: `~var` ɖesiaɖe nye dzesi. Ne èxlẽe le akɔntabubu, tɔtrɔɖenuŋunyaʋiʋli, alo nusiwo wotsɔ de eme me la, dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia dea dzesi nuxexlẽa le fifi nusiwo dzi woanɔ te ɖo ƒe nɔnɔmetata me. Ne èle nu ŋlɔm la, node ɖesiaɖe si xlẽe la, wogbugbɔ léa ŋku ɖe eŋu — zi ɖeka, le microtask si li fifia ƒe nuwuwu.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Woƒoa nuŋɔŋlɔ geɖe nu ƒu le handler ɖeka me. `=> ~a = 1 => ~b = 2` ʋãa render pass ɖeka pɛpɛpɛ.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Le gɔmedzedzea me la, duƒuƒu ƒe ɣeyiɣia zãa tasɔsɔ sesẽ (`===`). Asixɔxɔ ma ke ŋɔŋlɔ megawɔa naneke o. To nu/array yeye aɖe me be nàzi asitɔtrɔ dzi; wodea tɔtrɔmanɔmanɔ ƒe dzi ƒo gake womebiae o.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Canonical app ene, ɖesiaɖe le eɖokui si eye wòle fli 40 te. Kɔpi wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ɖe Architex tab la me eye nàzi Run dzi.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Xexlẽdzesi — reactive nɔnɔme, akɔntabubu, button handlers, nuŋɔŋlɔ babla.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo — ŋlɔ gɔmeɖeɖe, tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu / ɖee ɖa, inline editing.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Profile — nɔnɔmetata, akɔtagbalẽviwo, nɔnɔme ƒe dzedzeme, mɔzɔzɔ.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Killer features — tanyawo, imports, tabs, toasts, xexlẽdzesi siwo woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu, ternaries, typed vars.
architexDocs.errors: Vodada siwo bɔ kple nusi woawɔ
architexDocs.errUnknownName: `ŋkɔ si womenya o ~foo` — èzã reactive variable hafi ɖe gbeƒãe. Tsɔ `~foo = ...` kpe ɖe `@screen` si ƒo xlãe la tame.
architexDocs.errIndent: `unexpected indent` — ele be ɖeviwo nade to ɖe dzidzenu ɖeka nu wu wo dzila. Architex zãa teƒe eve pɛpɛpɛ le dzisasrã ɖesiaɖe dzi; wogbea tabwo be woaƒo asa na invisible-whitespace ƒe vodadawo.
architexDocs.errModifier: `unknown modifier` — èŋlɔ `:: vɔvɔli` gake dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia medo alɔe o. Kpɔ modifier ƒe xexlẽdzesi si le etame ɖa; Architex wɔa nu kpata le ŋkɔ siwo womenya o ŋu be yeatsɔ akpɔ ŋgɔgbe ƒe sɔsɔ ta.
architexDocs.errType: `ƒomevi ƒe masɔmasɔ` — e.g. èto ka aɖe si me wokpɔ mɔ na xexlẽdzesi aɖe le. Annotate reactive variable (`~count: number`) eye parser la agblɔ afisi asixɔxɔ gbegblẽa dzɔ tso na wò.
architexDocs.errDebug: Be nàɖɔ vodadawo ɖo le dɔwɔwɔɣi la, xatsa nyagbɔgblɔ si ŋu wole ɖi kem le la ɖe `debug(...)` me — dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia ŋlɔa dodokpɔ ɖesiaɖe ɖe console la me evɔ mekpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe asixɔxɔa dzi o.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Web — ewɔa vanilla DOM kple CSS tɔtrɔwo na tanya ƒe dzesiwo. React / Vue / Svelte ƒe ŋuɖoɖo ɖe ame ŋu aɖeke meli o.
architexDocs.compatIOS: iOS — woɖe `.arx` ma ke me eye woɖee fia ɖe SwiftUI ƒe nukpɔkpɔwo me to Vortex iOS host dzi. Trɔla ɖesiaɖe wɔa anyigbatata ɖe SwiftUI ƒe atsyã nu.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android — amedzroxɔla la ɖea egɔme ɖe Jetpack Compose me. Asiwɔwɔ ɖe nya dzi ƒe tɔtrɔwo (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) ɖea egɔme be Compose sɔsɔewo.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Version policy — Architex ka ɖe megbe be woawɔ ɖeka na `.arx` faɛlwo le tɔtrɔ suewo me. `.arx` faɛl si woŋlɔ ɖe 0.1 ŋu gakpɔtɔ le dɔ wɔm le 0.9 dzi.
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Xlẽ nuɖagbalẽa hena kpɔɖeŋuwo (ŋlɔɖi siwo seɖoƒe meli na o, agbalẽviwo, fexexe), dɔwɔnuwo ŋuti mɔfiame na CLI kple VS Code plugin, kple nudzɔdzɔ ƒe mɔfiame ne èdi be yeatsɔ akpa aɖe si wotu ɖe eme akpe ɖe eŋu. Dzɔtsoƒe bliboa le github.com/vortex/Architex.

meta.title: Vortex Nufiame
meta.subtitle: Vortex ƒe subsystem ɖesiaɖe le teƒe ɖeka.
meta.intro: Nya sia si ŋu woƒo nu tsoe la de blibo le alesi wowɔe nu. Dze egɔme tso afisiafi — ta ɖesiaɖe nye esi le eɖokui si. Nya ɖesiaɖe doa ka kple dzɔtsoƒemɔwo ne esɔ. Woyɔa nusianu si metrɔna o tẽ.
meta.howToUse: Emenyawo ƒe kplɔ̃ si le miame la sɔ kple ta siwo le afisia. Zi ta aɖe dzi be nàti kpo ayi edzi; tanya suewo kple xexlẽdzesi siwo nàte ŋu awɔ scan le sɛkɛnd 30 me hafi aƒu tsi le ta ɖesiaɖe me.
meta.updatedBy: Wowɔe tso `ŋɔŋlɔwo/build_vortex_docs_v2.py` me. Gbugbɔ tu kple `python3 ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo/build_vortex_docs_v2.py`.

architecture.title: Xɔtuɖaŋu ŋuti nyatakaka kpui aɖe
architecture.subtitle: Dɔwɔwɔ etɔ̃ — client, node, controller — kple protocol ɖeka si blaa wo.
architecture.intro: Vortex nye dɔla si woɖe ɖe vovo. Le esi teƒe be wòanye megbe-nu ɖeka si nye dɔwɔƒe ɖeka tɔ la, ewɔa ɖeka kple **nodes** siwo le wo ɖokui si ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si le ʋuʋu ɖi, si ŋu **dziɖula** si le sue si taa kɔda si dzi wòɖo kpee ƒe manifest si wode asi ete lae ke ɖe eŋu eye wòɖo kpe edzi. **Asitsalawo** léa ame ŋutɔ ƒe safuiwo katã ɖe asi eye woɖea UI. Ta sia ƒe akpa mamlɛa zɔa nuwɔna etɔ̃awo, woƒe liƒowo, kple nyatakaka siwo sina le wo dome.
architecture.h1p1: Dɔla siwo woɖo ɖe teƒe ɖeka nye amedzizizi ƒe nya ɖeka ko. Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe ƒe sedede, alilikpo-nana ƒe nutsotso, alo fuléle ƒe asixɔxɔ katã gɔmeɖeɖe be "zãlawo bu mɔɖeɖe". Vortex ɖea asi le ema ŋu to mɔɖeɖe na ame sia ame be wòawɔ node eye wònana asisiwo naʋu le nodewo dome evɔ womagaŋlɔ ŋkɔ ake o.
architecture.h1p2: Ele be dziɖuɖua nakpɔ nya ɣaɣlawo kple fɔmaɖimaɖi ta. Ne server siwo dzi womeka ɖo o ƒe habɔbɔ wɔa dɔ ne serverawo mete ŋu xlẽa nuŋɔŋlɔ dzrowo o eye womete ŋu wɔa aʋatso gbedasiwo o ko. Vortex zia edzi to nuwuwu vaseɖe nuwuwu ƒe nya ɣaɣlawo kple Ed25519 ɖaseɖiɖiwo dzi le cross-node gbedasi ɖesiaɖe dzi.
architecture.h1p3: Dzɔla lae nye ɖeka centralised-ish piece, gake ele sue ŋutɔ. `INTEGRITY.sig.json` kple gegeɖeƒe siwo dzi woka ɖo ƒe xexlẽdzesi koe wòtaa. Ame sia ame ateŋu awɔ ahuhɔ̃e ƒe amedzro, eyata dziɖula gɔ̃ hã menye kpododonu ƒe teƒe ɖeka pɛ ko o — nyateƒetsoƒe ɖeka koe na "si pubkey dea asi dziɖuɖu ƒe asiɖeɖe le eŋu".
architecture.h1l1: No vendor lock-in: asisiwo ateŋu aʋu woƒe dzeside le nodes dome ɣesiaɣi to asidede X25519 pubkey la te kple JWT yeye me.
architecture.h1l2: No outage correlation: ne node ɖeka ɖiɖi la, zãla siwo le node bubuwo dzi medea dzesii o.
architecture.h1l3: Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe ɖeka aɖeke meli o: dɔwɔƒewo tiaa woƒe aƒe si le se nu, eye ezãlawo tiaa woƒe dɔwɔƒe.
architecture.h1l4: UI ɖeka aɖeke meli o: iOS, Android, web nye hati gbãtɔwo — mɔ̃ aɖeke meli si nye agbalẽ xatsaxatsa tsɛ aɖe ɖe bubu dzi o.
architecture.h2: Ame si ŋu wole dɔ wɔm le
architecture.h2p1: Asitsalawo wɔa dɔ le zãla aɖe ƒe mɔ̃ dzi. Ema koe nye teƒe si gbedasi siwo woŋlɔna tẽ, ame ŋutɔ ƒe safuiwo, kple faɛl siwo me kɔ la nɔa agbe le. Node la mekpɔa wo gbeɖe o.
architecture.h2p2: Nuƒolanɔƒe ɖesiaɖe si wodo alɔe la wɔa ka ƒe ɖoɖo ɖeka mawo ke ŋudɔ (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC). SOLID-ma nɔnɔme modules (`api/` ɖoɖowɔɖiwo, `impl/` kɔda, `ui/` nukpɔkpɔwo) naa nubabla la le sesẽm eye platform-koŋ ƒe kɔda nɔa teƒe ɖeka.
architecture.h2p3: Nudzraɖoƒe le mɔ̃a dzi: Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences / HttpOnly cookie na dzesiwo; SQLite (GRDB le iOS, Xɔ le Android, IndexedDB wrapper le web) na cached ciphertext + FTS index la.
architecture.h2l1: iOS — Swift Package kple 30+ nɔnɔme modules. Min dɔwɔwɔ taɖodzinu iOS 17.
architecture.h2l2: Android — Kotlin + Kpa + Kpekpeɖeŋunana. minSdk 26, taɖodzinuSdk 34.
architecture.h2l3: Web — vanilla JS PWA, subɔsubɔdɔwɔla, xɔtutu ƒe afɔɖeɖe aɖeke megbɔ ES module bundling ŋu o.
architecture.h2l4: Desktop — Tauri ƒe agbalẽ xatsaxatsa ƒo xlã web client; bundle ma ke, Chrome gɔmeɖela gbãtɔ.
architecture.h3p1: Node nye Python dɔwɔwɔ (`python -m app.main`, alo `run.py` si woƒo ƒu) si le to ɖom le 9000 dzi le gɔmedzedzea me. Enɔa ciphertext dzi, elɔ̃a WebSocket nudzɔdzɔwo, eléa TURN ɖaseɖigbalẽwo ɖe asi, eye wòdzraa federation kple node bubuwo.
architecture.h3p2: Eɖoe koŋ na node layer la le sue. Eɖea mɔ siwo ade 120 ɖe go to `/api/*` ati la dzi kpe ɖe `/ws` ŋu hena ɣeyiɣi ŋutɔŋutɔ me fan-out. Wotsɔa nu kpekpea kɔklɔ (crypto, anyinɔnɔ, ɖoɖowɔɖi) dea `app/dedienɔnɔ/`, `app/ʋuɖoɖo/`, `app/hati/` me.
architecture.h3p3: Node ɖeka le SQLite nɔnɔme gbãtɔ me kpɔa ~50 zãla siwo le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me gbɔ bɔbɔe le M1 dzi. Ne Postgres kple Redis wɔ dɔ la, kɔda ɖeka ma ke dzidzena le tsia dzi — node ɖesiaɖe zua nɔnɔmemanɔsitɔ to DB kple fan-out ŋu.
architecture.h3l1: Teƒewo: `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/integrity` kple `/health` hena agbe nɔnɔ.
architecture.h3l2: Nusiwo dzi woanɔ te ɖo: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, nya ɣaɣlawo (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-nu geɖe, Pillow, Rust kekeɖenudɔ `vortex_chat` na hot-mɔ dzi nya ɣaɣlawo.
architecture.h3l3: Tiatia: Redis (anyinɔnɔ fan-out le node geɖe), Postgres (ewɔwɔ DB), coturn (TURN relay), fluent-bit (log meliɖoɖo).
architecture.h3l4: Binary ƒe lolome: ~60 MB Python deps + ~10 MB Rust kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔ. Docker nɔnɔmetata abe 400 MB hafi squash.
architecture.h4p1: Dzɔla la nye Python dɔwɔwɔ si le eɖokui si (`vortex_controller`) si ƒe taɖodzinu le kpuie: ata `INTEGRITY.sig.json` eye wòaɖo kpe edzi, ɖe URL siwo woŋlɔ ɖe eme la ɖe go, eye nàlé ŋku ɖe hati siwo wɔ ɖeka ƒe lãmesẽ ŋu.
architecture.h4p2: Le gɔmedzedzea me la, dziɖula la zɔa dzɔtsoƒeti la, ewɔa hash na faɛl ɖesiaɖe, eye wòtsɔa esɔ kple manifest la. Ne hash aɖe mesɔ o la, dziɖula la gbe be yemadze egɔme o. Esia fia be disk dzi faɛl si wotrɔ asi le mateŋu asubɔ `status:"verified"` o.
architecture.h4p3: Asitsalawo ƒoa `/v1/integrity` hafi ka ɖe node aɖe dzi. Ne wokpɔ `nɔnɔme != "woɖo kpe edzi"` la, wogbea be yewomatsɔ ɖaseɖigbalẽwo ade asi na ame o, ɣeyiɣi. Emae nye kakaɖedzi ƒe seke.
architecture.h4l1: Wode asi ete kple `safuiwo/release.key` (Ed25519). Dutoƒo afã ɖa ɖe asisiwo ƒe asiɖeɖe le wo ŋu.
architecture.h4l2: Manifest entries: `{path, sha256, size}` na faɛl ɖesiaɖe si wometsɔ gitignored o.
architecture.h4l3: Gbugbɔ tu: `python -m vortex_dziɖula.integrity.dzesi_dɔwɔnu`. Eɖea `INTEGRITY.sig.json` ɖa le repo ke me.
architecture.h4l4: Trɔtrɔ: dɔwɔlawo forking Vortex ɖɔlia `release.key`. Azɔ asisi siwo woɖo kple woƒe pubkey la ka ɖe fork ma dzi.
architecture.h5p1: Zɔ to nusi dzɔna ne Alice ɖo "hi" ɖe Bob me:
architecture.h5p2: 1. Asitsalawo dia xɔa ƒe ke ƒe safui le eƒe nutoa me fiase me. Ne meli o la, exɔa agbalẽkotoku yeye tso `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` me na eya ŋutɔ ƒe pubkey. DM siwo va zi gbãtɔ la ƒua du Diffie-Hellman si ƒoa xlãe zi ɖeka le prekeys dzi.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node dzraa fli la ɖo eye wòƒoa nu tso `{type:"m", xɔ:..., msg:{id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at}}` na WebSocket ɖesiaɖe si do ƒome si ŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe xɔa me.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Bob ƒe asisi xɔa frame la, tsɔa ke ƒe safui ma ke ɖea nyawo me, ɖoa kpe edzi be sender pseudo sɔ kple hamevinyenye si wokpɔ mɔ na, ​​eye wòwɔa bubble la.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Bob ƒe asisi ŋlɔa `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` kple gbedasi mamlɛtɔ si woxlẽ ƒe id. Ema ʋãa `{type:"r"}` ƒe gbeƒãɖeɖe ale be Alice ƒe bubble ɖea tick fiana.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) nye nya sesẽ, eve, eye wòte ŋu ŋlɔa nu kabakaba. Ne wotsɔe sɔ kple JSON la, eɖea payload ƒe lolome dzi kpɔtɔna ~30 % le chat ciphertext si bɔ me eye wòɖea whitespace ambiguity ɖa.
architecture.h6p2: Ne wotsɔe sɔ kple Protobuf la, mehiã schema generator o eye metsɔa agble xexlẽdzesiwo tsia tsikpe me o. Ema le vevie elabena Vortex trɔna — míetsɔ `thread_id`, `reply_to`, `reactions_count`, `kind` kpe ɖe asiɖeɖe le wo ŋu dzi evɔ míegbã asisi xoxowo o.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR hã nye nusi Signal, Matrix, kple NIP-29 zãna le susu siwo ɖi wo nɔewo ŋutɔ ta. Woƒe tiatia ƒe sɔsɔ fia be míaƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia ƒe agbalẽdzikpɔkpɔ le bɔbɔe wu na dedienɔnɔ ŋuti numekula siwo nya encoding la xoxo.
architecture.h7p1: Frame ɖesiaɖe tsɔa `v:<int>`. Fifia ƒe tɔtrɔe nye 1. Woɖea frame si ƒe tɔtrɔ womenya o la ɖa; asisiwo ŋlɔa nuxlɔ̃ame aɖe ɖi eye woyia edzi kple nɔnɔmetata si kplɔe ɖo.
architecture.h7p2: Woka ɖe megbe ƒe sɔsɔ dzi na xɔtunu ɖesiaɖe si gakpɔtɔ tsɔ `v:1`. Do ŋgɔ ƒe ɖekawɔwɔ nye agbagbadzedze nyuitɔ kekeake: wotsɔa agble yeyewo kpena ɖe dict la ƒe nuwuwu, asisi xoxowo ŋea aɖaba ƒua wo dzi.
architecture.h7p3: Wodzra gbagbã sesẽ ɖo na tɔtrɔ siwo le vevie na dedienɔnɔ (e.g. HKDF nya siwo ƒo xlãe ƒe kawo ɖɔliɖɔli). Le nɔnɔme mawo me la, version la bumps to 2 eye wotaa migration window.
architecture.h1_a: Vortex network la ma ɖe ɖoɖo etɔ̃ me. Wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe zɔna le eɖokui si, eƒoa nu kple bubuawo to ka ƒe ɖoɖo siwo me kɔ nyuie dzi, eye woate ŋu aɖɔlii le wo ɖokui si. Monolith aɖeke meli o — nɔnɔme ɖesiaɖe ƒoa ka ɖe akpa etɔ̃awo dometɔ ɖeka me.
architecture.h1_b: Asisi aɖe léa safuiwo ɖe asi eye wòwɔa UI. Node aɖe nɔa ciphertext dzi, fans out nudzɔdzɔwo le WebSocket dzi, eye brokers WebRTC signalling. Dzɔla aɖe taa manifest kple entry URL siwo wode asi ete. Woɖoa dze to HTTPS + WebSocket dzi to CBOR-encoded payloads zazã me le AES-GCM envelopes me.
architecture.h1_c: Woto mamaa vɛ le v0.0.3 me le esi monolith ƒe tɔtrɔ gbãtɔa do go kuxi eve vɔ megbe: wobla asiɖeɖe le eŋu ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ɖe node si le du dzi ŋu (ale node si ŋu wogblẽ nu le ateŋu ada alakpa le eya ŋutɔ ƒe kɔda ŋu), eye federation manya wɔ o elabena node ƒe nɔnɔme kple kakaɖedzi ƒe nɔnɔme nɔa kplɔ̃ ɖeka dzi. Mamã ɖaseɖiɖi ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe ɖoɖo me na dɔwɔla ɖesiaɖe pubkey ɖeka be pin eye na míadzidze federation ɖe arbitrary N.
architecture.h1_f:
asisi --HTTPS/WSS--> node
  ^ |
  |                        v
  +------/v1/integrity-- dziɖula (wode asi manifest te)
architecture.h2_a: Node/controller ƒe mama ɖea asinudɔwɔwɔ si ŋu dedienɔnɔ le wu (manifest si wode asi ete) ɖe vovo tso amedzidzedze ƒe anyigba gãtɔ kekeake (API server) gbɔ.
architecture.h2_b: Controller dzraa SQLite DB sue aɖe ɖo: pubkey siwo dzi woka ɖo, ahuhɔ̃e URLwo, kple lãmesẽ ƒe dzesiwo. Egbe be yemadze egɔme ne INTEGRITY.sig.json mesɔ kple ati si le disk dzi o — faɛl si wotrɔ asi le mateŋu asubɔ `nɔnɔme:"woɖo kpe edzi"` gbeɖe o. Node la zɔna ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe Postgres/SQLite dzi eye meléa asiɖeɖe le safuia ŋu gbeɖe o.
architecture.h2_c: Kpɔɖeŋua tso Chrome ƒe root-store mama (certs nɔa agbe le browser ƒe release track dzi, ke menye web ƒe gɔmedzedze o) kple Debian ƒe Release.gpg (manifest signed, packages unsigned). Woxɔe elabena aɖaŋu eveawo siaa tsi agbe le ƒe bla nanewo ƒe tsitretsiɖeŋulawo ƒe ŋkuléle ɖe wo ŋu me.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 le hop ɖesiaɖe dzi, nuwuwu-na-nuwuwu ƒe payloads encrypted le eme. TLS kpɔa ʋuɖoɖo gbɔ; AES-GCM kpɔa emenyawo gbɔ.
architecture.h3_b: Le asitsaha kple node dome: HTTPS (`/api/*`) kple WSS (`/ws`). Le nodewo dome: HTTPS (`/federation/*`). Le node kple dziɖula dome: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). Wo katã zãa TLS 1.3 kple Chrome 120 asibidɛwo tsɔ tsi tre ɖe DPI ŋu.
architecture.h3_c: Vortex gbãtɔ zãa TCP ƒuƒu kple asiléle si wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu si nye toɣliɖeɖe-ɖoɖowɔɖi. Wotrɔ ɖe TLS 1.3 le v0.0.4 me le esi wòkpɔe dze sii be ɖoɖowɔɖi tɔxɛwo ɖea dzesi be "edoa dzidzɔ na ame" na ŋkuléla siwo mewɔa naneke o vɔ megbe. TLS 1.3 nye nusi tea ɖeɖi ame ŋu, ele afisiafi, eye wòdzra ɖo ɖe ECH ŋu — nunɔamesi etɔ̃ siwo míedi.
architecture.h3_f:
ʋuɖoɖo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446) + tiatia ECH (RFC 9460)
emenyawo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo: AES-256-GCM wotre enu ɖe eme CBOR .
architecture.h4_a: Gbedasi ɖeka si dona toa afɔɖeɖe ene me: frame → encrypt → post → fan out.
architecture.h4_b: Asitsalawo bua xɔa ƒe safui (X25519 + HKDF), tsɔa gbedasi la ɖoa ɖoɖo nu abe CBOR ene, trea nu kple AES-256-GCM to 96-bit nonce si wowɔ le vome zazã me, POSTs yi `/api/rooms/{id}/messages`. Node dzraa ciphertext row la ɖo eye wòtsɔa fans doa goe na WebSocket ɖesiaɖe si do ƒome si ŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe xɔa me. Xɔla ƒe asisi tsɔa safui ma ke ɖea nyatakakawo gɔme. Mɔzɔzɔ yiyi kple gbɔgbɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi didi le 50 ms te le nutoa me LAN dzi, ~120 ms si bɔ WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Afɔɖeɖe ene ƒe pɔmpia nye esi Signal zã le ƒe 2014 me la ke; míetrɔ ʋuɖoɖo (WebSocket ɖe Signal ƒe TCP teƒe) kple nuŋɔŋlɔ (CBOR ɖe protobuf teƒe) ko. Aɖaŋu si ŋu kpeɖodzi le ƒe sɔsɔ ƒo yeye toto vɛ.
architecture.h5_a: Míeɖe CBOR ɖe JSON kple Protobuf dzi esi míetsɔ payload ƒe lolome, evolvability, kple debug ergonomics sɔ kple wo nɔewo le chat workloads ŋutɔŋutɔwo dzi vɔ megbe.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR wɔa ~30% ƒe fetu suewo wu JSON le unicode-heavy gbedasiwo dzi, whitespace ambiguity aɖeke mele esi o, eye wòdoa alɔ field addition schema generators manɔmee. Proto ahiã .proto faɛl le dodo ɖesiaɖe me eye wòatsi agble ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo nu.
architecture.h5_c: Signal trɔ tso protobuf yi CBOR-like framing le ƒe 2017 me le susu mawo ke ta. Matrix zãa CBOR le eƒe nɔnɔme-ɖeɖefia ƒe ƒuƒoƒo me. CBOR nye IETF dzidzenu (RFC 8949) eye gbegbɔgblɔ ɖesiaɖe si míeɖo taɖodzinu na la ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe si tsi.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR ƒe lolome: ~0.7 × JSON le utf-8 si wotsaka dzi
          ~1.05 × protobuf le ɖoɖo ɖeka ma ke dzi
Agble aɖe tsɔtsɔ kpee = append le nuwuwu. Asisi xoxowo ŋea aɖaba ƒua edzi.
architecture.h6_a: Nukatae CBOR — xɔtuɖaŋu ƒe ta ƒe akpa aɖe. Esia nye mɔnu vevi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Vortex ƒe nufiame bliboa me la dometɔ ɖeka. Xlẽ ta si ƒo xlãe hena nya siwo ƒo xlãe si keke ta wu; akpa sia dzia nuwɔna tɔxɛa ɖe edzi.
architecture.h6_b: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe wɔwɔfia na "Nukatae CBOR". Wowɔa mɔ̃a ŋudɔ le module si sɔ me le `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, alo `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` te. Module README yɔa faɛl mɔ siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
architecture.h6_c: "Nukatae CBOR" mɔnu la trɔ le Vortex ƒe asiɖeɖe le eŋu me. Aɖaŋu si wowɔ la tso numekuku kple ewɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu siwo wota siwo dɔla siwo do ŋgɔ wɔ la gbɔ. Version ŋutinya le `CHANGELOG.md` me ŋlɔa ɣeyiɣi si me akpa ɖesiaɖe ɖi kple nusi ʋãe.
architecture.h7_a: Protocol versioning — xɔtuɖaŋu ƒe ta ƒe akpa aɖe. Esia nye mɔnu vevi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Vortex ƒe nufiame bliboa me la dometɔ ɖeka. Xlẽ ta si ƒo xlãe hena nya siwo ƒo xlãe si keke ta wu; akpa sia dzia nuwɔna tɔxɛa ɖe edzi.
architecture.h7_b: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe wɔwɔfia na "Protocol versioning". Wowɔa mɔ̃a ŋudɔ le module si sɔ me le `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, alo `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` te. Module README yɔa faɛl mɔ siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
architecture.h7_c: "Protocol versioning" mɔnu la trɔ le Vortex ƒe tatawo katã me. Aɖaŋu si wowɔ la tso numekuku kple ewɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu siwo wota siwo dɔla siwo do ŋgɔ wɔ la gbɔ. Version ŋutinya le `CHANGELOG.md` me ŋlɔa ɣeyiɣi si me akpa ɖesiaɖe ɖi kple nusi ʋãe.

crypto.title: Cryptographic ƒe gɔmedzenuwo
crypto.subtitle: Algorithm ɖesiaɖe si le stack la me, eƒe taɖodzinu, eƒe parameters, eƒe RFC.
crypto.intro: Vortex zãa gɔmedzenu siwo me hatiwo to ko. Block ciphers siwo wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu aɖeke meli o, KDF siwo wodo le aƒeme aɖeke meli o, asidede agbalẽ te ƒe ɖoɖo yeye aɖeke meli o. Ta sia ŋlɔa primitive ɖesiaɖe si míezãna, parameters tututu, kple susu si ta míewɔ tiatia ɖesiaɖe ɖo.
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) le eƒe Montgomery nɔnɔme me, si wozãna na Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman. 32-byte ame ŋutɔ ƒe safuiwo, 32-byte dutoƒo safuiwo, 32-byte ƒe adzame nyatakaka si woama.
crypto.h1p2: Wozãnɛ na: static device identity, ephemeral session keys, sealed push envelopes, xɔme safui babla, federation envelopes.
crypto.h1p3: iOS ƒe dɔwɔwɔ: `Curve25519.KeyAgreement.PrivateKey` tso CryptoKit gbɔ. Android: `x25519-dalek` to JNI dzi. Node: `nya ɣaɣlawo.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519` le OpenSSL dzi.
crypto.h1p4: Wo ame etɔ̃a katã wɔa dɔ ɖekae bit-ɖe-bit. Wodo mɔzɔzɔ yiyi kple gbɔgbɔ kpɔ kple RFC 7748 Alice/Bob dodokpɔ vektorwo le xɔ ɖesiaɖe dzi.
crypto.h1p5: Dɔwɔwɔ: ~100 μs ɖe Diffie-Hellman ɖeka dzi le ƒe 2020 iPhone dzi, ~30 μs le ƒe 2020 Mac dzi. Xɔme-safui babla ƒoƒo ɖeka na ƒuƒoƒo si me tɔwo nye ame 200 xɔa abe 10 ms gli-gaƒoɖokui ene.
crypto.h1p6: Ɣeyiɣi si nɔa anyi ɖaa: ẽ, le curve akɔntabubu kple raw-byte decoding mɔ siaa me.
crypto.h1p7: Axadzimɔ ƒe nɔnɔme: Montgomery atrakpui mekpɔa ɣeyiɣi ƒe amedzidzedze ƒe hatsotso si ƒoa Weierstrass ƒe ʋuʋudediwo o; OpenSSL kple Swift CryptoKit siaa zãnɛ.
crypto.h1p8: Safuiwo ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ ɖe wo nɔewo yome: 32-byte little-endian. Woblaa dutoƒo safuiwo ɖe nusiwo wotsɔ tso duta vɛ dzi ale be nusiwo wotsɔ de eme siwo mewɔ dɔ nyuie o nagahe low-order-point leaks vɛ o.
crypto.h1l1: Nukatae X25519 eye menye P-256 o: kabakaba wu, sue wu, NIST-curve dzitsitsi aɖeke mele eme o.
crypto.h1l2: Nukatae 32-byte ƒe dodo eye menye 64 o: sɔ kple HKDF-SHA256 nyawo tsɔtsɔ yi eme ƒe didime pɛpɛpɛ.
crypto.h1l3: Nusitae Montgomery ke menye Edwards o: DH koe míehiã, ke menye asidede agbalẽ te o, le nya vevi sia dzi. Edwards ahiã dzimetɔtrɔ ƒe afɔɖeɖe ɣesiaɣi.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) le edwards25519 dzi. 32-byte dutoƒo safui, 64-byte asidede agbalẽ te.
crypto.h2p2: Wozãnɛ na: node ɖaseɖiɖiwo le federation gbedasiwo dzi, release-key signatures le integrity manifest dzi, bot deploy signing, device ƒe ɣeyiɣi didi ƒe dzeside na Double Ratchet.
crypto.h2p3: Determinism: RFC 8032 ƒe tɔtrɔ si míezãna la wɔa asidede agbalẽ te ɖeka zi eve na gbedasi + safui ɖeka. Apple ƒe CryptoKit le iOS 17+ zãa RFC 8032bis randomized variant — wo ame evea siaa sɔ eye wo ame evea siaa ɖoa kpe edzi kple kpeɖodzinu ɖesiaɖe si wɔ ɖeka.
crypto.h2p4: Ga si woatsɔ aɖo kpe edzi: ~200 μs le egbegbe CPU dzi. Batch verify (`batch_verify ([msg, sig, pk] * N)`) nye ~ 10× kabakaba wu le asidede agbalẽ te ɖesiaɖe me.
crypto.h2p5: Asidede agbalẽ te ƒe ɖoɖo: `R || S`, byte 32 ɖesiaɖe, sue-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Dutoƒo safui ƒe nɔnɔmetata: 32-byte compressed point. Ɣesiaɣi si sɔ — "point at infinity" nya aɖeke meli o.
crypto.h2l2: Ame ŋutɔ ƒe safui ƒe nɔnɔmetata: 32-byte nuku. Wokpɔa scalar si keke ta la le dzodzo me to SHA-512 dzi.
crypto.h2l3: Nukatae màwɔ ECDSA o: ECDSA hiã RNG si ƒe nyonyome deŋgɔ na asidede agbalẽ te ɖesiaɖe; RNG si ƒe akpaɖekedzimademade la dona le safui si nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ la me. Ed25519 nye nusi woɖo ɖi, RNG aɖeke mehiã le dzesideɣi o.
crypto.h3: AES-256-GCM nya ɣaɣla si ŋu woɖo kpee
crypto.h3p1: AES le Galois/Akɔntabubu ƒe Nɔnɔme me (NIST SP 800-38D). 256-bit safuiwo, 96-bit nonces, 128-bit ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe dzesiwo.
crypto.h3p2: Wozãnɛ na: gbedasi ƒe nya ɣaɣla ƒe agbalẽkotoku, faɛl ƒe akpa ƒe agbalẽkotokuwo, agbalẽkotoku siwo wotsɔ ɣla ɖe megbe, fetu siwo wotre nu na.
crypto.h3p3: Nonce xɔtutu: gbedasi ɖesiaɖe wɔa 96-bit random nonce yeye. Node la léa ŋku ɖe 10 ^ 6 nonces mamlɛawo ŋu le xɔ ɖeka me eye wòdaa duplicates defensively — mele be asisi la nawɔ duplicates le gɔmedzedzea me o, gake tsɔe be-naneke mexɔ asi o.
crypto.h3p4: Nukatae 96-bit nonces eye menye 128-bit o: 96 bits nye GCM-dzidzenu "deterministic" nonce ƒe didime, eye wònaa 2^32 random nonces mí hafi dzigbezã ƒe ƒoƒo va zua nusi ŋu míetsi dzi ɖo. Wotrɔa xɔa ƒe safui ɖeka ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe do ŋgɔ na ema, eyata ele dedie.
crypto.h3p5: Tag ƒe lolome: blibo 128 bits. Míetsoa nu o — nudzraɖoƒe ƒe gadzadzraɖo meɖi naneke o eye truncation dzia aʋatsokaka ƒe kakaɖedzi ɖe edzi.
crypto.h3l1: Hardware ƒe ablaɖeɖe: AES-NI (x86), ARMv8-A crypto kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔwo, crypto block siwo woɖo ɖi le Apple Silicon dzi. Nya ɣaɣlawo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ~3 GB/s.
crypto.h3l2: Le ARM mɔ̃ xoxo siwo me crypto kekeɖenudɔ aɖeke mele o dzi la: ~300 MB/s to kɔmpiuta dɔwɔɖoɖo dzi. Egale du dzi wu disk IO.
crypto.h3l3: Nyatakaka siwo do ƒome kplii: wotsɔa frame ƒe tanya (`{v, room_id, sender_pseudo}`) toa eme abe AAD ale be tanya si wowɔ alakpatɔe maɖo kpe edzi o.
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) kple SHA-256. Exɔa safui sue siwo ƒe didime nye byte 32 geɖe tso byte 32 ƒe nyawo tsɔtsɔ yi eme ɖeka me.
crypto.h4p2: Wozãnɛ na: X25519 ƒe emetsonua mama ɖe nya ɣaɣla ƒe safui + MAC safui + tanya safui me; ke ƒe ratchet safuia ɖeɖe tso Diffie-Hellman ƒe gogloƒe aɖe me; tu per-chunk file keys tso faɛl ƒe ke me.
crypto.h4p3: Nyatakaka kawo nyea nusi woɖo ɖi ɣesiaɣi ASCII: `"v1: nya ɣaɣla"`, `"v1:mac"`, `"v1:ta"`, `"v1: megbenyawo"`. Versioning na míetrɔa key hierarchy bliboa to info-string change dzi.
crypto.h4p4: Dze nye nusi woate ŋu awɔ le wo ɖokui si. Le Vortex me la míezãa xɔ ƒe id abe dze ene na xɔ-safui ƒe ɖeɖe ale be xɔ vovovowo mate ŋu agazã safui siwo woɖe tso eme le vo me ne X25519 ƒe dodo ma ke dze gɔ̃ hã o.
crypto.h4l1: Nukatae SHA-256 eye menye SHA-512 o: hardware SHA-256 acceleration le platformwo katã si; SHA-512 le du dzi vie le 64-bit CPUwo dzi gake menye le telefonwo dzi o.
crypto.h4l2: Nukatae menye KMAC-si wotu ɖe KDF dzi o: KMAC nye niche. HKDF le crypto agbalẽdzraɖoƒe ɖesiaɖe si míezãna me.
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106) ƒe xexlẽme. Nusiwo woatsɔ awɔe: m = 64 MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32.
crypto.h5p2: Wozãnɛ na: server-side password hash (`users.password_hash`), teƒea-backup babla safui, nuku-nyagbe tsɔtsɔ yi duta ƒe dzɔtsoƒe.
crypto.h5p3: Nusitae parameter siawo: OWASP 2023 ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖowo. 64 MiB + 3 iterations xɔa ~0.5 s le iPhone X — míaƒe mɔ̃ si wodoa alɔe blewu wu. ASIC amedzidzela si ƒe ŋkuɖodzinu ƒe didime nye 100× le telefon me la hiã ~5 ms kokoko le agbagbadzedze ɖesiaɖe me. Nyagbe ɣaɣla didiwo (entropy > 40 bits) va zua nusi mate ŋu adzɔ le akɔntabubu nu be woagbã le dzidzenu nu o.
crypto.h5p4: Nudzraɖoƒe ƒe nɔnɔme: `argon2:<encoded>` afisi woŋlɔe ɖo nye RFC-nɔnɔme ƒe ka si me dze, ŋkuɖodzinu, gbugbɔgawɔ, kple hash le.
crypto.h5l1: Nusitae Argon2id eye menye Argon2i alo Argon2d o: 2id nye hybrid — gbãtɔ ƒe yiyi tsi tre ɖe axadzi-mɔ̃wo ŋu (i-mode), emegbe yiyi tsi tre ɖe GPU/ASIC (d-mode). Signal hã zãa nu ma ke.
crypto.h5l2: Dummy-hash tsɔtsɔ sɔ kple wo nɔewo: ne zãla la meli o hã la, míegawɔa aʋatso Argon2 ƒe kpeɖodzinana kokoko kple hash si nɔa anyi ɖaa. Esia na be ɣeyiɣi si woatsɔ age ɖe eme la sɔ ale be amedzidzelawo mate ŋu axlẽ ŋkɔ siwo wozãna le ŋuɖoɖoɣi nu o.
crypto.h5l3: Rehash on login: ne server admin bumps memory cost la, wogbugbɔa hash xoxowo wɔa hash le gege ɖe eme si kplɔe ɖo dzidzedzetɔe me. Edzena le gaglãgbe na ezãla.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, ƒe 2024). ML-KEM-768 ƒe ɣeyiɣia. 1184-byte dutoƒo safui, 1088-byte nya ɣaɣla, 32-byte nya ɣaɣla si woama.
crypto.h6p2: Wozãnɛ na: hybrid post-quantum session safuiwo. Ne hati eveawo siaa do boblo Kyber ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu la, ɣeyiɣia ƒe safui nye `HKDF(x25519_output || kyber_output)`.
crypto.h6p3: Nukatae hybrid: ne Kyber gbã emegbe hã (enye ɖekakpui ne wotsɔe sɔ kple wo nɔewo), X25519 ƒe akpaa gakpɔtɔ kpɔa mía ta. Ne wotsɔe ƒo ƒui la, wonaa nu nyuitɔ kekeake le evea siaa me.
crypto.h6p4: Nukatae Kyber ke menye NIST ame bubu siwo di be yewoaxɔ ɖoƒea o: eyae nye esi wotia na dzidzenuwo. Kɔda ƒe anyinɔnɔ keke ta (liboqs, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: Dɔwɔwɔ: dzidzime vevi ~ 100 μs, encapsulation ~ 30 μs, decapsulation ~ 50 μs. Wometsɔ ɖeke le eme ne wotsɔe sɔ kple mɔzɔzɔ yiyi kple gbɔgbɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi didi o.
crypto.h6l2: Bandwidth ƒe asi: 1088 bytes le session ciphertext ɖeka me, 1184 bytes na dutoƒo safuia. Woxea fe na kpekpea le kadodo gbãtɔ me; emegbe la, enye zero.
crypto.h6l3: Server ƒe akpa: `pqcrypto` Python agbalẽvi kple `kem.ml_kem_768`. Asitsalawo ƒe akpa: liboqs to platform bindings dzi.
crypto.h7p1: Signal ƒe Double Ratchet (abe alesi wogblɔe le ƒe 2016 ƒe dutoƒo spec me ene). Etsɔa Diffie-Hellman ƒe ratchet kple kɔsɔkɔsɔ si ƒe safui sɔ kple wo nɔewo ƒoa ƒui.
crypto.h7p2: Wozãnɛ na: gbedasiwo tẽ le mɔ̃ eve dome. Ƒuƒoƒoxɔwo zãa "dɔla ƒe safui" ɖoɖo bɔbɔe aɖe si wotsɔ safui ɖe xɔa ƒe ke dzi.
crypto.h7p3: Nɔnɔmewo: nya ɣaɣla si woatsɔ aɖo ŋgɔ (ne woɖe asi le mɔ̃ aɖe ŋu la, gbedasi siwo wòxɔ xoxo koe wòɖena fiana, ke menye esiwo ava va o), dedienɔnɔ le nugblẽfexeɖoɖo megbe (gagbugbɔ ratcheting heals after a key compromise), out-of-order delivery (vaseɖe 1000 gbedasi siwo nye skip).
crypto.h7l1: Kɔsɔkɔsɔ ƒe didime ƒe nutrenu: gbedasi 1000 le kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɖesiaɖe me hafi wozi wo dzi be woagawɔ ratchet. Eɖoa seɖoƒe na nusiwo kɔsɔkɔsɔ ƒe safui si wofi gblẽna.
crypto.h7l2: Skipped-key cache: safui siwo mele ɖoɖo nu o siwo ade 1000 siwo wodzrana ɖo ɖe ŋkuɖodzinu me le kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɖesiaɖe me. Le ema godo la, wogbea gbedasia be enye nusi tsi.
crypto.h7l3: Tanya ƒe nya ɣaɣla: le edzi le gɔmedzedzea me. Tanya la tsɔa ratchet metadata eye wotsɔa tanya safui tɔxɛ si wokpɔ tso kea me to HKDF dzi la ɣlae.
crypto.h8p1: Fail ƒe dzeside kple blibodede si menye cryptographic o zãa BLAKE3 elabena ewɔa dɔ kabakaba wu SHA-256 le blob gãwo dzi 10×.
crypto.h8p2: Wozãnɛ na: faɛl `sha256` kɔlam le DB (ŋutinya me ŋkɔ; le nyateƒe me BLAKE3 le hood te tso esime v0.1.2), attachment dedup, file-upload integrity check.
crypto.h8p3: Dedienɔnɔ ƒe nɔnɔme: BLAKE3 sesẽ le nya ɣaɣlawo me (256-bit); míeyɔa kɔlam la be `sha256` hena ʋuʋu ƒe sɔsɔ ɖeɖeko.
crypto.h9p1: Wowɔa nonces, prekeys, kuxi ƒe asixɔxɔwo katã to OS RNG dzi: `SecRandom` le iOS, `java.security.SecureRandom` le Android, `secrets.token_bytes` le Python (woxatsa `/dev/urandom` alo esi sɔ kplii).
crypto.h9p2: Gbeɖe `random.random ()`, gbeɖe `Math.random ()`, gbeɖe `rand ()`. Lint sewo xe mɔ ɖe wo zazã le crypto modules me nu.
crypto.h10p1: HMAC tsɔtsɔ sɔ kple wo nɔewo, asidede agbalẽ te ƒe kpeɖodzi, nyagbe ɣaɣla hash ƒe kpeɖodzi — katã zãa ɣeyiɣi madzudzɔmadzudzɔe ƒe gɔmedzenuwo tsɔ xea mɔ na ɣeyiɣi ƒe axadzimɔwo.
crypto.h10p2: Python: `hmac.tsɔe sɔ kple_nuɖuɖu`. Swift: `Ɣeyiɣi ƒe tsɔtsɔ sɔ kple wo nɔewo ɣesiaɣi` kpeɖeŋutɔ. Kotlin: `MessageDigest.esɔ`.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 nye elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman ɖe Curve25519 dzi le eƒe Montgomery nɔnɔme me. 32-byte safuiwo, 32-byte nya ɣaɣla si woama. Ame ŋutɔ ƒe safui / static device identity / session key ɖesiaɖe le Vortex me zãnɛ.
crypto.h1_b: Alice kple Bob dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe safui siwo nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ a, b kple dutoƒo safuiwo A = a·G, B = b·G afisi G nye curve base point. Wobua akɔnta be s = a·B = b·A. Nya ɣaɣla sia si woama si ƒe didime nye byte 32 la yia HKDF-SHA256 me be yeakpɔ AES-GCM safui siwo sɔ. Wowɔa curve akɔntabubua le ɣeyiɣi madzudzɔmadzudzɔe me to Montgomery atrakpui zazã me; alɔdze aɖeke mele nyatakaka ɣaɣlawo ŋu o.
crypto.h1_c: Curve25519 nye esi Daniel J. Bernstein ta le ƒe 2005 me eye IETF ye tiae le RFC 7748 (2016). Woxɔe to Dzesi, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard dzi. Vortex zãnɛ elabena ewɔa dɔ kabakaba wu P-256, eƒe safui ƒe lolome nye 32-byte sesẽ wu, eƒoa asa na NIST curve dzitsitsiwo, eye platform ɖesiaɖe ɖoa dɔwɔwɔ sesẽ aɖe ɖe amewo.
crypto.h1_f:
Ame ŋutɔ ƒe safui: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 bytes little-endian) .
Dutoƒo safui: A = a · G (32-byte ƒe teƒe si woƒo ƒu) .
Nya ɣaɣla si woama: s = a · B = b · A (32 bytes, →HKDF nyawo tsɔtsɔ yi eme)
crypto.h2_a: Ed25519 nye X25519 ƒe asidede agbalẽ te nɔvi, zãa ʋuʋudedi ma ke le eƒe twisted-Edwards nɔnɔme me. 32-byte dutoƒo safuiwo, 64-byte asidede agbalẽ te, deterministic le gɔmedzedzea me.
crypto.h2_b: Be nàde asi gbedasi m te kple ame ŋutɔ ƒe safui d: bu akɔnta be r = SHA-512(d, m), R = r·G, c = SHA-512(R, A, m), S = r + c·a. Asidede agbalẽ te nye (R, S). Kpeɖodzi: kpɔ R + c·A = S·G ɖa. Deterministic signing ƒoa asa na nonce-reuse risk keŋkeŋ — gbedasi ɖeka ƒe asidede eve siwo si safui ɖeka le la sɔ vie.
crypto.h2_c: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) do tso Bernstein ƒe ƒe 2011 ƒe agbalẽ si wòŋlɔ kple Duif, Lange, Schwabe, kple Yang me. Woxɔe le afisiafi le ƒe 2013 megbe.Apple ƒe CryptoKit, Google ƒe Tink, libsodium, OpenSSH katã zãnɛ. Vortex dea asi federation ƒe agbalẽkotoku ɖesiaɖe kple node ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ɖesiaɖe te kple Ed25519.
crypto.h2_f:
Dzesi (d, m): r = SHA-512 (d∥m);  R = r·G ƒe xexlẽme
              c = SHA-512 (R∥A∥m);  S = r + c·a ƒe ƒuƒoƒo
              trɔ gbɔ (R, S) .

Kpɔ egbɔ be: c = SHA-512 (R∥A∥m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G ƒe ƒuƒoƒo
crypto.h3_a: AES le Galois/Akɔntabubu ƒe Nɔnɔme me. 256-bit safuiwo, 96-bit random nonces, 128-bit ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe dzesiwo. Blob ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔe le Vortex me zãa GCM.
crypto.h3_b: GCM zɔna AES le CTR nɔnɔme me eye wòbua GHASH ɖe ciphertext + AAD dzi to safui bubu si woɖe tso nya ɣaɣla safuia me zazã me. Tag = GHASH(AAD, nya ɣaɣla) ⊕ AES-CTR(0). Decryption gbugbɔ bu akɔnta GHASH eye wòtsɔe sɔ kple wo nɔewo — bit-flip ɖeka ɖesiaɖe do kpo kpeɖodzinana. Hardware-si wowɔ kabakaba le egbegbe CPU ɖesiaɖe dzi to AES-NI alo ARMv8-A crypto kekeɖenudɔwo dzi.
crypto.h3_c: AES ɖu dzi le NIST AES hoʋiʋli me le ƒe 2001. Woɖo GCM ɖe ɖoɖo nu le NIST SP 800-38D le ƒe 2007 me eye wònye AEAD si woɖo ɖi le TLS 1.3 me. Vortex tiaa 256-bit safuiwo togbɔ be 128-bit asɔ gbɔ ɖe blema futɔwo ŋu hã — titri yi 256-bit naa mí abe 128 bits ƒe post-quantum dedienɔnɔ le Grover ƒe algorithm te.
crypto.h3_f:
Nya ɣaɣla (k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR (k, n, pt) .
                          tag = GHASH_h (aad∥ct∥lens) ⊕ AES (k, n∥1) .
                          trɔ gbɔ ct∥tag
Nonce reuse ⇒ nya ɣaɣla + nyateƒetoto gblẽ.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (HMAC-si wotu ɖe KDF, RFC 5869) trɔa safui ɖeka wòzua geɖe. Exɔa entropy gã ƒe nyawo tsɔtsɔ de eme kple nya siwo ƒo xlãe ƒe dzeside; eɖea byte 32 ɖe go le dzesidenu ɖesiaɖe dzi.
crypto.h4_b: Afɔɖeɖe Eve: Ðee le eme eye nàkekee ɖe enu. Nusi woɖe tso eme = HMAC-SHA256(dze, IKM) → PRK. Keke = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, info∥counter) si wotsɔ ƒo ƒui na len bytes. Míezãa esia tsɔ maa X25519 ƒe emetsonu ɖe ​​nya ɣaɣla safui, MAC safui, kple tanya safui si me nyatakaka kawo le "v1:encryption", "v1:mac", "v1:header".
crypto.h4_c: HKDF nye esi Hugo Krawczyk ta le EUROCRYPT 2010 eye woɖoe ɖe ɖoɖo nu be RFC 5869 le ƒe 2010. TLS 1.3 zãe na eƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi, to Signal for Double Ratchet, to WireGuard na session keys. Versioning le info strings me na míetrɔa key hierarchy bliboa to bumping "v1" → "v2".
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256(dze, IKM) .
T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ nyatakaka ∥ i) .
OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... woɖee ɖa wòzu len bytes
crypto.h5_a: Argon2id nye memory-hard password hash si wowɔ be wòatsi tre ɖe GPU kple ASIC amedzidzelawo ŋu. Kpɔɖeŋuwo m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32.
crypto.h5_b: Argon2id tsaka Argon2i (tsi tre ɖe axadzimɔwo ŋu to alɔdzewo wɔwɔ ɖe nyatakaka siwo wokpɔ tso nyagbegbɔgblɔ me dzi) kple Argon2d (eyɔa ŋkuɖodzinu me le mɔ si womate ŋu agblɔ ɖi o nu ale be parallel hardware mate ŋu atso dzogoewo o). Gbãtɔ afã-to nye data-maɖemaɖe (i-mode); susɔea nɔa te ɖe nyatakakawo dzi (d-mode). 0.5 sɛkɛnd ƒe akɔntabubu le iPhone X le míaƒe parameters, abe 5 ms le ASIC — ~ 100× ƒe duƒuƒu le sue ŋutɔ ne wotsɔe sɔ kple SHA-256-si wotu ɖe hashes afisi ASICs ɖu dzi to 1 000 000×.
crypto.h5_c: Argon2 ɖu dzi le ƒe 2015 ƒe Password Hashing Hoʋiʋli si ŋu Dmitry Khovratovich kple Alex Biryukov wɔ ɖoɖo ɖo la me. Woɖoe ɖe ɖoɖo nu be RFC 9106 le ƒe 2021. Wozãe to 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass dzi. Vortex ƒe nɔnɔmewo tso OWASP 2023 ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖowo me, siwo woɖɔ ɖo be woawɔ gege ɖe míaƒe mɔ̃ si wodoa alɔe blewu wu (iPhone X) dzi le sɛkɛnd 1 te.
crypto.h5_f:
gazazã (m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4) ≈ 0.5 s le iPhone X dzi
amedzidzela ƒe asi: m × t × (p / amedzidzedze_si sɔ kple wo nɔewo)
Le 1010 akɔntabubu/s kple 40-bit nyagbe ɣaɣla entropy:
  Sɛkɛnd 1012 = ƒe 32 000
crypto.h6_a: Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) nye NIST-dzidzenu post-quantum safui encapsulation mɔnu. Enaa quantum-safe session keys siwo wotsɔ ƒo ƒu kple X25519.
crypto.h6_b: Alice dzia (pk, sk). Bob yɔa Encapsulate (pk) → (c, ss); ɖo c ɖe Alice. Alice yɔa Decapsulate(sk, c) → ss. Fifia akpa evea siaa ma ss, si nye nya ɣaɣla si ƒe didime nye byte 32. Dedienɔnɔ dzi ɖena kpɔtɔna va ɖoa Module-LWE kuxia, si woxɔ se be quantum-hard. Míeƒonɛ nu ƒu kple X25519: session_key = HKDF(x25519_dometsotso ∥ kyber_domeɖeɖe). Ne afã eveawo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe tsi agbe la, ke kpekpea tsi agbe.
crypto.h6_c: Kyber nye esi NIST tia le July 2022 me le ƒe 6 ƒe hoʋiʋli megbe. Standardized as FIPS 203 in August 2024. Vortex ɖoa Kyber ɖe amewo abe tiatia ene elabena etsɔa ~2 KB kpena ɖe eŋu le ɣeyiɣi ɖesiaɖe me asiléle; wowɔe le gɔmedzedzea me na tiers siwo woxea fe na, tiae le teƒe bubu. Signal kafu mɔnu si nye hybrid la le ƒe 2023 me eye Chrome hã xɔe le ƒe 2024 me.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen (): (pk ∈ Zq ^ k, sk ∈ Zq ^ k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Encaps (pk): (ct ∈ Zq ^ k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B
Decaps (sk, ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256
hybrid ɣeyiɣi = HKDF (x25519_do go ∥ kyber_do, nyatakaka = "ɣeyiɣi-v1")
crypto.h7_a: Signal ƒe Double Ratchet naa nya ɣaɣla si yi ŋgɔ kple dedienɔnɔ le nugblẽfexeɖoɖo megbe na dzeɖoɖo 1:1.
crypto.h7_b: Kɔsɔkɔsɔ eve: kɔsɔkɔsɔ si ɖoa ame ɖa kple kɔsɔkɔsɔ si xɔa ame. Gbedasi ɖesiaɖe doa eƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɖe ŋgɔ to HKDF dzi. Ɣesiaɣi la, Diffie-Hellman ƒe lãgbalẽgolo aɖe doa kea ɖe ŋgɔ, eye wògbugbɔa kɔsɔkɔsɔ eveawo ƒe safui. Kɔsɔkɔsɔ ƒe safui ƒe nugblẽfexexe ɖea gbedasi siwo wòɣla tẽe la ɖe go. Le DH ratchet megbe la, gbedasi siwo gbɔna la le dedie ne amedzidzela aɖe fi kɔsɔkɔsɔ ƒe safui gɔ̃ hã.
crypto.h7_c: Trevor Perrin kple Moxie Marlinspike ye wɔe le ƒe 2013 me, wotsɔe de Signal 2014 me, si WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Dɔla Adzame Dzeɖoɖowo, Skype Ame ŋutɔ ƒe Dzeɖoɖowo xɔ. Public spec le ƒe 2016. Vortex ƒe dɔwɔwɔ nye melidzeƒe tẽ; interop kple Signal-protocol asisi bubuwo le v0.4 mɔfiame la dzi.
crypto.h7_f:
ɖo ɖa: CK = HKDF (CK, "afɔɖeɖe");  MK = HKDF(CK, "nyatakaka")
xɔ: CK' = HKDF (CK', "afɔɖeɖe"); MK' = HKDF(CK', "nyatakaka")
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(míaƒe_eph, woƒe_eph), RK_do ŋgɔ)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 hashing na faɛlwo — crypto ta ƒe akpa aɖe. Esia nye mɔnu vevi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Vortex ƒe nufiame bliboa me la dometɔ ɖeka. Xlẽ ta si ƒo xlãe hena nya siwo ƒo xlãe si keke ta wu; akpa sia dzia nuwɔna tɔxɛa ɖe edzi.
crypto.h8_b: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe wɔwɔfia na "BLAKE3 hashing for files". Wowɔa mɔ̃a ŋudɔ le module si sɔ me le `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, alo `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` te. Module README yɔa faɛl mɔ siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
crypto.h8_c: "BLAKE3 hashing for files" mɔnu la trɔ le Vortex ƒe tatawo me. Aɖaŋu si wowɔ la tso numekuku kple ewɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu siwo wota siwo dɔla siwo do ŋgɔ wɔ la gbɔ. Version ŋutinya le `CHANGELOG.md` me ŋlɔa ɣeyiɣi si me akpa ɖesiaɖe ɖi kple nusi ʋãe.
crypto.h9_a: Xexlẽdzesi dzidzi le vome — crypto ta ƒe akpa aɖe. Esia nye mɔnu vevi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Vortex ƒe nufiame bliboa me la dometɔ ɖeka. Xlẽ ta si ƒo xlãe hena nya siwo ƒo xlãe si keke ta wu; akpa sia dzia nuwɔna tɔxɛa ɖe edzi.
crypto.h9_b: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe wɔwɔfia na "Xexlẽdzesi dzidzi le vome". Wowɔa mɔ̃a ŋudɔ le module si sɔ me le `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, alo `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` te. Module README yɔa faɛl mɔ siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
crypto.h9_c: "Xexlẽdzesi dzidzi le vome" mɔnu la trɔ le Vortex ƒe asiɖeɖe le eŋu me. Aɖaŋu si wowɔ la tso numekuku kple ewɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu siwo wota siwo dɔla siwo do ŋgɔ wɔ la gbɔ. Version ŋutinya le `CHANGELOG.md` me ŋlɔa ɣeyiɣi si me akpa ɖesiaɖe ɖi kple nusi ʋãe.
crypto.h10_a: Ɣesiaɣi-ɣeyiɣi dɔwɔwɔwo — akpa aɖe le crypto ta. Esia nye mɔnu vevi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Vortex ƒe nufiame bliboa me la dometɔ ɖeka. Xlẽ ta si ƒo xlãe hena nya siwo ƒo xlãe si keke ta wu; akpa sia dzia nuwɔna tɔxɛa ɖe edzi.
crypto.h10_b: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe wɔwɔfia na "Ɣeyiɣi madzudzɔmadzudzɔe dɔwɔwɔwo". Wowɔa mɔ̃a ŋudɔ le module si sɔ me le `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, alo `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` te. Module README yɔa faɛl mɔ siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
crypto.h10_c: "Ɣeyiɣi-ɣeyiɣi ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo" ƒe mɔnu la trɔ le Vortex ƒe asiɖeɖe le wo ŋu me. Aɖaŋu si wowɔ la tso numekuku kple ewɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu siwo wota siwo dɔla siwo do ŋgɔ wɔ la gbɔ. Version ŋutinya le `CHANGELOG.md` me ŋlɔa ɣeyiɣi si me akpa ɖesiaɖe ɖi kple nusi ʋãe.

cryptoWire.title: Crypto ka ƒe nɔnɔmewo
cryptoWire.subtitle: Byte ƒe ɖoɖo siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ na blob ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ.
cryptoWire.intro: Ta sia gblɔ byte siwo le ka la dzi. Amesiame si le asisi bubu alo ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe ƒe dɔwɔnu aɖe zãm ate ŋu axlẽ nu ɖekae.
cryptoWire.h1p1: Dɔwɔɖoɖo: `{v:1, nonce: <12-byte hex>, ciphertext: <hex si trɔna>, amedɔdɔ_aʋatso: <32-hex>, woɖo_le:<unix_ms>}`. Woɖoe ɖe HTTPS (POST) kple WebSocket (frame ƒomevi `m`) dzi.
cryptoWire.h1p2: `ciphertext` me nyawo le AES-GCM nya ɣaɣlawo ɖeɖeɖa megbe: CBOR `{v:1, nuŋɔŋlɔ?:<ka>, kpeɖeŋutɔ?:[<file_id>, ...], ŋuɖoɖo_na?:<msg_id>, ɖɔɖɔɖowo?:[<nuŋɔŋlɔ_do ŋgɔ>, ...], yɔ?:[<zãla_id>, ...]}`.
cryptoWire.h1p3: Tag le megbe: `ciphertext` byte ka nye (encrypted payload || 16-byte tag). Asitsalawo ma le didime nu.
cryptoWire.h1p4: AAD: wotsɔa ŋɔŋlɔdzesi sue hex xɔ id la toa eme abe nyatakaka siwo do ƒome kplii ene. Xɔa ƒe id babla xea mɔ na cross-room replay.
cryptoWire.h2p1: Fail ke ƒe safui nye random 32 bytes. Per-chunk safui: `HKDF (ke, nyatakaka: "faɛl:chunk:" + <offset>, len: 32)`.
cryptoWire.h2p2: Chunk ciphertext: AES-GCM kple safui ɖesiaɖe, 96-bit nonce le vome, AAD: `<file_id> || <offset>`. Max chunk ƒe lolome 512 KiB.
cryptoWire.h2p3: Faɛl bliboa ƒe blibonyenye: asisi la bua BLAKE3 ɖe nuŋɔŋlɔ gbadzaa dzi eye wòɖonɛ ɖa abe `plain_blake3` na amesi xɔe to xɔa me gbedasi dzi. Amesi xɔe la gabua akɔnta le eƒe kɔpi wɔwɔ vɔ megbe eye wòɖoa kpe edzi.
cryptoWire.h3: Push envelope si wotu nu ɖo
cryptoWire.h3p1: Asitsalawo tsɔa `p256dh_pub` (32-byte X25519) dana ɖe node la dzi.
cryptoWire.h3p2: Ne push aɖe ɖo la, node wɔa ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe X25519 safui, wɔa DH kple `p256dh_pub`, xɔa AES-GCM safui to HKDF dzi.
cryptoWire.h3p3: Blob si wotre enu: `{nuwuƒe, p256dh: asisi ƒe pub, auth: 16 bytes, nyatakaka: ciphertext||tag}`. APNs/FCM kpɔ `nyatakaka` ko.
cryptoWire.h3p4: Client decrypts on receive zã eƒe private key kple `p256dh` (si nye nyateƒe node ƒe ephemeral pub le envelope me).
cryptoWire.h4p1: Nyagbe ɣaɣla xɔa megbenya safui to Argon2id (m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, dze = <random 16B>, hashLen = 32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{dze, nonce, nya ɣaɣla}`. Nya ɣaɣla nye CBOR ƒe `{v:1, xɔwo:[{id,key,ct_refs}...], nɔnɔmetata:{...}, kadodowo:[...]}`.
cryptoWire.h4p3: Wodzrae ɖo ɖe teƒea (iCloud / Google Drive) alo ɖe node aɖe dzi le zãla ƒe xɔ si me ame aɖeke mele o me.
cryptoWire.h5p1: Cross-node gbedasi: `{tsoƒe_node: <pubkey>, taɖodzinu_zãla: <id>, ememe: {... nenema ke abe xɔ ƒe agbalẽkotoku ...}, sig: <64-byte Ed25519>}`.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` xɔ CBOR-si woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu `{tsoƒe_node, taɖodzinu_zãla, ememe}`. Taɖodzinu ɖo kpe edzi ɖe `source_node` pubkey tso `trusted_nodes`.
cryptoWire.h1_a: Xɔ ɖeka ƒe gbedasi si le ka dzi nye CBOR dict si me payload si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ, nonce, amedɔdɔ ƒe ŋkɔ bubu, kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesi. Envelope la sɔ ne edo HTTPS (POST) alo WebSocket (frame type `m`).
cryptoWire.h1_b: Asitsaha la ɖoa gbedasi ƒe ŋutilã `{v:1, nuŋɔŋlɔ, ŋuɖoɖo_na, woɖo_le}` ɖe ɖoɖo nu abe CBOR → `pt` ene. Ewɔa nonce si ƒe didime nye byte 12 le vome. Bu akɔnta be `aad = hex (xɔ_id)`. Yɔa `ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt (xɔ_safui, nonce, pt, aad)`. Woxatsa ɖe `{v:1, nya ɣaɣla: hex (ct), nonce: hex (nonce), sender_pseudo: hex (pseudo), sent_at: unix_ms}` eye wòɖoa ɖa. Xɔla ɖoa kpe GCM tag dzi le decrypt me, emegbe CBOR-ɖea nuŋɔŋlɔ gbadzaa me.
cryptoWire.h1_c: Ka ƒe nɔnɔme nye version-tagged tso v0.0.4 le abortive v0.0.3 ƒe dodo si me `v` agble aɖeke menɔ o megbe — ele be míaƒo nɔnɔme bliboa esi míetsɔ `thread_id` kpee elabena asisi xoxowo ge ɖe safui si womenya o dzi. Nusɔsrɔ̃ si míesrɔ̃: etsɔme ka ƒe nɔnɔme ɖesiaɖe tsɔa `v:N` le eƒe agble gbãtɔ me eyata ŋgɔgbe ƒe sɔsɔ ɖe enu dze ƒã.
cryptoWire.h2_a: Woma faɛlwo ɖe akpa siwo ƒe lolome woɖo ɖi me, eye wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe kple eƒe safui si woɖe tso faɛl ƒe ke me kple akpa ƒe vovototo. Per-chunk encryption na be dɔla la tɔ te/gbugbɔ dzea egɔme le chunk ƒe liƒo ɖesiaɖe dzi.
cryptoWire.h2_b: Fail ke ƒe safui nye random 32 bytes. Per-chunk safui nye `HKDF (ke, info="faɛl:chunk:" + str (offset), len = 32)`. Wotsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe safui, random 96-bit nonce, kple `aad = file_id ∥ offset` ɣla ɖe akpa ɖesiaɖe AES-GCM. Chunks default nye 512 KiB; 4 MiB ƒe nutrenu. Woɖoa faɛl blibo BLAKE3 ɖa abe `plain_blake3` ene le xɔme gbedasi si fia faɛl la me ale be amesiwo xɔe nateŋu aɖo kpe edzi le eɖeɖe vɔ megbe.
cryptoWire.h2_c: Chunked E2E encryption kple per-chunk keys nye mɔɖela to Mega.nz le ƒe 2013 me eye woɖɔe ɖo to Signal ƒe large-file support le ƒe 2019. Vortex ƒe 512 KiB default nye lolome si me TCP sisi dziɖuɖu nana pɔmpia yɔ fũu asike didi manɔmee le asitelefon 4G dzi. Míedo 256/512/1024/4096 KiB kpɔ eye 512 ye nye nusi vivina le míaƒe dzidzenuwo me.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Push envelope si wotu nu ɖo ɣlaa nyatakaka ƒe viɖe tso Apple / Google / Mozilla to nya ɣaɣlawo tsɔtsɔ ɣla kple mɔ̃ tɔxɛ X25519 safui.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Asitsaha ŋlɔa `p256dh_pub` kple `auth` ɖe node la dzi. Ne push aɖe ɖo la, node ƒua du ephemeral-ECDH kple p256dh_pub, xɔa key + nonce to HKDF dzi kple auth nya ɣaɣla la abe dze ene. Encrypts `{tanya, ŋutilã, xɔ_id, gbedasi_id}` kple AES-GCM. Ðo nuŋlɔɖia abe opaque `data` field ene na push provider. Mɔ̃ ƒe kekeɖenudɔa gbugbɔa xɔa, ɖea nya ɣaɣlawo me, ɖea nu gɔme.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Nutrenu tutu nye Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe Tutu Gbedasɛ Nya ɣaɣla spec (RFC 8291, 2017). Apple xɔe le iOS 16 ƒe Nyatakaka Dɔwɔƒe ƒe Kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔwo me. Hafi sealed push va zu amesi wodo alɔe le afisiafi la, Signal kple WhatsApp ɖo ɖoɖoezizi "nane va ɖo" pings emenyawo manɔmee eye wona app la xɔ gbedasi la le nyɔnyrɔ̃ — si nɔ blewu. Sealed push naa mí adzamenyawo tso nuwuwu vaseɖe nuwuwu kpe ɖe instant render ŋu.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Encrypted backup blob na zãla gbugbɔ xɔa ƒe safuiwo + profile + nɔa anyi ŋkeke 90 le mɔ̃ yeye dzi tso nyagbe ɣaɣla ɖeɖeko dzi.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Backup key xɔa tso nyagbea me to Argon2id dzi kple dze 16-byte si wowɔ le vome. Payload nye CBOR: `{v:1, xɔwo: [{id, safui, msg_ref_ids}], nɔnɔmetata, kadodowo}`. Wotsɔ AES-GCM ɣla ɖe safui si woɖe tso eme la te. Wodzrae ɖo ɖe teƒea (iCloud / Google Drive) alo abe faɛl ene le zãla ƒe alilikpoxɔ si nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ me. Gbugbɔgaɖo: ŋlɔ nyagbegbɔgblɔ → Argon2id → decrypt → gbugbɔ safuiwo kple nufiamewo va.
cryptoWire.h4_c: Wowɔ ɖoɖoa ƒe kpɔɖeŋu ɖe 1Password ƒe OPVault (2013) kple Bitwarden ƒe encrypted export (2017) dzi. Wo ame evea siaa zãa KDF-emegbe-AEAD kple metadata siwo wotsɔ dze ƒo ƒui. Vortex tsɔ ŋkeke 90 ƒe lãɖeɖe kpee elabena ŋutinya bliboa ƒe megbenyawo nye 100 MB+ le dodokpɔ me; gbedasi siwo woŋlɔ nyitsɔ laa koe hiã na gbugbɔgaɖoanyi ƒe akpa gãtɔ, eye woate ŋu aɖo nyatakaka xoxowo gbɔ to server ciphertext dzi ne kadodo le zãla la si.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Cross-node federation message xatsa ememe envelope si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ xoxo la ɖe gota envelope si wode asi ete si ɖo kpe dzɔtsoƒe node dzi.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A ɖoa `{tsoƒe_node, taɖodzinu_zãla, ememe_ct, ememe_nonce, woɖo_le}` ɖe ɖoɖo nu abe CBOR ene. De dzesiwo kple eƒe Ed25519 ame ŋutɔ ƒe asiɖeɖe le safui → `sig`. POSTs `{envelope, sig}` na node B ƒe `/federation/deliver`. B ɖo kpe `sig` dzi ɖe pubkey ŋu na `source_node` le `federations` me, léa ŋku ɖe ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesi ŋu le miniti 5 ƒe skew fesre me, emegbe eŋlɔa ememe ciphertext ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe `messages` kplɔ̃ dzi na taɖodzinu zãla.
cryptoWire.h5_c: Wodo gotagome agbalẽkotoku siwo wode asi ete tso Matrix ƒe federation spec (2015) kple ActivityPub ƒe HTTP Signatures (2018) me. Aɖabaƒoƒo 5 ƒe fesrea sɔ kple SMTP ƒe RFC 5321 ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo eye wòxea mɔ na amedzidzedze gbugbɔgaƒoƒo afisi amedzidzela aɖe lé federation POST ɖeka eye wògaƒoe le gaƒoƒo aɖewo megbe. Vortex tia Ed25519 wu RSA-PSS elabena Ed25519 ƒe asidede agbalẽ te nye 64 bytes vs RSA-PSS-2048 ƒe 256 bytes — le vevie ne federation nye dzeɖoɖo.
cryptoWire.h2_f:
faɛl_ke = rand (32) .
chunk_key (o) = HKDF (faɛl_ke, "faɛl:chunk:" + o, 32)
chunk_ct (o) = AES-GCM (chunk_key (o), rand (12), nuŋɔŋlɔ gbadzaa, aad = faɛl_id ∥ o)
full_hash = BLAKE3 (nuŋɔŋlɔ gbadzaa_bytes_le_faɛl_blibo) // woɖoe abe plain_blake3 ene
cryptoWire.h3_f:
ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe nuwɔna = (priv, pub);  ikm = ECDH (ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe nu.priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(nyatakaka, ikm) .
key = HKDF-Keke ɖe enu (prk, "Emenyawo-Nuŋɔŋlɔ: aes128gcm \ 0", 16)
nonce = HKDF-Expand (prk, "Emenyawo-Nuŋɔŋlɔ: nonce \ 0", 12)
ct = AES-GCM(safui, nonce, CBOR{tanya, ŋutilã, xɔ_id, gbedasi_id})
ka = dze (16) ∥ rs (4) ∥ dɔmawɔmawɔ (1) ∥ ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko.pub (32) ∥ ct
cryptoWire.h4_f:
dze = rand(16) .
safui = Argon2id (nyagbe, dze, m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, len = 32)
nonce = rand(12) ƒe ɣeyiɣia.
ct = AES-GCM(safui, nonce, CBOR{xɔwo, nɔnɔmetata, kadodowo}, aad="vortex-backup-v1")
faɛl = {v:1, dze, nonce, ct}.

auth.title: Nyateƒetotodedeameme
auth.subtitle: Ŋlɔ ŋkɔ, ge ɖe eme, gbugbɔ, te fli ɖe eme. JWT + X25519 + tiatiawɔblɔɖe ƒe safui / nuku / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex ɖea JWT siwo nɔa anyi ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe (15 min ƒe mɔɖeɖe, ŋkeke 30 ƒe gbugbɔgawɔ) kple zãla ƒe X25519 dutoƒo safui si wobla ɖe eme.Nuwuƒe ɖesiaɖe si le vevie la léa ŋku ɖe eŋu JWT + ɖoa kpe edzi be womete fli ɖe safuia me o. Ta sia ƒo nu tso sisi ɖesiaɖe si tso nuwuwu vaseɖe nuwuwu ŋu.
auth.h1p1: Asitsalawo dzea egɔme kple 32-byte X25519 ame ŋutɔ ƒe safui yeye wɔwɔ kple OS RNG. Exɔa dutoƒo safuia, encodes abe 64 hex chars.
auth.h1p2: Asitsaha la ŋlɔa `POST /api/authentication/register` kple `{zãla ƒe ŋkɔ, nyagbegbɔgblɔ, x25519_dutoƒo_safui, ɖeɖefia_ŋkɔ, telefon, e-mail, avatar_emoji, kyber_dutoƒo_safui?}`.
auth.h1p3: Node ɖo kpe edzi: zãla ƒe ŋkɔ sɔ kple `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$` (ŋɔŋlɔdzesi suewo be woaƒo asa na homograph squats); nyagbegbɔgblɔ to zxcvbn-style ŋusẽ (min dzesi 2); telefon si sɔ kple E.164 ne wonae; email sɔ kple RFC 5322 gɔmedze regex ne wonae.
auth.h1p4: Node léa ŋku ɖe `x25519_public_key` ƒe etɔxɛnyenye ŋu — pubkey ɖesiaɖe ateŋu aŋlɔ akɔnta ɖeka pɛpɛpɛ. Esia tɔa te amedzidzedze gbogbotɔ ƒe ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ me siwo gbugbɔ zãa pubkey ma ke.
auth.h1p5: Node wɔa Argon2id ɖe nyagbea dzi (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) eye wòdzraa `argon2:$...$` ɖo ɖe `users.password_hash` me.
auth.h1p6: Node mints JWT eve: mɔɖeɖe (15 min, `jti:<device_id>`) kple gbugbɔgawɔ (30 d). Nyawo: `{sub: zãla_id, jti: mɔ̃_id, typ: mɔɖeɖe|gbugbɔ, exp: ...}`. Wode asi ete HS256 le 64-byte server nya ɣaɣla si wotsɔ tso `.env` me.
auth.h1p7: Node wɔa `zãla_mɔ̃wo` fli: `{zãla_id, mɔ̃_id, zãla_dɔla, wowɔ_le}`. Wobla gbugbɔgawɔ ɖesiaɖe ɖe eƒe device_id ŋu; mɔ̃ aɖe ɖeɖeɖa wua tɔsisi ma ko.
auth.h1p8: Ŋuɖoɖo: `{ok, zãla_id, zãla ƒe ŋkɔ, mɔɖeɖe_dzesi, gbugbɔgawɔ_dzesi, x25519_dutoƒo_safui, kyber_dutoƒo_safui, ɖeɖefia_ŋkɔ, avatar_url, telefon, e-mail}`.
auth.h1p9: Asitsaha dzraa dzesiwo ɖo ɖe Keychain (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite=Kuki sesẽwo (web) me.
auth.h1l1: Seɖoƒe na ga home: Ame 5 ŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe sɛkɛnd 60 ɖesiaɖe me le IP ɖesiaɖe me. TESTING=nyateƒe wɔa esia nuwɔametɔe.
auth.h1l2: Kpe ƒe nɔnɔme: ne `REGISTRATION_MODE=kpe`, ele be ŋutilã la nade `ame_kɔda` si sɔ. Wowɔa kɔdawo to admin API dzi.
auth.h1l3: Wotu nɔnɔme: `REGISTRATION_MODE=wotu`. Seed admin koe ateŋu aŋlɔ ŋkɔ. Ame siwo zãnɛ emegbe la toa amekpekpe ƒe kadodowo dzi va ɖoa xɔ aɖewo koŋ me.
auth.h2p1: Asitsaha ŋlɔa `POST /api/authentication/login` kple `{zãla ƒe ŋkɔ, nyagbegbɔgblɔ}`.
auth.h2p2: Node biaa `zãlawo` to zãla ƒe ŋkɔ suewo me. Ne womekpɔe o la, egawɔa dummy Argon2 verify ɖe hash si nɔa anyi ɖaa ŋu be wòana ɣeyiɣi nasɔ (~0.5 s le mɔ evea siaa nu).
auth.h2p3: Ne Argon2 verify kpɔ dzidzedze eye akɔntabubua mewɔ dɔ o la, node trɔa envelope ma ke abe register ene. Wowɔ `user_devices` fli yeye aɖe; wogblẽa fli siwo li xoxo la ɖeɖeko ale be zãla la nate ŋu age ɖe eme le mɔ̃ geɖe dzi.
auth.h2p4: Ne verify do kpo nu la, node trɔna 401 kple `{error:"invalid credentials"}`. Vovototo aɖeke mele "zãla ƒe ŋkɔ gbegblẽ" kple "nyagbe si mesɔ o" dome le ŋuɖoɖoa me o.
auth.h2l1: Seɖoƒe na agbɔsɔsɔme: Agbagbadzedze 10 siwo do kpo nu le sɛkɛnd 60 ɖesiaɖe me le IP ɖesiaɖe me. Exceeding trɔna 429 kple `Retry-After` tanya.
auth.h2l2: Akɔntabubu ƒe mɔxexe: agbagbadzedze 20 siwo do kpo nu le 24 h me de dzesi akɔnta la hena admin ƒe ŋkuléle ɖe eŋu. Legit zãlawo ɖeko password-reset woƒe mɔ yi.
auth.h2l3: Session tracking: `/api/authentication/devices` ŋlɔ ɣeyiɣi siwo katã le dɔ wɔm; zãla ate ŋu ate fli ɖe ɖesiaɖe me.
auth.h3p1: Ne mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi la gogo eƒe nuwuwu (asitsalawo léa ŋku ɖe `exp` ŋu le nutoa me) alo ne biabia aɖe trɔ gbɔ 401 kple `dzesi ƒe ɣeyiɣi wu enu` la, asitsala la ɖoa `POST /api/authentication/refresh` kple `{refresh_token}`.
auth.h3p2: Node ɖea refresh la gɔme, léa ŋku ɖe `jti` gakpɔtɔ li le `user_devices` (womeɖe asi le eŋu o), léa ŋku ɖe `exp` ŋu, eye wò mints mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi yeye.
auth.h3p3: Gbugbɔgaɖɔɖo ƒe tɔtrɔ tsi le gɔmedzedzea me. Nawɔ dɔ kple `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` be nàɖe gbugbɔgawɔ yeye hã ɖe go.
auth.h3p4: Ne refresh la wu enu, woɖe asi le eŋu, alo wowɔ aʋatso la, node trɔna 401. Client doa go le teƒea eye wòbiaa be woagage ɖe eme ake.
