auth.h4p1: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe asisiwo ate ŋu ade agbalẽ me na mɔ̃dzikpɔƒe ƒe kpeɖodzi (Ka asi ID, Mo ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric). Server dzraa `{ɖaseɖiɖi_id, dutoƒo_safui, xexlẽdzesi}` ɖo.
auth.h4p2: Ge ɖe eme: `POST /api/ɖaseɖiɖi/passkey/dze egɔme` → dɔdzikpɔla trɔa kuxi; asisiwo dea asi kple passkey private (si le Secure Enclave / TPM); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → dɔdzikpɔla ɖoa kpe edzi eye wòɖea JWT ɖe go.
auth.h4p3: Counter monotonicity check: ele be kpeɖodzi ɖesiaɖe nadzi counter la ɖe edzi. Ne mewɔe o la, wobua passkey la be enye cloned eye wogbee.
auth.h5p1: Abe afɔku-gbugbɔgaxɔ mɔ ene la, ezãla ateŋu aɖo nya 24 ƒe BIP-39 nuku ɖe duta. Etsɔtsɔ va mɔ̃ ɖesiaɖe dzi gbugbɔa X25519 ƒe dzesidenu (nuku → HKDF → static key) ɖoa kpe edzi eye wòɖoa kpe edzi be ele ame si to gbetɔame si wode asi na dzi.
auth.h5p2: Nuku medzona le mɔ̃a me gbeɖe o. Node la kpɔa X25519 dutoƒo safui si woɖe tso eme kple asidede agbalẽ te le server ƒe kuxi aɖe dzi ko.
auth.h5p3: Entropi: 256 bits (32 byte) ƒe lolome. BIP-39 checksum nye standard, eyata woléa typos hafi ɖoa server la gbɔ.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) kple afɔɖeɖe siwo nye s 30 kple xexlẽdzesi 6 ƒe kɔdawo. Tiatiawɔblɔɖe na zãla ɖesiaɖe.
auth.h6p2: Ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` trɔa nya ɣaɣla + otpauth URI + QR. Zãla tsɔa Google Dzesidede / Authy / 1Password skan. Zãla la ɖoa xexlẽdzesi 6 ƒe kpɔɖeŋu kɔpi aɖe ɖe megbe tsɔ ɖoa ​​kpe edzi be dɔwɔnua le dɔ wɔm.
auth.h6p3: Ge ɖe eme kple 2FA: ne nyagbe ɣaɣla va yi vɔ la, node trɔna `{needs_2fa: nyateƒe}`. Asitsaha bia be yeatsɔ kɔda aɖe eye yeaɖoe ɖe `/api/authentication/login/2fa`.
auth.h6p4: Seɖoƒe na agbɔsɔsɔme: 5 TOTP agbagbadzedze le miniti 5 ɖesiaɖe zãla ɖesiaɖe. Ne ègbɔ eme la, eʋãa sɛkɛnd 60 ƒe fafa kple nuxlɔ̃ame to e-mail dzi.
auth.h6p5: Backup codes: 12 × 10-digit code siwo woɖena fiana zi ɖeka le ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ me. Woate ŋu azã kɔda ɖesiaɖe zi ɖeka pɛpɛpɛ.
auth.h7: QR gege ɖe eme (akɔnta ɖeka me ƒoƒo ƒu ɖekae) .
auth.h7p1: Telefon si ge ɖe eme ate ŋu age ɖe tablɛt yeye si ŋu QR ƒe dzesi le la me. Mɔ̃ A ɖoa `POST /api/authentication/qr/begin` → dɔdzikpɔla trɔa nonce kple TTL.
auth.h7p2: Mɔ̃ A ɖea QR si me `nonce + user_id + server_url` le la fiana. Mɔ̃ B skan eye wòɖoa `POST /api/authentication/qr/verify` kple nonce la.
auth.h7p3: Server ɖo kpe edzi be nonce gakpɔtɔ le agbe (TTL 60 s, one-shot), blaa mɔ̃ B ƒe X25519 pubkey yeyea ɖe zãla A ƒe akɔnta ŋu (`user_devices` fli yeye), eye wòtrɔna JWT yia mɔ̃ B gbɔ.
auth.h7p4: Mɔ̃ A xɔa WebSocket nyatakaka `{type:"n", event:"new_device"}` ale be zãla nate ŋu aɖo kpe edzi / ate fli ɖe eme le ɣeyiɣi ŋutɔŋutɔ me.
auth.h8p1: Míeɖoe koŋ trɔa vodada ma ke na "zãla ƒe ŋkɔ si womenya o" kple "nyagbe si mesɔ o". Seɖoƒe siwo woɖo na amewo be woade asi agbalẽ te ɣlaa zãla ƒe ŋkɔ siwo li.
auth.h8p2: Profile ƒe nuwuƒewo (`/api/users/{username}`) hiã auth. Attacker mateŋu axlẽ zãla ƒe ŋkɔwo dzesi si sɔ manɔmee o.
auth.h8p3: Rate limit le `/api/authentication/login` dzi léa brute force ɖe crawl dzi.
auth.h1_a: Ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ wɔa dzesidenu yeye: X25519 keypair le mɔ̃a dzi, Argon2id password hash le server la dzi, JWT pair si woɖe ɖe go le dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ me.
auth.h1_b: Afɔɖeɖe 1: asisi ƒua du `crypto.randomBytes(32)` na X25519 ame ŋutɔ ƒe safui, xɔa dutoƒo safui (~100 μs le telefon dzi). Afɔɖeɖe 2: POST /api/ɖaseɖiɖi/ŋlɔ ŋkɔ kple `{zãla ƒe ŋkɔ, nyagbegbɔgblɔ, x25519_dutoƒo_safui, ɖeɖefia_ŋkɔ, telefon, e-mail, avatar_emoji}`. Afɔɖeɖe 3: node ɖo kpe edzi to Pydantic (zãla ƒe ŋkɔ regex, nyagbe ɣaɣla ≥ 8 chars, telefon E.164, e-mail RFC-5322-lite). Afɔɖeɖe 4: node ƒua du Argon2id (nyagbegbɔgblɔ) → `argon2:...`, dzrana ɖo ɖe `zãlawo.nyagbe_hash`. Afɔɖeɖe 5: node na mɔɖeɖe JWT (15 min) + gbugbɔgawɔ JWT (ŋkeke 30), nɔa anyi ɖe `zãla_mɔ̃wo` fli.
auth.h1_c: Sisi la nye egbegbe nɔnɔmetɔtrɔ le PHP ƒe mysql_real_escape_string ɣeyiɣia me. Egbegbe auth stack ɖesiaɖe — Auth0, Firebase, Supabase — wɔa nɔnɔme sia teti. Trɔtrɔ tɔxɛ si le Vortex me enye X25519 pubkey la ɖoɖo ɖa le ŋkɔ yɔyɔ me: efia be wobla akɔnta la ɖe ɣeyiɣi didi ƒe E2E dzesidenu ŋu tso frame ɖeka me, wometsɔe kpee emegbe o. Signal ƒe ƒe 2013 ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ ye ʋãe.
auth.h2_a: Login ɖoa kpe nyagbea dzi le Argon2 hash si wodzra ɖo la nu eye wònaa JWT eve yeye ne esɔ.
auth.h2_b: POST /api/ɖaseɖiɖi/ge ɖe eme kple `{zãla ƒe ŋkɔ, nyagbegbɔgblɔ}`. Node biaa `zãlawo` to zãla ƒe ŋkɔ suewo me. Ne wokpɔe la, eɖoa kpe Argon2id dzi le ɣeyiɣi madzudzɔmadzudzɔe me ɖe `users.password_hash` ŋu. Ne womekpɔe o la, egawɔa dummy Argon2 verify ɖe ka si nɔa anyi ɖaa ŋu be wòana ɣeyiɣi nasɔ. Dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ → yeye JWT eve + yeye `zãla_mɔ̃wo` fli (ɖeka le mɔ̃ si ge ɖe eme ɖesiaɖe me). Dodokpɔ → 401 kple "ɖaseɖigbalẽ siwo mesɔ o" si nye generic — vovototo aɖeke mele zãla ƒe ŋkɔ gbegblẽ kple nyagbe gbegblẽ dome o, be woatsi tre ɖe xexlẽdzesiwo ŋu.
auth.h2_c: Ɣesiaɣi ƒe kpeɖodzinana kple dummy hashing na zãla siwo meli o nye kpɔɖeŋu si Signal xɔ le ƒe 2014 me le esi numekulawo ɖe ɣeyiɣi ƒe xexlẽdzesi fia le woƒe gege ɖe eme ƒe nuwuƒe vɔ megbe. Tso ɣemaɣi la, woxɔe le afisiafi — django-axes, authelia, Keycloak katã zãnɛ. Nuwɔna la tsɔa ~0.5 s kpena ɖe gege ɖe eme ƒe agbagbadzedze ɖesiaɖe si do kpo nu ŋu, si nyo; míeɖoa seɖoƒe na gege ɖe eme le 10/min/IP to mɔ sia mɔ nu.
auth.h2_f:
dummy_hash = Argon2id ("__ɣeyiɣi_si_sɔ__", dze = woɖɔe ɖo, ...)

gege ɖe eme (u, p): .
  row = zãlawo.di (zãla ƒe ŋkɔ = u.lower ())
  ne fli nye Ðeke meli o:
      Argon2Verify (dummy_hash, p) // na ɣeyiɣi ƒe didime nasɔ
      dzi 401 ɖe dzi
  ne menye Argon2Verify (fli.nyagbe_hash, p): .
      dzi 401 ɖe dzi
  trɔ asi le nya_jwt (fli) ŋu.
auth.h3_a: Mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesiwo nu yina le miniti 15 megbe. Refresh ɖɔlia refresh token si nɔa anyi didi kple mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi yeye evɔ megabia zãla la be wòagblɔ eƒe nyagbe ɣaɣla o.
auth.h3_b: Asitsaha léa ŋku ɖe `exp` ŋu le nutoa me. Ne `fifia + 30s > exp`, alo ne biabia aɖe trɔ 401 kple `token_expired` la, asisi la POST gbugbɔgawɔ ƒe dzesi la ɖe `/api/authentication/refresh`. Node decodes, léa ŋku ɖe `jti` le `user_devices` me eye menye `revoked_at` me o, léa ŋku ɖe `exp` ŋu, eye wòmints aɖabaƒoƒo 15 ƒe mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi yeye. Gbugbɔgaɖɔli ƒe tɔtrɔ nye tiatia-ɖe eme to `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` — tsi le gɔmedzedzea me elabena tɔtrɔ gbugbɔgawɔ dzesiwo le mɔɖeɖe gbugbɔgawɔ ɖesiaɖe me wɔa duɖimekeke ne asisi eve gbugbɔ gbugbɔgawɔ le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) to mɔɖeɖe + gbugbɔgawɔ ƒe mama vɛ. Aɖabaƒoƒo 15 ƒe mɔɖeɖe ƒe agbenɔƒe nye titina le dɔwɔƒea katã — Google zãa gaƒoƒo 1, Auth0 zãa ​​gaƒoƒo 24, Okta zãa gaƒoƒo 1. Míetia miniti 15 be míaɖe fesre si me mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi si wofi la ɖea vi le la dzi akpɔtɔ. Ŋkeke 30 ƒe gbugbɔgawɔ sɔ kple nusi asitelefon dzi dɔwɔɖoɖo akpa gãtɔ hiã be ezãlawo nate ŋu age ɖe eme le ɣleti ɖeka ƒe dɔmawɔmawɔ me.
auth.h4_a: WebAuthn / passkey ƒe gege ɖe eme zãa platform ƒe kpeɖodzinamɔ̃ (Ka asi ID, Mo ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric) ɖe nyagbegbɔgblɔ teƒe.
auth.h4_b: Ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ: server ɖoa kuxi aɖe ɖe afima; client ƒe authenticator wɔa keypair yeye le eƒe secure enclave me eye wòɖoa public key + attestation ɖa. Server dzraa `{ɖaseɖiɖi_id, dutoƒo_safui, xexlẽdzesi}` ɖo. Ge ɖe eme: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → dɔdzikpɔla trɔa kuxi aɖe; asitsalawo dea asi agbalẽ te kple ɖaseɖiɖila ƒe safui si nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ (si le Secure Enclave me, medzona le chip la me gbeɖe o); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → dɔdzikpɔla ɖoa kpe asidede agbalẽ te dzi ɖe dutoƒo safui si wodzra ɖo la nu. Xexlẽdzesi si ƒe gbeɖiɖi le ɖeka dea dzesi kpeɖodzinu siwo wowɔ le wo ɖokui si.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn nye esi W3C ɖoe ɖe ɖoɖo nu le ƒe 2019 me le ƒe geɖe ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si FIDO Nubabla la wɔ megbe. Apple tsɔ platform-authenticator ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu kpe ɖe eŋu le iOS 16 (2022); Google, Microsoft, 1Nyagbe ɣaɣla kplɔe ɖo. Vortex xɔ WebAuthn le v0.0.8 me. Enye tiatia gake wokafui vevie — passkey zãlawo mekpɔa phishing-based account takeover gbeɖe o elabena private key metsoa device ƒe liƒo gbeɖe o.
auth.h4_f:
register_begin (): kuxi = rand (32) .
                    tiatia = { rp.id, zãla.id, pubKeyCredParams, kuxi }
                    tɔtrɔgbɔ ƒe tiatiawɔblɔɖewo

register_finish (ɖaseɖiɖi): .
  ɖo kpe ɖaseɖiɖi dzi le TPM / Dedienɔnɔ Enclave ke CA .
  store { ɖaseɖigbalẽ_id, dutoƒo_safui, xexlẽdzesi: 0 } .
auth.h5_a: Nuku-nyagbewo gbugbɔgaxɔ gbugbɔa X25519 dzesidenu la ɖoa mɔ̃ yeye dzi tso nya 24 ƒe BIP-39 ŋkuɖodzinu me. Mebia tso server la si gbeɖe be wòalé nyatakaka aɖeke si wotsɔ ɖea nyatakakawo gɔme o.
auth.h5_b: Zãla ŋlɔa ŋkuɖodzinu la ɖi le eƒe dodo zi gbãtɔ me (elɔ̃na, zi ɖeka ƒe nyabiase). Be nàhaya: le mɔ̃ yeye dzi la, ezãla gena ɖe ŋkuɖodzinu la me; asisi ƒua du PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(ŋkuɖodzinya, "ŋkuɖoɖonudzi", 2048 ƒoƒo) → 64 bytes ƒe nuku. Nukua ƒe byte 32 gbãtɔwo va zua X25519 ame ŋutɔ ƒe safui; woɖe dutoƒo safui. Dutoƒo safui yeyea koe wogblɔna na server; etsɔa Ed25519 challenge-response (si wode asi nonce) ɖoa kpe nusiwo le ame si dzi, emegbe enaa JWTwo.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Bitcoin Improvement Proposal 39, 2013) nye canonical mɔnu si dzi woato aŋlɔ nya ɣaɣlawo abe nyawo ƒe xexlẽdzesi siwo dzi woaɖo ŋkui ene. Eŋlisigbe me nya 2048 ƒe nyagɔmeɖegbalẽ si me 4-byte checksum le le eƒe nuwuwu. Vortex zãa nya 24 elabena dɔwɔƒea ƒe dzidzenu na gakotoku siwo ŋu dedienɔnɔ le ŋutɔ (Trezor, Ledger) nye 24. Nya 12 asɔ gbɔ na 128-bit dedienɔnɔ gake medzena nu vevi aɖeke na ezãla akpa gãtɔ o.
auth.h5_f:
nyawo = BIP39_Encode (entropy=256_bits + 8_bit_checksum)
nuku = PBKDF2-SHA512(nyawo, "ŋkuɖodzinu", gogloeƒewo=2048, len=64)
sk = nuku [0:32] // X25519 ame ŋutɔ tɔ
pk = sk · G // X25519 dutoƒo
auth.h6_a: Nu eve ƒe kpeɖodzinana tsɔa ɣeyiɣi ɖeka ƒe nyagbegbɔgblɔ (TOTP) ƒe afɔɖeɖe kpena ɖe nyagbe ɣaɣla ƒe kpeɖodzinana megbe.
auth.h6_b: Ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` → server wɔa 160-bit random nya ɣaɣla, trɔnɛ abe base32 ka + otpauth:// URI na QR scanning. Zãla tsɔa Google Dzesidede / Authy / 1Password skan; posts back a sample 6-digit code be wòaɖo kpe edzi be ɖoɖoa wɔ dɔ. Ge ɖe eme: ne nyagbe ɣaɣla va yi vɔ la, dɔdzikpɔla trɔna `{needs_2fa: true}` ɖe JWTs teƒe. Asitsaha bia be yeaxɔ xexlẽdzesi 6 ƒe kɔda kple POSTs `/api/authentication/login/2fa`. Server ɖo kpe HOTP(nya ɣaɣla, T=fifia_unix / 30) dzi ɖe kɔdasia ŋu.
auth.h6_c: TOTP nye RFC 6238 le ƒe 2011 me to Mark Pei dzi. Do ŋgɔ na ema la, RSA SecurID zãa mɔnu si nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ; emegbe la, 2FA app ɖesiaɖe nɔ anyi ɖe TOTP dzi. Vortex ƒe sɛkɛnd 30 ƒe afɔɖeɖe kple xexlẽdzesi 6 ƒe didime nye RFC ƒe gɔmedzedze. Wodo backup codes (12 × 10-digit, woɖee fia zi ɖeka) tso GitHub ƒe design tso ƒe 2012 me.
auth.h6_f:
nya ɣaɣla = rand (20 bytes) // 160 bits ɖesiaɖe RFC 6238
TOTP(nya ɣaɣla, t) = HOTP(nya ɣaɣla, ⌊t / 30⌋)
HOTP(k, c) = lãɖeɖe( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106

fesre: ±1 afɔɖeɖe si woɖe mɔ na na gaƒoɖokui ƒe skew
auth.h7_a: QR login tsɔa mɔ̃ yeye aɖe ƒoa ƒu ɖe akɔnta si li xoxo me evɔ megaŋlɔa nyagbea ake o. Telefon si ge ɖe eme xoxo la dea asi nonce si mɔ̃ yeyea zãna tsɔ ɖoa ​​kpe edzii te.
auth.h7_b: Mɔ̃ A ɖoa `/api/ɖaseɖiɖi/qr/dze egɔme`. Server wɔa 128-bit nonce kple TTL 60s, blanɛ ɖe A ƒe user_id ŋu, trɔnɛ vɛ. A ɖea nonce si woŋlɔ ɖe kɔpi me abe QR (si me `nonce + user_id + server_url` hã le). Mɔ̃ B skan, ɖoa `/api/authentication/qr/verify` kple nonce la. Server: nonce valid kple ɖeka-tu? Tsɔ B ƒe X25519 pubkey yeyea do ƒome kple user_id (yeye `user_devices` fli), mint JWTs na B. Mɔ̃ A xɔa WebSocket nyatakaka ale be zãla nate ŋu akpɔe eye wòate fli ɖe eme le eɖokui si.
auth.h7_c: QR-si wotu ɖe evewɔwɔ dzi la xɔ ŋkɔ zi gbãtɔ to WhatsApp Web dzi le ƒe 2015. Telegram kplɔe ɖo; Signal kɔpie hena woƒe mɔ̃ geɖe ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu le ƒe 2021. Vortex ƒe tɔtrɔ: evewɔwɔ ƒe nudzɔdzɔ ɖesiaɖe dona ɖe mɔ̃ gbãtɔa dzi kple "ɖo kpe edzi" ƒe dzesi, eyata amedzidzela si lé QR tso screenshot me mateŋu awu evewɔwɔ nu zãla ƒe kadodo manɔmee le mɔ̃ A dzi o.
auth.h8_a: Akɔntabubu ƒe tsitretsitsi — auth ta ƒe akpa aɖe. Esia nye mɔnu vevi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Vortex ƒe nufiame bliboa me la dometɔ ɖeka. Xlẽ ta si ƒo xlãe hena nya siwo ƒo xlãe si keke ta wu; akpa sia dzia nuwɔna tɔxɛa ɖe edzi.
auth.h8_b: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe wɔwɔfia na "Akɔntabubu ƒe tsitretsitsi". Wowɔa mɔ̃a ŋudɔ le module si sɔ me le `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, alo `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` te. Module README yɔa faɛl mɔ siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
auth.h8_c: "Akɔntabubu ƒe tsitretsitsi" mɔnu la trɔ le Vortex ƒe asiɖeɖe le eŋu me. Aɖaŋu si wowɔ la tso numekuku kple ewɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu siwo wota siwo dɔla siwo do ŋgɔ wɔ la gbɔ. Version ŋutinya le `CHANGELOG.md` me ŋlɔa ɣeyiɣi si me akpa ɖesiaɖe ɖi kple nusi ʋãe.

rooms.title: Xɔwo kple gbedasiwo ɖoɖo ɖe amewo
rooms.subtitle: Xɔ eneawo ƒomevi, hamevinyenye, safuiwo ƒe tɔtrɔ, gbedasiwo.
rooms.intro: Xɔ eneawo katã ƒomevi — DM, ame ŋutɔ ƒe ƒuƒoƒo, dutoƒo ƒuƒoƒo, mɔ̃ — ma `xɔwo` kplɔ̃ ɖeka si le ete. Nuwɔna nye agbo to boolean aflagawo dzi.
rooms.h1p1: **DM**: hamevi eve pɛpɛpɛ, `nye_dm=nyateƒe`, `nye_ame ŋutɔ=nyateƒe`. Ŋkɔ auto-set ɖe hamevi kemɛa ƒe asiléƒe.
rooms.h1p2: **Ƒuƒoƒo si nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ**: amekpekpe-ko, `nye_ame ŋutɔ tɔ=nyateƒe`, `nye_mɔ̃ = alakpa`. Max 5000 hameviwo le gɔmedzedzea me.
rooms.h1p3: **Dukɔa ƒe ƒuƒoƒo**: `nye_ame ŋutɔ tɔ=aʋatso`. Amesiame si si amekpekpe ƒe kadodo le ate ŋu awɔ ɖeka kplii; woŋlɔ ɖe dutoƒonudzraɖoƒea ne aƒetɔa tiae be yeawɔe.
rooms.h1p4: **Channel**: nyadzɔdzɔwo ɖeɖeko, `is_channel=nyateƒe`. Aƒetɔwo/adminwo koe ateŋu aɖo nyatakakawo ɖe amewo; hamevi siwo nɔa anyi edziedzi xlẽa nu.
rooms.h2: Hamea me nɔnɔ kple akpa siwo wowɔna
rooms.h2p1: Dɔ siwo wowɔna: `aƒetɔ`, `admin`, `hamevi`. Aƒetɔ ɖeka koe le xɔ ɖeka me (woate ŋu ade dɔ asi na wo).
rooms.h2p2: Admins ateŋu akpe, aƒo afɔkpodzi, azi ɖoɖoe, eye woatrɔ asi le xɔa ƒe ɖoɖowo ŋu. Hameviwo ateŋu aɖo gbedasiwo, awɔ nu ɖe ​​wo ŋu, atrɔ asi le wo ɖokui ŋu, atutu wo ŋutɔ tɔ.
rooms.h2p3: Mɔɖeɖewo cascade: aƒetɔwo si admin ŋusẽ ɖesiaɖe. Admins mateŋu aɖe aƒetɔa dzi akpɔtɔ o.
rooms.h2p4: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe tɔtrɔwo naa ɖoɖo ƒe gbedasi (`ƒomevi: "role_changed"`) si wokpɔna na hamevi ɖesiaɖe.
rooms.h3p1: Xɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe 32-byte **root key** si wowɔ le nuwɔwɔ me to `secrets.token_bytes(32)` dzi le wɔla ƒe mɔ̃ dzi.
rooms.h3p2: Hamevi ɖesiaɖe xɔa agbalẽkotoku `{hamevi_id, agbalẽkotoku: X25519_encrypt(hamevi_pubkey, ke_safui)}` si wodzra ɖo ɖe `xɔme_safuiwo` me.
rooms.h3p3: Ne hamevi aɖe va kpe ɖe eŋu la, hamevi ɖesiaɖe si li xoxo ƒe asisi wɔa agbalẽkotoku yeye na wo. Envelope minting nye O(1) le join ɖesiaɖe me.
rooms.h3p4: Ne hamevi aɖe dzo la, xɔa trɔna: wɔla (alo gbãtɔ si le dɔ wɔm) xɔa ke yeye, gbugbɔa agbalẽkotokuwo na hamevi susɔeawo, ɖoa `{type:"k", xɔ:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` to WebSocket dzi. Ciphertext xoxoa nɔa xlẽm kple safui xoxo si asisiwo gakpɔtɔ le cach me.
rooms.h3l1: Variant-B key publish: na dutoƒoxɔ siwo me hamevi > 1000 le la, agbalẽkotokuwo dzudzɔa scaling. Ke boŋ, aƒetɔa dea asi ke ƒe safui si li fifia te eye wòtae ɖe `room_public_keys` kplɔ̃a dzi. Asitsalawo ɖoa kpe asidede agbalẽ te dzi le xɔa tɔ ƒe ahadzraƒe ƒe safui dzi. Eyata tɔtrɔ le hameviwo ƒe mɔkeke dzi nye no-op na Variant-B xɔwo.
rooms.h3l2: Per-room pseudo: xɔ ɖesiaɖe hã ƒe `room_pseudo_salt` le esi. Hameviwo ƒe ŋkɔ bubu siwo le gbedasiwo me nye `HMAC-SHA256(dze, zãla_id)` si wotso ɖe hex chars 16 me. Node mateŋu anya zãla si ɖo gbedasi ɖa asitsaha ƒe akpa ƒe nɔnɔmetata manɔmee o.
rooms.h4p1: Gbedasiwo ƒe ID siwo nye monotonic le xɔ ɖesiaɖe me (64-bit auto-increment, `bigserial` le Postgres me, `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` le SQLite me).
rooms.h4p2: Nudɔdɔ nye nusi server-de asi na. Asisiwo mewɔa avu le ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesiwo ta o; woɖea nu gɔme le ID ƒe ɖoɖo nu eye woɖea amesi ɖoe ɖa ƒe gli-gaƒoɖokui ƒe ɣeyiɣi fiana abe UI metadata ɖeɖeko ene.
rooms.h4p3: Trɔ asi le eŋu: nya ɣaɣla yeye xɔ ɖe xoxo le teƒe, `edited_at` ƒe yeyewɔwɔ teƒe. Asitsalawo ɖea `(wotrɔ asi le)` dzesi fiana.
rooms.h4p4: Tsɔe ɖa: ɖo `tutu_le`, null out ciphertext. `{type:"m", woɖe:nyateƒe}` gbeƒãɖeɖe.
rooms.h4p5: Ŋuɖoɖowo: `reply_to` = gbedasi id si ŋu woƒo nu tsoe. Asitsalawo ɖea nyayɔyɔ ƒe tanya sue aɖe gɔme.
rooms.h5p1: Nuwɔnawo nye fliwo le `nuwɔnawo (gbedasi_id, zãla_id, emoji, wowɔ_le)`. Asitsaha ƒe POSTs `/api/gbedasiwo/{id}/nuwɔnawo/{emoji}`. DELETE na nusiwo mewɔa nu o.
rooms.h5p2: Node fans out `{type:"m", reactions:[...]}` na nudɔla ɖesiaɖe. Asitsalawo ƒoa ƒu.
rooms.h5p3: Mɔxexeɖedɔ aɖeke mele emoji ŋu o — Unicode ɖesiaɖe. Asitsalawo de-dupe kple render xexlẽmewo.
rooms.h6p1: Ka nye alakpaxɔ si ƒo ke ɖe to ɖe gbedasi aɖe me. `POST /api/messages/{id}/thread` wɔa `{id: <xɔ_yeye_id>, dzila_gbedasi_id: <msg_id>, dzila_xɔ_id: <gɔmedzedze>}`.
rooms.h6p2: Kaxɔwo nyia hamevinyenye ƒe dome tso dzila gbɔ. Dzila-xɔmetɔ ɖesiaɖe ate ŋu aŋlɔ nu ɖe ​​ka ɖesiaɖe me.
rooms.h6p3: Safui ƒe dzɔtsoƒe: ka ƒe ke safui = `HKDF(dzila_ke, nyatakaka: "ka:" + <dzila_gbedasi_id>, len: 32)`. Compromise of the thread key mewɔa leak dzila o.
rooms.h7p1: Admins ateŋu awɔ pin vaseɖe gbedasi 10 le xɔ ɖeka me. `POST /api/xɔwo/{id}/pin` kple `{gbedasi_id}`.
rooms.h7p2: Wotsɔa pinned set dea agba me le xɔ si le ʋuʋu ɖi dzi; asisiwo ɖea tanya si wotsɔ pin wɔe le etame.
rooms.h8p1: Xɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo gakpɔtɔ le node la dzi: `PUT /api/rooms/{id}/draft` kple `{text}`. `GET` trɔna fifia. `DELETE` kɔe.
rooms.h8p2: Asitsalawo wɔa nuŋlɔɖiwo ɖekae le mɔ̃wo dzi ale be nuŋɔŋlɔ le telefon dzi wu enu le kɔmpiuta dzi. Wometsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ɣla tso nuwuwu vaseɖe nuwuwu o — wonye nuŋɔŋlɔ gbadza si woate ŋu akpɔ le server dzi. Ema nye asitsatsa si woɖo koŋ wɔ na cross-device UX. Zãla siwo tsi tre ɖe eŋu ate ŋu axe mɔ ɖe sync per-room nu.
rooms.h9: Gbedasɛ siwo woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu
rooms.h9p1: `POST /api/ɖoɖowɔɖi` kple `{xɔ_id, nya ɣaɣla, dɔdɔ_le}`. Node dzraa nu ɖo le `scheduled_messages` me; cron dɔwɔla aɖe tsɔ eɖokui na ɖe game dzi.
rooms.h9p2: Woateŋu atrɔ asi le eŋu eye woateŋu ate fli ɖe eme vaseɖe esime send_at tick la natɔ dzo. Le eɖoɖo vɔ megbe la, gbedasi la zua fli dzro aɖe le `gbedasiwo` me.
rooms.h1_a: Xɔ eneawo katã (DM, ame ŋutɔ ƒe ƒuƒoƒo, dutoƒo ƒuƒoƒo, mɔ̃) ma `xɔwo` kplɔ̃ ɖeka. Vovototo le boolean aflaga etɔ̃ me.
rooms.h1_b: Aflagawo: `nye_dm`, `nye_ame ŋutɔ tɔ`, `nye_mɔ̃`. DM: is_dm=nyateƒe, is_private=nyateƒe, hamevi 2 pɛpɛpɛ. Ƒuƒoƒo si nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ: is_private=true, is_channel=false, vaseɖe hamevi 5000. Dutoƒo ƒuƒoƒo: is_private=aʋatso, woŋlɔe ɖe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe ne aƒetɔ tiae. Channel: is_channel=true, aƒetɔwo/admins koe ŋlɔa. Wo katã woama safuiwo dzikpɔkpɔ, fan-out, reactions, threads.
rooms.h1_c: Single-table polymorphism nye kpɔɖeŋu si tso Martin Fowler ƒe *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002) me. Telegram zãa xɔ ƒomevi vovovo etɔ̃ le ememe; Slack zãa channels + DMs + multi-party DMs abe ƒomevi ene ene; Discord zãa "channels" na nusianu. Míetia kplɔ̃ ɖeka le profiling megbe ɖee fia be gazazã vevitɔe nye fan-out (si sɔ le ƒomeviwo katã me) eye le v0.0.3 refactor ƒo kplɔ̃ etɔ̃ siwo sɔ kple wo nɔewo nu ƒu ɖe ɖeka megbe.
rooms.h1_f:
CREATE TABLE xɔwo (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, .
  ƒomevi VARCHAR(16), -- domenyinu, si mehiã o kple aflagawo
  ŋkɔ VARCHAR(256), .
  nye_ame ŋutɔ tɔ BOOLEAN, .
  nye_mɔ̃ BOOLEAN, .
  nye_dm BOOLEAN, .
  hameviwo ƒe xexlẽme INT, .
  avatar_url VARCHAR (512) ƒe ɣleti gbãtɔ me.
  wowɔ_le TIMESTAMP, .
  wowɔ_to BIGINT REFERENCES zãlawo(id) .
);
rooms.h2_a: Dɔwo le etɔ̃ me: aƒetɔ, admin, hamevi. Aƒetɔ ɖeka pɛpɛpɛ le xɔ ɖeka me, admin ɖeka ya teti, hamevi geɖe le wo ɖokui si.
rooms.h2_b: `xɔ_members (xɔ_id, zãla_id, akpa, joined_at, muted_vaseɖe)`. Roles cascade: aƒetɔwo le admin ŋusẽ ɖesiaɖe. Admins ateŋu akpe, aƒo afɔkpodzi, azi nu, eye woatrɔ asi le xɔa ƒe ɖoɖowo ŋu gake womateŋu aɖe aƒetɔa ɖe anyi o. Hameviwo ateŋu aɖo gbedasiwo, awɔ nu ɖe ​​wo ŋu, atrɔ asi le wo ɖokui ŋu, atutu wo ŋutɔ tɔ. Aƒetɔ ƒe tɔtrɔ to `PATCH /api/rooms/{id}` dzi kple `new_owner_id` — aƒetɔ xoxoa ɖiɖina ɖe admin.
rooms.h2_c: Aƒetɔ/aƒedzikpɔla/hamevi nye akpa etɔ̃ ƒe IRC op/gbe/zãla ƒe kpɔɖeŋu tso ƒe 1988 me, si Slack, Discord, Telegram va xɔ emegbe. Tiatia tɔxɛ si nye be aƒetɔ ɖeka tututu nanɔ ame si (menye ame geɖe o) tso senyawo ŋu bubu me: le ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe siwo me ƒuƒoƒo ƒe agbanɔamedzi ƒe sewo le la, aƒetɔ ɖeka si me kɔ ƒe amesinɔnɔ nana DMCA kple biabia mawo tɔgbe nɔa bɔbɔe.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE xɔmetɔwo (
  xɔ_dzesi BIGINT, .
  zãla_dzesi BIGINT, .
  akpa VARCHAR(16) CHECK(dɔ IN ('aƒetɔ','aƒedzikpɔla','hamevi')),
  wowɔ ɖeka_le TIMESTAMP, .
  muted_vaseɖe TIMESTAMP, .
  PRIMARY KEY (xɔme_dzesi, zãla_dzesi)
);
rooms.h3_a: Ke ƒe safui si ƒe didime nye byte 32 si sɔ kple wo nɔewo le xɔ ɖesiaɖe me. Hameviwo lé kɔpi siwo woxatsa ɖe woƒe X25519 pubkey te.
rooms.h3_b: Le nuwɔwɔ me la, asisi wɔa `root_key = secrets.token_bytes (32)`. Le hamevi ɖesiaɖe gome la, asisi tsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ɣla `root_key` le `X25519(member_pubkey)` → agbalẽkotoku te. Envelopes nɔa agbe le `xɔ_safuiwo(xɔ_id, zãla_id, agbalẽkotoku)`. Ne zãla aɖe va kpe ɖe eŋu la, hamevi ɖesiaɖe si li xoxo ƒe asisi ƒoa agbalẽkotoku yeye na wo. Ne zãla aɖe dzo la, aƒetɔ alo dɔdzikpɔla gbãtɔ si le dɔ wɔm la trɔna — wɔa root_key yeye, gbugbɔa agbalẽkotokuwo na hamevi susɔeawo, eɖea gbeƒã `{type:"k", room:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` ɖe WebSocket dzi.
rooms.h3_c: Per-member wrapping nye kpɔɖeŋu si Signal dze mɔɖeɖedɔa gɔme le ƒe 2014 me na eƒe ƒuƒoƒowo-v2. Matrix ƒe Megolm zãa "dɔla ƒe safuiwo" ƒe mɔnu ma tɔgbe. Vortex yi kple hamevi ɖesiaɖe ƒe agbalẽkotokuwo elabena ele bɔbɔe wu be woabu tame le: nya ɣaɣla aɖeke si yi ŋgɔ le amedɔdɔwo dome o. Asitsatsae nye O(N) envelope minting le hamevinyenye ƒe tɔtrɔ ŋu, si nyo vaseɖe ~5000 hameviwo; public-channel Variant-B ƒoa asa na seɖoƒea.
rooms.h3_f:
le wɔwɔ dzi:
  ke_safui = rand (32) .
  na m le hameviwo me:
    agbalẽkotoku [m] = X25519_Encrypt (m.pubkey, ke_safui)

le mɔkeke dzi:
  ke_yeye = rand (32) .
  rebroadcast(envelope yeyewo na hamevi susɔeawo)
rooms.h4_a: Variant-B key publish tsɔa safui ɖeka si wode asi ete, si woda ɖe kplɔ̃ si dzi amewo xlẽna dzi la ɖɔlia hamevi ɖesiaɖe ƒe agbalẽkotokuwo. Nudanu na 100k+ hameviwo.
rooms.h4_b: Le O(N) envelope minting teƒe la, aƒetɔa dea asi root_key te eye wòɖoa nyatakakawo ɖe `room_public_keys(room_id, key, signed_by, signed_at)`. Asitsalawo xɔa, ɖoa kpe edzi ɖe aƒetɔa ƒe Ed25519 pubkey ŋu, eye wozãnɛ. Rotation nye no-op na hamevinyenye ƒe tɔtrɔ — amesiame si si safuia nɔ la gakpɔtɔ le esi ne wotu afɔkpo wo gɔ̃ hã. Ema sɔ na dutoƒo gbeƒãɖeɖe-mɔ̃ siwo me "ŋutinya goglo" menye ŋɔdzinu ƒe kpɔɖeŋu o gake kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔ kple lolome nye.
rooms.h4_c: Wowɔ tɔtrɔ-B ƒe kpɔɖeŋu ɖe Matrix ƒe "xexeame si woateŋu axlẽ" ŋutinya dzedzeme si wotsɔ kpe ɖe safui ƒe tɔtrɔ si wode asi ete ŋu. Wotsɔe kpe ɖe Vortex ŋu le v0.0.8 me le beta la si 50k-member public channel si ƒe ɣeaɖewoɣi re-envelope bursts saturated the node megbe. Mɔnu si wode asi ete eye wotae la dzidzena le fli me kple safuiwo ƒe tɔtrɔ (siwo mebɔ o) tsɔ wu be woadzidzee kple hameviwo ƒe tɔtrɔ (siwo nɔa anyi ɖaa).
rooms.h4_f:
Tɔtrɔ-B:
  aƒetɔ ƒe dzesiwo: sig = Ed25519Sign (aƒetɔ_priv, xɔ_id ∥ ke_safui ∥ tɔtrɔ)
  publish: xɔ_dutoƒo_safuiwo += {xɔ_id, ke_safui, tɔtrɔ, dzesi}
  asisi: GET /api/xɔwo/{id}/dutoƒo-safui → ɖo kpe sig dzi ɖe aƒetɔ_pubkey ŋu
rooms.h5_a: Kpekpe ƒe kɔdawo nye hex chars 32. Tiatia max_zã, expires_at, assign_role, woate ŋu agbugbɔ.
rooms.h5_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/invite` (admin-ko) wɔa fli le `invites(code, room_id, created_by, max_uses, used_count, expires_at, assign_role, revoked_at)`. `POST /api/rooms/join` kple kɔdasia léa ŋku ɖe eƒe nyateƒenyenye ŋu (womeɖe asi le eŋu o, mewu enu o, used_count < max_uses), dzia `used_count` ɖe edzi, wɔa `room_members` fli, trɔa xɔa me metadata. Te fli ɖe eme to `DELETE /api/invites/{code}` dzi — emegbe ƒoƒo do kpo nu.
rooms.h5_c: Kpe kɔdawo abe gbãtɔ ene do xoxo abe IRC ƒe `+i` nɔnɔme (1988) ene. Telegram ƒe dutoƒo amekpekpe ƒe kadodowo kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu kple zazã ƒe seɖoƒewo woto vɛ le ƒe 2017. Vortex ƒe tɔtrɔ tsɔ `assign_role` kpee ale be aƒetɔwo ateŋu ama admin-granting codes dedie le zi ɖeka ƒe nɔnɔme me — viɖe le eŋu na onboarding a new moderator evɔ mahiã be woanya woƒe user id tututu do ŋgɔ o.
rooms.h5_f:
kpea ame be fli:
  kɔda : VARCHAR(64) -- 32 hex ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo
  xɔ_dzesi : BIGINT .
  max_uses : INT -- NULL = seɖoƒe meli na o
  wozã_xexlẽme : INT .
  expires_at : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = gbeɖe o
  de dɔ asi na : VARCHAR(16) -- NULL = hamevi
  woɖe asi le_le_le : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = agbe
rooms.h6_a: Gbedasi ƒe fli aɖe dzraa nya ɣaɣla + metadata ɖo; womedzraa sender ɖo ɖe nuŋɔŋlɔ gbadzaa me gbeɖe o.
rooms.h6_b: `gbedasiwo (id, xɔ_id, dɔla_id, ciphertext, nonce, dɔla_pseudo, dɔ_le, woɖɔli_le?, wotutu_le?, ŋuɖoɖo_na?, ka_id?, ƒomevi)`. `sender_id` li na mɔɖeɖe dzikpɔkpɔ eye woɖoe ɖe index me. `sender_pseudo` nye xɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe deterministic hash si nye sender_id eyata fan-out mehiã be wòaka asi zãlawo ƒe kplɔ̃ ŋu o. `ƒomevi` nye ɖeka le: nuŋɔŋlɔ, nɔnɔmetata, faɛl, gbe, yɔyɔ, ɖoɖo. `ciphertext` nye opaque AES-GCM dodo; xɔa me tɔ siwo si safuia le koe ate ŋu aɖe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea gɔme.
rooms.h6_c: Sender_pseudo susua tso Signal sealed-sender (2018) gbɔ. Signal zãnɛ tsɔ gbãa ŋku na server la be wòagakpɔ amesi ɖoe ɖa o; míezãnɛ na taɖodzinu ma tɔgbe gake míeléa `sender_id` cleartext na ACL kple rate limits. Mamã la na míekpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe "hameviwo koe ateŋu aɖoe" dzi evɔ server la masrɔ̃ amesi gblɔ nusi le DB dump blibo aɖe dzi o.
rooms.h7_a: Trɔtrɔwo ŋlɔa `ciphertext` ɖe teƒea eye woƒoa `edited_at`. Tutua null out ciphertext eye wòɖo `deleted_at`.
rooms.h7_b: Trɔ asi le eŋu: `PATCH /api/messages/{id}` kple `{ciphertext, nonce}` yeye. Amesi ɖoe ɖa koe ate ŋu atrɔ asi le woawo ŋutɔ ƒe gbedasi ŋu. Row ƒe ciphertext/nonce ɖɔli, `edited_at = fifia`, `ƒomevi` metrɔ o. Fan-out `{ƒomevi:"m", id, ct, nonce, woɖɔli_le}`. Tsɔe ɖa: `DELETE /api/gbedasiwo/{id}`. Sender alo admin ateŋu atutu. `wotutu_le = fifia`, `nya ɣaɣla = NULL`. Row nɔa anyi ale be gɔmesese gakpɔtɔ le ŋuɖoɖowo ŋu. Fan-out `{ƒomevi:"m", woɖee ɖa:nyateƒe, id}`.
rooms.h7_c: Edit-in-place nye Telegram/Slack ƒe kpɔɖeŋu; Discord dzra asitɔtrɔ ŋutinya bliboa ɖo le gɔmedzedzea me eye emegbe wòɖe asi le eŋu hena ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyawo. Vortex dzraa yeyetɔwo ko ɖo — ɖɔɖɔɖo ŋutinya nye PR nudzɔdzɔwo tsoƒe ne woate ŋu agbugbɔ ɖɔɖɔɖo si wotutu ɖa. Soft-delete kple null ciphertext tso Telegram fefegbalẽ ɖeka ma ke me eye wòkpɔa ŋuɖoɖo ƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔwo ta evɔ meléa emenyawo ɖe te o.
rooms.h7_f:
ɖɔɖɔɖo: UPDATE gbedasiwo SET nya ɣaɣla = $1, nonce = $2, ɖɔɖɔɖo_le = NOW() WHERE id = $3
tutu: UPDATE gbedasiwo SET tutu_le = NOW(), nya ɣaɣla = NULL WHERE id = $1
rooms.h8_a: Drafts — xɔawo ƒe ta ƒe akpa aɖe. Esia nye mɔnu vevi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Vortex ƒe nufiame bliboa me la dometɔ ɖeka. Xlẽ ta si ƒo xlãe hena nya siwo ƒo xlãe si keke ta wu; akpa sia dzia nuwɔna tɔxɛa ɖe edzi.
rooms.h8_b: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe wɔwɔfia na "Drafts". Wowɔa mɔ̃a ŋudɔ le module si sɔ me le `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, alo `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` te. Module README yɔa faɛl mɔ siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
rooms.h8_c: "Drafts" mɔnu la trɔ le Vortex ƒe tatawo katã me. Aɖaŋu si wowɔ la tso numekuku kple ewɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu siwo wota siwo dɔla siwo do ŋgɔ wɔ la gbɔ. Version ŋutinya le `CHANGELOG.md` me ŋlɔa ɣeyiɣi si me akpa ɖesiaɖe ɖi kple nusi ʋãe.
rooms.h9_a: Gbedasi siwo woɖo ɖi — xɔawo ƒe ta ƒe akpa aɖe. Esia nye mɔnu vevi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Vortex ƒe nufiame bliboa me la dometɔ ɖeka. Xlẽ ta si ƒo xlãe hena nya siwo ƒo xlãe si keke ta wu; akpa sia dzia nuwɔna tɔxɛa ɖe edzi.
rooms.h9_b: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe wɔwɔfia na "Gbedasi siwo woɖo ɖi". Wowɔa mɔ̃a ŋudɔ le module si sɔ me le `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, alo `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` te. Module README yɔa faɛl mɔ siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
rooms.h9_c: "Gbedasi siwo woɖo ɖi" ƒe mɔnu la trɔ le Vortex ƒe tatawo katã me. Aɖaŋu si wowɔ la tso numekuku kple ewɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu siwo wota siwo dɔla siwo do ŋgɔ wɔ la gbɔ. Version ŋutinya le `CHANGELOG.md` me ŋlɔa ɣeyiɣi si me akpa ɖesiaɖe ɖi kple nusi ʋãe.

files.title: Failwo kple kpeɖeŋutɔ siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu
files.subtitle: Single-shot na sue, rezuable na gã, client-side encryption na wo ame evea siaa.
files.intro: Fail ɖesiaɖe si woda ɖe Internet dzi la toa nya ɣaɣla ƒe mɔ̃ ɖeka ma ke dzi. Vovototo si le mɔwo dome la ku ɖe network ƒe tenɔnɔ ɖe nɔnɔme sesẽwo nu ŋu ko: resumable tolerates flaky links.
files.h1: Mɔ si dzi woato aɖoe ɖe mɔ̃ ɖeka dzi
files.h1p1: Taflatse: 5 MB. Wozãnɛ na fotowo, gbeɖiɖi ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, video kpuiwo.
files.h1p2: Asitsalawo tsɔa AES-GCM, random 96-bit nonce, safui = `file_root = secrets.token_bytes(32)`.
files.h1p3: POSTs `multipart/form-data` yi `/api/files` kple agblewo `file` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (integrity claim), `mime_type` (aɖaŋuɖoɖo; server gbugbɔ léa ŋku ɖe eŋu kple `python-magic`).
files.h1p4: Node dzraa nu ɖo ɖe `uploads/<category>/<sha256>.bin` te eye wòtrɔa `{file_id, url}`.
files.h1p5: Emegbe asisi ɖoa xɔme gbedasi si fiaa file_id eye wòtsɔa file_root ɖe eƒe ciphertext me ale be xɔa me tɔwo nate ŋu aɖe nya ɣaɣlawo gɔme.
files.h2: Mɔ si dzi woate ŋu agbugbɔ aɖo ɖe Internet dzi
files.h2p2: Afɔɖeɖe 1: `POST /api/faɛlwo/rezuable/init` kple `{faɛl ŋkɔ, lolome, chunk_size_hint}`. Node maa upload id, tiaa chunk ƒe lolome (512 KiB gbãtɔ, si woɖo tae ɖe 4 MiB), trɔna `{upload_id, chunk_size}`.
files.h2p3: Afɔɖeɖe 2: na akpa ɖesiaɖe, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` kple ciphertext ƒe ŋutilã xoxo. Ele be woaɖo offsets ɖe ɖoɖo nu ɖe ​​`chunk_size` nu.
files.h2p4: Afɔɖeɖe 3: `POST /api/faɛlwo/gbugbɔgadze/{upload_id}/wu enu` kple `{plain_blake3}`. Node gaƒoa ƒu, ɖoa kpe lolome dzi, dzraa nu ɖo, trɔna `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2p5: Dodokpɔwo gbɔ kpɔkpɔ: nusiwo wotɔ te ate ŋu adze egɔme ake to offset siwo bu ko gbugbɔgaɖo ɖe amewo me. Node léa ŋku ɖe offset siwo va ɖo le Redis (alo le ŋkuɖodzinu me na SQLite nɔnɔme).
files.h2p6: TTL: woɖea nusiwo womewu enu o siwo woda ɖe Internet dzi la ɖa le 24 h megbe.
files.h3p1: Nɔnɔmetatawo ɖoɖo ɖe Internet dzi (MIME `nɔnɔmetata/*`) ʋua Pillow-based thumbnail generator le 256×256 JPEG q=80. Wodzrae ɖo ɖe `uploads/thumbs/<hash>.jpg` te.
files.h3p2: Nɔnɔmetata suewo hã nye asitsalawo ƒe akpa dzi nya ɣaɣlawo — amesi xɔe hiã file_root be wòaɖee afia. Dzra bandwidth ɖo hena xexlẽdzesiwo ƒe ŋgɔdonyawo.
files.h3p3: Video ƒe dada ɖe Internet dzi (MIME `video/*`) ʋãa ffmpeg-dzi poster ɖeɖe le 10 % le clip ƒe ɣeyiɣi didime me, wodzrae ɖo nenema ke.
files.h4p1: `mime_type` si asitsalawo ɖo ɖa la nye aɖaŋuɖoɖo. Server wɔa `python-magic` ɖe 1 KB gbãtɔwo ŋu eye wògbea ne ƒomevi si woʋẽ la le gbegbe ƒe xexlẽdzesi me: `dɔwɔwɔ/x-dosexec`, `dɔwɔwɔ/x-sharedlib`, `dɔwɔwɔ/x-mach-binary`.
files.h4p2: Esia xea mɔ na ezãla siwo mebua tame o be woagama kɔmpiutadziɖoɖo gbegblẽwo to amedɔdɔa dzi le vo me o. Amedzidzela siwo ʋãa ame ate ŋu ato eme kokoko kple nugoe siwo woŋlɔ ŋkɔ na nyuie — ametakpɔkpɔa nye asisiwo ƒe akpa dzi unwrap gbegbe, ke menye server-side sniff o.
files.h5p1: Default: teƒea ƒe faɛlɖoɖo. Good na ɖeka-node deploys.
files.h5p2: S3: ɖo `NUDZRAÐOƑE_AGBALẼDZRAÐOƑE=s3` + `S3_BUCKET=...`. Wotsɔa faɛlwo ɖoa S3 tẽe evɔ womekaa asi node ƒe disk ŋu o. Wozãa URL siwo wode asi ete do ŋgɔ tsɔ wɔa kɔpi.
files.h5p3: IPFS: dodokpɔ. Uploads ɖea gbeƒã CIDwo to DHT dzi; downloads xɔa pinning node ɖesiaɖe.
files.h1_a: Single-shot upload nye mɔ kabakaba na nusianu si mede 5 MB o — fotowo, gbeɖiɖi ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, video kpuiwo. HTTPS POST ɖeka, blob ɖeka si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ, fli ɖeka le `faɛlwo` me.
files.h1_b: Asitsalawo tsɔa AES-GCM ɣlaa faɛl bytewo tso nuwuwu vaseɖe nuwuwu le baiti 32 ƒe `file_root` si wowɔ le vome te. POSTs ` akpa geɖe / nɔnɔme-nyatakaka` na ` / api / faɛlwo` kple agblewo `faɛl` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (fɔmaɖimaɖi ƒe nya), `mime_ƒomevi` (aɖaŋuɖoɖo). Node zi 5 MB ƒe nutrenu dzi le xɔxlɔ̃ ƒe buffer ƒe ɖoɖo nu, ewɔa `python-magic` hena ƒomevi didi, gbe ne MIME le gbegbe ƒe xexlẽdzesi me, dzraa nu ɖo ɖe `uploads/<category>/<hash>.bin` te, trɔna `{file_id, url, mime_type, size}`. Emegbe asisi ɖoa xɔme gbedasi si fia asi `file_id` eye wòtsɔa `file_root` ɖe eƒe nya ɣaɣlawo me.
files.h1_c: 5 MB cap la nye xexlẽdzesi ma ke si Slack kple Telegram zãna na woƒe "inline" upload mɔ. Fail gãwo yia mɔ si dzi woate ŋu agbugbɔ awɔ dɔ le la dzi. Vortex ƒe gɔmedzedze la, 100 MB ƒe tu ɖeka ƒe kposɔ nɔ esi; míeɖiɖi va ɖo 5 MB le profiling ɖee fia be single-shot uploads si wu 5 MB ƒe ɖiɖi 40 % le asitelefon networkwo dzi vɔ megbe. Mɔ si woate ŋu agbugbɔ awɔ la nyo wu keŋkeŋ na faɛl gãwo togbɔ be enye mɔzɔzɔ yiyi kple gbɔgbɔ geɖe wu le dzidzɔmɔwo dzi hã.
files.h2_a: Resumable upload nye mɔ na faɛl gãwo. Client uploads fixed-size chunks, ateŋu atɔ vie, ateŋu agbugbɔ adze egɔme le chunk ƒe liƒo ɖesiaɖe dzi, ateŋu ahaya tso network blips me.
files.h2_b: Afɔɖeɖe etɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi. Init: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` kple `{faɛl ŋkɔ, lolome, chunk_size_hint}` → node ma `upload_id` + ɖo kpe chunk ƒe lolome dzi. Chunks: na offset ɖesiaɖe, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` kple raw ciphertext ŋutilã. Ele be offsets nanye chunk_size ƒe teƒe geɖe. Nuwuwu: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` kple `{plain_blake3}` — node gbugbɔ ƒo ƒu, ɖo kpe lolome + tag dzi, dzrae ɖo, trɔ `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2_c: Afɔɖeɖe etɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖia ƒe nɔnɔme sɔ kple tus.io (Resumable Uploads, 2013), AWS S3 akpa geɖe ƒe kɔpiwo, kple Google Drive gbugbɔgaɖoanyiwo. Vortex xɔ tus.io ƒe nɔnɔme elabena eyae nye nusi sɔ bɔbɔe wu na FastAPI + streaming. 24 h TTL le uploads siwo womewu enu o dzi sɔ kple S3 ƒe default eye balances gbugbɔgadze ƒe asitɔtrɔ le server disk zazã ŋu.
files.h3_a: Wowɔa nɔnɔmetata suewo le server-side le upload me gake wonɔa encrypted le file root ɖeka te, eyata xɔa me tɔwo koe ateŋu awɔ wo.
files.h3_b: Le `nɔnɔmetata/*` MIME gome la, Pillow wɔa 256×256 JPEG q=80 tso ŋgɔdonya si woɖe tso eme la me. Lala — ao, server la mekpɔa plaintext gbeɖe o. Sisi nyuitɔ: asitsala wɔa asibidɛ la le teƒea, tsɔa file_root + yeye nonce ɖeka ɣlana, tsɔa nu abe nɔvi blob ene, eye wòyɔa `thumb_id` le xɔa me gbedasi me. Server dzraa nya ɣaɣla la ɖo. Le `video/*` gome la, asisi la wɔa nenema ke kple ffmpeg-si woɖe tso keyframe.
files.h3_c: Gbãtɔ Vortex ƒe server-side thumbnail dzidzi tso plaintext — míeɖe ŋutete ma le v0.0.4 me le dedienɔnɔ me toto ɖee fia be eda E2E kakaɖedzi dzi vɔ megbe. Asitsalawo ƒe akpa dzi asibidɛwo nye kpɔɖeŋu si Signal zã tso ƒe 2018 kple WhatsApp tso ƒe 2020. Bandwidth ƒe asi mede naneke kura o — a 256×256 JPEG le 20 KB te.
files.h4_a: Server la zi MIME deny list dzi le sniff layer la dzi be wòatɔ te executables siwo woma le vo me.
files.h4_b: Le blibodede (ɖeka-tu) alo nuwuwu (gbugbɔgadze) megbe la, dɔdzikpɔla la wɔa `python-magic` ɖe 1 KB gbãtɔ siwo le ciphertext ƒe host container dzi be wòade dzesi ƒomevi vavãtɔ. Ne ʋeʋẽa ka nya ta be `dɔwɔwɔ/x-dosexec` (Windows PE), `dɔwɔwɔ/x-sharedlib` (Linux ELF), alo `dɔwɔwɔ/x-mach-binary` (macOS Mach-O) la, wogbea dɔdɔa kple 415 Media Ƒomevi si womedo alɔe o. Esia nye server ƒe ɖoɖo, menye dedienɔnɔ ƒe liƒo o — asisi la ƒe xɔmetɔwo ateŋu aɖo wrapper format si to sniff la ŋu kokoko.
files.h4_c: MIME ʋeʋẽ abe gbegbe ƒe ɖoɖo ene nye IETF draft-mime-sniffing-0X tso ƒe 2012. Discord / Slack / Telegram katã wɔa esia. Wonya seɖoƒea (zipped/containerised executables bypass sniff) tso ƒe 2016 — míaƒe ametakpɔkpɔ nye layered: kpe ɖe zãla ƒe akpa dzi nuxlɔ̃amewo le faɛl ɖesiaɖe si si executable extension le.
files.h5_a: Nudzraɖoƒe ƒe megbenyawo — faɛlwo ƒe ta ƒe akpa aɖe. Esia nye mɔnu vevi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Vortex ƒe nufiame bliboa me la dometɔ ɖeka. Xlẽ ta si ƒo xlãe hena nya siwo ƒo xlãe si keke ta wu; akpa sia dzia nuwɔna tɔxɛa ɖe edzi.
files.h5_b: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe wɔwɔfia na "Nudzraɖoƒe ƒe megbenyawo". Wowɔa mɔ̃a ŋudɔ le module si sɔ me le `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, alo `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` te. Module README yɔa faɛl mɔ siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
files.h5_c: "Storage backends" mɔnu la trɔ le Vortex ƒe tatawo katã me. Aɖaŋu si wowɔ la tso numekuku kple ewɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu siwo wota siwo dɔla siwo do ŋgɔ wɔ la gbɔ. Version ŋutinya le `CHANGELOG.md` me ŋlɔa ɣeyiɣi si me akpa ɖesiaɖe ɖi kple nusi ʋãe.

presence.title: Dzesiwo ƒe anyinɔnɔ kple wo tsɔtsɔ yi na ame
presence.subtitle: Typing indicators, xexlẽ ƒe gaxɔgbalẽviwo, mamlɛtɔ-kpɔ — katã ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko.
presence.intro: Dzesi siawo nyea toɣliɖeɖe. Vortex nana womenɔa anyi o le gɔmedzedzea me: nuŋɔŋlɔ nɔa agbe le Redis (alo le ŋkuɖodzinu me), nuxexlẽ ƒe xɔgbalẽviwo koe nye dzesi si tsi agbe le gbugbɔgadzedze me.
presence.h1p1: Asitsaha ɖoa `{type:"t", xɔ:..., state:"start"|"stop"}` ɖe safui ƒoƒo dzi. Debounced to nudzɔdzɔ ɖeka ya teti le s 3 ɖesiaɖe me.
presence.h1p2: Node ɖea gbeƒã `{type:"t", xɔ:..., zãla:..., nɔnɔme:...}` na WebSocket siwo katã ŋlɔ ŋkɔ.
presence.h1p3: Auto-expire: `dze egɔme` si me `tɔtrɔ` si gbɔna manɔmee ɣeyiɣiwo vɔ le s 10 megbe le asisi ƒe akpa dzi.
presence.h2p2: Node nɔa anyi le `xlẽ_xɔxlɔ̃wo (xɔ_id, zãla_id, gbedasi_id, xlẽ_le)` eye wòɖea gbeƒã `{ƒomevi:"r", xɔ:..., zãla:..., gbedasi_id:...}`.
presence.h2p3: Asitsalawo ɖea "seen by N" gɔme le gbedasi siwo do go te.
presence.h2p4: Adzamenyawo: zãla ateŋu awɔ "seen" nuwɔametɔe keŋkeŋ; ekema node la meléa gaxɔgbalẽviwo ɖe te na wo o. Asitsatsa: womekpɔa ame bubuwo ƒe gaxɔgbalẽviwo hã o (symmetry).
presence.h3p1: Node kplɔa `presence.last_seen_at` (unix ms) ɖe zãla ɖesiaɖe dzi. Wowɔe yeyee le WebSocket ƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖesiaɖe dzi.
presence.h3p2: Granularity tiers (zãla-tiatia): pɛpɛpɛ, woƒo xlãe va ɖo 5 min si te ɖe eŋu wu, woƒo xlãe va ɖo gaƒoƒo si te ɖe eŋu wu, "nyitsɔ laa", alo tsi.
presence.h3p3: Wobia nya to `GET /api/zãlawo/{id}/anyinɔnɔ` dzi. Woŋlɔ ŋkɔ to `{type:"sub_presence", zãla:...}` dzi.
presence.h4p1: Zãla aɖe le "online" ne WebSocket ɖeka ya teti le dɔ wɔm le woƒe mɔ̃ aɖe dzi.
presence.h4p2: Wokpɔnɛ na kadodowo ɖeɖeko — amesiwo menye kadodowo o kpɔa esiwo wokpɔ mamlɛtɔ gake menye dometsotso gbagbe o.
presence.h1_a: Woɖoa ŋɔŋlɔdzesi ƒe dzesi to WebSocket frame `{type:"t", xɔ, nɔnɔme: "dze egɔme"|"tɔ te"}` dzi eye woɖea gbeƒãe to node dzi na nudɔla ɖesiaɖe si le xɔa me.
presence.h1_b: Client debounces at 3 s — gbãtɔ keystroke ɖoa `dze egɔme`, emegbe le 3 s me mewɔa naneke o. 10 s le safui mamlɛtɔ ƒoƒo megbe la, asisi ɖoa `dzudzɔ` ɖa. Node kakaa frame la nya ɖe nya nu, eye wotsɔa `user_id` ɖoa ŋgɔe. No persistence — ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe nɔnɔme nɔa agbe le in-memory per-room dicts (alo Redis pub/sub na multi-node). Auto-expire 10 s le receiver ƒe akpa dzi: ne update aɖeke meva o la, asisiwo tsɔe be wodzudzɔ.
presence.h1_c: Nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dzesiwo trɔ yi AIM / ICQ (1997). Egbegbe debounced designs trace to Skype 2006 kple iMessage 2011. 3 s / 10 s xexlẽdzesiwo tso iMessage ƒe nuwɔna si wokpɔ — mí A / B do 2/5, 3/10, 5/15 kple 3/10 kpɔ nyuitɔ kekeake subjective "matches human rhythm" nyaŋuɖoɖo.
presence.h2_a: Xlẽ xɔxɔ gakpɔtɔ li: asisi POSTs gbedasi id si woxlẽ mamlɛtɔ; node dzraa nu ɖo ɖe `read_receipts` kple gbeƒãɖeɖewo me.
presence.h2_b: `POST /api/xɔwo/{id}/xlẽ` kple `{xexlẽ_mamlɛtɔ_gbedasi_id}`. Node trɔa asi le `xlẽ_xɔxlɔ̃wo (xɔ_id, zãla_id, gbedasi_id, xlẽ_le)` kple UPSERT gɔmesesewo. Gbeƒãɖeɖewo `{ƒomevi:"r", xɔ, zãla, gbedasi_id, xexlẽ_le}`. Asitsalawo ɖea "seen by N" gɔme le gbedasi siwo do go te. Adzamenyawo: ezãla ate ŋu axe mɔ ɖe gaxɔgbalẽviwo nu keŋkeŋ; ekema node la menɔa anyi na wo o AND womekpɔa ame bubuwo ƒe xɔgbalẽviwo o (symmetric).
presence.h2_c: Xlẽ ƒe xɔgbalẽviwo va bɔ ɖe afisiafi le iMessage 2011 kple WhatsApp 2014 megbe.Symmetry sea (ne èɣla tɔwò la, màkpɔ ame bubuwo tɔ o) tso Telegram 2014 me eye eya koe nye mɔ si dzi nàto aƒo asa na mɔ ɖeka dzi kpɔkpɔ ƒe mɔnu. Vortex zia symmetry dzi le server la dzi — menye client la ɖeɖeko o — ale clients siwo da alakpa le aflaga la ŋu la mekpɔa dzedzeme kokoko o.
presence.h3_a: Last-seen nye ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesi ɖeka si wozãna na zãla ɖesiaɖe, si wowɔ yeyee le WebSocket ƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖesiaɖe dzi eye wòtsina ne nɔnɔmetata aɖeke meva o.
presence.h3_b: Node kplɔa `presence.last_seen_at` ɖo abe unix ms ene. Wowɔ yeyee le WebSocket frame ɖesiaɖe si ŋu woɖo kpee tso zãla ma gbɔ dzi. Xlẽ to `GET /api/zãlawo/{id}/anyinɔnɔ` dzi. Ðo ŋkɔ to `{type:"sub_presence", zãla}` dzi be nàxɔ live push ɖe tɔtrɔ dzi. Granularity nye zãla-ɖoɖo: ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesi tututu, woƒo xlãe va ɖo 5 min, woƒo xlãe va ɖo 1 h, "nyitsɔ laa", alo tsi.
presence.h3_c: Granularity tiers trace to WhatsApp ƒe 2012 ƒe ameŋunyatakaka yeyewo le nyatoƒoetoto le stalking si wokpɔ zi mamlɛtɔ ŋu megbe. Telegram le ƒe 2013 me tsɔ "nyitsɔ laa / le kwasiɖa ɖeka me / le ɣleti ɖeka me" buckets kpee. Vortex ƒe 5 min / 1 h / "nyitsɔ laa" gbugbɔ Telegram. "Tsi" tiatia la ɣlaa zãla la le mɔ si sɔ nu be wòagakpɔ ame bubuwo ƒe nu mamlɛtɔ si wokpɔ le susu ma ke si ta woxlẽ xɔgbalẽviwo o.
presence.h4_a: Internet dzi dzesi: zãla aɖe le "inline" nenye be WebSocket ɖeka ya teti le agbe le woƒe mɔ̃ aɖe dzi.
presence.h4_b: Node dzraa `active_ws_count(user_id)` ɖo ɖe ŋkuɖodzinu me. Dzidziɖedziwo le WS dodoɖeŋgɔ dzi, ɖiɖi le nuwuwu. `online = active_ws_xexlẽme (zãla_id) > 0`. Wokpɔnɛ na kadodowo ɖeɖeko — amesiwo menye kadodowo o kpɔa mamlɛtɔ-si wokpɔ (le granularity te) gake gbeɖegbeɖe gbagbe green dot. Trɔ nudzɔdzɔwo dzo ne xexlẽmea tso zero le mɔ eveawo siaa nu.
presence.h4_c: Kadodowo ɖeɖeko ƒe dzedzeme nye kpɔɖeŋu si dzi dɔla vevi ɖesiaɖe ɖo le amedzidzedze ƒe nudzɔdzɔ geɖe megbe (WhatsApp 2014, Telegram 2015). Gbãtɔ Vortex na internet dzi dze na amesiame; míetrɔ asi le nusi woɖo ɖi ŋu esi beta-tomedzrola aɖe ɖee fia be dutoƒoxɔwo ana amedzro akpe geɖe ƒe anyinɔnɔ adze na amedzro akpe geɖe bubuwo vɔ megbe.

calls.title: WebRTC yɔyɔwo
calls.subtitle: Gbe + video, 1:1 kple ƒuƒoƒo, si woɖe dzesi to WebSocket dzi, si woɖo to coturn dzi.
calls.intro: Vortex zãa stock WebRTC ƒe ƒuƒoƒo. Node nye dzesiwo ɖeɖeko. Ne hatiwo nya do ka kple woƒe ICE ame siwo di be yewoaxɔ ɖoƒea ko la, nyadzɔdzɔgblɔmɔnuwo sina tẽ (hatiwo kple hatiwo) alo to TURN relay dzi le bad NAT dzi.
calls.h1p1: Yɔla: `POST /api/yɔ/{xɔ_id}/dze egɔme` kple `{video: bool, odio: bool}`. Node ma call_id, kaka `{type:"c", kind:"invite", call_id, video, odio}` ɖe xɔ me.
calls.h1p2: Ame si woyɔ la xɔ: `POST /api/yɔyɔ/{yɔyɔ_id}/xɔ` → `{ƒomevi:"c", ƒomevi:"xɔ"}`.
calls.h1p3: Nusiwo wotsɔ na/ŋuɖoɖo ƒe asitɔtrɔ: `{ƒomevi:"tsɔtsɔ na", sdp:...}` → `{ƒomevi:"ŋuɖoɖo", sdp:...}` → `{ƒomevi:"ame si di be yeaxɔ ɖoƒe", tsikpe:...}` × N vaseɖe esime wodo ka.
calls.h1p4: Yɔyɔ ƒe nuwuwu: `POST /api/yɔyɔwo/{yɔyɔ_id}/nuwuwu`. Akpa evea siaa ate ŋu atɔ kaƒoƒoa. Node ŋlɔa `yɔyɔ_nuŋlɔɖiwo (yɔyɔ_id, ɣeyiɣi didime_s, video, odio, kplɔ̃ɖoƒewo)`.
calls.h2p1: Server Interactive Kadodo ƒe Ðoɖowɔwɔ. Hatiwo ɖɔlia ame siwo di be yewoaxɔ ɖoƒea (amedzroxɔla, srflx, prflx, relay).
calls.h2p2: STUN: woblae kple coturn. Stun-ko ƒe nɔnɔme si wozãna na symmetric-NAT deteksi.
calls.h2p3: TURN: coturn kple HMAC-de asi agbalẽ te ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe ɖaseɖigbalẽwo. Kaƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe xɔa creds yeye siwo le dɔ wɔm hena 24 h.
calls.h2p4: Ðaseɖigbalẽwo: `{zãla ƒe ŋkɔ: <ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesi>:<zãla_id>, nyagbe: base64(HMAC-SHA1(nya ɣaɣla, zãla ƒe ŋkɔ))}`. Dzesi RFC 5389 ƒe ɖoɖo.
calls.h3p1: Odio: Opus 48 kHz ƒe bitrate si trɔna (6-128 kbps). DTX ɖe edzi hena ɖoɖoezizi nutsitsi.
calls.h3p2: Video: VP9 (elɔ̃ wu) / H.264 / AV1 (tiae be yeawɔe). Simulcast na ƒuƒoƒo yɔyɔ: yɔla ŋlɔa nyametsotso etɔ̃ le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me.
calls.h3p3: FEC: ɣesiaɣi le edzi na odio; na video ne bitrate headroom ɖe mɔ.
calls.h4p1: Le gomekpɔla > 2 gome la, Vortex dzia SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) ɖe node la dzi. Gomenɔla ɖesiaɖe tsɔa zi ɖeka, SFU fans do.
calls.h4p2: Fifia la, gomekpɔla 100 koe woate ŋu aƒo o; video ƒuƒoƒo siwo ƒe seɖoƒe le 8 le v0.1 me (video SFU sesẽ le v0.3 mɔfiame me).
calls.h4p3: SFU zãa coturn relay ma ke hena mɔzɔzɔ; mehiã be woawɔ dɔ bubu aɖeke kpee o.
calls.h5p1: To `getDisplayMedia` dzi. Client tsɔ track yeye kpe ɖe PeerConnection si li fifia ŋu; gbugbɔ dzroa nusi woatsɔ ana/ŋuɖoɖo me.
calls.h5p2: Amesiwo xɔe la ɖea screen si woama la gɔme abe video ƒe haƒoƒo si woɖe ɖe vovo ene. Le asitelefon dzi la, screen sharing bia OS-level mɔɖeɖe — iOS bia, Android ɖea system dialog fiana.
calls.h6p1: WebRTC ƒe NetEQ si wotu ɖe eme la kpɔa nusiwo bu kple ʋuʋu gbɔ. Ne egblẽ vevie la, asisi la ɖea resolution dzi kpɔtɔna alo wɔa videoa nuwɔametɔe keŋkeŋ esime odio le agbe.
calls.h6p2: 500 ms ƒe tsikpe ʋãa agbagbadzedze be woagbugbɔ aɖo kadodoa me (ICE gbugbɔgadze egɔme). Zãlawo kpɔa "Reconnecting..." ƒe nutsyɔnu.
calls.h1_a: Kaƒoƒo ƒe dzesiwo doa sɔ WebSocket si wozãna na dzeɖoɖo. Node nye signalling-ko — ewɔa brokers SDP kple ICE le hatiwo dome gake meka asi nyadzɔdzɔgblɔmɔnuwo ŋu gbeɖe o.
calls.h1_b: Yɔla POSTs `/api/calls/{room_id}/dze egɔme` kple `{video, odio}`. Node ma `yɔyɔ_id`, kaka `{ƒomevi:"c", ƒomevi:"kpe", yɔyɔ_id, video, odio}` ɖe xɔa me. Yɔyɔ ŋlɔa `/api/yɔyɔwo/{yɔyɔ_id}/xɔ` → `{ƒomevi:"c", ƒomevi:"xɔ"}`. SDP na/ŋuɖoɖo ƒe asitɔtrɔ: `{ƒomevi:"na", sdp}` → `{ƒomevi:"ŋuɖoɖo", sdp}`. ICE ame siwo di be yewoaxɔ ɖoƒea: `{ƒomevi:"ame si di be yeaxɔ ɖoƒe", tsikpe}` × N vaseɖe esime PeerConnection ka nya ta be `wodo ƒome`.
calls.h1_c: SDP + ICE dzesiwo nye WebRTC ƒe ɖoɖo si sɔ si ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le RFC 8839 kple 8841. Vortex meto naneke vɛ le afisia o; enye sisi Chrome, Firefox, kple WebRTC agbalẽdzraɖoƒe ƒe dɔwɔnu ɖesiaɖe. Node-as-signalling-only tiatia la tso ekpɔkpɔ dze sii be SFU-style media forwarding blaa bandwidth eye wòbia hardware siwo míedi be míaɖo ɖe base install me o.
calls.h2_a: ICE dia mɔ to NATwo me to host + server-reflexive + relay candidates zazã me. coturn ƒe asiléƒewo STUN kple TURN le Vortex ƒe akpa dzi.
calls.h2_b: Hati ɖesiaɖe xlẽa ame siwo di be yewoaxɔ ɖoƒea: amedzroxɔla (nutoa me IPwo), srflx (server-reflexive via STUN), relay (TURN-allocated). Hatiwo ɖɔlia ame siwo katã di be yewoaxɔ ɖoƒea; eve ɖesiaɖe wɔa "eve", kadodo ƒe dodokpɔ ɖoa ​​STUN babla biabia ɖe UDP dzi. Atsu kple asi gbãtɔ siwo kpɔ dzidzedze va zua mɔ si wotia. Le megbe na symmetric NAT, relay eve koe wɔa dɔ — ɣemaɣie TURN relay la relay media ŋutɔŋutɔ.
calls.h2_c: Woɖo ICE ɖe ɖoɖo nu abe RFC 5245 le ƒe 2010 me eye wogbugbɔe wɔ yeyee abe RFC 8445 le ƒe 2018. Le carrier-grade-NAT megbe la, STUN doa kpo nu abe 15 % ene eye TURN nye nusi womate ŋu aƒo asa na o. coturn nye nufiame ʋuʋu-dzɔtsoƒe TURN dɔdzikpɔla; míeɖonɛ ɖee elabena esi woate ŋu azã ɖe eteƒe (Twilio/Vonage TURN si wodzrana) xɔa aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka ƒe odio si woɖona ɖe amewo.
calls.h3_a: TURN ɖaseɖigbalẽwo nye ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe HMAC-de asi zãla/nyagbe eve siwo woɖe ɖe go le kaƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe me, ke menye nya ɣaɣla siwo nɔa anyi didi o.
calls.h3_b: Le yɔyɔ ƒe gɔmedzedze la, node wɔa `zãla ƒe ŋkɔ = "<expiry_unix>:<zãla_id>"` kple `nyagbe = base64(HMAC-SHA1(server_secret, zãla ƒe ŋkɔ))`. Wo ame evea siaa ƒe TTL 24 h. Asitsaha zãa wo le eƒe RTCPeerConnection ɖoɖowɔɖi me. coturn ɖoa kpe HMAC dzi le ɣeyiɣi ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ me. Creds siwo ƒe ɣeyiɣi do kpo nu le HMAC check la me — wodzudzɔa dɔwɔwɔ le wo ɖokui si revocation database manɔmee.
calls.h3_c: HMAC creds siwo nɔa anyi kpuie la tso RFC 5389 (STUN) eye wonye kpɔɖeŋu si nuwɔwɔ ɖesiaɖe WebRTC deployment zãna. Twilio, Google, Xirsys katã wɔa esia. Mɔnu bubu — static TURN creds — leaks ne asisi ɖesiaɖe dze afɔku. Creds siwo nɔa agbe kpuie la ɖoa seɖoƒe na nusiwo gblẽ ƒe fesrea be wòanye 24 h.
calls.h4_a: Odio nye Opus le 48 kHz kple DTX; video nye VP9 gbãtɔ / H.264 ƒe megbedede / AV1 tiatia-ɖe.
calls.h4_b: Odio: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR ƒe ʋuʋudedi. DTX (Discotinuous Transmission) dzudzɔa dɔdɔ le ɖoɖoezizi me, egadzea egɔme le gbe dzi. FEC le ɣesiaɣi. Video: VP9 le gɔmedzedzea me; H.264 si wodo bobloe na mɔ̃ siwo me xɔtunu VP9 decode mele o (iOS do ŋgɔ na A10 Bionic); AV1 si wotsɔ na abe opt-in na premium le egbegbe hardware dzi. Simulcast na ƒuƒoƒo yɔyɔ: yɔla encodes etɔ̃ resolutions le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me, SFU fans do nyuitɔ kekeake na nukpɔla ɖesiaɖe.
calls.h4_c: Opus nye IETF ƒe odio codec si ŋu woɖe mɔ ɖo (RFC 6716, 2012). VP9 nye Google ƒe ʋuʋu H.265-si sɔ kple. H.264 nye fallback elabena Apple lé VP9 ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu vaseɖe ƒe 2021. AV1 va zu nusi woateŋu awɔ le telefonwo dzi le esi iPhone 15 Pro (2023) kple Pixel 8 (2023) tsɔ hardware decode kpee vɔ megbe. Vortex ƒe codec tsakatsaka nye esi Google Meet zãna.
calls.h5_a: Ƒuƒoƒo ƒe kaƒoƒo zãa SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) le node la dzi. Gomenɔla ɖesiaɖe tsɔa nyatakakawo da ɖe Internet dzi zi ɖeka; SFU yi ŋgɔ na amesiame.
calls.h5_b: Le > 2 hatiwo gome la, yɔla la ŋlɔa `/api/calls/{room_id}/group/start`. Node trɔa SFU kpɔɖeŋu si wobla ɖe yɔyɔa ŋu. Gomenɔla ɖesiaɖe ʋua PeerConnection na SFU tsɔ wu be wòaʋu na hati bubu ɖesiaɖe. Uplink: ɖesiaɖe ɖoa tɔsisi 1 ɖa. Downlink: SFU yi ŋgɔ N-1 tɔsisiwo. Simulcast layers fia be SFU tiaa resolution si sɔ ɖe nukpɔla ɖesiaɖe ƒe bandwidth si li nu.
calls.h5_c: SFU xɔtuɖaŋu dze egɔme tso Jitsi ƒe Videobridge (ƒe 2013). Do ŋgɔ na SFU la, WebRTC ƒuƒoƒo ƒe yɔyɔwo nye full-mesh — hati ɖesiaɖe ŋlɔa N-1 tɔsisiwo, si dzidzena le dzogoe ene me. Zoom, Google Do go, Jitsi, Dzesi ƒuƒoƒo yɔyɔwo katã zã SFU. Vortex odio-ko ƒuƒoƒo kaƒoƒo siwo woɖo ɖe v0.0.8; video ƒuƒoƒo ƒe kaƒoƒo le v0.3 ƒe mɔfiamegbalẽa dzi.
calls.h6_a: Screen sharing nye nyadzɔdzɔgblɔmɔ̃ yeye aɖe le PeerConnection si li fifia dzi, si wogbugbɔ wɔ to offer/answer dzi.
calls.h6_b: Zãla ƒoa asi Share Screen → web-browser / iOS / Android yɔa `getDisplayMedia()`. Wotsɔ MediaStream si wogbugbɔ tsɔ kpe ɖe PeerConnection ŋu. Renegotiation dzowo: nu yeye si wotsɔ na/ŋuɖoɖo kple track si wotsɔ kpee. Amesiwo xɔe la ɖea screen si woama la gɔme abe video ƒe akpa aɖe si le vovo ene. Le iOS dzi la, screen sharing hiã na Broadcast Upload Extension; le Android dzi la, ŋgɔgbe dɔwɔƒe + MediaProjection mɔɖeɖe.
calls.h6_c: getDisplayMedia woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu le ƒe 2017 me eye wòle browser ɖesiaɖe me tso ƒe 2019. iOS ƒe Broadcast Upload Extension va le iOS 11 (2017) me. Android MediaProjection li ke tso esime Lollipop (2015) do. Vortex screen mamã si woɖo ɖe v0.0.8.
calls.h2_f:
ame siwo di be yewoaxɔ ɖoƒea:
  amedzroxɔla : rtp:addr (nutoa me IP) .
  srflx : STUN ke ɖe dutoƒonuƒoa ŋu
  relay : TURN-si woɖo na relay adrɛs

eve eve ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi: STUN babla biabia wu UDP .
eve tiatia: gbãtɔ si akpɔ dzidzedze
calls.h3_f:
username = "{nux_wu enu}:{zãla_dzesi}".
nyagbegbɔgblɔ = base64 (HMAC-SHA1 (server_nya ɣaɣla, zãla ƒe ŋkɔ))

        H.264 ƒe gɔmedzedze (woxe mɔ ɖe enu) .
