federation.title: Dukɔwo Dome Habɔbɔ
federation.subtitle: Pubkey siwo dzi woka ɖo, nyatoƒoetoto siwo wode asi na, cross-node DMs.
federation.intro: Federation ɖea mɔ na zãlawo le node A gbedasi zãlawo le node B. It's opt-in per operator. Woka ɖe node pubkeys dzi tẽ; "node ɖesiaɖe ateŋu awɔ ɖeka kple tɔnye" ƒe nɔnɔme aɖeke meli le eɖokui si o.
federation.h1p1: Node ɖesiaɖe léa `federations (pubkey, nuwuƒe, lãmesẽ_dzesi, wotsɔ kpe ɖe_le, wotsɔ kpe ɖe_to)`.
federation.h1p2: Hati tsɔtsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu bia be dɔwɔla si de asi ete na admin action. Admin UI ɖea remote la ƒe asibidɛ fiana ale be dɔwɔlawo ateŋu aɖo kpe out-of-band dzi.
federation.h1p3: Hati siwo woɖe ɖa la gakpɔtɔ le DB si wode dzesii be `revoked_at` hena agbalẽdzikpɔkpɔ. Wogbea federation yeyewo ƒe biabiawo tso pubkey ma ke gbɔ vaseɖe esime admin aɖe ɖe asi le eŋu.
federation.h2p1: Dodo tso A yi user@B: node A xatsa gbedasi ƒe agbalẽkotokua ɖe blob si wode asi ete me eye wòɖoa `/federation/deliver` ɖe node B dzi.
federation.h2p2: Envelope: `{tsoƒe_node, taɖodzinu_zãla, ememe_ciphertext, ememe_nonce, woɖo_le, sig}`. Sig xɔa nusianu negbe sig ŋutɔ ko.
federation.h2p3: Node B ɖoa kpe asidede agbalẽ te dzi ɖe `source_node` pubkey dzi tso eƒe `federations` kplɔ̃ dzi. Sig → 401 + audit nudzɔdzɔ si mesɔ o.
federation.h3p1: Ne B nye esi gbɔ womate ŋu aɖo o la, A ɖoa fli ɖe `federation_outbox(target_node, payload, agbagbadzedzewo, next_retry_at)`.
federation.h3p2: Kpekpeɖeŋunana ƒe megbedede: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, woɖo tae le 6h. Dodokpɔ tegbee le ŋkeke 14 megbe.
federation.h3p3: Dɔwɔla ƒe nuxlɔ̃ame dzo ne outbox depth > 1000 gbedasiwo — fia be federation kadodo si tsi anyi.
federation.h4p1: Le s 60 ɖesiaɖe me la, node ɖesiaɖe ƒoa `GET /v1/health` ɖe hati ɖesiaɖe dzi. Wolé ŋku ɖe ŋuɖoɖo ƒe ɣeyiɣi + nɔnɔme ŋu.
federation.h4p2: Lãmesẽ ƒe dzesi: gbãtɔ 100. Ɣeyiɣi ɖesiaɖe si woatsɔ awɔ dɔe la ɖea 1 le eme; dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ ɖesiaɖe tsɔa 1 kpena ɖe eŋu (cap 100). Dzesi 0 → federation tɔ vie na hati ma.
federation.h4p3: Wotae to `GET /v1/peers` dzi na dɔwɔla ƒe dashboardwo.
federation.h1_a: Federation le Vortex me nye kadodo si me kakaɖedzi le wo nɔewo ŋu le node dɔwɔla eve dome. Node ɖesiaɖe taa Ed25519 dutoƒo safui si ƒe didime nye byte 32; node kemɛa tsɔe kpe ɖe `trusted_nodes` kplɔ̃ ŋu le eƒe nuwuƒe kple lãmesẽ ƒe dzesi aɖe xa.
federation.h1_b: Pubkey si dzi woka ɖo tsɔtsɔ kpee bia tso dɔwɔla si be wòade asi admin biabia te kple node la ŋutɔ ƒe asiɖeɖe le safui. UI la ɖea remote la ƒe asibidɛ ƒe dzesi fiana le 64-hex-char nɔnɔme me ale be admins ateŋu aɖo kpe edzi le out of band. Ne wotsɔe kpee ko la, woɖoa kpe federation ƒe agbalẽkotoku ɖesiaɖe si ge ɖe eme dzi le pubkey ma ƒe Ed25519 ƒe asidede agbalẽ te nu — wokpɔa aʋatsokakawo enumake eye woŋlɔa wo ɖe agbalẽ me. Teteɖeanyi fa: fli la nɔa dzesi `revoked_at` hena agbalẽdzikpɔkpɔ, gake agbalẽkotokua ƒe asidede agbalẽ te do kpo nu azɔ.
federation.h1_c: Woɖe kpɔɖeŋua tso Matrix ƒe federation (afisi server ɖesiaɖe doa boblo asidede safui aɖe eye wodea asi wɔna ɖesiaɖe te kplii) kple tso email ƒe DKIM (afisi DNS taa asidede ƒe pubkey). Matrix ɖo kpe edzi be kpɔɖeŋua wɔa dɔ le dzidzenu nu — woƒe network la wu 100k federated servers. Vortex ƒe tɔtrɔ to vovo to biabia be woawɔ ɖeka kple wo nɔewo ƒe tiatia tẽ ɖe Matrix ƒe "dɔdzikpɔla ɖesiaɖe ateŋu awɔ ɖeka le gɔmedzedzea me" se teƒe; míetsɔ nusiwo sɔ ɖɔ li ametakpɔnu sesẽ wu ɖe dukɔwo dome habɔbɔ alakpatɔ ŋu.
federation.h1_f:
trusted_nodes ƒe fli:
  pubkey : 32 bytes Ed25519 ƒe ƒuƒoƒo
  nuwuƒe : https://...
  lãmesẽ_xexlẽdzesi : int [0, 100].
  wotsɔe kpe ɖe eŋu le : unix_ms
  added_by : admin_zãla_dzesi
  woɖe asi le_le_le : unix_ms | NULL ƒe .
federation.h2_a: Gbedasi si tso cross-node la doa E2E envelope ma ke abe nutoa me tɔ ene, woxatsae ɖe gota envelope si wode asi ete si ɖoa kpe node si ɖoa ɖa la dzi na node si xɔe.
federation.h2_b: Node A di be yeatsɔe ayi na user@B. Afɔɖeɖe 1: A serialises `{tsoƒe_node, taɖodzinu_zãla, ememe_ciphertext, ememe_nonce, ɖo_le}`. Afɔɖeɖe 2: A dea asi byte siwo woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu kple eƒe Ed25519 private key → `sig`. Afɔɖeɖe 3: A POSTs tuple la ɖe `POST /federation/deliver` le node B. Afɔɖeɖe 4: B dia `source_node` le eƒe `trusted_nodes` me, ɖoa kpe `sig` dzi, léa ŋku ɖe `sent_at` ŋu ɖe replay-window ŋu, eye wòléa agbalẽkotoku ememetɔa ɖe te le eƒe teƒea ƒe `messages` kplɔ̃a dzi. Asisi si xɔe la kpɔae abe gbedasi si le nutoa me ene pɛpɛpɛ — federation layer la nye nusi nuwuwu zãlawo mekpɔna o.
federation.h2_c: Wodo agbalẽkotoku si wode asi na gota la tso Matrix ƒe `m.room.message` federation events me. Wodo fesre si wogbugbɔ ƒo (aɖabaƒoƒo 5) kple nudidi si nye be ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesi siwo wode asi na tso teƒea nasɔ kple gli gaƒoɖokui la tso DKIM gbɔ. Gbãtɔ Vortex (v0.0.2) te federation si womede asi o kple TLS client certs kpɔ; míetrɔ ɖe payload signatures ŋu le v0.0.5 me le esi míekpɔe dze sii be client certs metsi agbe le load balancers me o eye woɣla nyateƒetoto ŋutɔŋutɔ tso application layer la me vɔ megbe.
federation.h2_f:
agbalẽkotoku = { .
  dzɔtsoƒe_node : hex32, .
  taɖodzinu_zãla : int64, .
  ememe_nyatakaka: bytes, .
  ememe_nonce : bytes, .
  woɖoe_le : unix_ms, .
} .
sig = Ed25519Sign (tsoƒe_priv, CBOR (kotoku))
POST /federation/deliver { agbalẽkotoku, sig } .
federation.h3_a: Ne adzɔge node la gbɔ mateŋu aɖo o la, node si ɖoa ɖa la ɖoa envelope la ɖe fli me le eƒe `federation_outbox` me eye wògadzea agbagba kple exponential backoff.
federation.h3_b: Backoff ɖoɖowɔɖi: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, woɖo tae le 6h. Le agbagbadzedze ɖesiaɖe si do kpo nu me la, woɖoa fli ƒe `agbagbadzedze` kɔlam ɖe edzi eye woɖo `next_retry_at` ɖe fifia + fifia-afɔɖeɖe. Megbedɔwɔla (`app/federation/outbox_worker.py`) nyɔna le s 5 ɖesiaɖe me eye wòfɔa fli siwo me `next_retry_at <= now()`. Dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ tutua fli la ɖa; Ŋkeke 14 ƒe kpododonuwo de dzesii be wòanɔ anyi ɖaa eye nàɖo admin alert ɖa.
federation.h3_c: Exponential backoff with a ceiling nye kpɔɖeŋu ma ke si Kafka zãna na producer gbugbɔgadze agbagba eye SMTP zãna na bounced mail. Ŋkeke 14 ƒe kposɔa sɔ kple SMTP ƒe RFC 5321 ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo. Gbãtɔwo zã sɛkɛnd 60 ƒe gbugbɔgadzedze siwo woɖo ɖi si na dziɖegbe-hawo ƒe dzidziɖedzi ne hati aɖe trɔ gbɔ va Internet dzi le nutsotso aɖe megbe; exponential kaka ɖɔ ema ɖo le v0.0.7.
federation.h3_f:
megbedede (n) = min (6h, 1s · 20) na n = 0, 1, 2, ...

gbugbɔgadze agbagba ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s, ..., 6h
nuxlɔ̃ame: outbox_depth > 1000 hena > 5 min
federation.h4_a: Le sɛkɛnd 60 ɖesiaɖe me la, node ɖesiaɖe ƒoa ping na hati ɖesiaɖe ƒe `/v1/health` nuwuƒe. Dzesiawo yia dzi le dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ me, ɖiɖina ɖe anyi ne wodo kpo nu, eye woɖo seɖoƒe nɛ le [0, 100].
federation.h4_b: Dzesi dzea egɔme tso 100 le add. Dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ ɖesiaɖe tsɔa +1 kpena ɖe eŋu (woɖo seɖoƒe na 100), ɣeyiɣi ɖesiaɖe ƒe nuwuwu ɖea -1 (si wotsɔ anyigba ɖo 0) ɖa. Dzesi 0 tɔa te federation na hati ma — gbedasi yeyewo le fli me le outbox me, wometea kpɔ be yewoatsɔe ayi ŋgɔe yeyee o vaseɖe esime dzesia lia yi megbe wu 20. Woɖea dzesia ɖe go to `GET /v1/peers` dzi na operator dashboards kple to `/metrics` dzi na Prometheus. Dzesi ƒe ɖiɖi kpata le hati geɖewo dome le fesre kpui aɖe me hea "network partition suspected" ƒe nuxlɔ̃ame vɛ.
federation.h4_c: AIMD ƒe atsyã ƒe dzesi la tso TCP ƒe ʋuʋudedi fesre kple Akamai ƒe lãmesẽ-kpɔkplɔ ƒe mɔxenu gbɔ. Afɔɖeɖe si mesɔ o ±1 (ɖe TCP ƒe afã ɖeɖe teƒe) na be hayahaya nɔa blewu wu kpododonu, si naa ɖoɖoa dea akpa aɖe dzi yia ŋuɖɔɖɔɖo gbɔ — anyo na mí be míatɔ te federation ne kakaɖedzi mele mía ŋu o tsɔ wu be míaɖo gbedasi eve ɖa to kadodo si le ʋuʋum dzi. Wotsɔe kpe ɖe eŋu le v0.0.6 me le esi hati aɖe si mewɔ nu gbegblẽ o yɔ hati nyui eve kple agbagbadzedze ake vɔ megbe.
federation.h4_f:
le dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ dzi: dzesi = min(100, dzesi + 1)
le ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu: xexlẽdzesi = max (0, dzesi - 1)
ne xexlẽdzesi == 0: pause_federation (hati) .
ne xexlẽdzesi >= 20: gbugbɔ dze_federation (hati) // hysteresis

gossip.title: Gossip kple hatiwo ƒe nu yeyewo didi
gossip.subtitle: Alesi nodes kpɔa wo nɔewoe ne central registry mele wo si o.
gossip.intro: Le dziɖula ƒe xexlẽdzesi si ŋu woɖo kpee godo la, Vortex nodes ƒoa nu tso hatiwo ŋu le wo nɔewo dome. Esia ke ɖe node yeyewo ŋu esime dɔwɔlawo le wo trɔm, nenye be dziɖula la meɖo kpe wo dzi haɖe o gɔ̃ hã.
gossip.h1p1: Le s 60 ɖesiaɖe me la, node tiaa hati si woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu eye wòɖoa 256-bit Bloom filter si nye hati nyanyɛwo ɖa. Hatiwo ɖoa eŋu kple hati NOT le filter la me, tsɔ kpe ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe filter la ŋu. Bandwidth nye `O(hati yeyewo × 32 bytes)`, zi geɖe le 1 KiB te le ƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe me.
gossip.h1p2: Boblododo ƒe akpaa dea asi hati ɖesiaɖe si wodo bobloe te. Asitsalawo ɖoa kpe asidede agbalẽ te dzi le kadodo gbãtɔ me — amedzidzela mate ŋu awɔ hati aɖe ɖe nyatoƒoetotoa me o.
gossip.h1p3: Woɖo seɖoƒe na ƒoƒoa: asitɔtrɔ ɖeka na hati ɖeka le s 30 ɖesiaɖe me (fesre si wotsɔna ƒua du).
gossip.h2p1: Node yeyewo dzea egɔme kple 8 hardcoded bootstrap controllers. Nyatoƒoetoto ƒe ɣeyiɣi gbãtɔ ke ɖe hati gbogbo aɖewo ŋu; network la ƒoa ƒu le ~1 miniti me.
gossip.h2p2: Woateŋu atrɔ asi le gɔmedzedze ƒe xexlẽdzesi ŋu to `.env` `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@nuwuƒe1,pubkey2@nuwuƒe2,...`.
gossip.h3: Ame si tsi tre ɖe Sybil ŋu
gossip.h3p1: Ele be woatsɔ dɔwɔƒea ƒe Ed25519 ƒe asiɖeɖe le eŋu ƒe safui ade asi hati ɖesiaɖe si wodo bobloe te. Hatiwo ƒe gbeƒãɖeɖe aʋatsokaka bia be woafi safui si sɔ.
gossip.h3p2: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kpeɖodzi (si woate ŋu atrɔ asi le, default 2^18 leading zeros) le hatiwo ƒe ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ yeyewo dzi nana be Sybil-bot ƒutsotsoe gbogbowo mewɔa dɔ o.
gossip.h3p3: Ŋkɔ nyui xɔxɔ ƒe ɖoɖo: hati siwo wɔa nu gbegblẽ (asidede agbalẽ te gbegblẽwo, gbeƒãɖeɖe alakpatɔe, ɣeyiɣi ƒe didime enuenu) ƒe ŋkɔ gblẽna. Zero ŋkɔ → ameyibɔwo ƒe ŋkɔ.
gossip.h1_a: Le s 60 ɖesiaɖe me la, node ɖesiaɖe tiaa hati si woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu eye wòɖoa 256-bit Bloom filter si ƒoa hati nyanyɛwo nu ƒu kpuie. Hatiwo ɖoa eŋu kple hati yeyewo + eya ŋutɔ ƒe filter. Bandwidth nye `O (hati_yeyewo × 32 bytes)`.
gossip.h1_b: Bloom ƒe ʋuʋudedi k=5 hashes, m=256 bits. Node A tsɔa eƒe peer_ids siwo katã wonya la dea eme. Eɖoa hati B. B biaa nya tso filter la ŋu kple ehati ɖesiaɖe; nusianu si to la, B ɖoa ɖe A (tsɔ kpe ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe filter ŋu). A hã wɔa dodokpɔ ma ke le megbedede me. Le asitɔtrɔa megbe la, sidzedze ɖeka kloe le node eveawo siaa si. Nusiwo woɖɔlia zi geɖe: 200-800 bytes. Nya yeyewo ƒoa ƒu ɖe network la katã dzi le ~5 ƒoƒo (aɖabaƒoƒo 5) me akpe ɖe nyatoƒoetoto ƒe nunɔamesi ŋu.
gossip.h1_c: Bloom-filter ƒe nyatoƒoetoto dze egɔme tso Cornell ƒe ƒe 1998 bimodal multicast paper dzi. Apache Cassandra zãnɛ hena hamevinyenye; Bitcoin na asitsatsa ƒe nyatakakaɖoɖoɖa; IPFS na DHT beléle na wo. O(log N) ƒe ƒoƒo ɖekae ƒe nɔnɔmee nye nusi na wòsɔ nyuie na míaƒe zazã — míehiã xexeame katã ƒe nukpɔsusuwo o, ɖeko míehiã hatiwo ƒe sidzedze si sɔ mlɔeba. Wotrɔ asi le filter ƒe lolome (256 bits) ŋu ale be alakpa-nyui ƒe agbɔsɔsɔme nye < 1 % le hati 100 me.
gossip.h2_a: Node yeyewo dzea egɔme kple 8 hardcoded bootstrap controllers. Nyatoƒoetoto ƒe ɣeyiɣi gbãtɔ ke ɖe nu geɖe ŋu; ƒoa ƒu le ~1 miniti me.
gossip.h2_b: `.env` ɖoe kple `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@nuwuƒe1,pubkey2@nuwuƒe2,...`. Le gɔmedzedzea me la, node tea ɖesiaɖe kpɔna ɖe ɖoɖo nu. Gbãtɔ si ɖoa nya ŋu naa hatiwo ƒe xexlẽdzesi gbãtɔ (to `GET /v1/trusted_nodes` dzi). Node tsɔa esiawo dea eƒe nutoa me hatiwo ƒe kplɔ̃ me, dea dzesi wo be wonye bootstrapped, eye wòdzea 60 s ƒe nyatoƒoetoto ƒe ʋuƒoa gɔme. Kpekpe siwo kplɔe ɖo la ke ɖe hatiwo ŋu.
gossip.h2_c: Hardcoded bootstraps nye kpɔɖeŋu ɖeka ma ke Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS zazã. Mɔnu bubu — DHT-si wotu ɖe nusi ŋu woke ɖo — bia be woage ɖe eme gbã to mɔ sia mɔ nu. Wotia Vortex ƒe 8 bootstrap xexlẽme elabena > 4 ƒe amesinɔnɔ naa tenɔnɔ ɖe nɔnɔme 2-3 siwo dzɔna le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me, eye < 16 nana be `.env` faɛl la te ŋu xlẽa. Trɔ asi le dɔwɔwɔ ɖesiaɖe ŋu to asitɔtrɔ le `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS` ŋu.
gossip.h3_a: Ele be woade asi hati ɖesiaɖe si wodo bobloe te to eƒe dzɔtsoƒe dɔwɔla ƒe Ed25519 ƒe asiɖeɖe le eŋu ƒe safui dzi. Amedzidzela mate ŋu awɔ hatiwo ɖe kɔmpiutadziɖoɖoa me o.
gossip.h3_b: Ne node A do boblo hati P le nyatoƒoetoto me na node B la, A dea `P.pubkey`, `P.endpoint`, kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesi, siwo katã wode asi to P ŋutɔ ƒe asiɖeɖe le eŋu ƒe safui me. B ɖoa kpe asidede agbalẽa te dzi hafi ka ɖe P. Ne B do ka kple P emegbe eye P ƒe TLS cert + dzi ƒe tsotso gbãtɔ mesɔ kple pubkey si wodo bobloe o la, wodea dzesi boblododoa be aɖi le eme eye wòkakana ɖe anyi.
gossip.h3_c: Hatiwo ƒe boblododo siwo wode asi ete nye anti-Sybil primitive si wozãna ɖaa tso Chord (2001) kple Kademlia (2002) gbɔ. Bitcoin ƒe addr gbedasiwo zãa kpɔɖeŋu si gbɔdzɔ wu (asidede asi aɖeke meli o, woɖoa ŋu ɖe kadodo ƒe gazazã ŋu abe Sybil ƒe mɔxenu ene); Ethereum ƒe discv5 dzesiwo. Vortex xɔ boblododo siwo wode asi ete le v0.0.6 me le esi testnet amedzidzela aɖe do boblo aʋatso hati 1000 to node ɖeka si le se nu dzi vɔ megbe.
gossip.h1_f:
ʋuʋudedi: k = 5, m = 256 bits
tsɔe de eme (x) = na i le 0..k me: filter [hash_i (x) mod m] = 1
biabia (x) = na i le 0..k: kpɔ filter [hash_i (x) mod m].
alakpa-nyuitɔ le hati 100, bit 256, k=5: ~0.4 % .
gossip.h2_f:
.env: .
  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=abcd...@https://a.kpɔɖeŋu,efgh...@https://b.kpɔɖeŋu

gɔmedzedze:
  na hati le BOOTSTRAP_PEERS me:
    dze agbagba: hatiwo ← hatiwo.xɔ ('/ v1 / kakaɖedzi_nodes'); break
    negbe ɖe: yi edzi
  dze nyatoƒoetoto ƒe loop gɔme
gossip.h3_f:
boblododo = {pubkey, nuwuƒe, boblododo_le}
sig = Ed25519-Dzeside (pubkey_priv, CBOR (boblododo))
nyatoƒoetoto ƒe fetu: [..., {ad, sig}, ...]

xɔla: ɖo kpe sig dzi tsi tre ɖe ad.pubkey → fiase iff ok
kpeɖeŋutɔ: PoW si nye 2^18 ŋgɔgbe zero le {pubkey, nuwuƒe} dzi.

stealth.title: Adzame network
stealth.subtitle: Layer atɔ̃, mɔ̃ 28. Nusianu tso TLS padding dzi va ɖo Tor onion subɔsubɔdɔwo dzi.
stealth.intro: Vortex tsɔe be enye dukɔ-dukɔ ƒe futɔ. Wotsɔa adzame ƒuƒoƒoa ɖoa ƒuƒoƒo me ale be ne woto gotagome ƒuƒoƒoawo ŋu gɔ̃ hã la, ememetɔwo gakpɔtɔ naa subɔsubɔdɔ si gblẽ-gake-wɔa dɔ.
stealth.h1p1: Layer 1 — asibidɛ ƒe dzesi ƒe nɔnɔme si sɔ. Dzudzɔ vovototodedeameme siwo mewɔa dɔ o.
stealth.h1p2: Layer 2 — nɔnɔme / lolome morphing. Dzudzɔ ʋuwo ƒe zɔzɔ me dzodzro ƒe hatsotsowo.
stealth.h1p3: Layer 3 — ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo. Dzudzɔ dɔwɔwɔ DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Layer 4 — ʋuɖoɖo siwo woate ŋu atsɔ aƒo ka na. Ewɔa dɔ le network siwo xea mɔ na míaƒe primary la me.
stealth.h1p5: Layer 5 — mamlɛtɔ-mɔnukpɔkpɔ ƒe fallback. Sabala, BMP, hop geɖe ƒe ʋuʋu. Ewɔa dɔ ne nu bubu aɖeke mewɔa dɔ o.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello sɔ kple Chrome le Windows 11 dzi byte-ɖe-byte. JA3/JA4 hash sɔ kple Chrome 120 — asibidɛ ƒe dzesi Vortex tɔxɛ aɖeke meli o.
stealth.h2p2: Record-layer padding: TLS nuŋlɔɖiwo katã padding va ɖo 16 KB. Packet ƒe lolome sɔ kple browser ƒe ʋuɖoɖo le agbɔsɔsɔ gã me.
stealth.h2p3: Constant-rate send: fli ɖea frame ɖeka le N ms ɖesiaɖe me metsɔ le dɔwɔwɔ ƒe dɔwɔna me o. Dɔmawɔmawɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣiwo doa aʋatsonu siwo wode dzesii le agbalẽkotoku ememetɔ me ale be amesiwo xɔa wo la tsɔa wo ƒua gbe.
stealth.h2p4: Ɣeyiɣi ƒe ʋuʋu: 0-50 ms ƒe megbedede le vome le dodo me be woaɖu latency-si wotu ɖe DPI dzi.
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morfer: packet-size mama, burst cadence, kple ɖoɖoezizi ƒe dometsotsowo sɔ kple YouTube live stream. Classifiers siwo le dɔla ƒe dzi ƒe tsotso dim la mete ŋu sɔ o.
stealth.h3p2: Mɔ geɖe: sisi ɖeka ma ke ma ɖe Wi-Fi, lãmenugbagbeviwo, kple VPN ɖesiaɖe si le dɔ wɔm dzi le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me. Gbugbɔ ƒo ƒu ɖe xɔla la gbɔ. Eɖua mɔ ɖeka ƒe nɔnɔmewɔwɔ dzi.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC data channel tunnel: ne woxe mɔ na TLS gake WebRTC wɔ dɔ la, Vortex toa DTLS-SRTP channel me yia hati si wonya gbɔ.
stealth.h3p4: Decoy kadodowo: 3 ɣeyiɣi didi ƒe TLS ɣeyiɣi siwo me womewɔa naneke le o na Google, YouTube, kple Cloudflare. Observer kpɔa browser ƒe nuwɔna si sɔ.
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): wokpɔ DNS katã gbɔ to DoH dzi va ɖo Cloudflare / Google / Quad9 dzi. ISP kpɔa HTTPS ko na egbɔkpɔnu mawo, ke menye domenyinyi ƒe xexlẽdzesi ŋutɔŋutɔ o.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Encrypted Client Hello): SNI wotsɔ safui si wota ɖe DNS HTTPS nuŋlɔɖi me ɣla. Eteƒekpɔla siwo mewɔa naneke o mate ŋu akpɔ teƒe si woɖo tae ƒe amedzroxɔƒe ŋkɔ o.
stealth.h4p3: Probe detection: node kplɔa biabia siwo me auth session aɖeke mele o. Etɔ̃ siwo do kpo nu tso IP le miniti 5 me ʋãa "decoy site" nɔnɔme — be IP fifia kpɔa HTML landing page gbadzaa kple 200 OK.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm): deterministic domain generator si woƒã kple egbe ƒe ŋkeke. Ne woxe mɔ na nuwuƒe gbãtɔ la, asisiwo bua akɔnta le ame si kplɔe ɖo ŋu eye wodzea agbagba.
stealth.h5: Level 4 — Ʋuɖoɖo siwo woate ŋu atsɔ aƒo ka na
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: V2Ray-style ʋuɖoɖo siwo sɔ kple JSON config si woate ŋu atsɔ aƒo ka na.
stealth.h5p2: Nyateƒenya: TLS-le-TLS mɔ̃memi me. Asiléle le gota gome ƒe taɖodzinuwo www.microsoft.com; asiléle ememetɔ nye Vortex. Probes siwo tsi tre ɖe gota gome ŋu la xɔa ŋgɔ yia Microsoft eyata active probing meɖea naneke fiana o.
stealth.h5p3: Snowflake: lɔlɔ̃nu faa nyatakakadzraɖoƒewo ɖoa Vortex ʋuwo ƒe zɔzɔ ɖe WebRTC dzi. Zãla siwo le Snowflake ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔa dem la naa nutsyɔnu.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: trɔa asi le HTTPS probes ŋu be woatsaka kple Chromium ŋutɔ ƒe nuwɔna vaseɖe microsecond dzi.
stealth.h6p1: Sabala subɔsubɔdɔwo: node ɖesiaɖe hã ɖea eɖokui ɖe go be `.sabala`. Asisi siwo si Tor ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu le la dzea anyi to esia me ne nu bubu ɖesiaɖe do kpo nu.
stealth.h6p2: Blind Mailbox Protocol (BMP): dzra ɖo ɖe gbedasiwo ŋu si womeyɔ ŋkɔ na o. Kpɔ BMP ta.
stealth.h6p3: Multi-hop relay: gbedasiwo ate ŋu atso domedome node siwo ade 5 me, eye wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe atsɔ agbalẽkotoku ƒe ƒuƒoƒo aɖe akpe ɖe eŋu. Abe Tor ene gake le mía ŋutɔwo ƒe mesh me.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): womenya HTTP to relay dzi. Akpa ɖeka aɖeke mekpɔa biabia kple ŋuɖoɖo siaa o.
stealth.h1_a: Wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe adzame ŋu abe ƒuƒoƒo atɔ̃ siwo le wo ɖokui si ene. Layer ɖesiaɖe ɖua futɔ ƒe hatsotso vovovo aɖe dzi. Layer ɖeka ƒe kpododonu gblẽna yia esi kplɔe ɖo dzi — mewɔa cascade o.
stealth.h1_b: Layer 1 naa míaƒe TLS asibidɛ ƒe dzesi nɔa ɖoɖo nu ale be passive DPI mate ŋu ade hatsotsowo me o. Layer 2 morphs ʋuwo ƒe nɔnɔme be wòadze abe streaming ene. Layer 3 ɣlaa ɖoɖowɔɖia to ECH / DoH / probe-response tricks dzi. Layer 4 trɔna ɖe pluggable transports (vmess, nyateƒe, Snowflake) ne woxe mɔ na gbãtɔa vevie. Layer 5 nye mɔnu mamlɛtɔ: Tor sabala, BMP, multi-hop relay.
stealth.h1_c: Layered model la tso Tor ƒe pluggable-transports architecture (2013) me. Vortex tsɔ ƒuƒoƒo atɔ̃ kpe ɖe Tor ƒe etɔ̃ teƒe elabena kaka ƒe 2025 naɖo la, tsitretsiɖeŋu ƒe nɔnɔme la lɔ DPI si de dzesi Tor ƒe ʋuɖoɖowo ŋutɔ (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). Woto Vortex ƒuƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe vɛ le agblemenudzɔdzɔ aɖe megbe: L1 le Kazakhstan ƒe mɔxexe megbe (si sɔ kple ƒe 2019), L2 le Iran ƒe ƒe 2022 ƒe amedzidzedze megbe, L3 le China ƒe ƒe 2020 DoH ƒe dzesi megbe, L4 le Turkey ƒe mɔxexe 2023 megbe, L5 le dzadzraɖo me.
stealth.h2_a: Layer 1 na be womate ŋu ade vovototo Vortex ƒe ʋuɖoɖo tso Chrome gbɔ le Windows 11 dzi le TLS layer la gbɔ o.
stealth.h2_b: ClientHello ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ, kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔ ƒe xexlẽdzesi, cipher suite ƒe xexlẽdzesi, ALPN ƒe asixɔxɔwo — wo katã wotrɔ asi le wo ŋu be woasɔ kple Chrome 120 ƒe bytes pɛpɛpɛ. JA3/JA4 hash sɔ kple Chrome ƒe tata si woɖe ɖe go fifia. TLS nuŋlɔɖi padding va ɖo 16 KB. Constant-rate sender doa frame ɖeka le N ms ɖesiaɖe me kple dummy fillers le dɔmawɔmawɔ me. Ɣeyiɣi ƒe jitter 0-50 ms be woaɖu latency numekuku dzi. Decoy kadodowo yi Google, YouTube, Cloudflare zɔna le megbe le s 45 ƒe dometsotsowo me.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 asibidɛ ƒe dzesi nye esi Salesforce ƒe mɔ̃ɖaŋudɔwɔlawo ta le ƒe 2017. Kaka ƒe 2019 naɖo la, ezu dzidzenu le dɔwɔƒe DPI. Wowɔ Vortex ƒe asibidɛ ƒe dzesi ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu ƒe kpɔɖeŋu ɖe uTLS, Go agbalẽdzraɖoƒe si Snowflake zãna hena taɖodzinu ma ke dzi. Nudɔdɔ siwo xɔa fetu ɣesiaɣi nye WireGuard ƒe "cover traffic" ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo ƒe melidzeƒe tẽ.
stealth.h2_f:
AsitsalawoHello bytes = chrome_120_template kple { .
  random = míaƒe random, .
  server_name = míaƒe amedzro ŋkɔ (alo ECH-xatsa), .
  session_id = míaƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe id, .
} .
JA4 = t13d_xxxx_xxxx_xxxx (esɔ kple Chrome si li fifia)
stealth.h3_a: Layer 2 morphs traffic be wòadze abe bulk streaming media ene tsɔ wu be wòanye interactive chat.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morfer: packet-lolome mama sɔ kple 720p YouTube live stream (nuteƒekpɔkpɔ kplɔ̃), burst cadence sɔsɔ, ɖoɖoezizi dometsotsowo sɔ. Mɔ geɖe: tɔsisi ɖeka si me susu le si ma ɖe Wi-Fi, lãmenugbagbeviwo, kple VPN ɖesiaɖe si le dɔ wɔm dzi le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me; receiver gaƒoa ƒu ɖe ɖoɖo si nu xexlẽdzesiwo kplɔ wo nɔewo ɖo nu. WebRTC data channel fallback: ne woxe mɔ na TLS gake WebRTC to eme la, to Vortex to DTLS-SRTP data channel dzi yi hati si wonya gbɔ.
stealth.h3_c: Ʋuwo ƒe tɔtrɔ ŋuti numekuku dze egɔme tso Wright et al. 2009. Obfs4 tsɔe de dɔwɔwɔ me abe eƒe "morph" sub-mode ene le ƒe 2014. Meek+domain-fronting fia mí be nɔnɔmea le vevie abe encryption ene. Wotia YouTube koŋ elabena eyae nye nyatakakadzraɖoƒe gãtɔ ɖeka kolia si womexe mɔ na o le mɔxexeɖedɔléle nu ƒe kadodo akpa gãtɔ me — bebeƒe le YouTube-nɔnɔme ƒe ʋuɖoɖo me nye "bebe ɖe amehawo dome".
stealth.h3_f:
packet_lolome [nye] ~ P (lolome | YT-720p)
ɖo_heheɖemegbe [nye] ~ P (heheɖemegbe | YT-720p)
dummy_frames siwo wotsɔ de eme le dɔmawɔmawɔ me be woalé agbalẽkotoku ƒe nɔnɔme me ɖe asi
stealth.h4_a: Layer 3 ɣlaa ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe dzesidenu ŋutɔ — SNI, DNS, ŋuɖoɖo ƒe kɔdawo.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS katã toa DNS-dzi-HTTPS dzi va ɖoa Cloudflare/Google/Quad9. ISP kpɔa HTTPS ko na nyagbɔkpɔla mawo. ECH (RFC 9460): Wotsɔ safui si wota ɖe DNS HTTPS nuŋlɔɖi me la ɣla SNI. Eteƒekpɔla siwo mewɔa naneke o kpɔa ŋgɔgbe IP ko. Probe detection: nodes kplɔa unauth'd IPs ƒoƒo `/api/*`; kpododonu etɔ̃ le miniti 5 me trɔ IP la ɖe "decoy mode" — be IP fifia kpɔa static HTML landing page kple 200 OK. DGA: deterministic domain generator seeded kple egbe ƒe ŋkeke ale be asisiwo kpɔa fallback ne woxe mɔ na gbãtɔa.
stealth.h4_c: DoH dze egɔme le Firefox 2018 me eye wòzu default na Chrome le 2019. ECH to atɔ̃ drafts hafi standardization le 2024 — Vortex ɖo kpekpeɖeŋu le draft-13 me eye fifia edoa alɔ spec mamlɛtɔ. Wodo probe-response decoys tso meek ƒe ƒe 2014 ƒe nɔnɔme me eye wotrɔ asi le wo ŋu le ƒe 2023 me le esi Iran ƒe active probers de dzesi meek to eƒe ŋuɖoɖo ƒe ɣeyiɣi dzi vɔ megbe.
stealth.h5_a: Layer 4 zãa pluggable transports — ame etɔ̃lia ƒe mɔ̃ siwo le abe nu bubu aɖe ene keŋkeŋ.
stealth.h5_b: vmess/vless/trojan: V2Ray ƒe atsyã ƒe ʋuɖoɖo siwo wozãna ɖaa; ɖoɖowɔɖi JSON. Nyateƒenya: TLS-le-TLS mɔ̃ si me gotagome asiléle tɔa ŋku www.microsoft.com; asiléle ememetɔ nye Vortex. Woɖoa probes siwo le dɔ wɔm yi gota la ɖe Microsoft, eyata probing meɖea naneke fiana o. Snowflake: lɔlɔ̃nu faa nyatakakadzraɖoƒewo tsɔa Vortex ɖoa WebRTC dzi; infra aɖeke mele míaƒe akpa dzi o. NaiveProxy: trɔa asi le HTTPS probes ŋu be woatsaka kple Chromium ƒe nuwɔna tututu.
stealth.h5_c: V2Ray ƒe VMess nye esi Chinatɔwo ƒe habɔbɔ si tsi tre ɖe mɔxexeɖedɔléle nu ƒe habɔbɔa to vɛ le ƒe 2015 me. Trojan dze egɔme le ƒe 2019. Nyateƒea tso ƒe 2022 — si nye ŋuɖoɖo na Great Firewall ƒe TLS asibidɛ ƒe dzesi didi. Snowflake nye Tor Project ƒe ƒe 2020 ƒe xɔ ɖe obfs4 teƒe; Vortex tsɔ kpekpeɖeŋu kpee le v0.0.9 me le Iran ƒe ƒe 2023 ƒe Tor ƒe gegeɖeƒewo ƒe mɔxexe blibo megbe.
stealth.h5_f:
nyateƒe si gena ɖe eme ƒe kpɔɖeŋu:
  dɔwɔƒe ƒe Ŋkɔ: www.microsoft.com
  dest: www.microsoft.com: 443 ƒe agbalẽa me
  shortIds: ["<nuwɔna le vome>"].
asisi doa ka kple míaƒe IP, SNI=www.microsoft.com, míewɔa proxy Microsoft ŋuɖoɖo ŋutɔŋutɔ
ne mɔ sɔ kple shortId+auth ⇒ mɔ si yi Vortex .
stealth.h6_a: Layer 5 nye ayemɔ ƒe akplo mamlɛtɔ: sabala subɔsubɔ, BMP fiase-kple-yi ŋgɔ, multi-hop relay, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Node ɖesiaɖe taa `.onion` adrɛs. Asisi siwo si Tor-ŋutete ƒe amedzro le la dzea anyi to eme ne TLS + L1-L4 katã do kpo nu. BMP (Blind Mailbox Protocol): dɔla tsɔa blob si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔe la ƒua gbe ɖe node ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ `HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1")`; ameŋunyagbɔgblɔ kaka; amesi xɔe la hea nu tso woƒe aƒeme node me. Multi-hop: gbedasiwo ƒua du to domedome nodes siwo ade 5 me, wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe tsɔa agbalẽkotoku ƒe ƒuƒoƒo kpena ɖe eŋu — abe Tor ene gake le mía ŋutɔwo ƒe mesh me. OHTTP (RFC 9458): oblivious HTTP to relay dzi ale be akpa ɖeka aɖeke mekpɔa biabia kple ŋuɖoɖo siaa o.
stealth.h6_c: Sabala subɔsubɔ dze egɔme tso ƒe 2004 me le Tor. BMP nye mía ŋutɔwo ƒe nutovɛ, si wotsɔ Tor ƒe subɔsubɔ ɖɔɖɔɖonu ɣaɣla ƒe nyatoƒoetoto ƒe kpɔɖeŋu wɔ. Multi-hop relay ahuhɔ̃ewo Signal ƒe nutrenu-dɔla kpe ɖe sabala mɔzɔzɔ. OHTTP tso ƒe 2024 me, si Cloudflare kple Apple to vɛ hena telemetry si akpɔ ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyatakakawo ta; míexɔe le v0.0.9 me abe fallback mamlɛtɔ ene.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP lɛtaɖaka_id = HKDF(xɔla_pk, "bmp-v1", 32)
Dede: POST /bmp/deposit { lɛtaɖaka_id, blob }
Pickup: GET /bmp/gbedasiwo (wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu)
TTL: 7200 s |  Max blob: 1 MB |  Max ɖe node ɖeka dzi: 500 MB

bmp.title: Blind Mailbox ƒe Ðoɖowɔɖi
bmp.subtitle: Dzraɖoƒe-kple-yi ŋgɔ na gbedasiwo to nyatoƒoetoto ƒe mɔ̃a dzi.
bmp.intro: BMP na be ame si ɖoe ɖa la tsɔa gbedasi aɖe dea node ɖesiaɖe me evɔ meɖea amenyenye fiana o. Gbedasi la ƒoa nya ta vaseɖe esime wòɖoa amesi xɔe ƒe aƒeme node gbɔ, afisi wòɖea nya ɣaɣlawo gɔme le abe alesi wònɔna ɖaa ene.
bmp.h1p1: Dɔdɔla xɔa `mailbox_id = HKDF(amesi xɔla_pubkey, nyatakaka: "bmp-v1", len: 32)`. Dɔla (amesi nya recipient_pubkey) koe ateŋu abu akɔnta le eŋu; amesi xɔe hã nya.
bmp.h1p2: Dɔla ɖoa `POST /bmp/deposit` kple `{mailbox_id, blob}` ɖe nyatoƒoetoto ƒe node ɖesiaɖe.
bmp.h1p3: Node dzraa eve ɖo hena s 7200. Node hã dea mailbox_id le next gossip round ƒe Bloom filter me.
bmp.h1p4: Node bubuwo hea blobs na mailbox_ids siwo ŋu wotsɔ ɖe le le nutoa me (ame siwo xɔe le woƒe node dzi).
bmp.h1p5: Amesi xɔe ƒe asisi bia gbe `GET /bmp/messages` eye wòɖea blob yeye ɖesiaɖe gɔme kple eƒe nya vevi siwo wòzãna ɖaa.
bmp.h2p1: Node aɖeke mateŋu atsɔ blob aƒo ƒu kple amedɔdɔ o — dɔla ƒe TLS kadodoa dea dzesi dzɔtsoƒe IP, gake kɔsɔkɔsɔ si me sabala hops le le dɔla kple BMP node gbãtɔ dome ɖea ema hã ɖa.
bmp.h2p2: Recipient-hiding: blob nye nya ɣaɣla kple amesi xɔe ƒe pubkey. Titina nodes kpɔa opaque byte string kple random mailbox_id ko.
bmp.h2p3: Womeɖo kpe dɔdɔ ƒe kpeɖodzi aɖeke na amesi ɖoe ɖa o. At-most-once gɔmeseseŋutinunya.
bmp.h3p1: Max blob ƒe lolome: 1 MB. Ele be woaɖe payload gãwo ɖe akpa vovovowo me to faɛl ƒe sisi dzroa me.
bmp.h3p2: Max nudzraɖoƒe le node ɖeka me: 500 MB ƒe deposits le wo katã me. LRU ameɖeɖe le aƒea me le cap. Dɔdzikpɔlawo ate ŋu awɔ toɖoɖo.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: per-IP deposit rate seɖoƒe li na 10 / min. Mailbox ID siwo wokpɔ wu zi 3 / gaƒoƒo le node ɖeka dzi la nye rate-limited abe tsiɖɔɖɔ si wosusu ene.
bmp.h4p1: High-censorship recipients: mehiã be dɔla nanya amesi xɔe ƒe aƒeme node o.
bmp.h4p2: Kadodo si nɔa anyi ɣeaɖewoɣi: blobs lalana vaseɖe esime amesi xɔe la gaɖo kadodo me ake eye wòabia gbe.
bmp.h4p3: Nyatakaka si womeyɔ o: sabala si le amedɔdɔ ƒe akpa dzi + BMP = metadata aɖeke meli le amesi tsɔ nusi de eme ŋu o.
bmp.h1_a: BMP nye fiase-kple-do ŋgɔ ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si ƒe ŋkɔ womeyɔ o. Sender tsɔa blob ƒua gbe ɖe node ɖesiaɖe si ŋu nyatoƒoetoto le; blob la lala le lɛtaɖaka si me wotsɔ safui ɖo ɖe amesi xɔe ƒe dutoƒo safui ɖeɖeko me.
bmp.h1_b: Dɔla bua akɔnta be `mailbox_id = HKDF(amesi_xɔla_pubkey, "bmp-v1", 32)`. Ame aɖe si nya `recipient_pubkey` koe ateŋu abu akɔnta — amesi xɔe nya, amesi ɖoe ɖa, ame etɔ̃lia menyae o. Dɔla POSTs `{mailbox_id, blob}` na nyatoƒoetoto ƒe node ɖesiaɖe. Node dzraa eveawo ɖo vaseɖe 7200 s (2 h), eye wòɖea gbeƒã mailbox_id le nyatoƒoetoto ɖɔliɖɔli Bloom ƒe ʋuʋudedi si kplɔe ɖo me. Node bubu siwo kpɔ mailbox_id le teƒea si sɔ kple zãla ƒe lɛtaɖaka si wodzra ɖo ɖi la hea blob la eye wòyia ŋgɔ na zãla ma ƒe asisi.
bmp.h1_c: BMP nye esi Vortex ƒe ƒuƒoƒoa wɔ tso gɔmedzedzea me ke. Míetue elabena dɔla vevi aɖeke melɔ̃ be yeazã nunɔamesi siwo hiã be woatsɔ aɣla metadata tso nuwuwu vaseɖe nuwuwu o — adzɔnu vevi ɖesiaɖe ɖoa nyatakakawo ƒe nya ɣaɣlawo ɖe amewo gake wogblẽa agbalẽɖoɖoɖa ƒe akpaa ɖi wòʋu, eyata dɔdzikpɔla aɖe gakpɔtɔ nya amesi ƒoa nu kple amesi kple ɣekaɣi. Le ƒuƒoƒoa me la míenɔ gbɔgblɔm be "dɔla si le dedie si doa go le hadome graph la me la le dedie afã ko." BMP nye míaƒe ŋuɖoɖo: ame si ɖoe ɖa, amesi xɔe, kple emenyawo katã va zua nusiwo me mekɔna o; node ɖeka aɖeke si le mesh la me meléa kakɛ siwo sɔ gbɔ be woagbugbɔ dzeɖoɖo aɖe aɖo o. Eƒua du to Vortex ŋutɔ ƒe nyatoƒoetoto avɔ dzi tsɔ wu be woatsɔ bolted-on xɔtuɖoɖowo, si na be asitsatsa ƒe gazazã sɔ eye woate ŋu adzro aɖaŋua me le aƒea me.
bmp.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF (amesi xɔla_pubkey, nyatakaka = "bmp-v1", len = 32)

Dede: POST /bmp/deposit {mailbox_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Ðe gbeƒã: nyatoƒoetoto Bloom filter += lɛtaɖaka_id
Pickup: GET /bmp/messages (auth'd) → blobs na zãla ƒe mailbox_ids
TTL: 7200 s |  ɖesiaɖe-node nudzraɖoƒe ƒe nutrenu: 500 MB |  ga si woatsɔ ade eme ƒe agbɔsɔsɔme: 10/min/IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP naa ameŋunyatakaka ƒe nɔnɔme etɔ̃ siwo le wo ɖokui si: dɔla-ɣla, amesi xɔ-ɣla, emenyawo ɣla.
bmp.h2_b: Sender-hiding: TLS kadodo kple depositing node ɖea dzɔtsoƒe IP fiana; Tor hop alo kɔsɔkɔsɔ si wotsɔ sabala zɔ mɔe tsɔtsɔ kpe ɖe BMP node gbãtɔ ŋu ɖea ema ɖa. Recipient-hiding: mailbox_id nye mɔ ɖeka dzi hash si nye recipient_pubkey si wotsɔ BMP version string dze dzee — titina node kpɔa 32-byte ƒe dzesidenu si me mekɔ o. Content-hiding: blob nye E2E-encrypted xoxo na amesi xɔe to Vortex xɔ / DM safui dzrowo zazã me, eyata titina node la kpɔa nya ɣaɣlawo ko.
bmp.h2_c: Nu etɔ̃ ƒe wɔwɔme nye alesi Pond ɖɔ eƒe taɖodzinuwo le ƒe 2014. Vortex trɔ asi le eŋu to mailbox_id wɔwɔ be wòate ŋu anɔ te ɖe ƒoƒo nu (256-bit hash) ale be zãla eve siwo medo ƒome kple wo nɔewo o mate ŋu ama lɛtaɖaka le vo me o. 7200-sɛkɛnd TTL tso ŋkuléle ɖe eŋu be 95 % le amesiwo xɔe le míaƒe beta me he le 2 h me; nudzraɖoƒe si didi wu TTL si wodo ya ɖe node ɖesiaɖe me si me viɖe aɖeke manɔmee le delivery me o.
bmp.h2_f:
Futɔ si kpɔ node nɔnɔme:
  - nya be mailbox_id li le ɣeyiɣi T
  - ɖe NOT nya dɔla (nye TLS/Tor hop away) .
  - ɖe NOT nya amesi xɔe (mailbox_id nye mɔ ɖeka dzi hash)
  - ɖe NOT nya emenyawo (blob nye E2E-ncrypted) .
bmp.h3_a: Seɖoƒe sesẽwo na blob ƒe lolome, node ɖesiaɖe ƒe nudzraɖoƒe, kple deposit rate na BMP mezua dead-drop na nyatakaka siwo wodi o.
bmp.h3_b: Max blob ƒe lolome: 1 MB. Ele be payload gãwo natso faɛl ɖoɖo dzro si si eya ŋutɔ ƒe nudzraɖoƒemɔ le la me. Max per-node nudzraɖoƒe: 500 MB katã ƒe BMP deposits. Ne woɖo ta la, xoxotɔ-gbãtɔ ɖeɖeɖa tsɔa blobs ƒua gbe hafi woƒe TTL — dɔwɔlawo ateŋu atrɔ asi le eŋu to `BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Deposit rate per IP: 10 per minute, be woatsi tre ɖe tsiɖɔɖɔ si tso amedzidzela ɖeka gbɔ ŋu. Woɖo seɖoƒe na lɛtaɖaka ƒe ID siwo wokpɔ wu zi 3/gaƒoƒo le network la katã me abe "si wosusu be tsiɖɔɖɔ ƒe taɖodzinu" ene.
bmp.h3_c: 1 MB blob cap la sɔ kple IRC DCC-dɔdɔ ƒe kɔnyinyiwo kple Signal ƒe sealed-sender cap — lolo ale gbegbe na gbedasi kpuiwo kple nɔnɔmetata suewo, sue ale gbegbe be amedzidzela mate ŋu azã BMP na faɛlwo xɔxɔ o. 500 MB ɖesiaɖe-node nye OSS-default susu; dɔwɔla gãwo fɔnɛ ɖe dzi kple `BMP_MAX_BYTES`. Rate limits va le v0.0.8 beta megbe afisi tester ƒe dodokpɔ script yɔ node 50 kple deposits le miniti 20 me.
bmp.h3_f:
seɖoƒewo:
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 # 1 MB .
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB .
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # le miniti ɖeka me le IP ɖeka me.
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # lɛtaɖaka_id ɖeka le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me
bmp.h4_a: BMP klẽna le nɔnɔme etɔ̃ me: amesiwo xɔa nyatakaka siwo me woɖea mɔ ɖe nu ŋu le vevie, kadodo si nɔa wo dome ɣeaɖewoɣi, nyatakaka siwo wogblɔna le amewo ƒe ŋkɔ manɔmee.
bmp.h4_b: High-censorship: sender menya recipient ƒe aƒeme node o (eye ɖewohĩ mateŋu aɖo egbɔ le mɔ aɖeke nu o). Drop at any hati, na nyatoƒoetoto ƒe mɔ. Kadodo si nɔa anyi ɣeaɖewoɣi: amesi xɔe la mele Internet dzi gaƒoƒo geɖe o; blob lala, mehiã be woagadze agbagba ake o. Nyatakaka si womeyɔ o: sabala si le amedɔdɔ ƒe akpa dzi + BMP = metadata aɖeke meli ku ɖe amesi tsɔ nusi de eme ŋu o. Ne wotsɔ xɔa ƒe safui si ame siwo dzi woka ɖo koe nya kpe ɖe eŋu la, emenyawo hã me mekɔna na mɔxenu ɖesiaɖe o.
bmp.h4_c: Zãzã etɔ̃awo léa ŋku ɖe ŋutinya me nusiwo ʋãa ame kukuwo le ŋkutsala ŋutɔŋutɔ me (Soviet-ɣeyiɣi), na `alt.anonymous.messages` le Usenet (ƒe 1990-awo), kple na SecureDrop (2013 yi ŋgɔe). BMP nye míaƒe agbagbadzedze be míatsɔ ŋutinya ma ava egbegbe dɔla me evɔ mahiã be míazã dɔwɔnu bubu aɖeke o.

push.title: Push nyatakakawo
push.subtitle: APNs, FCM, Web Push — wo katã kple agbalẽkotoku siwo wotre nu na ale be dɔwɔƒewo mate ŋu axlẽ nu o.
push.intro: Standard push services (APNs, FCM, Web Push) kpɔa agba ɖesiaɖe si ŋu viɖe le. Vortex xatsa nyatakaka ɖesiaɖe ɖe E2E ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si le vovo me ale be dɔwɔƒea nakpɔ blob si me mekɔ o si me xɔ ƒe id, amedɔdɔ, alo nuŋɔŋlɔ aɖeke mele o ko.
push.h1p1: Asitsaha xɔa platform token (APNs device token, FCM ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe id, alo Web Push ƒe nudɔdɔ JWT).
push.h1p2: Asitsaha wɔa 32-byte X25519 safui yeye `p256dh_pub` kple 16-byte `auth` nya ɣaɣla. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` kple `{nuwuƒe, p256dh, auth, platform}`.
push.h1p3: Node gakpɔtɔ li `push_subscriptions (zãla_id, nuwuƒe, p256dh, auth, mɔ̃, wowɔ_le)`.
push.h2p1: Ne gbeƒãɖeɖe ƒe ɣeyiɣia de (gbedasi yeye le xɔ si me womeƒoa nu le o si woɖo be wòana nyanya, ayɔ, ayɔ amekpekpe), node tsɔa AES-GCM ɣlaa payload la to safui si woɖe tso `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` me to HKDF dzi.
push.h2p2: Node packages `{nuwuƒe, TTL, kpata, tanya: <collapse_key>, nyatakakawo: <ciphertext>}` eye woɖonɛ ɖe APNs / FCM / Web Push server.
push.h2p3: `nyatakaka` (nya ɣaɣla) + `tanya` koe nananala kpɔna. Nuŋɔŋlɔ siwo me kɔ o ƒe dodo aɖeke meli o.
push.h3p1: Xɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe tanya vevitɔ: `xɔ:<id>`. Gbedasi geɖe siwo le xɔ ɖeka me la mu va zua nyatakaka ɖeka le OS ƒe ɖoɖo nu.
push.h3p2: Kaƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe ƒe tanya: `yɔ:<id>`. Ŋuɖoɖo alo gbegbe hea aflagaa; ameyɔyɔ yeye siwo va xɔ ma ke me tsɔ xɔ ɖe xoxoa teƒe.
push.h4p1: iOS: Notification Service Extension ɖea nyatakakawo gɔme le NSE ƒe ɖoɖoa me (eɖe vovo tso dɔwɔnu vevitɔ gbɔ). Ezãa CryptoKit ƒe gɔmedzenu mawo ke.
push.h4p2: Android: FirebaseMessagingService ɖea nyatakakawo gɔme le megbenyawo me. JobScheduler wɔa ɖoɖo ɖe UI yeye ŋutɔŋutɔ ne app le ŋgɔgbe.
push.h4p3: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe: Subɔsubɔdɔwɔla ɖea nya ɣaɣlawo gɔme le SW nyawo me, ɖoa teƒea ƒe nyatakaka to Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe Nyatakakawo API dzi.
push.h5: Quirks siwo ku ɖe dɔwɔƒe si naa kpekpeɖeŋu koŋ ŋu
push.h5p1: APNs: bia be woagbugbɔ dɔwɔƒe si naa dzesi la awɔ yeyee le miniti 60 ɖesiaɖe me. Wowɔa dzesi ƒe yeyewɔwɔ le eɖokui si to Apple ƒe `auth-team-id` + `auth-key-id` + p8 safui faɛl dzi.
push.h5p2: FCM: domenyinu HTTP nuwuƒe si woɖe asi le; míezãa HTTP v1 ƒe nuwuƒe kple OAuth2 subɔsubɔ ƒe akɔnta ƒe ɖaseɖigbalẽwo. Trɔtrɔ le gaƒoƒo 1 ɖesiaɖe me.
push.h5p3: Web Push: VAPID safuiwo (safui eve ɖeka le node ɖesiaɖe me). TTL capped le ŋkeke 28 dzi to browser akpa gãtɔ dzi.
push.h1_a: Asitsaha ŋlɔa mɔ̃ ƒe dzesi (APNs/FCM/Web Push) ɖekae kple X25519 dutoƒo safui yeye kple 16-byte auth nya ɣaɣla.
push.h1_b: Asitsalawo wɔa `p256dh_priv = rand (32)` kple `auth = rand (16)`. Woɖea `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G` ɖa. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` kple `{nuwuƒe, p256dh, auth, mɔ̃, zãla_dɔwɔla}`. Node gakpɔtɔ li `push_subscriptions (zãla_id, nuwuƒe, p256dh, auth, mɔ̃, wowɔ_le, mamlɛtɔ_gbugbɔ_le)`. Trɔtrɔ: asisi la gbugbɔ ŋlɔa ŋkɔ le dɔwɔnua ƒe gɔmedzedze ɖesiaɖe me, si gbugbɔa `last_refreshed_at` yeyee. Woɖea nudɔdɔ siwo xɔ wu ŋkeke 30 la ɖa.
push.h1_c: p256dh + auth ƒe agbleawo tso Web Push RFC 8291 (2017) me. Míegazã wo na APNwo kple FCM togbɔ be subɔsubɔdɔ mawo mehiã na nɔnɔme si wotre enu o hã — esia wɔwɔ nana kɔdamɔ ɖeka nɔa etɔ̃awo katã dzi. Hafi v0.0.5 la Vortex ɖoa agbalẽ gbadzawo ƒe viɖewo to push dɔwɔƒewo dzi; le Apple ƒe ƒe 2022 ƒe push privacy update kple nudzɔdzɔ bubu aɖe si me FCM dɔ aɖe si womeɖo nyuie o la do nyatakakawo do go megbe la, míetsɔ nusianu yi agbalẽkotoku siwo wotu nu ɖo me.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = rand (32) ƒe ɣeyiɣia me.
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519 .
nyateƒe = rand (16) .

POST /api/tutu/wɔ nudɔdɔ
  { nuwuƒe, p256dh: hex (p256dh_pub), auth: hex (auth), nuƒolanɔƒe }
push.h2_a: Ne gbeƒãɖeɖe aɖe ƒe ɣeyiɣia de la, node la tsɔa nyatakaka si woatsɔ awɔ dɔe la ɣlana ale be amesi xɔe ƒe mɔ̃ koe ate ŋu axlẽe. Push subɔsubɔdɔ (Apple / Google / Mozilla) kpɔa blob si me mekɔ o ko.
push.h2_b: Node tia ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe X25519 safui eve. Ekpɔa `ikm = ECDH(ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe_priv, p256dh_pub)`. Dua HKDF (dze = auth, ikm, info = "aesgcm", len = 32) → safui. Encrypts `{tanya, ŋutilã, xɔ_id, gbedasi_id}` abe CBOR → AES-GCM kple safui si wokpɔ + random 96-bit nonce. Ðo `{nuwuƒe, TTL, kpata, tanya: collapse_key, nyatakakawo: ciphertext, aes128gcm: {dze, pub_ephemeral}}` ɖe APNs/FCM/Web-Push. Device xɔa, kekeɖenudɔ / subɔsubɔ dɔwɔla ƒua du ma ke safui derivation le megbe, decrypts, ɖea gbeƒãɖeɖe fiana.
push.h2_c: Sealed push nye tẽ Web Push Gbedasɛ Encryption spec tso 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple ƒe ƒe 2022 iOS 16 ƒe yeyewɔwɔ tsɔ gbãtɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu kpee na nyatakaka dɔwɔƒe ƒe kekeɖenudɔ siwo le nya ɣaɣlawo ɖeɖeɖa wɔm; Android do alɔe to FCM data gbedasiwo dzi ƒe geɖe. Vortex nye dɔla ʋee siwo wɔa sisi bliboa ŋudɔ kple kɔda ɖeka le mɔ̃ etɔ̃awo katã dzi la dometɔ ɖeka — iOS zãa `NotificationServiceExtension`, Android zãa `FirebaseMessagingService`, Web zãa subɔsubɔdɔwɔla.
push.h2_f:
ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe_priv = rand (32);  ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe_pub = ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe_priv · G
ikm = ECDH (ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ƒe_priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(nyatakaka, ikm) .
safui = HKDF-Kkeke (prk, "Emenyawo-Nuŋɔŋlɔ: aes128gcm \ x00", 16)
nonce= HKDF-Expand (prk, "Emenyawo-Nuŋɔŋlɔ: nonce \ x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Encrypt (safui, nonce, fetu)
send { nuwuwu, nyatakaka: dze∥nuŋlɔɖi_lolome∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct }
push.h3_a: Collapse keys xea mɔ na nyatakaka geɖe siwo tso dzeɖoɖo ɖeka me be woagaƒo ƒu abe aflaga ɖekaɖekawo ene o — OS la ƒoa wo nu ƒu ɖe ɖeka me.
push.h3_b: Xɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe mumu: tanya = `xɔ:<id>`. APNwo ƒe `apns-collapse-id` kple FCM ƒe `collapse_key` gblɔ na OS be woatsɔ tanya ma ke aɖɔli nyatakaka siwo do ŋgɔ. Zãla kpɔa aflaga ɖeka le xɔ ɖesiaɖe me eɖanye gbedasi agbɔsɔsɔme kae va o. Kaƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe ƒe mumu: tanya = `yɔyɔ:<id>`; amekpekpe yeyewo va xɔ ma ke me axɔ ɖe esiwo nɔ anyi tsã la teƒe. Per-mention: topic = `yɔ:<zãla>:<xɔ>`; ɖeka yɔ aflaga ɖesiaɖe zãla-xɔ eve.
push.h3_c: Wotsɔ collapse keys kpe ɖe APNs ŋu le iOS 10 (2016) kple FCM le ƒe 2014. Do ŋgɔ na ema la, gbedasi geɖewo ƒe gbagbãwo na multi-banner stacks siwo zãlawo lé fui ɖekae. Telegram ye nye mɔɖela le xɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe mumu UX me le ƒe 2015 me; dɔla gã ɖesiaɖe kplɔe ɖo. Vortex ƒe mama ɖe xɔ / yɔyɔ / yɔyɔ ƒe mumu tso zãla ƒe nyaŋuɖoɖo le v0.0.6 beta me be "yɔyɔ amekpekpe xɔ ɖe dzeɖoɖo ƒe aflaga teƒe" se le eɖokui me be mesɔ o — tanya vovovowo ɖɔe ɖo.
push.h3_f:
APNs: apns-collapse-id = xɔ:42 → ɖɔlia aflaga siwo nɔ anyi do ŋgɔ
FCM: collapse_key = yɔ:17 → ɖɔlia aflaga siwo do ŋgɔ
Web: topic = mention:u12:r5 → ɖɔlia aflaga siwo nɔ anyi do ŋgɔ
push.h4_a: Gotchawo le nuƒolanɔƒe ɖesiaɖe si. iOS hiã Nyatakaka Dɔwɔƒe ƒe Kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔ; Android hiã FCM nyatakaka gbedasiwo; Web hiã subɔsubɔdɔwɔla + VAPID.
push.h4_b: iOS: dɔwɔnua ƒe babla la ɖoa `NotificationServiceExtension` taɖodzinu. System tsɔa payload si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ la yina na NSE; NSE si 30 s ƒe CPU + 25 MB ƒe ŋkuɖodzinu be wòaɖe nyatakakaa gɔme ahatrɔe hafi woaɖee afia. FCM: míeɖoa `data` gbedasiwo (menye `nyatakaka` o) ale be app la ƒe FirebaseMessagingService zɔna le vava me — si naa míekpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe nenye be míaɖe aflaga aɖe afia. Web Push: subɔsubɔdɔwɔla xea mɔ na `push` nudzɔdzɔwo, ɖea wo gɔme, ɖea wo fiana to `self.registration.showNotification` dzi.
push.h4_c: NSE ƒe kpɔɖeŋua nye esi Apple to vɛ le iOS 10 (2016) me koŋ na gbedasi-ɖe nya ɣaɣlawo zazã ƒe nɔnɔmewo. Do ŋgɔ na ema la, ele be dɔla siwo wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ tso nuwuwu yi nuwuwu natiae le nuŋɔŋlɔ gbadzaa ƒe push payloads (privacy-hostile) kple badge-only pushes (UX-hostile) dome. WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram katã ti kpo yi NSEwo me le ƒe ɖeka me. Vortex hã zɔna ɖe ɖoɖo ma ke dzi.
push.h5_a: Provider-specific quirks — akpa aɖe le push ta la me. Esia nye mɔnu vevi siwo ŋu woƒo nu tsoe le Vortex ƒe nufiame bliboa me la dometɔ ɖeka. Xlẽ ta si ƒo xlãe hena nya siwo ƒo xlãe si keke ta wu; akpa sia dzia nuwɔna tɔxɛa ɖe edzi.
push.h5_b: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe wɔwɔfia na "Provider-specific quirks". Wowɔa mɔ̃a ŋudɔ le module si sɔ me le `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, alo `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` te. Module README yɔa faɛl mɔ siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
push.h5_c: "Provider-specific quirks" mɔnu la trɔ le Vortex ƒe asiɖeɖe le eŋu me. Aɖaŋu si wowɔ la tso numekuku kple ewɔwɔ ƒe mɔnu siwo wota siwo dɔla siwo do ŋgɔ wɔ la gbɔ. Version ŋutinya le `CHANGELOG.md` me ŋlɔa ɣeyiɣi si me akpa ɖesiaɖe ɖi kple nusi ʋãe.

controller.title: Dzɔla ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ
controller.subtitle: Fɔmaɖimaɖi ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi, gege ɖe eme ƒe didi, lãmesẽ dzi kpɔkpɔ.
controller.intro: Dzɔla la nye Python dɔwɔwɔ si to vovo. Eƒe amedzidzedze ƒe anyigba le sue (anɔ abe mɔ wuieve ene) eye eƒe kakaɖedzi le Ed25519 dutoƒo safui ɖeka si woɖa ɖe asisiwo me ŋu.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/integrity` — ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe emetsonu. Schema: `{nɔnɔme, signed_by, trusted_pubkey, version, built_at, sɔ, mesɔ o, bu, kpeɖeŋutɔ, gbedasi}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1/lãmesẽ` — agbe nɔnɔ. Schema: `{nɔnɔme: "ok", tɔtrɔ, pubkey, akɔntabubuwo:{inline, woda asi ɖe edzi, blibo}}`.
controller.h1p5: `GET /v1/trusted_nodes` — hati siwo wonya be wowɔ ɖeka.
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/dzi ƒe tsotso/{pubkey}` — node ƒe agbenɔnɔ ŋuti numekuku. Wozãnɛ to federated nodes dzi be woƒe ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ nanɔ yeye.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` — node yeye aɖe bia be woaka ɖe edzi. Ebia be admin nada asi ɖe edzi negbe ɖe `AUTO_APPROVE=true`.
controller.h2p1: Faɛl si dzena: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 ƒe asidede agbalẽ te le faɛl ɖesiaɖe me.
controller.h2p2: Dzidzime: `python -m vortex_dziɖula.integrity.dzesi_dɔwɔnu`. Xlẽ asiɖeɖe le safui ŋu tso `keys/release.key`, zɔ ati, ŋlɔ manifest.
controller.h2p3: Kpeɖodzi: dziɖula xlẽa manifest la le gɔmedzedzea me eye wòtsɔnɛ sɔna kple disk. Gɔmedzedze doa kpo nu sesĩe le masɔmasɔ ta.
controller.h3p1: Ahuhɔ̃ewo wɔa controller code ɖeka ma ke kple release key ma ke si wowɔ kɔpi ɖe edzi. Asitsalawo kpɔa `signed_by` ɖeka le ahuhɔ̃ewo dzi — mɔ ɖeka si dzi woato ade dzesi aʋatso ahuhɔ̃e enye be woatsɔ pubkeys asɔ kple wo nɔewo.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS ta nufiamɔ̃wo ɖe ahuhɔ̃e geɖewo dometɔ ɖeka ŋu. Asitsalawo dzea agbagba le ɖoɖo si nu wole vevie wu nu kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu.
controller.h3p3: `vortex.sol-mirror/` ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe si le repo sia me nye trycloudflare ahuhɔ̃e si le klalo na ŋgɔyiyi.
controller.h1_a: Controller ƒe dutoƒo API anyigba la anɔ abe mɔ wuieve ene. Wo katã wole sue, wo katã woƒe susu nɔ ɖaseɖiɖi kple gege ɖe eme-URL kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔ ŋu.
controller.h1_b: `/v1/integrity` — wode asi ɖaseɖiɖi si dze ƒã te. `/v1/lãmesẽ` — agbenɔnɔ + pubkey + akɔntabubuwo. `/v1/entries` — nuŋɔŋlɔ URLwo hena kadodo. `/v1/mirrors` — ahuhɔ̃edzikpɔlawo. `/v1/trusted_nodes` — habɔbɔa ƒe hatiwo. `/v1/dzi ƒe tsotso/{pubkey}` — node ƒe agbenɔnɔ ŋuti numekuku. `/v1/register` — node yeye bia na kakaɖedzi (admin ƒe mɔɖeɖe negbe ɖe `AUTO_APPROVE=true`). Emae nye ema — eɖoe koŋ le kpuie be amedzidzedzea ƒe anyigba nanɔ sue ŋutɔ.
controller.h1_c: Wona nyanya anyigba ƒe nɔnɔme si le gbadzaa la to ŋkuléle ɖe eŋu be ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe ɖoɖoa va zua taɖodzinu si ƒe asixɔxɔ lolo wu ne asisiwo nya tsɔe de asi eŋu ko. Kɔda suetɔ = anyigba si le sue wu. Tsɔe sɔ kple node si si mɔ 120+ le; the controller has 12. Kpɔɖeŋu ma tɔgbe: Debian ƒe apt-get ka ɖe `Release.gpg` ƒe dɔwɔwɔ sue aɖe si to vovo tso package hosting gbɔ dzi.
controller.h2_a: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` zɔa dzɔtsoƒeti la, hashes faɛl ɖesiaɖe, dea dzesi kple asiɖeɖe le safui, ŋlɔa `INTEGRITY.sig.json`.
controller.h2_b: Dɔwɔnu xlẽ `safuiwo/release.key` (32-byte Ed25519 ame ŋutɔ ƒe safui). Azɔli `vortex_controller/` + `app/` (metsɔ gitignored faɛlwo o). Le faɛl ɖesiaɖe gome la: `blake3(emenyawo) → hash`. Builds manifest `{version, built_at, faɛlwo: [{mɔ, sha256, lolome}]}`. Bu akɔnta be `canonical_bytes = CBOR(ɖee fia)`. Dzesiwo: `sig = Ed25519-Dzesi (ɖe asi le_safui, canonical_bytes)`. Ŋlɔ `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {ɖee fia, de asi_to: pubkey, dzesi}`.
controller.h2_c: Manifesto siwo wode asi la trɔ yi Debian ƒe Release.gpg (1997) kple PGP-siwo wode asi na Linux kernel tarballs. Sigstore (2021) trɔ asi le kpɔɖeŋua ŋu hena nuzazãwo ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi. Vortex ƒe tɔtrɔa le bɔbɔe wu elabena eɖo kpe dɔwɔwɔ ɖeka dzi, ke menye akpa geɖe ƒe asiɖeɖe le kɔsɔkɔsɔ ŋu o. Míate ŋu axɔ Sigstore le v0.4 me na dutoƒo ƒe dodo.
controller.h3_a: Ahuhɔ̃ewo wɔa controller code ɖeka ma ke kple release key ɖeka. DNS / SNS / IPFS nya geɖe fia ahuhɔ̃e geɖe dometɔ ɖeka.
controller.h3_b: Dɔwɔlawo ɖoa ahuhɔ̃e N (zi geɖe la, 3-5). Wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe wɔa `vortex_controller` kɔda ɖeka ma ke kple `keys/release.key` ɖeka ma ke. Asitsalawo kpɔa `signed_by` ɖeka le ahuhɔ̃ewo dzi — susuŋudɔwɔwɔ ƒe dodokpɔ nyui aɖe. DNS/SNS/IPFS ŋlɔa ahuhɔ̃ewo kple nusiwo wotsɔ ɖo nɔƒe gbãtɔ. Asitsalawo dzea agbagba le ɖoɖo si nu wole vevie wu nu, eye sɛkɛnd 7 ƒe ɣeyiɣia wu enu le agbagbadzedze ɖesiaɖe me. `vortex.sol-mirror/` ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe si le repo sia me nye trycloudflare ahuhɔ̃e ƒe kpɔɖeŋu si wotsɔ ka bla do ŋgɔ.
controller.h3_c: Ahuhɔ̃e geɖe siwo me didi vevie le la nye kpɔɖeŋu ɖeka ma ke si SMTP zãna na MX nuŋlɔɖiwo eye HTTPS zãna na SRV nuŋlɔɖiwo. Tor ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe dziɖuɖumegãwo nye kpɔɖeŋu si do ƒome kplii — 9 hardcoded DAs + votes. Vortex tia "tia ahuhɔ̃e si wɔa dɔ" wu "quorum vote" elabena aɖaŋu siwo wotu ɖe akɔdada dzi la te ŋu nɔa te ɖe nɔnɔme sesẽwo nu wu gake wodzea egɔme blewu ŋutɔ.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/integrity : GET → ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe emetsonu
/v1/health : GET → {nɔnɔme, tɔtrɔ, pubkey, akɔntabubuwo}
/v1/entries : GET → [{ɖoɖowɔɖi, url}, ...]
/v1/huhɔ̃ewo : GET → [dziɖula_url, ...]

storage.h2p3: Prod mode: `alembic dodoɖeŋgɔ ta` hafi dze egɔme. Docker nɔnɔmetata la ƒua du le entrypoint la me.

storage.h4p1: `make db-backup` wɔa ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesi ƒe nudzraɖoƒe. Encrypted le ɖiɖiɖemeɣi kple operator key.
storage.h4p2: Nusiwo woalé ɖe te: gbesiagbe hena ŋkeke 14, kwasiɖa sia kwasiɖa hena kwasiɖa 4, ɣleti sia ɣleti hena ɣleti 12.
storage.h4p3: Gbugbɔgaɖoanyi: `wɔ db-gbugbɔ FILE=<mɔ>`. Dua le fefewɔƒe DB gbã; operator verifies emegbe swaps.
storage.h1_a: Node ƒe nudzraɖoƒe nye SQL. SQLite na dev kple sue ɖokuitɔdidi; PostgreSQL na federated alo multi-node wɔwɔ. SQLAlchemy 2.x async code ɖeka ma ke ʋu evea siaa.
storage.h1_b: Ðoɖowɔwɔ to `DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///vortex.db` alo `postgresql+asyncpg://zãla:pw@host/db` dzi. Single config, kɔda forks aɖeke meli o. SQLite zɔna le dɔwɔwɔ me; Postgres ƒua du ɖe vovo. Dɔwɔwɔ: SQLite kpɔa ~50 zãla siwo le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me gbɔ bɔbɔe le M1 dzi; Postgres ƒe dzidzenuwo va ɖoa akpe geɖe. Ʋuʋu Postgres → SQLite nye mɔ ɖeka to `pg_dump --data-ko` + SQLite tsɔtsɔ yi duta; mɔfiame kemɛa hã le nenema ke.
storage.h1_c: "Ðeka ORM, megbetɔ eve" ƒe kpɔɖeŋua nye ƒe ewo ƒe SQLAlchemy nuwɔna. Vortex zãa async 2.x API eyata biabia ɖesiaɖe le lalam. Míeɖe SQLAlchemy Core ɖe Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / raw `asyncpg` dzi na ʋuʋu ŋutinya si me kesinɔnuwo le wu kple esi sɔ kple FastAPI ƒe async nyagbɔgblɔwo.
storage.h2_a: 18 core tables: zãlawo, zãla_mɔ̃wo, xɔwo, xɔ_metɔwo, gbedasiwo, nuwɔna, faɛlwo, nuxexlẽ_xɔwo, anyinɔnɔ, federations, federation_outbox, ɖoɖowɔɖi_gbedasiwo, kadodowo, saved_gifs, agbalẽdzraɖoƒewo, bot_installations, sessions, push_subscriptions.
storage.h2_b: Zãlawo ƒe kplɔ̃e nye dzesidenu ƒe ke. room_members lé (xɔ, zãla, akpa, joined_at, muted_vaseɖe). gbedasiwo tsɔa nya ɣaɣlawo + metadata; indexed on (room_id, id) na axadzixɔse. reactions nye kplɔ̃ si wotsɔ ƒo ƒui-gbãtɔ-safui. Nu bubu ɖesiaɖe le tẽ. Nudzraɖoƒe tsina ɖe fli me kple gbedasiwo ƒe xexlẽme — anɔ abe 1 KB le gbedasi ɖesiaɖe dzi le disk dzi le index ƒe ta dzi megbe.
storage.h2_c: Ðoɖoa li ke le v0.0.4 megbe. Do ŋgɔ la, `dm_messages` kple `group_messages` kplɔ̃ vovovowo nɔ mía si; ƒo ƒu ɖe v0.0.3 me le fanout code la gbugbɔgawɔ le wo ame evea siaa dzi vɔ megbe. Tabla 18-awoe nye esiwo le sue wu na dɔla si ƒe nɔnɔmewo de blibo; dɔwɔwɔ gãwo tsɔa numekuku kplɔ̃wo kpena ɖe eŋu gake esiawo mehiã na dɔwɔwɔ o.
storage.h3_a: Alembic kpɔa ʋuʋu yi teƒe bubuwo dzi. Linear revision history, revision ɖeka le dodo ɖesiaɖe me. `upgrade()` kple `downgrade()` dɔwɔwɔwo siaa le tɔtrɔ ɖesiaɖe si.
storage.h3_b: `alembic/versions/` léa tɔtrɔwo ɖe asi. Wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe nye Python faɛl si me wodoa ŋgɔyiyi/ɖiɖi le. CI ƒua du `alembic upgrade head` + `alembic downgrade -1` + `alembic upgrade head` tsɔ ɖoa ​​kpe mɔzɔzɔ yiyi kple gbɔgbɔ dzi. Ewɔwɔ: `wɔ db-migrate` wɔa dɔ le Docker ƒe gegeɖeƒe hafi app dze egɔme. Dev mode zãa `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` eyata iteration le kabakaba evɔ mehiã ʋuʋu le rebase ɖesiaɖe dzi o.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) nye SQLAlchemy ʋuʋu dɔwɔnu si le se nu. Linear ŋutinya (menye alɔdzewo o) nye tiatia — eƒoa asa na "dɔwɔla eve wɔa ɖɔɖɔɖo xexlẽdzesi ɖeka" ƒe kuxia. Django ƒe ʋuʋu yi teƒe bubuwo hã zãa mɔnu ma ke. Rails ʋu tso linear dzi yi timestamped dzi le ƒe 2014 me gake wogaxɔ linear-with-merge le ƒe 2020 me.
storage.h4_a: Wotiaa key indexwo nyuie ale be hot reads (gbedasiwo, reactions, read receipts) ƒoa disk dzi ƒã.
storage.h4_b: `messages(room_id, id DESC)` — axadzidzedze ƒe dzesi gbãtɔ. `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — ɣeyiɣi si woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu ƒe megbedede na ɖɔɖɔɖowo. `reactions(message_id)` — nuƒoƒoƒu le xɔ si le ʋuʋu ɖi dzi. `xlẽ_xɔxlɔ̃wo (xɔ_id, gbedasi_id)` — "kpɔe to N" xexlẽme. `zãla_mɔ̃wo (zãla_id)` — dɔwɔnuwo ƒe xexlẽdzesi. FTS virtual kplɔ̃wo hena didi (FTS5 le SQLite dzi, tsvector le Postgres dzi).
storage.h4_c: Index tiatia tso explain-plan-profiling le v0.0.4 agba dodokpɔ me. Míedze egɔme kple naive indexes eye míetsɔe kpe ɖe eŋu/ɖee ɖa le biabia ƒe ɖoɖo siwo wokpɔ nu. `messages(room_id, id DESC)` nye index ɖeka si xɔ dzo wu — anɔ abe 80 % ene le nuxexlẽwo me ƒoe. Ne èna wònɔ kpuie (no include columns) la, enaa wòdzena le ŋkuɖodzinu me.

bots.title: Bot ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + asitsaƒe + antispam.
bots.intro: Bots nye xɔme gomekpɔlawo le hatsotso gbãtɔ me. Wotsɔa bot ƒe Ed25519 safui dea asi gbedasiwo te ale be woate ŋu ade dzesi aʋatsokakawo.
bots.h1p1: Tiatia eve: Python SDK alo Gravitix DSL. Python nye dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo sesẽwo tɔ; Gravitix na nudzɔdzɔ-ʋuʋu chat bots siwo wòle be woaɖo ɖe wo kaba.
bots.h1p2: Python kpɔɖeŋu: `tso vortex_bot import Bot\nbot = Bot (dzesi =...) \ n@bot.le_gbedasi\nasync def echo (nyatakaka): lala bot.ɖo (nyatakaka.xɔ_id, gbedasi.nuŋɔŋlɔ) \ nbot.run ()`. SDK la kpɔa WebSocket, kadodo yeye, nya ɣaɣla ƒe safui ɖɔliɖɔli gbɔ.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix kpɔɖeŋu: `on /start { emit "Mido gbe nam, {ctx.ŋkɔ_gbãtɔ}!" }`. Eƒoa nu ƒu ɖe bytecode me eye wòwɔa dɔ le gbegɔmeɖela si wotsɔ sandbox me.
bots.h1p4: Woɖea bot token ɖe go le bot wɔwɔ me. Token si bu la? `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token` ɖe yeye ɖe go.
bots.h2p1: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu eve: le dɔwɔwɔ me (coroutine le node la me) kple egodo (bot polls `/api/bots/{id}/updates`).
bots.h2p2: Le dɔwɔwɔ me: zero network hop, kabakaba wu, gake ele be dɔwɔla naka ɖe bot code dzi. Good na eya ŋutɔ ƒe bots.
bots.h2p3: External: webhook alo didi-biabia. Node-level kakaɖedzi aɖeke mehiã o. Good na ame etɔ̃lia ƒe bots kple asitsaƒea.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix bots zɔna ɣesiaɣi le dɔwɔwɔ me le sandbox — woƒe faɛlɖoɖo alo network ƒe mɔɖeɖe aɖeke mele wo si o negbe API si dze ƒã ko.
bots.h3p1: Dutoƒo botwo ate ŋu atsɔ wo ɖokui ade asi me. Totoɖemelawo ɖoa kpe edzi be code mewɔa phish o, mewɔa spam o, meɖea zãla ƒe nyatakakawo do goe o.
bots.h3p2: Ƒomewo: dɔwɔwɔ, fefewo, nyadzɔdzɔwo, dɔwɔnuwo, ai, gbegɔmeɖeɖe.
bots.h3p3: Install: zi ɖeka. Node ŋlɔa nudɔdɔ na zãla la ɖe bot ƒe zãla ƒe ŋkɔ me ale be DMwo zɔ mɔ nyuie.
bots.h3p4: Gakpɔkpɔ: femaxee, zi ɖeka ƒe nuƒle, nudɔdɔ. Nuƒolanɔƒe ƒe fetu 10 %% le ga gbogbotɔ me.
bots.h4p1: Wotsɔa antispam bot si womekpɔna o léa ŋku ɖe xɔ ɖesiaɖe ŋu. Dzodzrowo: kadodo ƒe tsɔtsɔme > 3 le miniti ɖeka me, ŋɔŋlɔdzesi gãwo ƒe xexlẽme > 70 %% na ŋɔŋlɔdzesi 10+, gbedasi siwo wogbugbɔna, akɔntabubu yeye ƒe ƒuƒoƒo ƒe gbagbã kpata.
bots.h4p2: Nuwɔnawo: nuxlɔ̃ame → ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu (5 min) → afɔkpodzi → mɔxexe ɖe enu. Nyagbugbɔgadrɔ̃wo yi na xɔdzikpɔla.
bots.h4p3: Tuneable le xɔ ɖesiaɖe me to bot config dzi.
bots.h1_a: Bots nye xɔme gomekpɔlawo le hatsotso gbãtɔ me. Ed25519 safui kple dzesi le wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ŋu; wodea asi gbedasi ɖesiaɖe si woɖona ɖa la te, eyata woate ŋu ade dzesi aʋatsokakawo.
bots.h1_b: Wɔ: aƒetɔ POSTs `/api/bots` kple `{zãla ƒe ŋkɔ, ɖeɖefia_ŋkɔ, kɔda}`. Node wɔa `zãlawo` fli kple `is_bot=true`, wɔa Ed25519 safui eve, trɔa private-key bot dzesi na aƒetɔ (woɖee fia zi ɖeka). Run: bot nɔa agbe le dɔwɔwɔ me abe coroutine ene alo le gota la, eƒoa gbe na `/api/bots/{id}/updates` kple eƒe dzesi. Gbedasi siwo tso bots gbɔ tsɔa `from_bot: true` aflaga eye wodea asi ete kple bot ƒe safui ɣaɣla.
bots.h1_c: Slack (2014) ye dze Bot APIwo gɔme eye Telegram (2015) ye trɔ asi le wo ŋu. Vortex ƒe tɔtrɔ: bot ƒe asidede agbalẽ te blaa gbedasiwo ɖe bot ƒe dzesidenu ŋu, eyata node si ŋu wogblẽ nu le mete ŋu wɔ "@bot gblɔ X" o. Matrix ƒe bot ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔ nunɔamesi sia kpe ɖe eŋu le ƒe 2021 me to federated signatures dzi; Vortex si le esi tso v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix nye gbegbɔgblɔ si wozãna le domenyiŋusẽfianu koŋ me hena bots siwo nudzɔdzɔwo ʋãna ŋɔŋlɔ. Susu sue aɖe, si ɖea nu me, si woƒo ƒu ɖe sandboxed bytecode me.
bots.h2_b: Nyagɔmeɖegbalẽ: `on /start { emit "Mido gbe nam, {ctx.ŋkɔ_gbãtɔ}!" }`. Handlers blana ɖe triggers (sedede, regex, nudzɔdzɔ). Ŋutilã nye `emit`, `let`, `if`, `ɖoɖowɔɖi`, kple bubuawo ƒe tsiatsia Nuƒoƒoƒula ɖea bytecode ɖa; runtime ɖea egɔme le sandbox si me filesystem aɖeke mele o, network si wowɔ le wo ɖokui si mele o, Vortex ƒe API koe. Numekugbalẽ bliboa le Gravitix docs ta la me.
bots.h2_c: Wowɔ Gravitix le v0.0.6 me le esi wokpɔe be bot code akpa gãtɔ nye 80 % boilerplate be woatsɔ ka aƒo Vortex SDK la nu, eye susu ŋutɔŋutɔ ƒe kernel le titina. A DSL na be susua klẽna eye wòxea mɔ na shovelling arbitrary Python ɖe bot-dev nɔnɔme si me sandbox sisi ate ŋu adzɔ le.
bots.h3_a: Xɔ ɖesiaɖe me antispam bot si womekpɔna o si léa ŋku ɖe tsiɖɔɖɔ, kadodo spam, gbedasi siwo woɖona enuenu, kple akɔntabubu yeye ƒe join bursts ŋu.
bots.h3_b: Sewo: kadodo ƒe kpekpeme > 3 le miniti ɖeka me tso zãla ɖeka gbɔ, ALL-CAPS ƒe xexlẽme > 70 % le gbedasiwo dzi ≥ 10 chars, gbedasi gbugbɔgagblɔ > zi 3 le s 30 me, ƒuƒoƒo ƒe gbagbã kple akɔnta ƒe ƒe < 24 h > 20 le s 60 me. Nuwɔnawo doa gã ɖe edzi: nuxlɔ̃ame → miniti 5 ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu → gaƒoƒo 1 ƒe afɔkpodzi → mɔxexe ɖe enu (admin ƒe mɔɖeɖe ɖe mɔxexeɖedɔa nu). Woate ŋu atrɔ asi le xɔ ɖesiaɖe ŋu to `/antispam config` dzi.
bots.h3_c: Antispam heuristics tso IRC-ɣeyiɣia me bot sewo (Eggdrop, BitchX) kple egbegbe ɖoɖowo abe Discord AutoMod ene ƒe ƒuƒoƒo me. Wotrɔ asi le dzidzenu tɔxɛ siwo le Vortex me ŋu ɖe ɣleti 6 ƒe beta corpus si me gbedasi 200k le ŋu; alakpa-dɔlékui ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ nye ~0.3 % le mɔxexeɖedɔa nu ƒe nyagbugbɔgadrɔ̃ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ si wokpɔ la nu.
bots.h4_a: Dutoƒo botwo tsɔa wo ɖokui ɖoa asi me. Totoɖemelawo ɖoa kpe edzi be ameflunya aɖeke meli o / spam aɖeke meli o / nyatakaka aɖeke metso o. Zãlawo dzroa nu me le hatsotsowo nu eye wodaa wo ɖe mɔ̃a dzi kple asiƒoƒo ɖeka.
bots.h4_b: Submission: aƒetɔ ŋlɔ bot dzɔtsoƒe + numeɖeɖe. Reviewer tsɔa kɔdasia ƒua du le sandbox me, xlẽnɛ hena anti-pattern siwo wonya, léa ŋku ɖe network kaƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe si to API siwo ŋu woɖe mɔ ɖo me ŋu, ɖoa kpe ameŋunyatakakawo ŋuti ɖoɖowo dzi. Listing: hatsotso, asi, dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ, install xexlẽme. Dede: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` — node wɔa nudɔdɔ na zãla ɖesiaɖe. Gakpɔkpɔ: femaxee / zi ɖeka / nudɔdɔ; nuƒolanɔƒea xɔa 10 %.
bots.h4_c: App ƒe asitsaƒewo trɔ yi ƒe 2008 ƒe App Store. Slack App ƒe Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe (2015), Discord Bot ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024). Vortex ƒe 10 % ƒe ɖeɖe le anyi wu Apple ƒe 30 % eye wòɖiɖi vie wu Shopify ƒe 20 %, si wotia be woatsɔ ade dzi ƒo na dɔwɔlawo be woata. Wowɔ ŋkuléleɖenuŋu ƒe ɖoɖoa ƒe kpɔɖeŋu ɖe GitLab ƒe "totoɖeme le gɔmedzedzea me, ɖe xexlẽdzesi ɖa le nyatoƒoetoto" dzi.
bots.h3_f:
nusiwo ʋãa ame:
  link_density > 3/min → xlɔ̃ nu
  all_caps_ratio > 0.7 (≥10c) → xlɔ̃ nu
  repeat_count > 3 le ƒe 30 me → xlɔ̃ nu
  new_joiner_burst > 20 le ƒe 60-awo me → xɔmeʋuʋu

dzidzi ɖe edzi:
  Nuxlɔ̃ame 2 → 5 min ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu
  Nuxlɔ̃ame 3 → 1 h afɔkpodzi
  Nuxlɔ̃ame 4 → mɔxexe ɖe enu (admin da asi ɖe edzi)
bots.h4_f:
hatsotsowo: dɔwɔwɔ, fefewo, nyadzɔdzɔwo, nuzazãwo, ai, gbegɔmeɖeɖe
asixɔxɔ: femaxee | zi ɖeka (USD ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ) | nudɔdɔ (USD/ɣleti) .
lãɖeɖe: 90 % na developer, 10 % na Vortex .
review: manual, ~3 dɔwɔŋkekewo taɖodzinu tɔtrɔ

ops.title: Dɔwɔwɔwo
ops.subtitle: Deploy, ŋkuléle ɖe eŋu, rollback.
ops.intro: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe dɔ ɖesiaɖe kple `wɔ` taɖodzinu alo CLI sedede. Ops ƒe axawo nɔa `deploy/` me.
ops.h1p1: `docker compose up` hea node, dziɖula, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy vɛ.
ops.h1p2: Volumes: `/nyatakaka / vortex.db`, ​​`/nyatakaka / uploads`, `/nyatakaka / nuŋlɔɖiwo`. To dzi be nàxɔ amedzrowo hena kutrikuku.
ops.h1p3: Nutome: `.env` le repo ke me. Mègatsɔ ɖokuiwò na gbeɖe o. `.env.example` nye nɔnɔmetata la.
ops.h1p4: Caddy auto-fetches Let's Encrypt ɖaseɖigbalẽwo. Let's Encrypt rate limits apply — zã staging na dodokpɔwo.
ops.h2p1: `wɔ install` — de Python deps + dev dɔwɔnuwo.
ops.h2p2: `wɔ dev` — uvicorn kple reload le melidzeƒe 9000.
ops.h2p4: `wɔ lint` — ruff + mypy. CI xea mɔ na kpododonuwo.
ops.h2p5: `wɔ docker-build` — tu nɔnɔmetata si wode dzesii be `vortex:<VERSION>`.
ops.h2p8: `wɔ ci` — ƒu du CI pɔmpi bliboa le nutoa me.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` nye PyInstaller ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si me pywebview GUI le.
ops.h3p2: Sisi gbãtɔ: tia node ŋkɔ → wɔ asiɖeɖe le safuiwo → ɖoɖo TLS (Let's Encrypt / tsɔ-wò ŋutɔ / ɖokuiwò de asi) → tia nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ƒe URLwo → na adzame nawɔ dɔ → ʋu dzodoƒe ƒe ʋɔtruwo.
ops.h3p3: Le ɖoɖowɔwɔ megbe la, aɖaŋuwɔla nɔa anyi abe admin console ene: dze/tɔ te node, kpɔ nuŋlɔɖiwo, trɔ safuiwo, tsɔ federated peers kpee.
ops.h4p1: Wode dzesi ɖesiaɖe si woɖe ɖe go le git me. Tag hã de asi ete kple release key ale be tag la ŋutɔ nye esi ŋu woate ŋu aɖo kpee.
ops.h4p2: Rollback: `git checkout <tag> && na docker-tutu && docker nawɔ -d`. Nodes siwo le du dzi la tsia tsi eye wogadzea egɔme ake.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `downgrade <rev>` do alɔe na tɔtrɔ sue ɖeka megbe. Ne míeyi megbe yi ŋgɔe la, ebia asidede nu me.
ops.h1_a: `docker compose up` hea Vortex ƒe ƒuƒoƒo bliboa vɛ: node, dziɖula, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: `docker-compose.yml` le repo ke me. Volumes `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs` si wodo ɖe host dzi ale be nyatakakawo nanɔ anyi le gbugbɔgadzedzewo katã me. Healthchecks: node lãmesẽ iff `/lãmesẽ/dzra ɖo` trɔ 200; dziɖula iff `/v1/integrity` trɔ gbɔ woɖo kpe edzi. Caddy auto-fetches Let's Encrypt ɖaseɖigbalẽwo. `.env` naa nya ɣaɣlawo (megawɔe gbeɖe o). `.env.example` nye nɔnɔmetata la.
ops.h1_c: Docker Compose nye de-facto kpɔɖeŋu na multi-container self-hosted subɔsubɔdɔwo. Umami, Gbɔgbɔ, Plausible, Miniflux katã zãnɛ. Wogbugbɔ Vortex ƒe compose file la tso v0.0.2 dzi yi ŋgɔe; nɔnɔme si li fifia la li ke le v0.0.5 me. Wogblẽa mɔnu bubuwo (k8s, nomad) ɖi abe kamedede na dɔwɔla gãwo ene.
ops.h2_a: Makefile nye titina gegeɖeƒe na dev kple ops afɔɖeɖe ɖesiaɖe. `wɔ kpekpeɖeŋu` ŋlɔ taɖodzinuwo.
ops.h2_b: `wɔ install` → `pip install -r nudidiwo.txt`. `wɔ dev` → uvicorn kple reload. `wɔ dodokpɔ` → pytest + nutsyɔtsyɔ, emetsonuwo `kpekpeɖeŋu.xml`. `wɔ lãgbalẽ` → ruff + mypy. `wɔ docker-tu` → `docker tu -t vortex:$VERSION`. `wɔ db-migrate` → `alembic ƒe ŋgɔyiyi ƒe ta`. `wɔ db-backup` / `wɔ db-gbugbɔ FILE=...`. `wɔ ci` → blibo CI pɔmpi le nutoa me.
ops.h2_c: Makefile aɖe abe canonical entrypoint ene nye Unix ƒe nuwɔna si xɔ ƒe bla nanewo, si Python dɔ gã ɖesiaɖe xɔ (pytest, django, flask, fastapi). Dɔwɔnu bubuwo (Poetry, Hatch, uv) nye ƒea ƒe vivisese; Make nye nusi tea ɖeɖi ame ŋu eye wònye xexeame katã tɔ.
ops.h3_a: Setup wizard nye PyInstaller bundle (`Vortex Wizard.app`) si me pywebview GUI si zɔa dɔwɔla si le dɔ wɔm zi gbãtɔ to dɔwɔwɔ me.
ops.h3_b: Gbãtɔ ƒe sisi: tia node ŋkɔ → wɔ asiɖeɖe le safuiwo (Ed25519 safui eve si wodzra ɖo ɖe `keys/release.key`) → ɖo TLS (Let's Encrypt / tsɔ-wò ŋutɔ / ɖokuiwò de asi) → tia nyawo tsɔtsɔ yi URLwo (vortexx.sol / custom domain / .onion) → na be stealth level → ʋu firewall ʋɔtruwo (iptables/ufw/pf) ƒe agbalẽwo. Le duƒuƒu gbãtɔ megbe la, aɖaŋuwɔla nɔa anyi abe admin console ene: dze/tɔ te node, kpɔ nuŋlɔɖiwo, trɔ safuiwo, tsɔ federated peers kpee.
ops.h3_c: Setup wizards nye kpɔɖeŋu na dɔwɔnu siwo wowɔna na wo ɖokui si tɔa ŋku amesiwo menye sysadmin zãlawo o: Ghost ƒe onboarding (2015), Standard Notes ƒe server ɖoɖo, Mastodon ƒe installation biabia. PyInstaller na míeɖoa binary ɖeka si woate ŋu azi zi eve; pywebview wɔa teƒea ƒe HTML axa si FastAPI dzikpɔla API si woƒo ƒu le 127.0.0.1 — web-kpɔkplɔ UX tutu ƒe sesẽme GUI tutu manɔmee.
ops.h4_a: Wode dzesi ɖesiaɖe si woɖe ɖe go le git me. Rollback nye `git checkout <tag> && na docker-tutu && docker nawɔ -d`. `downgrade()` dɔwɔwɔwo le ʋuʋuwo si.
ops.h4_b: Wotsɔa asiɖeɖe le eŋu ƒe safuia dea asi dzesiwo te ale be woate ŋu aɖo kpe dzesidea ŋutɔ dzi. Rollback ɖoɖo: checkout xoxo tag, gbugbɔ nɔnɔmetata, gbugbɔ wɔ nugoewo — duƒuƒu kadodowo tsi le SIGTERM (default 15 s amenuveve). DB: `alembic downgrade <rev>` trɔ asi le tɔtrɔ ɖeka ŋu. Nyatakakawo ƒe bu ƒoƒo asa na: míetsɔa sɔtiwo ƒua gbe le tata ɖeka me gbeɖe o; drops dzɔna N+1 le code dzudzɔ wo xexlẽ vɔ megbe.
ops.h4_c: "Code-then-code" ʋuʋu ƒe ɖoɖo (keke-ʋuʋu-nubabla) nye dzidzenu na zero-downtime deployments. Stripe ƒe ʋuʋu ŋuti mɔfiamegbalẽ (2019) ɖɔe nyuie wu. Vortex xɔe le nudzɔdzɔ aɖe si dzɔ le v0.0.3 me afisi sɔti aɖe ƒe gege zi zi aɖabaƒoƒo 30 ƒe beléle na fesre dzi megbe.
ops.h1_f:
subɔsubɔdɔwo:
  node: nɔnɔmetata: vortex:melidzeƒe yeyetɔwo: [9000:9000].
  dziɖula: nɔnɔmetata: vortex-dziɖula melidzeƒewo: [8800:8800].
  postgres: nɔnɔmetata: postgres:16 bablawo: [./nyatakaka/pg:/var/lib/postgresql/nyatakaka].
  redis: nɔnɔmetata: redis:7
  coturn: nɔnɔmetata: coturn/coturn melidzeƒewo: [3478:3478/udp, 49152-65535:49152-65535/udp].
  caddy: nɔnɔmetata: caddy melidzeƒewo: [80:80, 443:443].
ops.h2_f:
wɔ install pip install -r nudidiwo.txt
wɔ dev uvicorn --gbugbɔ tsɔe
wɔ dodokpɔ pytest + nutsyɔtsyɔ
wɔ lint ruff + mypy
wɔ docker-tu docker tu -t vortex:$VERSION .
wɔ db-migrate alembic dodoɖeŋgɔ ta
wɔ ci lint + dodokpɔ + ʋuʋu ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi
ops.h3_f:
Vortex Aɖaŋudɔwɔla.app
  → PyInstaller ƒe ƒuƒoƒo
  → ʋu pywebview fesre (nutoa me HTML) .
  → ƒo nu kple bundled admin FastAPI le 127.0.0.1:random-port
  → wɔa safuiwo, ŋlɔa .env, wɔa ʋuʋu gbãtɔ
ops.h4_f:
asiɖeɖe le eŋu ƒe sisi:
  1. de kɔpi yeyewo ɖoɖo ɖe dɔa me; xoxo kple yeye siaa xlẽ "v1".
  2. ʋuʋu: kɔda yeye ŋlɔa "v2"; xoxoa gakpɔtɔ xlẽa "v1".
  3. megbenyawo yɔ "v1" → "v2".
  4. si kplɔe ɖo ƒe dodo: tsɔ xoxo kɔda mɔ
  5. ʋuʋu: tsɔ "v1" kɔlam la ƒu gbe

mobile.title: Asitelefon dzi asisiwo
mobile.subtitle: iOS kple Android — dzɔdzɔme UI, ɖoɖowɔɖi ɖeka.
mobile.intro: Asitelefon dzi asisi eveawo siaa nye hati blibowo, ke menye web wrappers tsɛwo o. Dzɔdzɔme dzedzeme, dzɔdzɔme dɔwɔwɔ, dzɔdzɔme ƒoƒo ɖekae (CallKit, ConnectionService, Lock Screen widgets).
mobile.h1p1: Swift Package le `ios/Modules/` me. 30+ feature modules, ɖesiaɖe SOLID-ma `api/` + `impl/` + `ui/`.
mobile.h1p2: App ƒe taɖodzinu le `ios/VortexApp/` me. XcodeGen spec le `ios/project.yml` gbugbɔa xcodeproj la wɔa.
mobile.h1p3: Nya ɣaɣlawo: Nya ɣaɣlawo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id).
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Dzɔdzɔmeŋusẽ ƒe tɔtrɔwo katã toa `db.write` me.
mobile.h1p6: Push: APNs to `UNUserNotificationCenter` + Nyatakaka Dɔwɔƒe ƒe Kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔ hena nya ɣaɣlawo ɖeɖeɖa.
mobile.h2p1: Gradle dɔ le `android/` me. 22 feature modules kple Hilt DI, ɖeka `api / impl / di / ui` mama.
mobile.h2p4: DB: Xɔ si me FTS4 ƒe ʋuʋudediwo le.
mobile.h2p6: Tu: FCM + FirebaseMessagingService ƒe nya ɣaɣlawo ɖeɖeɖa.
mobile.h3p1: Nutoa me 146 ƒe babla ma ke si me ŋkɔ gbãtɔwo le (`Русский ru`, `Eŋlisigbe en`, `中文 zh`, ...).
mobile.h3p2: 1500-emoji ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe ma ke kple hatsotso 9 + ŋutigbalẽ ƒe amadedewo + MRU + didi.
mobile.h3p3: Same multi-account X25519 kuxi-ŋuɖoɖo na tɔtrɔ.
mobile.h3p4: Dzeɖoɖo ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe mawo ke (All / Archived / custom) kple hehe-kple-dada gbugbɔɖoɖo.
mobile.h3p5: Saved-GIFs xexlẽdzesi ma ke (Tenor aɖeke meli o — ame ŋutɔ ƒe nuƒoƒoƒu ɖeɖeko).
mobile.h3p6: Ðoɖo-gbedasi mawo ke UI, kadodowo ƒe screen, premium nɔnɔme ƒe axa.
mobile.h1_a: iOS asisi nye Swift Package kple 30+ nɔnɔme modules. HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC ɖoɖowɔɖi ma ke abe asisi bubu ɖesiaɖe ene.
mobile.h1_b: Modules siwo woɖo ɖe nɔnɔme nu: `Bootstrap`, `Auth`, `Dzeɖoɖo`, `Files`, `Yɔyɔwo`, `Push`, `Emoji`, `Agbalẽdzraɖoƒewo`, `Akɔntabubuwo`, `SavedGifs`, `Kadodowo`, `Ðoɖowɔɖi`, `Premium`, `Nuwɔnawo`, .... Wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ma ɖe `api/` (ɖoɖowɔɖiwo), `impl/` (kɔkrit ƒe hatsotsowo), `ui/` (SwiftUI ƒe nukpɔkpɔwo). Nya Ɣaɣla: Nya Ɣaɣla ƒe Kit na X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2Swift na Argon2id. DB: GRDB kple FTS5. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFdɔwɔwɔ. Push: APN siwo si Notification Service Extension le na sealed-push ƒe nya ɣaɣlawo ɖeɖeɖa.
mobile.h1_c: Modular packages nye Swift ƒe nuwɔna si wozãna ɖaa tso esime Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019). Míaƒe mama ɖe api/impl/ui me nye SOLID-ish: dependency inversion (modules nɔ te ɖe api/ ɖeɖeko dzi), dzimaɖitsitsiwo ƒe mama, testability (swap impl na dodokpɔwo). 30+ module xexlẽme nye tiatia na xɔtutu parallelism — module ɖesiaɖe ƒoa ƒu le eɖokui si.
mobile.h2_a: Android asitsalawo ƒe ahuhɔ̃ewo iOS: Kotlin + Kpa + Hilt DI. 22 feature modules, ɖeka `api / impl / di` mama.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), taɖodzinuSdk 34 (Android 14) ye nye esi. Crypto: AndroidX dedienɔnɔ + Tink na AES-GCM; argon2-jvm na Argon2id. DB: Xɔ si me FTS4 ƒe ʋuʋudediwo le. WebRTC: Kpɔ WebRTC Android dzi. Tu: FCM to FirebaseMessagingService + agbalẽkotoku si wotu nu ɖo ƒe nya ɣaɣlawo ɖeɖeɖa dzi. Gradle multi-module, Hilt doa ka kple feature modules tẽe dependencies manɔmee.
mobile.h2_c: Compose nye Google ƒe declarative UI toolkit, si li ke tso ƒe 2021. Hilt (2020) nye Google-endorsed DI framework le Dagger 2. Wo katã wosɔ kple SwiftUI + nunɔamesi wrappers le iOS hena xɔtuɖaŋu ƒe seselelãme si sɔ kloe. Vortex xɔ Compose/Hilt tso v0.0.4 dzi; do ŋgɔ la, Android nye View-based.
mobile.h3_a: iOS kple Android siaa bundle ɖeka ma ke 146-locale JSON ɖoɖo kple 1500-emoji catalog — zãla ŋlɔ 🥹 le iOS 17 renders 🥹 le Android 9.
mobile.h3_b: `ios/Modules/Dzɔtsoƒewo/I18N/Dɔwɔnuwo/nutoa me/*.json` ƒe ahuhɔ̃ewo nye `android/app/src/main/assets/locales/*.json`. Dɔdamɔnu eveawo siaa tsɔa teƒe nyuitɔ dea teƒe nyuitɔ le wo dodo zi gbãtɔ me (gbegbɔgblɔ tiatia ƒe screen) eye woyia edzi nɔa tiatiaa wɔm. Emoji ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒea nye hatsotso 9 JSON si woɖo ɖe babla eveawo me; eɖea asi le OS-level emoji-set divergence si ne menye nenema o la, ehea `?` glyphs siwo womeɖe o vɛ le OS xoxowo dzi.
mobile.h3_c: Wò ŋutɔ wò emoji ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe ɖoɖo ɖa nye kpɔɖeŋu si Telegram zãna (woƒe Twemoji fɔkpa) kple WhatsApp zã vaseɖe ƒe 2022. Asitsatsa: ~300 KB bubu ɖe app bundle ɖesiaɖe dzi na emoji + ~1.2 MB na nutoawo. Worth it for cross-platform ƒe ɖekawɔwɔ.
