webclient.title: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe asitsaha
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanilla JS, nɔnɔme si mele internet dzi o, subɔsubɔdɔwɔla.
webclient.intro: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe asisi nye vanilla-JS PWA. React aɖeke meli o, bundler aɖeke meli si wu ESM o. ~400 KB gzipped katã, si me nuto 146 hã le.
webclient.h1p1: `static/js/main.js` nye nya si woŋlɔ. Feature modules kuviatɔ-agba le gbãtɔ zazã.
webclient.h1p2: Nɔnɔme: xɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe ring buffers le IndexedDB, in-memory decrypted cache. Subɔsubɔdɔwɔla doamenɔlawo na fetch.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Tsi Glass ƒe ŋusẽkpɔɖeamedziwo to CSS megbe-filter dzi. Dɔwɔɖoɖo aɖeke meli o; event delegation + idempotent na kpeɖeŋutɔwo.
webclient.h2p1: Nuŋɔŋlɔ ɖesiaɖe si wowɔ esime mele fli me le fli me yi IndexedDB. SW tsia ne kadodoa trɔ gbɔ.
webclient.h2p2: Idempotency key le POST ɖesiaɖe dzi na be gbugbɔgadze agbagba zi eve kpɔa dzidzedze dedie.
webclient.h2p3: Nuxexlẽ wɔa dɔ bliboe le internet dzi — nya ɣaɣla siwo katã wowɔ ɖekae la nɔa IndexedDB me.
webclient.h3p1: 146 teƒewo le `static/locales/*.json` me. Xɔxlɔ̃ ƒe screen (`lang-picker.js`) ƒoa xlãe to native-name aɖaŋuɖoɖowo me.
webclient.h3p2: Duƒuƒu ƒe teƒe ƒe tɔtrɔ: `document.documentElement.lang = code` + gbugbɔ ŋlɔ dzesiwo to `data-i18n` nɔnɔmewo dzi.
webclient.h1_a: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe asisi nye vanilla-JS PWA. No React, no build step si wu ESM bundling. JS siwo woɖo ɖa ƒe ƒuƒoƒo: ~400 KB gzipped.
webclient.h1_b: `templates/base.html` nye Jinja2-si woɖe ɖe go. `static/js/main.js` nye ES-module ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ. Feature modules le `static/js/<feature>/` kuviatɔ-agba me le zazã gbãtɔ me. CSS le `static/css/` me kple 1-file-per-component ƒe ɖoɖo. Subɔsubɔdɔwɔla kpɔa cache gbɔ; agba gbãtɔ tso network gbɔ, emegbe tso cache me; update checks le mɔzɔzɔ ŋu.
webclient.h1_c: Tsi le ɖoɖowo gbɔ nye v0.0.1 nyametsotso si woɖo koŋ wɔ le React kple Vue PWAwo ƒe sɔsɔ le ~1.5 MB gzipped kple nɔnɔme mawo tɔgbe megbe. Vanilla JS + ES modules na mí ~400 KB. Asitsatsa la nye DOM-manipulation boilerplate wu, si míeɖena kpɔtɔna kple kpeɖeŋutɔ suewo le `static/js/lib/dom.js` me.
webclient.h2_a: Offline mode: outgoing ŋlɔa fli ɖe IndexedDB; Subɔsubɔdɔwɔla tsia tsi ne kadodoa trɔ gbɔ.
webclient.h2_b: POST / PATCH ɖesiaɖe si zãla wɔ offline la xɔa idempotency safui eye wòɖina ɖe `outbox` (IndexedDB) me. Subɔsubɔdɔwɔla ɖoa to `online` nudzɔdzɔ eye wògbugbɔa nyawo ɖona kple idempotency safui abe tanya ene. Server dea dzesi duplicates to idempotency key dzi eye wòtrɔa ŋuɖoɖo gbãtɔa. Nuxexlẽ wɔa dɔ bliboe le internet dzi — nya ɣaɣla siwo katã wowɔ ɖekae la nɔa IndexedDB me eye woɖea nyawo gɔme le teƒea kple safui siwo le ŋkuɖodzinu me.
webclient.h2_c: Idempotency safuiwo na POST siwo woateŋu ate kpɔ ake nye Stripe ƒe ƒe 2017 ƒe takpekpe, si egbegbe API akpa gãtɔ xɔ. IndexedDB abe outbox ene nye kpɔɖeŋu si Google Drive web zãna na offline ɖɔɖɔɖowo. Vortex ƒe dɔwɔwɔ nye ~200 fliwo le `static/js/lib/outbox.js` me.
webclient.h3_a: 146-gbegbɔgblɔ ƒe babla le `static/locales/*.json`. Xɔxlɔ̃ ƒe screen tsatsam to native-name hints (`Выберите язык` / `Tia wò gbe` / `选择语言` / ...).
webclient.h3_b: Gbãtɔ ƒe gɔmedzedze: `lang-picker.js` fia aɖaŋunu si wotsɔ ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo wɔe si trɔna to teƒe 97 me le 45 ms/char, tɔ te 1.8 s, tutuna le 30 ms/char, yia ŋgɔ. Zãla tiaa gbe aɖe; eyi edzi le `localStorage.vortex_lang` me. Duƒuƒu ɖesiaɖe si kplɔe ɖo xlẽa tiatia si wodzra ɖo. Duƒuƒu ƒe tɔtrɔ: `setLang (code)` tsɔa agba JSON, gbugbɔa `data-i18n` nuawo gɔme.
webclient.h3_c: Agbalẽŋlɔmɔ̃-hint ƒe kpɔɖeŋua nye bubudede terminal splash screen xoxowo ŋu eye woxɔe hena UX dzoxɔxɔ le esi v0.0.6 beta ɖee fia be ezãlawo ŋe aɖaba ƒu static dropdown dzi vɔ megbe. Kekefɔfɔ ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖowo naa sɛkɛnd 1 ƒe fesre na zãla ɖesiaɖe be wòakpɔ woƒe gbea ƒe ŋkɔ eye wòade dzesii enumake.
webclient.h1_f:
shell: templates/base.html (si woɖe tso subɔsubɔha me Jinja2)
nya si woŋlɔ ɖe eme: static/js/main.js (ES module)
nɔnɔmewo: static/js/{chat,xɔwo,auth,yɔyɔ,faɛlwo,bots}/...
SW: static/subɔsubɔ-dɔwɔla.js
lolome: ~400 KB gzipped katã
webclient.h2_f:
offline nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe sisi:
  1. akɔntabubu idempotency_key = rand (16).hex
  2. db.outbox.put ({url, mɔnu, ŋutilã, idempotency_key, ts})
  3. le 'internet' dzi: flush outbox
     na fli ɖesiaɖe: fetch (url, {mɔnu, ŋutilã, tanyawo: {"Idempotency-Key": ikey}})
       → 2xx: ɖe fli ɖa
       → 4xx: drop row (do kpo nu tegbee) .
       → 5xx/offline: gbugbɔ dze agbagba emegbe
webclient.h3_f:
lang-picker.js ƒe ŋkɔ:
  hints = ["Выберите язык", "Tia wò gbe", "Elige tu idioma", ...]
  ŋlɔ hint le 45 ms/char → tɔ 1.8 s → tutu le 30 ms/char → tɔ 0.2 s → kplɔe ɖo

runtime ƒe tɔtrɔ:
  localStorage.vortex_lang = kɔda
  fetch ('locales/' + code + '.json') → wɔ dɔ ɖe data-i18n nuawo dzi

security.title: Dedienɔnɔ ƒe nɔnɔme
security.subtitle: Afɔku ƒe kpɔɖeŋu, ametakpɔkpɔ-goglo, WAF, agbalẽdzikpɔkpɔ ƒe mɔ, canary.
security.intro: Vortex zãa ametakpɔkpɔ-goglo: gbagbã layer ɖeka mesɔ gbɔ o, amedzidzela ŋutɔŋutɔ hiã dziɖuɖu geɖe le eɖokui si.
security.h1p1: **Netwɔƒe ƒe ŋkuléla si mewɔa dɔ o**: kpɔa TLS ƒe agbalẽviwo; wɔa lolome/ɣeyiɣi ŋuti numekuku. Woɖu edzi to Level 1 ƒe adzame.
security.h1p2: **Active network attacker**: ate ŋu aɖiɖi/he ɖe megbe/ado atike. Woɖu edzi to Level 2-4 ƒe adzame.
security.h1p3: **Node dɔwɔla si ŋu wogblẽ nu le**: kpɔa ciphertext + metadata. Gbedasiwo me nyawo gakpɔtɔ nye nya ɣaɣlawo.
security.h1p4: **Asitsalawo ƒe mɔ̃ si wofi**: gbedasi siwo va yi siwo woɖe ɖe go ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ gbadzaa. Double Ratchet seɖoƒe na ɣeyiɣi si li fifia; wipe-on-next-unlock la li.
security.h1p5: **Quantum futɔ si wodzra ɖo va yi ƒe ʋuɖoɖo**: woɖu edzi to hybrid Kyber-768 session keys esime hati eveawo siaa do boblo PQ.
security.h2p1: Bia ŋkutsala: SQLi ƒe kpɔɖeŋuwo, mɔ dzi zɔzɔ, template injection, LFI, NoSQLi. Drops do ŋgɔ na app code.
security.h2p2: Rate seɖoƒewo: xexeame katã ƒe 1000 req / s falɛfalɛ cap kple gbagbã; mɔ ɖesiaɖe dzi (ge ɖe eme 10/min, ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ 5/min); ɖesiaɖe-zãla 100 req/s le auth megbe.
security.h3p1: Nudzɔdzɔ siwo ku ɖe dedienɔnɔ ŋu (admin action, federation change, release upgrade, panic wipe) hash-chained to `app/security/canary.py` dzi.
security.h3p2: Kɔsɔkɔsɔ ƒe gbagbã ⇒ wokpɔ asitɔtrɔ le eŋu. Xlɔ̃ nu dzowo.
security.h3p3: `/api/admin/audit` ɖea nuŋlɔɖi la ɖe go (admin auth ɖeɖeko). Tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu ɖeɖeko.
security.h4p1: Canary file si wode asi gbesiagbe kple release key. Manɔmanɔ ⇒ nugblẽfexexe si wosusu.
security.h4p2: Kpata ƒe asiɖeɖe le nu ŋu: admin ɖea gbeƒã `{type:"n", event:"compromise", ...}` na WebSocket ɖesiaɖe. Asitsalawo tutua safui siwo wodzra ɖo ɖe cached me.
security.h4p3: Trɔtrɔ: safui yeye si woɖe ɖe go, gbugbɔ de asi manifest, gbugbɔ ta. Asitsalawo gbugbɔa bootstrap.
security.h1_a: Futɔ ƒe hatsotso ene ʋãa aɖaŋua: ŋkuléla si mewɔa naneke o, amedzidzela si le dɔ dzi, dɔwɔla si ŋu wogblẽ nu le, mɔ̃ si ŋu wogblẽ nu le. Woɖu wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe dzi to ƒuƒoƒo vovovo me.
security.h1_b: Passive observer: kpɔa TLS-encrypted packets, wɔa ʋuɖoɖo ŋuti numekuku. Woɖu dzi to Level 1-2 ƒe adzame. Active attacker: ate ŋu aƒu gbe/he ɖe megbe/ado packets ɖe eme. Woɖu edzi to Level 3-4 ƒe adzame. Dɔwɔla si ŋu wogblẽ nu le: kpɔa ciphertext + metadata. Woɖu edzi to E2E crypto + metadata dzi ɖeɖe kpɔtɔ me. Mɔ̃ si ŋu wogblẽ nu le: kpɔa gbedasi siwo va yi ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ dzrowo. Nugblẽfexexe si seɖoƒe li na to ŋgɔ ƒe nya ɣaɣla (Double Ratchet) kple vɔvɔ̃ tutu.
security.h1_c: Klass ene ƒe kpɔɖeŋua tso Schneier ƒe ƒe 1999 "Applied Cryptography" ŋɔdzinu ƒe kpɔɖeŋu ƒe hatsotsowo me, si keke ɖe enu kple Snowden megbe ŋkuléleɖenuŋu tso dukɔa ƒe ɖoƒe ŋkulélawo ŋu. Egbegbe secure-messenger design ɖesiaɖe yɔa nane si le abe esia ene. Vortex ƒe twist le hatsotso atɔ̃lia kpem ɖe v0.4 mɔfiameɖoɖoa ŋu: quantum-enabled adversary with stored past traffic, si Kyber kpɔa egbɔ.
security.h2_a: WAF la léa ŋku ɖe biabia ɖesiaɖe ŋu hafi ɖoa app code gbɔ, gbea SQL-i, mɔ zɔzɔ, template injection, NoSQLi.
security.h2_b: `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware` wɔa ~50 regex dodokpɔwo ɖe URL, biabia, kple ŋutilã ŋu. Wonya-vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nɔnɔmewo (`UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`) → 403. Seɖoƒewo ƒe seɖoƒewo: xexeame katã ƒe 1000 req/s falɛfalɛ ƒe kposɔ kple gbagbã ƒe mɔɖeɖe; mɔ ɖesiaɖe dzi `/ge ɖe eme` 10/min, `/ŋlɔ ŋkɔ` 5/min; ɖesiaɖe-zãla 100 req/s le auth megbe. Geo-blocking tiatia to `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN,IR` dzi be woakpɔ tohehe ƒe nudidiwo gbɔ na dɔwɔla siwo wɔ ɖe se dzi.
security.h2_c: WAFs abe titinamɔ̃ ene nye kpɔɖeŋu si woɖo anyi — mod_security (2002), Cloudflare ƒe WAF, AWS WAF. Vortex tɔ nye esi woɖoe koŋ le sue ŋutɔ elabena WAF kpekpe aɖe wɔa alakpa nyui siwo nyrɔa ŋɔdzinu ŋutɔŋutɔwo. Woƒo regex xexlẽdzesiwo nu ƒu tso OWASP Top 10 ƒe asidede agbalẽ te me eye wotrɔ asi le eŋu le v0.0.5 me le esi beta WAF se aɖe xe mɔ na ka ŋutɔŋutɔ "DROP TABLE" le dzeɖoɖo ƒe gbedasi si ku ɖe SQL ŋu me vɔ megbe.
security.h3_a: Nudzɔdzɔ siwo ku ɖe dedienɔnɔ ŋu la dzea anyi ɖe hash-chained audit log me. Kɔsɔkɔsɔa ƒe gbagbã fia be wotrɔ asi le eŋu.
security.h3_b: Wotsɔa admin ƒe afɔɖeɖe ɖesiaɖe, federation ƒe tɔtrɔ, asiɖeɖe le eŋu ƒe dodoɖeŋgɔ, alo vɔvɔ̃ tutu dea `audit_log (ts, event, actor_id, target_id, detail_cbor)` me. Fli ɖesiaɖe tsɔa `prev_hash = hash (fli_do ŋgɔ)`. Wobua fli si li fifia ƒe hash ɖe `ts ∥ nudzɔdzɔ ∥ prev_hash` dzi. Ne woɖe fli aɖe ɖa alo trɔe la, fli siwo kplɔe ɖo ƒe `prev_hash` kɔsɔkɔsɔa agbã — woate ŋu ade dzesii to kɔsɔkɔsɔa gbugbɔgaƒo me.
security.h3_c: Hash-chained audit logs nye xoxo xoxo aɖe (hash-linked timestamping, 1991). Linux auditd zãa wo. Git ƒe commit DAG nye nuwo ƒe wɔwɔme ɖeka koŋ. Vortex tsɔ wo kpee le v0.0.6 me esi aɖaŋuɖola aɖe ɖee fia be node si ŋu wogblẽ nu le ate ŋu atutu log rows le ɖoɖoezizi me vɔ megbe.
security.h4_a: Wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe nudzɔdzɔwo ƒe ŋuɖoɖo ŋu do ŋgɔ: canary ɖo kpe edzi be release key is uncompromised; ne woɖe asi le nu ŋu kpata la tutua safui siwo wodzra ɖo ɖe asisiwo katã dzi.
security.h4_b: Gbesiagbe `canary.txt` si wode asi to asiɖeɖe le safui ŋu, si wota ɖe dziɖula la xa. Asitsalawo tiae be woaɖo kpe edzi le gɔmedzedzea me — anyimanɔmanɔ ⇒ wosusu be wowɔ nugblẽfexexe. Ne woɖo kpe nugblẽfexexe aɖe dzi la: admin ɖea gbeƒã `{type:"n", event:"compromise", reason}` ɖe WebSocket ɖesiaɖe dzi. Asitsalawo tutu safui siwo wodzra ɖo ɖe cached me, zi wo dzi be woagage ɖe eme ake. Yeye asiɖeɖe le safui minted, manifest gbugbɔ de asi, asisiwo gbugbɔ bootstrap tso ahuhɔ̃e blibonyenye nuwuƒe. Ciphertext xoxo si wowɔ be womate ŋu axlẽe o le alesi wowɔe ta.
security.h4_c: Canary ƒe faɛlwo tso Apple ƒe ƒe 2013 ƒe mɔɖegbalẽ canary kple `canarywatch.org` dɔa gbɔ. Signal zãa wo. Vortex's nye automated: cron aɖe dea asi `canary.txt` kple asiɖeɖe le safui ŋu le gaƒoƒo 24 ɖesiaɖe me. Kpata ƒe nyadzɔdzɔwo ɖeɖeɖa nye kpɔɖeŋu ma ke si Let's Encrypt zãna na ɖaseɖigbalẽwo ɖeɖeɖa le agbɔsɔsɔ gã me.
security.h2_f:
léa ŋku ɖe nubiabia ɖesiaɖe ŋu:
  SQL atike dodo : de dzesi UNION SELECT, DROP TABLE, ; -- kple bubuawo.
  mɔ dzi zɔzɔ : de dzesi ../, ..%2f, URL-siwo woŋlɔ ɖe kɔpi me ƒe tɔtrɔwo
  template injection : de dzesi {{, {% .
  XSS : de dzesi <ŋɔŋlɔ, javascript:
  NoSQLi : de dzesi $ ne, $ afi si, $ regex
seɖoƒe siwo woɖo na agbɔsɔsɔme: 1000/s xexeame katã, 10/min gege ɖe eme, 5/min ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ
security.h3_f:
fli: {ts, nudzɔdzɔ, fefewɔla_id, taɖodzinu_id, tsitotsito_cbor, do ŋgɔ_hash, fli_hash}
row_hash = SHA-256 (ts ∥ nudzɔdzɔ ∥ fefewɔla_dzesi ∥ ... ∥ do ŋgɔ_hash)
ɖo kpe edzi: zɔ nuŋlɔɖi, gbugbɔ bu akɔnta le row_hash ɖesiaɖe ŋu, tsɔe sɔ kple asixɔxɔ si wodzra ɖo
break ⇒ tampering si wokpɔ le fli ma dzi

privacy.title: Ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyawo kple sedziwɔwɔ
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, gomenɔamesi be woatutu, metadata dzi ɖeɖe kpɔtɔ, nyatakakawo tsɔtsɔ yi teƒe bubu.
privacy.intro: Vortex ɖoa GDPR kple CCPA dɔwɔnuwo ɖa le aɖaka la me. Dɔdzikpɔla siwo le ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe siwo ŋu wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖo la ƒe admin ƒe nuwuƒe ɖeka le se ƒe biabia ɖesiaɖe si.
privacy.h1p1: IP logs aɖeke meli le gɔmedzedzea me o. Trɔ megbe proxy strips `X-Real-IP` negbe ɖe dɔwɔla tiae.
privacy.h1p2: `sender_pseudo` le gbedasi fliwo me hashes sender ID ŋutɔŋutɔwo — DB dump ɖea xɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe ŋkɔ alakpanyawo ko fiana.
privacy.h1p3: Didi zãa encrypted-tokens. Client tsɔa xɔme safui ɣlaa nya veviwo; node dzraa dzesi siwo me mekɔ o ɖo; lookup nye exact-match le ciphertext dzesiwo dzi.
privacy.h1p4: Last-seen truncated to zãla ƒe granularity si wòtia.
privacy.h2p1: `POST /api/privacy/erase` menya ŋkɔ na zãla ƒe fli o, etutu woƒe gbedasi siwo woɖo ɖa (metadata si wodzra ɖo na quorum), etutu faɛlwo ɖa le disk dzi.
privacy.h2p2: Dukɔwo Dome Habɔbɔ: nyatoƒoetoto si wode asi na na hatiwo nya; wotutuna le woƒe axadzi le gaƒoƒo 72 me.
privacy.h2p3: Audit: woŋlɔa erasure kple timestamp kple (hashed) user id ale be dɔwɔla ateŋu aɖo kpe edzi be yewɔ ɖe se dzi.
privacy.h3p1: `GET /api/privacy/export` streams a zip: profile JSON, ciphertext si woɖo ɖa/xɔ, faɛl ƒe nufiamewo kple faɛl ɖesiaɖe ƒe ke safuiwo, kadodowo ƒe xexlẽdzesi.
privacy.h3p2: Dzidzime ƒe ɣeyiɣi: ~5 min na gbedasi 10 k, si ƒe liƒo nye IO.
privacy.h3p3: Ele be amesi xɔe la ɖe nya ɣaɣlawo gɔme le teƒea; woɖoa dɔwɔnu siwo wotsɔna ɖoa duta ɖe axadzi.
privacy.h4p1: Long-press logo 5 s → enumake teƒea tutu: safuiwo, gbedasi siwo wodzra ɖo ɖe cached, kpeɖeŋutɔ.
privacy.h4p2: Coupled wipe: `/api/privacy/panic` hã nye yɔdokpe na server-side akɔnta.
privacy.h1_a: IP logs aɖeke meli le gɔmedzedzea me o. Metadata si dea dzesi zãla aɖeke mele gbedasi ƒe fliwo dzi o. Nuŋɔŋlɔ bliboa didi le dzesi siwo wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ dzi.
privacy.h1_b: Reverse proxy strips `X-Real-IP` hafi node la kpɔe negbe ɖe dɔwɔla tiae be yeawɔ seɖoƒe na rate. Gbedasɛ ƒe fliwo dzraa `sender_id` (na ACL) kple `sender_pseudo` (na fan-out); sender_pseudo nye HMAC(room_salt, sender_id) eyata DB dump meɖea amesi gblɔ nusi le xɔwo ƒe go kemɛ dzi fiana o. Didi: asisi tsɔa xɔa ƒe safui ɣlaa nya veviwo; node dzraa dzesi siwo me mekɔ o ɖo; lookup nye exact-match le ciphertext tokens dzi, nuŋɔŋlɔ gbadzaa ƒe index aɖeke mele eme o.
privacy.h1_c: Metadata dzi ɖeɖe kpɔtɔ nye Snowden megbe nukpɔsusu ɖeka — Signal na wòxɔ ŋkɔ le ƒe 2014 me, WhatsApp kplɔe ɖo kple sender-pseudo le ƒe 2019. Encrypted didi le ciphertext tokens dzi nye CryptDB (2011) kple ShadowCrypt (2014) ƒe kpɔɖeŋu. Vortex ƒe dɔwɔwɔ nye stripped-down version si dzraa biabia ƒe asitɔtrɔ aɖewo hena bɔbɔe.
privacy.h2_a: `POST /api/privacy/erase` menya ŋkɔ na zãla ƒe fli o, etutu woƒe nya ɣaɣla siwo woɖo ɖa, tutu faɛlwo, eye wòna hati siwo wɔ ɖeka la nya.
privacy.h2_b: Server-side: `zãlawo` fli ƒe sensitive fields zeroed (`zãla ƒe ŋkɔ = "wotutu-<id>"`, `telefon = null`, `email = null`, `ɖefia_ŋkɔ = "[tutu]"`); `messages.ciphertext` ɖo NULL na fliwo katã afisi `sender_id = u.id`; faɛl siwo do ƒome tso gbedasi mawo siwo wotutu ɖa le disk dzi la me. Hati siwo wowɔ ɖekae xɔa `{nudzɔdzɔ: "tutu", user_id, signed_by}` nyatoƒoetoto si wode asi ete; woƒua du ma ke le woƒe axadzi le gaƒoƒo 72 me (SLA).
privacy.h2_c: Gomenɔamesi be woatutu nu nye GDPR Se 17 ƒe nudidi tso ƒe 2018. CCPA kplɔe ɖo le ƒe 2020 me; LGPD (Brazil) le ƒe 2021. Vortex ɖoa gbãtɔa ɖa le aɖaka me ale be dɔwɔla siwo le ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe siwo ŋu wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖo megahiã be woatue o. 72 h federation SLA sɔ kple GDPR ƒe ŋkeke 30 ƒe ŋuɖoɖo fesre kple taɖoƒe na kaka.
privacy.h3_a: `GET /api/privacy/export` streams a zip: profile JSON, ciphertext si woɖo ɖa/xɔ, faɛl ƒe nufiamewo kple faɛl ɖesiaɖe ƒe ke safuiwo, kadodowo ƒe xexlẽdzesi.
privacy.h3_b: Dzidzime nye async elabena akɔntabubu gãwo xɔa miniti. Asitsalawo ƒe POSTs biabia → node enqueues dɔ → dɔa zɔna le megbe → asitsalawo ƒe numekuku `/api/privacy/export/{job_id}` → 200 kple asidede URL ne wole klalo. Zip me nyawo: `profile.json`, `rooms.jsonl` (ɖeka le xɔ ɖesiaɖe me), `messages.jsonl.enc` (ciphertext + faɛl ɖesiaɖe ƒe ke safuiwo), `faɛlwo/` (woɖe-abe alesi wòle blobs).
privacy.h3_c: Nyatakakawo tsɔtsɔ yi teƒe bubu nye nudidi eve kple etutu le GDPR me. Apple, Google, Telegram, Signal katã ƒe dɔwɔnuwo le esi. Vortex's tsɔa nu vevi la kpena ɖe eŋu (file_root per file) ale be zãlawo ateŋu aɖe nusiwo woɖo ɖa la gɔme le nutoa me — ne menye nenema o la, viɖe aɖeke mele dɔdɔa ŋu o. Ne nyatakaka sia mele eme o la, Apple / Google takeouts nye nyateƒe plaintext-ko elabena woɖe decrypted xoxo.
privacy.h4_a: Panic wipe: te Vortex ƒe dzesi la ɣeyiɣi didi sɛkɛnd 5 be nàtsrɔ̃ safuiwo katã kple nyatakaka siwo wodzra ɖo ɖe mɔ̃a dzi enumake. Nusi womate ŋu atrɔ o.
privacy.h4_b: Asitsalawo ƒe akpa dzi: le sɛkɛnd 5 ƒe nyati didi dzi la, ɖe kpeɖodzi fia; le kpeɖodzi dzi la, yɔ `wipeKeychainItems ()` / `kɔ Keystore ()` / `nutoa meNudzraɖoƒe.kɔ () + indexedDB.nyatakakawo (). forEach (tutuNyatakakawo)`. Cached ciphertext megali o, safuiwo megali o, JWTwo megali o. Optional coupled wipe: `POST /api/privacy/panic` hã tombstones akɔnta server-kpa dzi eye wòwɔ ɖeka kple erasure gossip.
privacy.h4_c: Panic buttons / dead-man switches ƒe ŋutinya didi aɖe le gbedasi siwo le dedie me: Wickr ƒe 2014 "Shred", Cryptocat ƒe 2013 "Forget", Signal ƒe "Secure Deletion" ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo (2016, womeɖoe ɖa gbeɖe o). Vortex ƒe sɛkɛnd 5 didi-nyatakaka ɖoe koŋ sesẽ be woaʋu le vo me — míesrɔ̃ nu tso haptic nyaŋuɖoɖo le iPhone 15 kple Pixel 8 dzi eye míetia 5 s abe teƒe vivi si le "kaba ale gbegbe le nɔnɔme kpata aɖe me" kple "mate ŋu ada tu to kotoku-bɔt dzi o" dome.
privacy.h1_f:
dɔla_pseudo = HMAC-SHA256 (xɔme dze, dɔla_id) [:16]
  ⇒ DB dump: {xɔ, amedɔdɔ_aʋatsonya, nya ɣaɣla}
  ⇒ amedzidzela mateŋu atsɔ sender_pseudo aƒo ƒu ɖe xɔwo me o (dze vovovowo) .

didi ƒe dzesi = HMAC-SHA256(xɔ_safui, nya vevi)
  ⇒ biabia "hello" ⇒ akɔntabubu dzesi ⇒ index-match index didi
  ⇒ node mekpɔa nya vevi si woŋlɔ tẽ gbeɖe o

debugging.title: Debugging kple dɔlélewo didi
debugging.subtitle: Dɔwɔnu siwo woatsɔ akpɔ nyawo le dev, staging, kple prod.
debugging.intro: Subsystem ɖesiaɖe ƒe logging si woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu kple /metrics surface le esi. Fefegbalẽ si wozãna tsɔ dia dɔlélewoe zi geɖee nye esi.
debugging.h1p1: JSON-ɖoe le gɔmedzedzea me. `logger.info ("nuwɔna", extra={"zãla_dzesi": ...})` wɔa `{"ts":..., "lvl":"INFO", "msg":"nuwɔna", "zãla_id": ...}`.
debugging.h1p2: Trɔe le 100 MB dzi; na 14 gens gzipped.
debugging.h1p4: Correlation id: biabia ɖesiaɖe xɔa `X-Request-Id`; RPC siwo le anyime la gazãnɛ ake.
debugging.h2p1: Prometheus ƒe nɔnɔme le `/metrics` (admin-ɖo kpe edzi le prod me).
debugging.h2p2: RED: agbɔsɔsɔme / vodadawo / ɣeyiɣi didime le mɔ ɖeka dzi.
debugging.h2p3: USE: zazã / saturation / vodadawo le DB ta, WebSocket fan-do, TURN relay.
debugging.h2p4: Dekɔnu: xɔ siwo le dɔ wɔm, gbedasiwo/wo, adzame-dzidzenu histogram.
debugging.h3p1: `py-spy` na duƒuƒu ƒe kpɔɖeŋu. Kpe ɖe node si le du dzi PID ŋu.
debugging.h3p2: `memray` na ƒuƒoƒo ƒe nɔnɔmetatawo wɔwɔ. Aɖabaƒoƒo 1 ƒe fotoɖeɖe ɖee fia be tsi si le dodom kabakaba.
debugging.h3p3: Rust kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔ `vortex_chat` ɖoa `--profile` aflaga si ŋlɔa dzesi si sɔ kple flamegraph.
debugging.h4p1: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` ƒua du ŋlɔ ŋkɔ/geɖe/dɔ/xɔ/do go ɖe teƒea ƒe node aɖe ŋu. Edona le non-zero me le kpododonu ɖesiaɖe me.
debugging.h4p2: CI ƒua du dzudzɔ le PR ɖesiaɖe dzi kpakple le merges to main dzi.
debugging.h4p3: Dzudzɔ si dona: gotagome nusi wotsɔna dzroa nu me si ƒoa canary akɔnta zi ɖeka le miniti ɖeka me.
debugging.h1_a: Logs nye JSON-ɖoɖo le gɔmedzedzea me. Log line ɖesiaɖe lɔ ts, level, module, message, kple correlation id ɖe eme.
debugging.h1_b: `logger.info("zãla_wɔ", extra={"zãla_dzesi": u.id})` wɔa `{"ts":"2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", "lvl":"INFO", "mod":"auth", "msg":"zãla_wɔ", "zãla_id": 42, "req_id": "..."}`. Correlation id tso `X-Request-Id` tanya me; RPC ɖesiaɖe si le anyime la gazãnɛ ake. Trɔtrɔ le 100 MB; na dzidzime 14 nanɔ gzipped. Dzidzenu ɖesiaɖe-module to `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG` dzi.
debugging.h1_c: Structured JSON logging nye nusi dzi woda asi ɖo fifia — Stripe, Datadog, egbegbe ŋkuléleɖenuŋu dzrala ɖesiaɖe xɔe. Correlation IDs trace to X-Request-Id (RFC 4557) eye wozu canonical le microservices me to Jaeger / Zipkin (2015) dzi. Vortex zãa tanya-kaka ƒomedodo id bɔbɔe tsɔ wu be wòazã traces siwo woma elabena distributed-trace tooling tsɔa nusiwo sesẽ si míehiã haɖe o kpena ɖe eŋu.
debugging.h2_a: Prometheus metriks le `/metrics` (admin-si woɖo kpe edzi le ewɔwɔ me). Grafana dashboards siwo woɖo ɖe `deploy/grafana/` me.
debugging.h2_b: RED metrics per-moute: biabia ƒe agbɔsɔsɔme, vodada ƒe agbɔsɔsɔme, ɣeyiɣi didi ƒe histogram. USE metriks ɖe dɔwɔnu ɖesiaɖe: DB tadeaguƒe zazã, WebSocket fan-out saturation, TURN relay bandwidth. Dekɔnu: xɔ siwo le dɔ wɔm, gbedasiwo le sɛkɛnd ɖeka me, histogram si le adzame. Admin dashboard si le `/admin/metrics` fiaa nɔnɔmetata siwo le etame; Prometheus le ʋuʋum be yeakpɔ ŋutinya blibo.
debugging.h2_c: RED (dzidzeme / vodadawo / ɣeyiɣi didime) nye Weaveworks ƒe ƒe 2016 ƒe kpukpui. USE (zazã / saturation / vodadawo) nye Brendan Gregg ƒe ƒe 2013 ƒe mɔnu. Wo katã woƒoa nu tso subɔsubɔ ƒe ɖoƒe kple dɔwɔnu ƒe ɖoƒe ƒe dzesiwo ŋu. Prometheus + Grafana nye ʋuʋu-dzɔtsoƒe ƒe gɔmedzedze tso ƒe 2016 me.
debugging.h3_a: `py-spy` na duƒuƒu ƒe kpɔɖeŋu; `memray` na ƒuƒoƒo ƒe nɔnɔmetatawo; `vortex_chat` Rust kekeɖenudɔa le `--profile` na flamegraph ƒe dzesiwo.
debugging.h3_b: `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid <node>` hena s 60 wɔa flamegraph SVG si ɖea Python stacks dzodzoewo fiana. `memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>` kplɔa mamawo ɖo; `memray flamegraph mem.bin` ɖea egɔme. Rust kekeɖenudɔa ɖoa ememe nɔnɔmetatawo ɖe duta abe Chrome-tracing JSON ne woyɔe kple `--profile`. Tsɔ esiawo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe kpe ɖe agba-dodokpɔ si le du dzi to `scripts/smoke/all.sh` me hena nɔnɔme siwo sɔ.
debugging.h3_c: py-spy (2018) nye akɔntabubu ƒe nɔnɔmetatawɔla si mewɔa nu ɖe ​​ame ŋu o si kpena ɖe Python dɔwɔwɔ si le du dzi ŋu kɔda ƒe tɔtrɔ manɔmee — Python nɔnɔmetatawɔlawo ƒe Go. memray (Bloomberg, 2022) nye Python heap profiler nyuitɔ kekeake egbea. Rust ŋutɔ ƒe profiling ecosystem tsi gake mewɔ ɖeka boo o; míaƒe kekeɖenudɔa ɖoa Chrome-tracing ɖe duta koŋ elabena wotu nukpɔla ɖe browser ɖesiaɖe me.
debugging.h4_a: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋlɔa ŋkɔ/geɖe/dɔ/xɔ/do go ɖe teƒea ƒe node aɖe ŋu. CI ƒua du le PR ɖesiaɖe dzi.
debugging.h4_b: Dzudzɔ ƒua du le ~5 sɛkɛnd me. Ewɔa akɔnta yeye eve, ʋua DM, ɖoa gbedasi ɖa, ɖoa kpe edzi be woɖoe ɖa, eɖea wo ame evea siaa doa goe. Edona le non-zero me le kpododonu ɖesiaɖe me. CI yɔe le xɔtutu megbe. Prod-smoke canary si le vovo la ƒua du aɖabaƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe tso gotagome probe gbɔ tsɔ tsia tre ɖe dodokpɔ ƒe akɔnta tɔxɛ aɖe ŋu le ewɔwɔ ƒe node la dzi.
debugging.h4_c: Dzudzɔ dodokpɔwo nye Toyota dɔwɔƒe ƒe kpɔɖeŋunyagbɔgblɔ (ƒe 1950-awo) — ƒu du yi ɖalé ŋku ɖe eŋu kaba be nàɖo kpe edzi be edze ƒã be ɖoɖoa megbã o. Le kɔmpiuta dɔwɔɖoɖowo me la wova zu dzidzenu le Michael Feathers ƒe "Dɔwɔwɔ Nyuie kple Domenyinu ƒe Se" (2004) megbe. Vortex ƒe dzudzɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ nye ~200 fli bash + curl.

testing.title: Dodokpɔ ƒe mɔnu
testing.subtitle: 29 k fli dodokpɔwo le Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS.
testing.intro: Layer ɖesiaɖe kple eƒe dodokpɔ suite. CI ƒua du wo katã le miniti 10 teti me.
testing.h1p1: `pytest app/tests` ƒo nu tso routers, dedienɔnɔ, ʋuɖoɖo, bots ŋu.
testing.h1p2: Nukpɔsusu nunɔamesi-si wotu ɖe dodokpɔwo dzi le crypto: `assert decrypt (encrypt (m, k), k) == m` na 1000 random m.
testing.h1p3: AFL-style fuzz on WAF: miliɔn geɖe siwo mewɔ dɔ nyuie o ƒe nyawo — ɖo kpe edzi be 5xx ƒe sisi aɖeke metso o.
testing.h2p1: `swift test` le `ios/Modules/` me wɔa unit dodokpɔwo ɖe RFC 7748 / 8032 / 5869 / 8446 dodokpɔ vektorwo ŋu.
testing.h2p2: XCUI dodokpɔwo ʋua SwiftUI ƒe nukpɔkpɔwo le simulator si ta mele o me; snapshot-tsɔtsɔ sɔ kple wo nɔewo.
testing.h3p2: `./gradlew connectedCheck` wɔa dɔwɔnu dodokpɔwo le emulator si le du dzi.
testing.h4p1: Fefeŋlɔla ʋua web client, ta manɔmee Chrome + ta manɔmee Firefox. Wowɔa yɔyɔwo kple `--zã-fake-ui-for-media-stream`.
testing.h4p2: Nɔnɔmewo: ŋlɔ akɔnta eve ɖi → DM → ɖo faɛl ɖe → tutu → ɖo kpe edzi be wowɔ ɖeka → wu enu.
testing.h1_a: Python dodokpɔwo zãa pytest + coverage. Router ɖesiaɖe, dedienɔnɔ primitive ɖesiaɖe, transport module ɖesiaɖe le dodokpɔwo. ~80 % ƒe kpekpeɖeŋunana.
testing.h1_b: `pytest app/tests` wɔa suite bliboa le miniti 2 teti me le nu vevi ɖeka dzi. Nukpɔsusu ƒe nunɔamesi-si wotu ɖe dodokpɔwo dzi le crypto primitives dzi: `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` na gbedasi 1000 siwo woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu. AFL-style fuzz dodokpɔwo le WAF dzi: nyatakaka miliɔn geɖe siwo womewɔ nyuie o siwo wogblɔ be wowɔa 4xx (menye 5xx o) ƒe ŋuɖoɖo. `pytest --cov=app` na xɔxlɔ̃.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) nye dodokpɔ duƒula si le nyateƒe me Python. Nukpɔsusu (2015) na dodokpɔ si wotu ɖe nunɔamesiwo dzi tsɔ QuickCheck susua tso Haskell gbɔ. AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) na fuzz nye canonical coverage-guided fuzzer. Vortex ƒe stack nye nu vevitɔ; vivi ɖeka koe nye míaƒe lɔlɔ̃ na pytest parametrisation wu test-class domenyinyi.
testing.h2_a: Swift dodokpɔwo le `ios/Modules/` me tsyɔa crypto primitives ɖe RFC dodokpɔ vektorwo ŋu kpe ɖe SwiftUI snapshot dodokpɔwo ŋu.
testing.h2_b: `swift test` tso `ios/Modules/` wɔa unit dodokpɔwo le s 1 teti me. RFC 7748 (X25519) ƒe vektorwo. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) ƒe vektorwo. RFC 5869 (HKDF) ƒe vektorwo. RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) ƒe xɔtunuwo. SwiftUI ƒe ŋgɔdonya ƒe nɔnɔmetata siwo wotsɔ sɔ kple wo nɔewo to nɔnɔmetata ƒe vovototo dzi kple git-tracked gɔmedzedze; regression le pixel ɖesiaɖe dzi do kpo xɔtutua.
testing.h2_c: Dodokpɔ crypto ɖe dziɖuɖu dodokpɔ vektorwo ŋu nye nuwɔna si me tu mele o wu — ne wò kɔda sɔ kple RFC vektorwo la, ewɔ ɖeka kple gɔmesese. Snapshot dodokpɔ na SwiftUI nye ~2022 nɔnɔme si me aɖaŋu le, si pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-testing xɔ ŋkɔ. Vortex zãa nu suetɔ kekeake si le aƒea me tsɔ ƒoa asa na nusiwo dzi woanɔ te ɖo.
testing.h3_a: Kotlin dodokpɔwo: JVM-ko to `./gradlew dodokpɔ` dzi; instrumented via `./gradlew connectedCheck` le emulator si le du dzi.
testing.h3_b: `./gradlew test` zɔna le sɛkɛnd ʋee aɖewo me — Android ƒe ɖoɖo aɖeke mehiã o, JUnit + Hilt-android-dodokpɔ koe. Unit-dodokpɔ taɖodzinuwo: crypto, nuƒolawo, coroutine-si wotu ɖe sisiwo dzi. `./gradlew connectedCheck` ƒoa emulator aɖe, dea dɔwɔnua eme, wɔa UI dodokpɔwo to Espresso dzi. E2E sisi: ge ɖe eme → ɖo gbedasi ɖa → kpɔ le dzeɖoɖo me.
testing.h3_c: Mamã JVM-ko dodokpɔwo tso instrumented dodokpɔwo nye Android 2019+ takpekpe. JVM dodokpɔwo zɔna kabakaba (sɛkɛnd); dodokpɔ siwo wotsɔa dɔwɔnuwo wɔe la nɔa blewu (aɖabaƒoƒo). Robolectric (2014) zã tsɔ xea vovototoa gake wotsɔ mama sia ɖɔ li eƒe akpa gãtɔ le egbegbe Android ŋgɔyiyi me.
testing.h4_a: Fefeŋlɔla ʋua web client la le Chrome kple Firefox si ta mele o me, ewɔa kamedede ŋutɔŋutɔ ƒe ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ → DM → yɔyɔ ƒe sisiwo.
testing.h4_b: `playwright-tests/` léa nɔnɔmewo ɖe TypeScript me. Wotrɔa asi le node si wotsɔ ƒua gbe + Postgres ŋu le dodokpɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi ɖesiaɖe me to docker compose dzi. Dodokpɔwo ʋua web la UI: ŋlɔ akɔnta eve ɖi, ʋu DM, ɖo gbedasi ɖa, ɖo kpe edzi be woɖoe ɖa, wɔ video kaƒoƒo kple `--zã-aʋatso-ui-na-nyatakakawo-tɔsisi` + `--zã-aʋatso-mɔ̃-na-nyadzɔdzɔgblɔmɔ̃-tɔsisi` aflagawo ale be Chrome nawɔ odio/video si wowɔ. Nɔnɔmeawo zɔna ɖekae to Fefeŋlɔlawo dzi.
testing.h4_c: Fefeŋlɔla (Microsoft, 2020) xɔ ɖe Selenium teƒe na web E2E dodokpɔ akpa gãtɔ elabena ewɔa dɔ kabakaba wu, kakaɖedzi le eŋu wu, eye eƒe debugging nyo wu. WebRTC dodokpɔ le web-browser siwo ta mele o me nye vevesese vaseɖe esime Chrome 69 tsɔ aʋatso-mɔ̃ ƒe aflagawo kpee; tso ɣemaɣi la, eva zu nuwɔna si wozãna ɖaa.

register.title: POST /api/ɖaseɖiɖi/ŋlɔ ŋkɔ
register.subtitle: Wɔ zãla yeye si si X25519 dzesideŋkɔ + Argon2id nyagbegbɔgblɔ le.
register.h1_a: Wɔ zãla ƒe akɔnta yeye eye wòɖe JWT eve gbãtɔ ɖe go. Blaa zãla ƒe dutoƒo safui si nɔa anyi didi X25519 ɖe akɔnta la ŋu tso kaƒoƒo gbãtɔ dzi.
register.h1_b: Node ɖoa kpe agblewo katã dzi to Pydantic dzi, léa ŋku ɖe zãla ƒe ŋkɔ kple x25519_public_key ƒe etɔxɛnyenye ŋu, ewɔa Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ɖe nyagbea dzi, tsɔa nu dea `zãlawo`, `zãla_mɔ̃wo`, `push_subscriptions`, mints access + reresh JWTs.
register.h1_c: Woɖoe ɖe v0.0.1 abe nuwuƒe gbãtɔ ene. Wotsɔ X25519 pubkey parameter kpe ɖe eŋu le v0.0.2 me le esi wokpɔe dze sii be ehiã be woawɔ dzesideŋkɔ kple akɔnta le atɔm me vɔ megbe — ne menye nenema o la, dɔdzikpɔla ate ŋu MITM zãla aɖe le ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ kple safui gbãtɔ ƒe tsɔtsɔ dome.
register.h2_a: Ebia be: **ɖeke meli o**. Titinamɔ̃ `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` agbo mɔ sia eye wògbea kple `401 si womeɖo kpe edzi o` nenye be ɖaseɖigbalẽ si hiã la bu alo mesɔ o.
register.h2_b:
- `none` — womeɖo kpe edzi o (do ŋgɔ na gege ɖe eme).
- `jwt` — Bearer JWT mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi le `Mɔɖeɖe` ƒe tanya me.
- `gbugbɔgadzɔ` — Bearer JWT gbugbɔgawɔ dzesi.
- `admin` — JWT si ƒe nyawo me `is_admin: nyateƒe` le.
- `peer-signed` — biabia ƒe ŋutilã si te hati si dzi woka ɖo ƒe Ed25519 safui de asi.
register.h2_c: Auth tier la ɖea gɔmeɖose si nye mɔnukpɔkpɔ suetɔ kekeake fiana: woɖo seɖoƒe na nuwuƒe siwo do ŋgɔ na gege ɖe eme la vevie na akɔntabubu wɔwɔ kple egbugbɔgaxɔ; nusianu si le megbe na JWT kpɔa ezãla ŋutɔŋutɔ; admin ƒe nuwuƒewo ɖea akɔtagbalẽvi aɖe fiana le UI me eyata woate ŋu akpɔ eŋudɔwɔwɔ le mɔ gbegblẽ nu.
register.h3_a: JSON ŋutilã kple zãla ƒe ŋkɔ + nyagbe si wòle be woawɔ + x25519_dutoƒo_safui; optional phone (E.164), email (RFC 5322 lite), display_name, avatar_emoji, invite_code, kyber_public_key.

  "zãla ƒe ŋkɔ": "alice", // [a-z0-9_] {3,30}
  "nyagbe": "...", // ≥ 8 ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo
  "x25519_dutoƒo_safui": "<64-hex>", // 32 bytes hex
  "ŋkɔ_ɖefia": "Alice", // tiatia
  "telefon": "+15551234567", // tiatia, E.164
  "email": "a@kpɔɖeŋu.com", // tiatia
  "avatar_emoji": "🦊", // tiatia, 1 emoji
  "invite_code": "...", // tiatia ne INVITE nɔnɔme
  "kyber_public_key": "<1184 hex>" // tiatia, na PQ
} .

  "zãla ƒe ŋkɔ": "alice",

login.title: POST /api/ɖaseɖiɖi/ge ɖe eme
login.subtitle: Kpɔ zãla ƒe ŋkɔ + nyagbe ɣaɣla ɖa, trɔ JWT eve.
login.intro: De asi eme — auth: **ɖeke meli o**.
login.h1_a: Eɖɔlia ɖaseɖigbalẽwo na JWT eve. Woɖo kpe nyagbea dzi ɖe Argon2id hash si le `users.password_hash` me. Ɣeyiɣi nye ɣeyiɣi si nɔa anyi ɖaa na zãla siwo womenya o gɔ̃ hã be woatsi tre ɖe xexlẽdzesiwo ŋu.
login.h1_b: Di zãla la to zãla ƒe ŋkɔ sue me, ewɔa `argon2.PasswordHasher.verify(dzrae ɖo, woɖoe ɖa)`. Ne zãla la meli o la, eɖoa kpe edzi kple dummy hash si wobu do ŋgɔ be wòana ɣeyiɣi nasɔ. Dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ → ɖe JWT + `zãla_mɔ̃wo` fli.
login.h1_c: Woɖoe kple register le v0.0.1 me. Constant-time dummy hashing kpe ɖe eŋu le v0.0.2 me le esi numekulawo ɖe ɣeyiɣi ƒe xexlẽdzesi fia le gɔmedzedze ƒe aɖaŋuwɔwɔa dzi vɔ megbe.
login.h2_a: Ebia be: **ɖeke meli o**. Titinamɔ̃ `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` agbo mɔ sia eye wògbea kple `401 si womeɖo kpe edzi o` nenye be ɖaseɖigbalẽ si hiã la bu alo mesɔ o.
login.h2_b:
- `none` — womeɖo kpe edzi o (do ŋgɔ na gege ɖe eme).
- `jwt` — Bearer JWT mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi le `Mɔɖeɖe` ƒe tanya me.
- `gbugbɔgadzɔ` — Bearer JWT gbugbɔgawɔ dzesi.
- `admin` — JWT si ƒe nyawo me `is_admin: nyateƒe` le.
- `peer-signed` — biabia ƒe ŋutilã si te hati si dzi woka ɖo ƒe Ed25519 safui de asi.
login.h2_c: Auth tier la ɖea gɔmeɖose si nye mɔnukpɔkpɔ suetɔ kekeake fiana: woɖo seɖoƒe na nuwuƒe siwo do ŋgɔ na gege ɖe eme la vevie na akɔntabubu wɔwɔ kple egbugbɔgaxɔ; nusianu si le megbe na JWT kpɔa ezãla ŋutɔŋutɔ; admin ƒe nuwuƒewo ɖea akɔtagbalẽvi aɖe fiana le UI me eyata woate ŋu akpɔ eŋudɔwɔwɔ le mɔ gbegblẽ nu.
login.h5_a: Standard Vortex vodada ƒe agbalẽkotoku `{vodada, nɔnɔme, mɔ}`. `401` le ɖaseɖigbalẽ gbegblẽwo dzi; `403` le mɔnukpɔkpɔ si mesɔ gbɔ o dzi; `422` le kpeɖodzinana dzi; `429` le seɖoƒe si woɖo na ga home dzi; `5xx` le vodada ememetɔ dzi.
login.h5_f:
401 invalid_credentials zãla ƒe ŋkɔ alo nyagbe gbegblẽ
401 account_suspended akɔnta la wodzudzɔ
401 totp_required na totp eye nàgadze agbagba ake
429 rate_limited >10 agbagbadzedze/min/IP .

refresh.title: POST /api/ɖaseɖiɖi/gbugbɔgawɔ
refresh.subtitle: Tsɔ nu yeye JWT dzrae hena mɔɖeɖe yeye JWT.
refresh.intro: Gbugbɔ yi mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi — auth: **gbugbɔ **.
refresh.h1_a: Mints aɖabaƒoƒo 15 ƒe mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi yeye aɖe evɔ megabia nyagbea tso zãla la si ake o. Wozãnɛ ne mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi si li fifia ƒe nuwuwu gogo alo wòtrɔ 401 teti koe nye ema.
refresh.h1_b: Decodes eye wòda asi ɖe refresh token (signature, exp, not-revoked), mints mɔɖeɖe yeye JWT kple `jti` ma ke. Ne `ROTATE_REFRESH=true`, hã ɖea gbugbɔgawɔ yeye ɖe go.

invite.title: POST /api/xɔwo/{id}/kpe
invite.subtitle: Wɔ amekpekpe ƒe kɔpi
invite.h1_a: Admin ɖeɖeko. Lɔ̃ ɖe tiatiawɔblɔɖe `max_uses`, `expires_at`, `de dɔ_asi`. Trɔ 32-hex-char ƒe kɔda.
invite.h1_b: Handler na mɔ sia nɔa module si sɔ me le `app/` te. Woɖe gbeƒã mɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu `/api/rooms/{id}/invite` kple `@router.post('/api/rooms/{id}/invite')`.
invite.h1_c: Woɖoe ɖe Vortex ƒe dodo kaba abe `amekpekpe` ŋutete ƒe akpa aɖe ene.
invite.h2_a: Ebia be: **jwt**. Titinamɔ̃ `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` agbo mɔ sia eye wògbea kple `401 si womeɖo kpe edzi o` nenye be ɖaseɖigbalẽ si hiã la bu alo mesɔ o.
invite.h2_b:
- `none` — womeɖo kpe edzi o (do ŋgɔ na gege ɖe eme).
- `jwt` — Bearer JWT mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi le `Mɔɖeɖe` ƒe tanya me.
- `gbugbɔgadzɔ` — Bearer JWT gbugbɔgawɔ dzesi.
- `admin` — JWT si ƒe nyawo me `is_admin: nyateƒe` le.
- `peer-signed` — biabia ƒe ŋutilã si te hati si dzi woka ɖo ƒe Ed25519 safui de asi.

roadmap.title: Mɔfiame
roadmap.subtitle: Nusiwo ŋu wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖo kple ɣekaɣie.
roadmap.intro: Nukpɔkpɔ si le ɖoƒe kɔkɔ aɖe. Ɣletiŋkekewo nye didi vevie; dedienɔnɔnyawo doa ŋgɔ na feature dɔwɔwɔ.
roadmap.h1: v0.2 — evelia si woɖe ɖe go le dutoƒo
roadmap.h1p1: Kyber-768 PQ wowɔe le gɔmedzedzea me le ɖoɖo yeyewo me.
roadmap.h1p2: Ƒuƒoƒo siwo ade 50 000 hameviwo kple Variant-B safui ta.
roadmap.h1p3: Desktop (Tauri) ƒe agbalẽviwo na macOS / Windows / Linux.
roadmap.h2p1: Ƒuƒoƒo si me odio ɖeɖeko le yɔa gomekpɔla siwo ade 100 to SFU dzi.
roadmap.h2p2: Opus DTX + simulcast + bitrate si trɔna ɖe nɔnɔmewo ŋu.
roadmap.h2p3: Gomenɔla ɖesiaɖe mute / kick le yɔyɔa me UI.
roadmap.h3p1: Miro-style collaborative canvas over CRDT (Yjs-vivi) to gbedasiwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒoa dzi.
roadmap.h3p2: Nufiamɔ̃ ƒe anyinɔnɔ le ɣeyiɣi ŋutɔŋutɔ me.
roadmap.h4p1: On-kɔsɔkɔsɔ escrow na bot ƒle (Solana + EVM).
roadmap.h4p2: Dɔwɔƒea ƒe gakpɔkpɔ ƒe akpa, 10 %% ƒe nuƒolanɔƒe ƒe fetu.
roadmap.h4p3: Fiat on/off ramp to Stripe kadodo dzi.
roadmap.h5p1: Le etame li ke, dedienɔnɔ ŋuti agbalẽdzikpɔkpɔ le se nu, xɔ siwo woate ŋu agbugbɔ awɔ, SemVer tsikpe.
roadmap.h5p3: Dedienɔnɔ ŋuti numekuku ɖeka ya teti le eɖokui si kple dutoƒonuŋɔŋlɔ.
roadmap.h1_a: v0.2 — evelia si woɖe ɖe go le dutoƒo. Kyber PQ le gɔmedzedzea me, dutoƒoxɔ gãwo to Variant-B dzi, Tauri kplɔ̃dzivɔwo, bot asi si woʋu.
roadmap.h1_b: Kyber-768 ɖoe be wowɔe na ɖoɖo yeyewo; asisi siwo si kpekpeɖeŋu mele o le amenuveve me downgrade. Xɔ siwo ade 50 000 hameviwo to Variant-B safui dzi — no per-member envelope fanout on rotation. Desktop (Tauri 2 wrapper ƒo xlã web client) si wota na macOS, Windows, Linux kple bundle ɖeka. Bot asitsaƒea ʋuna na dutoƒonudɔdɔwo kple 3-dɔwɔŋkekewo me toto SLA.
roadmap.h1_c: v0.2 ku ɖe gbãtɔ siwo li fifia ƒe lolome dzi ɖeɖe kpɔtɔ ŋu tsɔ wu be woato yeyewo vɛ. Kyber nɔa mɔa dzi ɣesiaɣi; tɔtrɔ yi default nɔ te ɖe liƒo le agba te dzi. Wotia Tauri ɖe Electron teƒe elabena babla la nye ~5 MB vs ~150 MB. Woxe mɔ na Bot asitsaƒe dutoƒo dɔdɔwo le ŋkuléle ɖe xɔtuɖoɖo siwo dze anyi ɖe v0.1 me.
roadmap.h2_a: v0.3 — ƒuƒoƒo ƒe yɔyɔwo. SFU-dzi odio ƒuƒoƒo siwo ade 100; video ƒe ƒuƒoƒo siwo ade 32; simulcast si trɔna ɖe nɔnɔmewo ŋu.
roadmap.h2_b: SFU si wowɔ le Rust me hena dɔwɔwɔ. Opus DTX + FEC + simulcast na odio. VP9 L1/L2/L3 simulcast na video kple SFU tiatia ɖesiaɖe-kpɔla layer si wotu ɖe nyatakaka downlink dzi. Gomenɔla ɖesiaɖe mute kple afɔ tso UI. Kaƒoƒo ƒe nuŋlɔɖi (si wotsɔ mɔɖeɖe ɖe nu ŋu, tsi le gɔmedzedzea me) si wodzra ɖo ɖe nya ɣaɣla me le kaƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe ƒe ke safui si woama le gomekpɔlawo dome te.
roadmap.h2_c: Ƒuƒoƒo ƒe kaƒoƒo nye nu ɖeka kolia si wobia wu tso v0.1 beta me. SFU ƒe wɔwɔme zɔna ɖe Jitsi Videobridge + Janus ƒe nɔnɔmewo dzi. Rust dɔwɔwɔ tsɔ wu be woagazã mediasoup elabena mediasoup ƒe Node.js runtime tsɔ latency si míedi le mɔ dzodzoe dzi kpena ɖe eŋu o.
roadmap.h3_a: v0.4 — nuwɔwɔ aduadu ƒe canvas. Miro-style shared board over CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) to gbedasiwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si li fifia dzi.
roadmap.h3_b: CRDT nuŋlɔɖi sync piggybacks le xɔme gbedasi siwo li xoxo dzi. Board ƒe ɖɔɖɔɖo ɖesiaɖe nye CRDT dɔwɔwɔ si woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu abe CBOR ene, si wotsɔ xɔme safui ɣla, si woda ɖe afima abe gbedasi si nye `kind:"board_op"` ene. Asitsalawo deserialise, bia, render. Ɣeyiɣi ŋutɔŋutɔ me fli ƒe anyinɔnɔ to `kind:"board_cursor"` gbedasi ƒomevi si le vovo dzi. Ðoe ɖe PNG / SVG / PDF to asisiwo ƒe akpa dzi canvas gɔmeɖeɖe dzi.
roadmap.h3_c: CRDTwo (Shapiro et al. 2011) va zu nusiwo woateŋu awɔ kple Yjs (Kevin Jahns, 2017). Figma xɔ ŋkɔ be wotu woƒe nuwɔwɔ aduadu ɖe xɔ si le abe CRDT ene si wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu dzi. Susu si nye be míagazã míaƒe gbedasi ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔe tsɔ wu be míatu WebSocket mɔnu vovovowo la tso gɔmeɖose aɖe gbɔ: ʋuɖoɖomɔ ʋɛ aɖewo, nugbagbevi ʋɛ aɖewo.
roadmap.h4_a: v0.5 — fexexe. On-kɔsɔkɔsɔ escrow (Solana + EVM) + fiat dzi/tsi mɔ dzi to Stripe Connect dzi.
roadmap.h4_b: Bot ƒle mɔ to kɔsɔkɔsɔ escrow nubabla. Nuƒlela da asi ɖe edzi; 24 h ƒe megbedede; emegbe ga siwo woɖena ɖe go na nudzrala tsɔ 10 % ƒe nuƒolanɔƒe ƒe fetu ɖa. Nyaʋiʋliwo yia nutoa me nyadrɔ̃la siwo wotia to staking dzi gbɔ. Fiat on-ramp: Stripe Connect ƒe akɔntabubuwo na dɔwɔla ɖesiaɖe alo bot dzrala ɖesiaɖe; off-ramp: gadzraɖoƒe ƒe gaɖoɖo tẽ alo USDC ƒe fexexe. Crypto ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu: SOL, USDC, USDT le Solana kple Ethereum siaa dzi.
roadmap.h4_c: Escrow smart contracts nye xoxo (OpenBazaar 2016) gake wogakpɔtɔ le ƒuƒlu ƒo xlã goawo le UX gome. Vortex nyi nusiwo sesẽ la dome gake eɣlaa eƒe akpa gãtɔ — nuƒlelawo kpɔa "ƒle" ƒe dzesi nyanyɛ aɖe. 10 % ƒe platform ƒe fetu sɔ kple App Store ƒe takpekpewo (togbɔ be Apple xɔa 30 % hã); woɖoe koŋ tso lãɖeɖe si le ete la be woatsɔ ahe nudzralawo vɛ.
roadmap.h5_a: v1.0 — liƒo. Dedienɔnɔ ƒe agbalẽdzikpɔkpɔ, xɔ siwo woate ŋu agbugbɔ awɔ le mɔ̃wo katã dzi, SemVer tsikpe.
roadmap.h5_b: Ame etɔ̃lia ƒe agbalẽdzikpɔkpɔ ɖoɖo do ŋgɔ na 1.0 freeze — anɔ eme be Trail of Bits alo NCC Group si wotu ɖe asitsatsa ƒe nyayɔyɔwo dzi. Tu siwo woate ŋu agbugbɔ awɔ fia be dzɔtsoƒeti ɖeka ma ke wɔa bit-identical binaries le xɔtumɔ̃ eve ɖesiaɖe dzi; esia dea dzesi asitɔtrɔ le nuzazãwo ƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔwo ŋu. SemVer frozen fia be ka ƒe ɖoɖowo, nudzraɖoƒe ƒe ɖoɖo, kple dutoƒo SDK anyigba dzi xɔa megbe-sɔsɔ ƒe kakaɖedziwo le 1.x me. Bug bounty program dzea egɔme kple $25k top tier na adzɔge code wuwu le node la dzi.
roadmap.h5_c: Stabilise-audit-freeze ƒe ɖoɖoa nye kpɔɖeŋu si dzi Signal, Tor, I2P, kple WireGuard katã kplɔ ɖo. Tu siwo woate ŋu agbugbɔ awɔ la va zu nu vevi aɖe le Reproducible Builds dɔa (ƒe 2014) megbe. Vortex zãa dɔwɔnu si nye Reproducible Builds. Bug bounties nye dzidzenu na dɔ ɖesiaɖe si kpɔa zãla ƒe nyatakakawo gbɔ; $25k nye titina-tier le ƒe 2025 ƒe dzidzenuwo nu.
roadmap.h1_f:
v0.2 tsɔtsɔ yi (wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu):
  PQ hybrid default : Kyber-768 le gɔmedzedzea me
  xɔ gãwo : Variant-B ta safui, vaseɖe 50k hameviwo
  kplɔ̃dzivɔ : Tauri 2 na macOS / Windows / Linux (~5 MB)
  bot asitsaƒe : dutoƒo nyatakakawo, ŋkeke 3 ƒe numetoto SLA .
roadmap.h2_f:
v0.3 tsɔtsɔ yi (wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu):
  SFU mɔ̃ : Rust, gbugbɔ zãa libwebrtc
  odio ƒuƒoƒowo : ≤ gomekpɔla 100, Opus simulcast
  video ƒuƒoƒowo : ≤ gomekpɔla 32, VP9 L1/L2/L3 simulcast
  nuŋɔŋlɔ : opt-in, E2E-nya ɣaɣla le call_root safui te
roadmap.h3_f:
v0.4 tsɔtsɔ yi (wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu):
  canvas : Yjs-vivi CRDT, piggyback le xɔme gbedasiwo
  dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo : CBOR{v:1, op_type, taɖodzinu, payload}
  cursor ƒe anyinɔnɔ : kind="board_cursor", woɖe asi le eŋu vaseɖe 10 Hz
  dɔdɔ : asisiwo ƒe akpa dzi PNG / SVG / PDF .
roadmap.h4_f:
v0.5 tsɔtsɔ yi (wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu):
  escrow : Solana ɖoɖowɔɖi + EVM nubabla, 24 h ƒe megbedede
  nuƒolanɔƒe ƒe fetu : 10 % le ga gbogbotɔ me
  fiat : Stripe Do ka kple nudzrala ɖesiaɖe
  crypto : SOL, USDC, USDT le Solana + Ethereum dzi
  nyaʋiʋli : nutoa me nyametsotsowɔlawo, akɔdada si woda ɖe akpa dzi
roadmap.h5_f:
v1.0 tsɔtsɔ yi (wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu):
  dedienɔnɔ ŋuti agbalẽdzikpɔkpɔ : Trail of Bits alo NCC (Q3) .
  xɔ siwo woate ŋu agbugbɔ awɔ: dzɔtsoƒe SHA256 → deterministic binary SHA256 .
  SemVer freeze : ka ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi kple SDK API li ke le 1.x me
  bug bounty : $25k max tier na RCE le node dzi

glossary.title: Nyagɔmeɖegbalẽ
glossary.subtitle: Nya ɖesiaɖe si wozã le Vortex docs me, woŋlɔe nyuie.
glossary.intro: Alfabeta ƒe mɔfiame. Nya gbalẽvi ɖesiaɖe kekena ɖe enu wòzua gɔmesese blibo, afisi wozãe le, eƒe ŋutinya, kple mɔfiame alo kpɔɖeŋu ne esɔ.

aead.title: AEAD ƒe .
aead.subtitle: Nya Ɣaɣla si Woɖo Ðe Edzi Kple Nyatakaka Siwo Do Ƒome Kplii.
aead.intro: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) nye nya ɣaɣlawo ƒe gɔmedzenu si ƒoa nya ɣaɣlawo kple nuteƒewɔwɔ nu ƒu le kaƒoƒo ɖeka me. Ne wona key, nonce, plaintext, kple optional associated data (AAD) la, ewɔa ciphertext + authentication tag ale be asitɔtrɔ ɖesiaɖe si woawɔ ɖe plaintext, ciphertext, alo AAD ŋu la do kpo kpeɖodzinana.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) nye nya ɣaɣlawo ƒe gɔmedzenu si ƒoa nya ɣaɣlawo kple nuteƒewɔwɔ nu ƒu le kaƒoƒo ɖeka me. Ne wona key, nonce, plaintext, kple optional associated data (AAD) la, ewɔa ciphertext + authentication tag ale be asitɔtrɔ ɖesiaɖe si woawɔ ɖe plaintext, ciphertext, alo AAD ŋu la do kpo kpeɖodzinana.
aead.h1_b: Vortex ƒe AEAD nye AES-256-GCM ɣesiaɣi. AAD ƒe ʋɔtrua tsɔa nya siwo ƒo xlãe si wòle be amesi xɔe nanya be wòaɖe nyatakakawo gɔme nyuie (xɔme id, file id, offset). Binding AAD xea mɔ na cross-context replay — womateŋu aɖe ciphertext si tso xɔ A me abe xɔ B ene o.
aead.h1_c: AEAD abe gbãtɔ si ŋkɔe nye dzesiwo tso Rogaway 2002. GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) nye dzidzenu to NIST le SP 800-38D (2007). Ezu AEAD si woɖo ɖi le TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018). Egbegbe dedienɔnɔ ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi ɖesiaɖe zãa AEAD.
aead.h1_f:
AEAD.Enc (k, n, pt, aad) = (ct, tag) // ct = len (pt) bytes, tag = 16 bytes
AEAD.Dec (k, n, ct, tag, aad) = pt alo ⊥

alembic.title: Alembic ƒe agbalẽ
alembic.subtitle: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe ʋuʋu dɔwɔnu na SQLAlchemy.
alembic.intro: Alembic nye canonical ʋuʋu ƒe ɖoɖo na SQLAlchemy. Ʋuʋu ɖesiaɖe nye Python faɛl si me `upgrade()` kple `downgrade()` dɔwɔwɔ siwo ɖɔa schema ƒe tɔtrɔwo abe SQL alo ORM dɔwɔwɔwo ene.
alembic.h1_a: Alembic nye canonical ʋuʋu ƒe ɖoɖo na SQLAlchemy. Ʋuʋu ɖesiaɖe nye Python faɛl si me `upgrade()` kple `downgrade()` dɔwɔwɔ siwo ɖɔa schema ƒe tɔtrɔwo abe SQL alo ORM dɔwɔwɔwo ene.
alembic.h1_b: Vortex zãa Alembic kple linear revision history (alɔdze aɖeke mele eme o). `alembic upgrade head` zɔna le Docker nugoe ƒe gɔmedzedze ɖesiaɖe dzi. `alembic downgrade -1` trɔa afɔɖeɖe ɖeka na rollback. Dev mode zãa `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` eyata teƒea ƒe iteration mehiã ʋuʋu le rebase ɖesiaɖe dzi o.
alembic.h1_c: Alembic nye esi Mike Bayer (SQLAlchemy ŋlɔla) ŋlɔ le ƒe 2011 me abe `sqlalchemy-migrate` teƒenɔla ene. Django ƒe ʋuʋu siwo wotu ɖe eme (2014) do kpɔɖeŋu vevitɔa. Alembic tsi ŋgɔ le nɔnɔmewo me — rollback, autogenerate, branching — togbɔ be Vortex mezãa alɔdzewo o hã.

apns.title: APN-wo
apns.subtitle: Apple Push Nyatakaka dɔwɔƒe.
apns.intro: APNs nye Apple ƒe push-notification subɔsubɔdɔ na iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Dɔwɔɖoɖowo ŋlɔa mɔ̃ ƒe dzesi eye dɔwɔƒewo ɖoa nyatakaka payloads ɖe APNs si fans wo doa goe ɖe mɔ̃wo.
apns.h1_a: APNs nye Apple ƒe push-notification subɔsubɔdɔ na iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Dɔwɔɖoɖowo ŋlɔa mɔ̃ ƒe dzesi eye dɔwɔƒewo ɖoa nyatakaka payloads ɖe APNs si fans wo doa goe ɖe mɔ̃wo.
apns.h1_b: Vortex zãa APN siwo si sealed-push envelopes le: node la tsɔa nyatakaka ƒe fetu ɖesiaɖe ɣla na amesi xɔe ƒe X25519 pubkey; Blob si me mekɔ o koe APN-wo kpɔa. iOS asitsaha la ƒe Nyatakaka Dɔwɔƒe ƒe Kekeɖenudɔa ɖea nyatakakawo gɔme le ɖoɖo bubu aɖe me hafi aflagaa ɖea nu gɔme.
apns.h1_c: APN siwo wodze egɔme kple iOS 3.0 (ƒe 2009). Sealed push / mutable content support va kple iOS 10 (2016). Token-based auth (.p8) xɔ ɖe ɖaseɖigbalẽ-based auth teƒe abe default ene le ƒe 2016. Vortex zãa token auth kple miniti 60 ƒe provider tokens.
apns.h3_a: FCM, Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe Tutu, nutrenu tutu, Nyatakaka Dɔwɔƒe ƒe Kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔ

argon2id.title: Argon2id ƒe ƒuƒoƒo
argon2id.subtitle: Memory-hard nyagbe ɣaɣla hash (RFC 9106).
argon2id.intro: Argon2id nye ŋkuɖodzinu-sesẽ, axa-mɔ̃-tsi tre ɖe nyagbe ɣaɣla hashing dɔwɔwɔ. Parameters: ŋkuɖodzinu ƒe lolome (m), ɣeyiɣi ƒe gazazã (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), kple hash ƒe didime. 'id' ƒe vovototoa tsakaa nyatakaka-siwo menɔa te ɖe nyatakaka dzi o (Argon2i) kple nyatakaka-dzikpɔkpɔ (Argon2d) ƒe mɔzɔzɔ.
argon2id.h1_a: Argon2id nye ŋkuɖodzinu-sesẽ, axa-mɔ̃-tsi tre ɖe nyagbe ɣaɣla hashing dɔwɔwɔ. Parameters: ŋkuɖodzinu ƒe lolome (m), ɣeyiɣi ƒe gazazã (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), kple hash ƒe didime. 'id' ƒe vovototoa tsakaa nyatakaka-siwo menɔa te ɖe nyatakaka dzi o (Argon2i) kple nyatakaka-dzikpɔkpɔ (Argon2d) ƒe mɔzɔzɔ.
argon2id.h1_b: Vortex zãa Argon2id kple m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32. Esia xɔa ~0.5 s le iPhone X (míaƒe mɔ̃ si wodoa alɔe blewu wu) dzi eye abe 5 ms ene le ASIC si ƒe asi de ŋgɔ dzi — 100× ƒe duƒuƒu meɖi naneke o ne wotsɔe sɔ kple SHA-256-si wotu ɖe hashes dzi afisi ASICwo ɖua dzi le miliɔn geɖe.
argon2id.h1_c: Argon2 ɖu dzi le ƒe 2015 ƒe Password Hashing Hoʋiʋli si ŋu Dmitry Khovratovich kple Alex Biryukov wɔ ɖoɖo ɖo la me. Woɖoe ɖe ɖoɖo nu be RFC 9106 le ƒe 2021. Wozãe to 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass dzi. Vortex ƒe parameters tso OWASP 2023 ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖowo me.
argon2id.h1_f:
Argon2id(nyagbe, dze, m, t, p, hashLen) → hash
gbãtɔ: m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32
ga home ≈ 0.5s le iPhone X dzi; ~5ms le ASIC (100× amedzidzela ƒe duƒuƒu)
argon2id.h3_a: nyagbe ɣaɣla tsɔtsɔ ƒu gbe, AEAD, HKDF, dze

blake3.title: BLAKE3 ƒe .
blake3.subtitle: Hash si nye cryptographic kabakaba.
blake3.intro: BLAKE3 nye nya ɣaɣlawo ƒe hash dɔwɔwɔ si dzɔ tso BLAKE2 kple BLAKE me. Ewɔa nusi ƒe didime nye nusi wodi tso nusiwo wotsɔ de eme si wodi me; 10× kabakaba wu SHA-256 le blobs gãwo dzi akpe ɖe ati ememetɔ ƒe hashing ta.
blake3.h1_a: BLAKE3 nye nya ɣaɣlawo ƒe hash dɔwɔwɔ si dzɔ tso BLAKE2 kple BLAKE me. Ewɔa nusi ƒe didime nye nusi wodi tso nusiwo wotsɔ de eme si wodi me; 10× kabakaba wu SHA-256 le blobs gãwo dzi akpe ɖe ati ememetɔ ƒe hashing ta.
blake3.h1_b: Vortex zãa BLAKE3 hena faɛl ƒe blibonyenye: faɛl ɖesiaɖe si woda ɖe Internet dzi la tsɔa `plain_blake3` hash si nye eƒe nyatakaka siwo woɖe tso eme ale be amesiwo xɔe nateŋu aɖo kpe edzi le kɔpi + eɖeɖe vɔ megbe. Wotsɔ ŋkɔ na DB kɔlam la le ŋutinya me be `sha256` hena ʋuʋu ƒe sɔsɔ gake BLAKE3 ƒe emetsonu le eme.
blake3.h1_c: BLAKE3 nye esi Jack O'Connor kple exɔlɔ̃wo ɖe ɖe go. le ƒe 2020. Edzi tso BLAKE, si nye SHA-3 mamlɛtɔ le ƒe 2012. Ati-hashing ƒe ɖoɖoa na BLAKE3 dzidze kple nu veviwo hena nu gãwo tsɔtsɔ de eme. SHA-256 gakpɔtɔ le kabakaba wu na nusiwo wotsɔ de eme suewo; BLAKE3 ɖua nusianu si > 4 KiB dzi.
blake3.h1_f:
BLAKE3(bytes) = 32 bytes // emetsonu gbãtɔ
BLAKE3(byte, len) = len byte (XOF) ƒe ƒuƒoƒo.
nusiwo dona: ~3 GB/s le Apple Silicon vs SHA-256 ~500 MB/s

bmp.title: BMP ƒe .
bmp.subtitle: Blind Mailbox ƒe Ðoɖowɔɖi.
bmp.intro: BMP nye Vortex ƒe fiase-kple-ŋgɔgbe ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si ŋkɔ mele o. Dɔdɔlawo tsɔa blob siwo wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔna dea node ɖesiaɖe si ŋu nyatoƒoetoto le, eye wotsɔa mɔ ɖeka dzi hash si le amesi xɔe ƒe pubkey la dea safui me. Blobs doa nyatoƒoetoto vaseɖe esime amesi xɔe ƒe node la he.
bmp.h1_a: BMP nye Vortex ƒe fiase-kple-ŋgɔgbe ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si ŋkɔ mele o. Dɔdɔlawo tsɔa blob siwo wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔna dea node ɖesiaɖe si ŋu nyatoƒoetoto le, eye wotsɔa mɔ ɖeka dzi hash si le amesi xɔe ƒe pubkey la dea safui me. Blobs doa nyatoƒoetoto vaseɖe esime amesi xɔe ƒe node la he.
bmp.h1_b: BMP naa ameŋunyatakaka ƒe nɔnɔme etɔ̃ siwo le wo ɖokui si: amedɔdɔ-ɣla (TLS + sabala si woate ŋu atia), amesi xɔe ɣla (mailbox_id nye nusi me mekɔ o na titina nodes), emenyawo ɣla (blob nye E2E-ncrypted xoxo). Max blob 1 MB, node ɖesiaɖe ƒe nutrenu 500 MB, gadede asi ƒe agbɔsɔsɔme 10/min/IP, TTL 7200 s.
bmp.h1_c: BMP nye esi Vortex ƒe ƒuƒoƒoa wɔ tso gɔmedzedzea me ke. Míetue elabena dɔla vevi aɖeke melɔ̃ be yeaxe mɔ̃ɖaŋununya ƒe ga si woatsɔ aɣla metadata tso nuwuwu vaseɖe nuwuwu o — wotsɔa nyatakakawo ɣla gake woɖea hadome nɔnɔmetata la doa goe. Míaƒe tenɔnɔ tso ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi enye be amedɔdɔ si le dedie si ƒoa nu tso amesi ƒoa nu na ame ŋu la ƒe afã koe le dedie. BMP xea afã ma to ewɔwɔ be ame si ɖoe ɖa, amesi xɔe, kple emenyawo me mekɔna le wo ɖokui si o, ɖe Vortex ŋutɔ ƒe nyatoƒoetoto ƒe mɔ̃ dzi tsɔ wu be woatsɔ bolted-on infrastructure dzi.
bmp.h3_a: nyatoƒoetoto, sabala subɔsubɔdɔ, nutrenu ɖola, Tɔsisi

cbor.title: CBOR ƒe .
cbor.subtitle: Nu Eve ƒe Nɔnɔmetata Kpuie.
cbor.intro: CBOR (RFC 8949) nye nyatakaka eve ƒe ɖoɖo si wowɔ na kɔda ƒe lolome sue kple nuŋɔŋlɔ kabakaba. Superset of JSON ƒe nyatakaka kpɔɖeŋu, binary-encoded, strictly deterministic.
cbor.h1_a: CBOR (RFC 8949) nye nyatakaka eve ƒe ɖoɖo si wowɔ na kɔda ƒe lolome sue kple nuŋɔŋlɔ kabakaba. Superset of JSON ƒe nyatakaka kpɔɖeŋu, binary-encoded, strictly deterministic.
cbor.h1_b: Vortex zãa CBOR abe payload ƒe nɔnɔme ene le AES-GCM agbalẽkotokuwo me. ~30 % sue wu JSON le unicode-heavy chat me; strict parsing (whitespace ambiguity aɖeke mele eme o) tsi tre ɖe parser-differential amedzidzedzewo ŋu; schema-free eyata agble tsɔtsɔ kpee mehiã .proto gbugbɔgaƒoƒo o.
cbor.h1_c: CBOR woɖoe ɖe ɖoɖo nu abe RFC 7049 le ƒe 2013 me, wowɔe yeyee wòzu RFC 8949 le ƒe 2020. Wozãe to Signal (ememe framing tso ƒe 2017), Matrix ƒe state-resolution layer, WebAuthn (ɖaseɖiɖinuwo). Wotiae to Vortex le v0.0.2 me le esi wotsɔe sɔ kple JSON kple protobuf vɔ megbe.
cbor.h1_f:
CBOR encoding: {major_type (3 bits), nyaʋiʋli (5 bits), [nyatakakawo]}
anyigbatata: ƒomevi=5 eve
array: ƒomevi=4 nu veviwo
nuŋɔŋlɔ: ƒomevi=3 bytes
bytes: ƒomevi=2 raw
