controller.title: Dzɔla
controller.subtitle: Vortex ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi + nu yeyewo didi ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ.
controller.intro: Dzɔla la nye Python dɔwɔwɔ si le vovo (`vortex_controller`) si ƒe dɔ ɖeka koe nye be wòata manifest si wode asi (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) kple nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe URLwo. Asitsalawo ƒoa pin controller la ƒe Ed25519 pubkey le ɣeyiɣi si me woɖee ɖe go.
controller.h1_a: Dzɔla la nye Python dɔwɔwɔ si le vovo (`vortex_controller`) si ƒe dɔ ɖeka koe nye be wòata manifest si wode asi (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) kple nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe URLwo. Asitsalawo ƒoa pin controller la ƒe Ed25519 pubkey le ɣeyiɣi si me woɖee ɖe go.
controller.h1_b: Eɖea API ƒe anyigba sue aɖe ɖe go (~12 mɔwo). Woɖoe koŋ le anyigba gbadzaa dzi — enye amedzidzedze ƒe taɖodzinu si ƒe asixɔxɔ de ŋgɔ wu ne asisiwo nya pin. Ahuhɔ̃ewo zãa kɔda ɖeka ma ke kple safui ɖeka si woɖena ɖe go; DNS/SNS/IPFS ta ahuhɔ̃ewo ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo.
controller.h1_c: Wotoe vɛ le v0.0.3 me le esi monolith ƒe tɔtrɔ gbãtɔ bla node ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ɖe node la ŋutɔ ŋu vɔ megbe (node ​​si wogblẽ ate ŋu ada alakpa le eya ŋutɔ ƒe kɔda ŋu). Mamã ɖaseɖiɖi ɖe dɔwɔwɔ vovovo si wowɔ ɖe Debian ƒe Release.gpg + Chrome ƒe kedzraɖoƒe ƒe kpɔɖeŋu nu.
controller.h3_a: integrity manifest, asiɖeɖe le safui, ahuhɔ̃e, kakaɖedzi_nodes

doubleRatchet.title: Ratchet si nye eve
doubleRatchet.subtitle: Signal ƒe per-DM ŋgɔ-nya ɣaɣla ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi.
doubleRatchet.intro: Double Ratchet la ƒoa Diffie-Hellman ratchet kple kɔsɔkɔsɔ si ƒe safui sɔ kple wo nɔewo nu ƒu ɖekae. Gbedasi ɖesiaɖe doa eƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔa ɖe ŋgɔ; ɣeaɖewoɣi DH ratchets gbugbɔ safui kea. Etsɔa nya ɣaɣla siwo yi ŋgɔ (gbedasi siwo va yi le dedie le nugblẽfexexe megbe) kple dedienɔnɔ le nugblẽfexeɖoɖo megbe (gbedasi siwo ava va le dedie le wo gbugbɔgawɔ vɔ megbe) naa.
doubleRatchet.h1_a: Double Ratchet la ƒoa Diffie-Hellman ratchet kple kɔsɔkɔsɔ si ƒe safui sɔ kple wo nɔewo nu ƒu ɖekae. Gbedasi ɖesiaɖe doa eƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔa ɖe ŋgɔ; ɣeaɖewoɣi DH ratchets gbugbɔ safui kea. Etsɔa nya ɣaɣla siwo yi ŋgɔ (gbedasi siwo va yi le dedie le nugblẽfexexe megbe) kple dedienɔnɔ le nugblẽfexeɖoɖo megbe (gbedasi siwo ava va le dedie le wo gbugbɔgawɔ vɔ megbe) naa.
doubleRatchet.h1_b: Vortex zãa Double Ratchet na kɔsɔkɔsɔ siwo ɖoa gbedasi tẽ. Ƒuƒoƒoxɔwo zãa ɖoɖo si le bɔbɔe wu si nye sender-key-safui si wotsɔ safui bla xɔa ƒe ke. Kɔsɔkɔsɔ ƒe didime si woɖo ɖe gbedasi 1000 hafi wozi wo dzi be woagawɔe ake; skipped-key cache vaseɖe gbedasi 1000 siwo mele ɖoɖo nu o; tanya ƒe nya ɣaɣlawo le dɔ wɔm le gɔmedzedzea me.
doubleRatchet.h1_c: Trevor Perrin kple Moxie Marlinspike ye wɔ eƒe nɔnɔmetata le ƒe 2013 me; woɖoe ɖe Signal 2014 me; adopted by WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Dzeɖoɖo Adzame, Skype Dzeɖoɖo Ame ŋutɔ. Public spec 2016. Vortex ƒe dɔwɔwɔ nye melidzeƒe tẽ.
doubleRatchet.h1_f:
kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɖoɖo: CK_dɔ → HKDF(CK_dɔ, "afɔɖeɖe") → CK_dɔ'.
                    MK → HKDF(CK_dɔ, "nyatakaka")
kɔsɔkɔsɔ si xɔa: CK_recv → HKDF(CK_recv, "afɔɖeɖe") → CK_recv'.
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(míaƒe_eph, woƒe_eph), RK_do ŋgɔ)
doubleRatchet.h2_a: `app / dedienɔnɔ / eve_ratchet.py`, iOS `Dzeɖoɖo / impl / eve Ratchet.swift`.
doubleRatchet.h3_a: adzamenyawo tsɔtsɔ yi ŋgɔe, dedienɔnɔ le nugblẽfexeɖoɖo megbe, X25519 .

ech.title: ECH ƒe .
ech.subtitle: Asitsalawo ƒe gbedoname si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ (RFC 9460).
ech.intro: ECH ɣlaa SNI (Server Name Indication) le TLS 1.3 dzi to ClientHello ememetɔ la xatsa ɖe ClientHello gotatɔ si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ ɖe dutoƒo safui si wota ɖe DNS HTTPS nuŋlɔɖi me te.
ech.h1_a: ECH ɣlaa SNI (Server Name Indication) le TLS 1.3 dzi to ClientHello ememetɔ la xatsa ɖe ClientHello gotatɔ si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ ɖe dutoƒo safui si wota ɖe DNS HTTPS nuŋlɔɖi me te.
ech.h1_b: Vortex nodes taa ECHConfigs ɖe woƒe DNS HTTPS nuŋlɔɖiwo me. Asitsalawo siwo si ECH ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu le zãa gotagome amedzro ŋkɔ (e.g. `vortex-public.cloudflare.com`) abe SNI si wokpɔna ene; eteƒekpɔla siwo mewɔa naneke o la kpɔa gotagome ŋkɔ ma si wozãna le mɔ gbadza nu la ko. DPI mateŋu anya Vortex asisi tso Cloudflare asisi bubu aɖeke gbɔ o.
ech.h1_c: ECH to IETF ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ 5 me hafi woɖoe ɖe ɖoɖo nu abe RFC 9460 le ƒe 2024. Tɔtrɔ siwo do ŋgɔ: ESNI (2018-2019, wogblẽe ɖi), ECH draft-00 va ɖo draft-13 (2020-2024). Chrome na ECH wɔ dɔ le gɔmedzedzea me le ƒe 2023 me; Firefox le ƒe 2024. Vortex doa alɔe tso v0.0.9.
ech.h1_f:
gota SNI: "public.cloudflare.com" ← si wokpɔna na eteƒekpɔlawo
ememe SNI: "node.vortex.example" ← wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔe
ECHConfig: wotae ɖe DNS HTTPS nuŋlɔɖi si ku ɖe gotagome domenyinyi ŋu me
ech.h3_a: TLS 1.3, DoH, SNI, domenyinyi ƒe ŋgɔgbe

ed25519.title: Ed25519 ƒe agbalẽ
ed25519.subtitle: EdDSA ƒe asidede agbalẽ te le edwards25519 (RFC 8032) dzi.
ed25519.intro: Ed25519 nye elliptic-curve ƒe asidede agbalẽ te ƒe ɖoɖo. 32-byte dutoƒo safuiwo, 64-byte asidede agbalẽ te, deterministic asidede le gɔmedzedzea me. Kpeɖodzi kabakaba (~200 μs le egbegbe CPU dzi), woateŋu aɖo kpe edzi le hatsotsowo me.
ed25519.h1_a: Ed25519 nye elliptic-curve ƒe asidede agbalẽ te ƒe ɖoɖo. 32-byte dutoƒo safuiwo, 64-byte asidede agbalẽ te, deterministic asidede le gɔmedzedzea me. Kpeɖodzi kabakaba (~200 μs le egbegbe CPU dzi), woateŋu aɖo kpe edzi le hatsotsowo me.
ed25519.h1_b: Vortex dea asi federation ƒe agbalẽkotoku ɖesiaɖe te, integrity manifest ɖesiaɖe, node ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ɖesiaɖe, kple bot gbedasi ɖesiaɖe te kple Ed25519. Apple ƒe CryptoKit le iOS 17+ zãa RFC 8032bis ƒe tɔtrɔ si wowɔ le vome; Vortex xɔa wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe — ɖaseɖiɖila ɖesiaɖe si wɔ ɖe se dzi la kpɔa evea siaa gbɔ.
ed25519.h1_c: Ed25519 nye esi Bernstein, Duif, Lange, Schwabe, Yang ta le ƒe 2011. Woɖoe ɖe ɖoɖo nu be RFC 8032 le ƒe 2017. OpenSSH 6.5 (2014), TLS 1.3, Apple Keychain, signal-protocol ye da asi ɖe edzi. Wotia deterministic signing tẽ wu ECDSA be woaƒo asa na ECDSA RNG-reuse vulnerability class.
ed25519.h1_f:
Dzesi(d, m): r = SHA-512(d ∥ m) .
              R = r · G. Ƒe 1999 me
              c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m) .
              S = r + c · a
              trɔ gbɔ (R, S) .
Kpɔ egbɔ be: c = SHA-512 (R ∥ A ∥ m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G ƒe ƒuƒoƒo
ed25519.h2_a: `app/dedienɔnɔ/crypto.py::dzesi`, iOS `VortexCrypto.Ed25519Adesign`, ɖe asi le safui ŋu le `safuiwo/ɖe asi le.safui` me.
ed25519.h3_a: X25519, ECDSA, asidede agbalẽ te, nya ɣaɣlawo tsɔtsɔ yi ŋgɔe

fanout.title: Fan-do-ɖe-nukpɔkpɔ
fanout.subtitle: Nudzɔdzɔ aɖe kaka tso teƒe ɖeka na nudɔla geɖe.
fanout.intro: Fan-out nye xɔtuɖaŋu ƒe ɖoɖo si me nuwɔla ɖeka doa nudzɔdzɔ aɖe ɖe go eye N nuƒlelawo xɔae. Le Vortex ƒe WebSocket layer me la, gbedasi ɖeka POST ʋãa N socket seds — ɖeka na subscriber ɖesiaɖe le xɔa me.
fanout.h1_a: Fan-out nye xɔtuɖaŋu ƒe ɖoɖo si me nuwɔla ɖeka doa nudzɔdzɔ aɖe ɖe go eye N nuƒlelawo xɔae. Le Vortex ƒe WebSocket layer me la, gbedasi ɖeka POST ʋãa N socket seds — ɖeka na subscriber ɖesiaɖe le xɔa me.
fanout.h1_b: Wowɔe abe xɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe hatsotso si me WebSocket asiléƒewo dzɔna to asyncio.Lock. Write xɔa, kɔpi ƒuƒoƒoa, ɖea asi le eŋu, emegbe gbugbɔa kɔpi si le lalam `ws.send_bytes(payload)` kple per-socket 1 s timeout. Nuƒlela siwo le blewu la nɔa fli me 256 hafi framewo naɖiɖi.
fanout.h1_c: Fan-out trɔna yia tata/nudɔdɔ ƒe ɖoɖowo me le ƒe 1980-awo me (POP, TIBCO). Egbegbe atsyãwo (Kafka, Redis pub/sub, NATS) dzia kpɔɖeŋua ɖe edzi va ɖoa ame miliɔn geɖe siwo ŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe eme. Vortex ƒe xɔ ɖesiaɖe me le ŋkuɖodzinu me fan-out le sue ŋutɔ elabena mehiã cross-node replication le single-node mode me o; Redis pub/sub wɔa dɔ le node geɖe ƒe ƒuƒoƒo me.
fanout.h1_f:
gbeƒãɖeɖe (xɔ_id, fetu):
  subs = fanout [xɔ_id] # O (1) dict didi
  na ws le snapshot(subs): # kɔpi be nàgbugbɔ awɔe dedie
      lala ws.send_bytes (fetu, ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu = 1s)
fanout.h2_a: `app/chats/fanout.py`, mɔ si le dzo dam wu na gbedasi ɖesiaɖe, nuwɔna, ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe nudzɔdzɔ, yɔyɔ ƒe dzesi.
fanout.h3_a: WebSocket, amesi ŋlɔ ŋkɔ, Redis pub/sub, fli

fcm.title: FCM ƒe .
fcm.subtitle: Firebase Alilikpo me Gbedasɛwo.
fcm.intro: FCM nye Google ƒe push-notification subɔsubɔdɔ na Android, iOS, web. Woɖɔli Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) xoxoa le ƒe 2016. Exɔ OAuth2 service-account auth.
fcm.h1_a: FCM nye Google ƒe push-notification subɔsubɔdɔ na Android, iOS, web. Woɖɔli Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) xoxoa le ƒe 2016. Exɔ OAuth2 service-account auth.
fcm.h1_b: Vortex zãa FCM le `nyatakaka` nɔnɔme me (menye `nyatakaka` nɔnɔme o) eyata dɔwɔnua ƒe FirebaseMessagingService zɔna le vava me eye wòɖea nutrenu-tutu payload la gɔme hafi tsoa nya me nenye be yeaɖe aflaga aɖe afia. Silent-delivery wake-ups hã zãa FCM nyatakaka gbedasiwo.
fcm.h1_c: FCM dze egɔme le ƒe 2016 me tsɔ xɔ ɖe GCM teƒe. Woɖe asi le domenyinu HTTP ƒe nuwuƒe ŋu le ƒe 2024 me; Vortex zãa HTTP v1 ƒe nuwuƒe kple OAuth2. Wowɔa dzesiwo ƒe tɔtrɔ gaƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe le wo ɖokui si to service-account credentials siwo woƒo ƒu dzi.
fcm.h3_a: APNs, Web Push, nutrenu tutu, OAuth2

federation.title: Dukɔwo Dome Habɔbɔ
federation.subtitle: Gbedasi siwo dzi woka ɖo le wo nɔewo gbɔ ɖoɖo ɖe Vortex node siwo le wo ɖokui si dome.
federation.intro: Federation nye kadodo si me kakaɖedzi le wo nɔewo ŋu le node dɔwɔla eve dome. Wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe tsɔa evelia ƒe Ed25519 pubkey kpena ɖe eƒe `federations` kplɔ̃ ŋu. Zãla siwo le node A ateŋu aɖo gbedasi na zãlawo le node B to mɔɖeɖe ɖe agbalẽkotokuwo ŋu to `POST /federation/deliver` si wode asi ete dzi.
federation.h1_a: Federation nye kadodo si me kakaɖedzi le wo nɔewo ŋu le node dɔwɔla eve dome. Wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe tsɔa evelia ƒe Ed25519 pubkey kpena ɖe eƒe `federations` kplɔ̃ ŋu. Zãla siwo le node A ateŋu aɖo gbedasi na zãlawo le node B to mɔɖeɖe ɖe agbalẽkotokuwo ŋu to `POST /federation/deliver` si wode asi ete dzi.
federation.h1_b: Opt-in per operator: "node ɖesiaɖe ateŋu awɔ ɖeka" ƒe gɔmedzedze aɖeke meli o. Hati tsɔtsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu bia be woawɔ dɔdzikpɔla ƒe afɔɖeɖe si dzi dɔwɔla de asi ete. Lãmesẽ ƒe dzesiwo (AIMD ±1) tɔa te federation na hati siwo mewɔa nu gbegblẽ o. Outbox retries do kpo nudɔdɔwo kple exponential backoff vaseɖe ŋkeke 14.
federation.h1_c: Federation nye Matrix ƒe amewula ƒe nɔnɔme (2014) eye do ŋgɔ na ema la XMPP/Jabber (1999). Vortex ƒe aɖaŋuwɔwɔ tso evea siaa me: agbalẽkotoku siwo wode asi (Matrix), kakaɖedzi ƒe seke siwo dze ƒã (wo dometɔ aɖeke — míesesẽ wu o), lãmesẽ ƒe dzesiwo (AIMD tso TCP). Wotsɔe kpe ɖe eŋu le v0.0.5.

fts5.title: FTS5 ƒe .
fts5.subtitle: SQLite ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ blibo-didi virtual kplɔ̃.
fts5.intro: FTS5 nye SQLite ƒe dzidzime atɔ̃lia ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ blibo didi ƒe kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔ. Wɔ virtual table si dzraa tokenised indexes ɖo na LIKE / MATCH biabia kabakaba.
fts5.h1_a: FTS5 nye SQLite ƒe dzidzime atɔ̃lia ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ blibo didi ƒe kekeɖenudɔwɔwɔ. Wɔ virtual table si dzraa tokenised indexes ɖo na LIKE / MATCH biabia kabakaba.
fts5.h1_b: Vortex wɔa ahuhɔ̃e na nuŋɔŋlɔ gbadzaa ƒe dzesiwo (siwo wotsɔ asisi ɣla abe dzesi siwo me mekɔ o ene) ɖe FTS5 virtual table me ale be didi naƒo `O(log n)` ɖe `O(n)` scans teƒe. Le Android ƒe Xɔ me la, wozãa FTS4 kple nusiwo aʋã ame siwo naa virtual table la nɔa ɖekawɔwɔ me. Postgres ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo zãa `tsvector` / `tsquery` hena taɖodzinu ma ke.
fts5.h1_c: FTS trɔ yi SQLite 3.7 (ƒe 2010) dzi. FTS5 woɖo ɖe SQLite 3.9 (2015) me. Woxɔe se le afisiafi; gbedasiɖoɖo ƒe dɔwɔnu ɖesiaɖe si le nutoa me gbã le iOS / Android dzi zãnɛ. Postgres ƒe `tsvector` tso ƒe 8.3 (2008) me.
fts5.h2_a: `app/database.py` (Postgres tsvector), iOS `Di/impl/Fts5Didi ƒe Nudzraɖoƒe`, Android Xɔ `@Fts4`.

gossip.title: Gossip ƒe ʋuʋu
gossip.subtitle: Hatiwo ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo ƒe asitɔtrɔ ɣeaɖewoɣi le Vortex nodes dome.
gossip.intro: Gossip nye bandwidth-efficient protocol si me node ɖesiaɖe ɖɔlia sidzedze kpuie ɣeaɖewoɣi kple hati si woɖo le vome. Le ɣeyiɣi aɖe megbe la, node ɖesiaɖe va ƒoa ƒu ɖe nukpɔkpɔ ɖeka me titinanudzraɖoƒe aɖeke manɔmee.
gossip.h1_a: Gossip nye bandwidth-efficient protocol si me node ɖesiaɖe ɖɔlia sidzedze kpuie ɣeaɖewoɣi kple hati si woɖo le vome. Le ɣeyiɣi aɖe megbe la, node ɖesiaɖe va ƒoa ƒu ɖe nukpɔkpɔ ɖeka me titinanudzraɖoƒe aɖeke manɔmee.
gossip.h1_b: Vortex nodes ƒoa nya ta le sɛkɛnd 60 ɖesiaɖe me. Asitɔtrɔ ɖesiaɖe nye Bloom-ʋuʋudedi si ƒe didime nye bit 256 si ƒoa hati siwo wonya nu ƒu kpuie; akpa kemɛa ɖoa eŋu kple hati siwo bu le filter la me kpe ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe filter la ŋu. Bandwidth nye O(hati yeyewo × 32 B), zi geɖe la, mede 1 KiB le ƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe me o.
gossip.h1_c: Bloom-filter ƒe nyatoƒoetoto dze egɔme tso Cornell ƒe ƒe 1998 bimodal multicast paper dzi. Apache Cassandra zãnɛ hena hamevinyenye; Bitcoin na asitsatsa ƒe nyatakakaɖoɖoɖa; IPFS na DHT beléle na wo. O(log N) ƒe ƒoƒo ɖekae nye nusi na wòwɔa dɔ na network gãwo.
gossip.h1_f:
asitɔtrɔ(A, B): .
  A → B: filter_A = de_katã (hatiwo_A, k = 5, m = 256)
  B → A: hati_yeyewo_na_A = {p ∈ hatiwo_B : p ∉ ʋuʋudedi_A}, ʋuʋudedi_B
  A hã ɖea nu me nenema ke
seɖoƒe na ga home: 1 ƒe asitɔtrɔ le hati ɖeka ŋu le s 30 ɖesiaɖe me
gossip.h2_a: `app / ʋuɖoɖo / nyatoƒoetoto_dedienɔnɔ.py`, `app / ʋuɖoɖo / xexeame katã ƒe_ʋuɖoɖo.py`.

gravitix.title: Gravitix ƒe .
gravitix.subtitle: Vortex ƒe DSL na bots ŋɔŋlɔ.
gravitix.intro: Gravitix nye gbegbɔgblɔ si wowɔ na domenyinyi tɔxɛ aɖe si wowɔ na Vortex bots ŋɔŋlɔ. Nudzɔdzɔ-ʋuʋu dzikpɔlawo (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), nɔnɔme si wotu ɖe eme, boilerplate suetɔ kekeake. Woƒoe nu ƒu ɖe bytecode me eye wowɔa dɔ le sandboxed gbegɔmeɖela me.
gravitix.h1_a: Gravitix nye gbegbɔgblɔ si wowɔ na domenyinyi tɔxɛ aɖe si wowɔ na Vortex bots ŋɔŋlɔ. Nudzɔdzɔ-ʋuʋu dzikpɔlawo (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), nɔnɔme si wotu ɖe eme, boilerplate suetɔ kekeake. Woƒoe nu ƒu ɖe bytecode me eye wowɔa dɔ le sandboxed gbegɔmeɖela me.
gravitix.h1_b: Mɔ bubu si woate ŋu azã ɖe Python SDK teƒe. Gravitix bots mateŋu age ɖe filesystem alo network si wodi la me o — Vortex ƒe API ƒe anyigba dzi koe. Nuƒoƒoƒula wɔa bytecode; Rust ƒe duƒuƒu le `Gravitix/` me ɖea egɔme. Numekugbalẽ bliboa le Gravitix docs ta la me.
gravitix.h1_c: Wotrɔ asi le eŋu le v0.0.6 me le esi wokpɔe be bot code akpa gãtɔ nye 80 % SDK boilerplate ƒo xlã kernel sue aɖe si me susu ŋutɔŋutɔ le vɔ megbe. A DSL na susuŋudɔwɔwɔ klẽna eye sandboxes afɔkuwo. Eƒe gbɔgbɔ sɔ kple Hubot (2011) gake kple sandboxing sesẽ wu kple native Vortex integration.
gravitix.h2_a: `Gravitix/` repo ke, bot ƒe kɔda ƒe agble le `POST /api/bots` me.

hkdf.title: HKDF ƒe .
hkdf.subtitle: HMAC-si wotu ɖe Safui Gɔmeɖeɖe Dɔwɔna (RFC 5869).
hkdf.intro: HKDF nye afɔɖeɖe eve ƒe safui ƒe dzɔtsoƒe ƒe dɔwɔwɔ: Extract ƒoa safui si wotsɔ de eme la nu ƒu wòzua safui si nye pseudo-random (PRK); Expand keke PRK ɖe output key material si didi ɖesiaɖe me, si dome info labels.
hkdf.h1_a: HKDF nye afɔɖeɖe eve ƒe safui ƒe dzɔtsoƒe ƒe dɔwɔwɔ: Extract ƒoa safui si wotsɔ de eme la nu ƒu wòzua safui si nye pseudo-random (PRK); Expand keke PRK ɖe output key material si didi ɖesiaɖe me, si dome info labels.
hkdf.h1_b: Vortex zãa HKDF-SHA256 le afisiafi: mama X25519 nya ɣaɣla siwo woama ɖe nya ɣaɣlawo + MAC + tanya safuiwo me, xɔa per-chunk file safuiwo, xɔa backup safuiwo tso Argon2id ƒe dodokpɔ me. Nyatakaka kawo tsɔa tɔtrɔ ƒe ŋgɔdonya ɣesiaɣi (e.g. "v1:encryption") ale be safui ƒe ɖoɖo bliboa ateŋu atrɔ to v1 → v2 ƒoƒo me.
hkdf.h1_c: Hugo Krawczyk ye tae le EUROCRYPT 2010 me; woɖoe ɖe ɖoɖo nu be RFC 5869 le ƒe ma ke me. TLS 1.3 zãnɛ na eƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi, Signal na Double Ratchet, WireGuard na session keys.
hkdf.h1_f:
Nusi woɖe tso eme: PRK = HMAC-SHA256(dze, IKM)
Keke ɖe enu: T(1) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, nyatakaka ∥ 0x01)
          T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ nyatakaka ∥ i) .
          OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... wotsoe wòzu len

hmac.title: HMAC ƒe .
hmac.subtitle: Gbedasɛwo ƒe Nyateƒetoto ƒe Kɔda si wotu ɖe Hash dzi (RFC 2104).
hmac.intro: HMAC nye xɔtutu si trɔa nya ɣaɣla ƒe hash ɖesiaɖe (SHA-256, SHA-512) wòzua MAC. Enaa fɔmaɖimaɖi kple nyateƒetoto si wona nya ɣaɣla si woama.
hmac.h1_a: HMAC nye xɔtutu si trɔa nya ɣaɣla ƒe hash ɖesiaɖe (SHA-256, SHA-512) wòzua MAC. Enaa fɔmaɖimaɖi kple nyateƒetoto si wona nya ɣaɣla si woama.
hmac.h1_b: Vortex zãa HMAC-SHA256 le HKDF me, na JWT asidede agbalẽ te (HS256), na sender_pseudo derivation le xɔwo me, kple na coturn TURN ɖaseɖigbalẽ ƒe asidede. Ɣeyiɣi madzudzɔmadzudzɔe tsɔtsɔ sɔ kple wo nɔewo hiã le kpeɖodzi ƒe akpa dzi — `hmac.compare_digest` le Python.
hmac.h1_c: HMAC nye esi Bellare, Canetti, Krawczyk to vɛ le ƒe 1996. Woɖoe ɖe ɖoɖo nu abe RFC 2104 (1997) kple FIPS 198 (2002). Ezu MAC si woɖo ɖi le TLS, IPsec, SSH me. Signal, Matrix, Discord, Slack katã zãa HMAC-SHA256 na woƒe JWT kple session tokens.
hmac.h1_f:
HMAC(safui, msg) = H( (safui ⊕ opad) ∥ H( (safui ⊕ ipad) ∥ msg ) )
  afisi opad = 0x5c gbugbɔgagblɔ, ipad = 0x36 gbugbɔgagblɔ, block ƒe lolome sɔ kple H
hmac.h2_a: Afisiafi le crypto stack la me. Grep na `hmac_sha256` alo `HKDF`.
hmac.h3_a: HKDF, JWT, SHA-256, ɣeyiɣi madzudzɔmadzudzɔe tsɔtsɔ sɔ kple wo nɔewo

ice.title: ICE ƒe .
ice.subtitle: Kadodo si me wowɔa nu aduadu le ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ (RFC 8445).
ice.intro: ICE nye WebRTC mɔnu si dzi woato adi network mɔ le hati eve siwo le megbe na NATwo dome. Hatiwo xlẽa ame siwo di be yewoaxɔ ɖoƒea (host, server-reflexive, relay), woɖɔlia wo, eye woate eveveve kpɔ vaseɖe esime ɖeka nakpɔ dzidzedze.
ice.h1_a: ICE nye WebRTC mɔnu si dzi woato adi network mɔ le hati eve siwo le megbe na NATwo dome. Hatiwo xlẽa ame siwo di be yewoaxɔ ɖoƒea (host, server-reflexive, relay), woɖɔlia wo, eye woate eveveve kpɔ vaseɖe esime ɖeka nakpɔ dzidzedze.
ice.h1_b: Vortex ƒe node brokers ICE candidate ɖɔliɖɔli to WebSocket dzesiwo dzi. coturn naa STUN (na srflx didi) kple TURN (na relay ne mɔ tẽwo do kpo nu). Wonaa HMAC ɖaseɖigbalẽ siwo nɔa anyi ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe le kaƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe me.
ice.h1_c: Woɖo ICE ɖe ɖoɖo nu abe RFC 5245 (2010) eye wogbugbɔe yeyee abe RFC 8445 (2018) ene. Le carrier-grade NAT megbe la, mɔ tẽwo doa kpo nu ~15 % le ɣeyiɣia me — TURN relay nye nusi womate ŋu aƒo asa na o. WebRTC na ICE nye nu vevitɔ; video-kaƒoƒo ƒe dɔwɔnu ɖesiaɖe zãnɛ.
ice.h1_f:
ame siwo di be yewoaxɔ ɖoƒea:
  amedzroxɔla : rtp 192.168.1.5:49152 (nutoa me IP)
  srflx : rtp://203.0.113.5:49152 (STUN-dutoƒonuƒo si ŋu woke ɖo)
  relay : rtp://turn.vortex:49153 (TURN-si wotsɔ na relay)
pair check: STUN Biabia si Wobla; eve gbãtɔ si akpɔ dzidzedze = tiatia
ice.h2_a: `app/yɔyɔ/`, asitsalawo ƒe akpa dzi WebRTC ɖoɖowɔɖi.
ice.h3_a: WebRTC, TURN, STUN, megbedede, NAT mɔzɔzɔ

jwt.title: JWT ƒe .
jwt.subtitle: JSON Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe Dzesi (RFC 7519).
jwt.intro: JWT nye dzesi ƒe ɖoɖo si le sue si me akpa etɔ̃ siwo woŋlɔ base64-url-encoded le: ta, payload (claims), asidede agbalẽ te. Wozãnɛ na stateless session ƒe kpeɖodzi.
jwt.h1_a: JWT nye dzesi ƒe ɖoɖo si le sue si me akpa etɔ̃ siwo woŋlɔ base64-url-encoded le: ta, payload (claims), asidede agbalẽ te. Wozãnɛ na stateless session ƒe kpeɖodzi.
jwt.h1_b: Vortex zãa HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) JWT-wo. Mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi tsɔa `{sub: zãla_id, jti: mɔ̃_id, typ: mɔɖeɖe, exp}`, 15 min TTL. Gbugbɔgadzɔ dzesi `ƒomevi: gbugbɔgawɔ`, 30 d TTL. Wode asi ete ɖe nya ɣaɣla si ƒe didime nye byte 64 dzi tso `.env`. Nya vevi aɖeke meli wu user_id o.
jwt.h1_c: Woɖo JWTwo ɖe ɖoɖo nu be RFC 7519 (2015). OAuth 2.0 na wo xɔ ŋkɔ tso ƒe 2012. Ƒe ewo ƒe ɖeklemiɖeɖe: alg-tɔtɔ ƒe amedzidzedze, asiɖeɖe le eŋu ƒe anyimanɔmanɔ. Vortex ɖea: HS256 ɖeɖeko dzi kpɔtɔna (RS/ES tɔtɔ aɖeke mele eme o), device-keyed jti (woateŋu agbugbɔ to user_devices dzi).
jwt.h1_f:
HEADER.PAYLOAD.SIGNATURE.
tanya = base64url ({alg: "HS256", ƒomevi: "JWT"})
payload = base64url ({sub, jti, ƒomevi, exp})
sig = base64url (HMAC-SHA256 (nya ɣaɣla, tanya + "." + fetu))
jwt.h3_a: HMAC, OAuth 2.0, gbugbɔgawɔ dzesi, mɔɖeɖe ƒe dzesi

kyber.title: Kyber-768 ƒe agbalẽ
kyber.subtitle: Post-quantum safui ƒe nutsyɔnu (FIPS 203).
kyber.intro: Kyber-768 (le se nu la, ML-KEM-768) nye NIST ƒe ɖoɖo si wowɔ le post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism. 1184-byte dutoƒo safuiwo, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte nya ɣaɣla siwo woama. Dedienɔnɔ dzi ɖena kpɔtɔna va ɖoa Module-LWE, si woxɔ se be quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_a: Kyber-768 (le se nu la, ML-KEM-768) nye NIST ƒe ɖoɖo si wowɔ le post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism. 1184-byte dutoƒo safuiwo, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte nya ɣaɣla siwo woama. Dedienɔnɔ dzi ɖena kpɔtɔna va ɖoa Module-LWE, si woxɔ se be quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_b: Vortex zãa Kyber le eɖokui si le hybrid me: `session_key = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info="session-v1")`. Ne afã eveawo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe lée la, ke kpekpea le dedie. Tiae le v0.1 me, on-by-default wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖe v0.2 ŋu. Gazazã: ~2 KB bubu le ɣeyiɣi ɖesiaɖe me asiléle; latency si ŋu womate ŋu awɔ naneke le o.
kyber.h1_c: Kyber nye ~70 siwo wotsɔ ɖo NIST ƒe PQ hoʋiʋli (2016) me la dometɔ ɖeka. Wotiae be woawɔ dzidzenuwo le July 2022 me; wowu enu abe FIPS 203 le August 2024. Chrome na hybrid Kyber le TLS 1.3 le ƒe 2024. Signal tsɔe kpe ɖe woƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi ŋu le ƒe ma ke me.
kyber.h1_f:
KeyGen (): (pk ∈ Zq ^ k, sk ∈ Zq ^ k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Encaps (pk): (ct ∈ Zq ^ k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B
Decaps (sk, ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256
hybrid = HKDF (x25519_do go ∥ kyber_do go, "ɣeyiɣi-v1")

mailbox.title: Posuɖaka
mailbox.subtitle: Nudzraɖoƒe si woɖo na amesi xɔe ƒe adrɛs le BMP me.
mailbox.intro: Posuɖaka nye BMP ƒe abstraction na "teƒe si gbedasiwo na ame si wona la lalana le". Wode dzesii to 32-byte `mailbox_id` si woɖe tso amesi xɔe ƒe pubkey me to HKDF dzi.
mailbox.h1_a: Posuɖaka nye BMP ƒe abstraction na "teƒe si gbedasiwo na ame si wona la lalana le". Wode dzesii to 32-byte `mailbox_id` si woɖe tso amesi xɔe ƒe pubkey me to HKDF dzi.
mailbox.h1_b: Amesi ɖoe ɖa (amesi nya recipient_pubkey) kple amesi xɔe (amesi nya woawo ŋutɔ ƒe pubkey) koe ateŋu awɔ akɔnta le mailbox_id si wona ŋu. Titina nodewo kpɔa opaque 32-byte dzesidenu la ko. Posuɖaka ɖesiaɖe ƒe TTL 7200 s eye nudzraɖoƒe ƒe nutrenu 500 MB le node ɖeka me.
mailbox.h1_c: Nya la tso blema email me. BMP do kpɔɖeŋunyagbɔgblɔa gake ena be lɛtaɖaka la tso amesi xɔe gbɔ tsɔ wu be wòanye esi tso dɔdzikpɔla gbɔ — "mailbox wɔwɔ" ƒe afɔɖeɖe aɖeke meli o, dɔdzikpɔla aɖeke menya adrɛs siwo li o.
mailbox.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF (amesi xɔla_pubkey, nyatakaka = "bmp-v1", len = 32)
amedɔdɔ (nya recipient_pk) kple amesi xɔe (nya eya ŋutɔ ƒe pk) koe ateŋu awɔ akɔntabubu

nonce.title: Nonce
nonce.subtitle: Xexlẽdzesi si wozã zi ɖeka — asixɔxɔ si wozãna zi ɖeka.
nonce.intro: Nonce nye asixɔxɔ si mele be wòagbugbɔ awɔ le safui aɖe te gbeɖe o. Le Vortex me la, AES-GCM dɔwɔwɔ ɖesiaɖe zãa 96-bit random nonce yeye. Nonce gbugbɔgazã kple safui ɖeka gblẽa nya ɣaɣla kple nyateƒetoto me — amedzidzela si si ciphertext eve le ɖeka te (safui, nonce) ateŋu axɔ plaintext XORs.
nonce.h1_a: Nonce nye asixɔxɔ si mele be wòagbugbɔ awɔ le safui aɖe te gbeɖe o. Le Vortex me la, AES-GCM dɔwɔwɔ ɖesiaɖe zãa 96-bit random nonce yeye. Nonce gbugbɔgazã kple safui ɖeka gblẽa nya ɣaɣla kple nyateƒetoto me — amedzidzela si si ciphertext eve le ɖeka te (safui, nonce) ateŋu axɔ plaintext XORs.
nonce.h1_b: Vortex wɔa nonces kple OS CSPRNG (`nya ɣaɣlawo.dzesi_bytes`, `SecRandom`, `java.dedienɔnɔ.DedienɔnɔRandom`). Dzigbezã si wobla kple 96 bits: ~2^32 gbedasiwo hafi ʋu ƒe gododo va zua nusi ŋu kakaɖedzi le, si sɔ gbɔ sã wu alesi xɔ ƒe safui ɖesiaɖe kpɔna le eƒe agbenɔɣi. Ametakpɔkpɔ duplicate-nonce kplɔkplɔ le node abe alidziblanu-kple-suspenders.
nonce.h1_c: Nonce ƒe nukpɔsusua nye blematɔ le nya ɣaɣlawo ŋɔŋlɔ me; nya la ŋutɔ tso Eŋlisigbe Xoxoa me "for the once". GCM ƒe 96-bit kafukafu tso NIST SP 800-38D gbɔ. Adobe 2013 ƒe sedzidadaa xɔ ŋkɔ be exɔ nya dzrowo tso nonces siwo wogbugbɔ gblɔna le asitsalawo ƒe akpa dzi RSA.
nonce.h1_f:
P(gododo) le 109 AES-GCM nonces = ~10−19
dzigbezã bound: gbãtɔ ƒe gododo si wokpɔ mɔ na anɔ 248 nonces le safui ɖeka me
GCM dedienɔnɔ: 232 nonces le vome le safui ɖesiaɖe me hafi babla la gblẽ
nonce.h2_a: AES-GCM yɔyɔ ɖesiaɖe. Counter kplɔa ametakpɔkpɔ le `app / dedienɔnɔ / crypto.py`.
nonce.h3_a: AES-GCM, CSPRNG, dzigbezã si wobla, AEAD .

ohttp.title: OHTTP ƒe .
ohttp.subtitle: Woŋlɔa nu be HTTP (RFC 9458).
ohttp.intro: OHTTP nye ɖoɖowɔɖi na HTTP biabia siwo woɖona ɖe amewo le afisi akpa ɖeka aɖeke mekpɔa biabia la kple ŋuɖoɖoa siaa o. Asisi la ɖoa nu to relay si ɖea ta siwo dea dzesii ɖa; relay la yi ŋgɔ yi agbo si ɖea nyawo me eye wòɖoa eŋu.
ohttp.h1_a: OHTTP nye ɖoɖowɔɖi na HTTP biabia siwo woɖona ɖe amewo le afisi akpa ɖeka aɖeke mekpɔa biabia la kple ŋuɖoɖoa siaa o. Asisi la ɖoa nu to relay si ɖea ta siwo dea dzesii ɖa; relay la yi ŋgɔ yi agbo si ɖea nyawo me eye wòɖoa eŋu.
ohttp.h1_b: Vortex zãa OHTTP abe Layer-5 ƒe adzame fallback ene. Ne wotsɔ sabala subɔsubɔ kple BMP kpe ɖe eŋu la, OHTTP naa mɔ mamlɛtɔ si dzi woato ne woxe TLS keŋkeŋ. Relay nye kakaɖedzi-mamã akpa (zi geɖe la, Cloudflare alo Apple ƒe adzame-relay xɔtuɖoɖo).
ohttp.h1_c: OHTTP woɖoe ɖe ɖoɖo nu be RFC 9458 le ƒe 2024 me, si Cloudflare, Apple, Mozilla kpe ɖe eŋu. Apple ƒe iCloud Private Relay (2021) nye OHTTP-si te ɖe eŋu ƒe dɔwɔwɔ gbãtɔ. Vortex tsɔ OHTTP fallback ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu kpee le v0.0.9 me.
ohttp.h1_f:
asisi → relay: Encrypt_gateway_pub (biabia) + random-mɔfiame nyatakakawo
relay → agbo: yi ŋgɔ, ɖea ta siwo dea dzesi asisi
agbo → ŋuɖoɖo: decrypt, dɔwɔwɔ, Encrypt_client_pub (ŋuɖoɖo)
relay → client: yi ŋgɔ ƒe ŋuɖoɖo

onion.title: Sabala subɔsubɔ
onion.subtitle: Tor subɔsubɔdɔ ɣaɣla.
onion.intro: Sabala subɔsubɔdɔ nye TCP subɔsubɔdɔ si woate ŋu akpɔ to Tor ƒe rendezvous protocol dzi. Wode dzesii to sabala ƒe adrɛs dzi (ŋɔŋlɔdzesi 56 ƒe gɔmeɖoanyi32 si nye Ed25519 pubkey si le v3 dzi). Dutoƒo IP aɖeke meli o, DNS aɖeke meli o, titina ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ aɖeke meli o.
onion.h1_a: Sabala subɔsubɔdɔ nye TCP subɔsubɔdɔ si woate ŋu akpɔ to Tor ƒe rendezvous protocol dzi. Wode dzesii to sabala ƒe adrɛs dzi (ŋɔŋlɔdzesi 56 ƒe gɔmeɖoanyi32 si nye Ed25519 pubkey si le v3 dzi). Dutoƒo IP aɖeke meli o, DNS aɖeke meli o, titina ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ aɖeke meli o.
onion.h1_b: Vortex node ɖesiaɖe ɖea eɖokui fiana abe `.onion` ene kpakple eƒe HTTPS nuwuƒe si sɔ. Asisi siwo si Tor ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu le la dzea anyi to sabala me ne nu bubu ɖesiaɖe do kpo nu. Bandwidth nye ~10× blewu gake woate ŋu aɖoe le network siwo ŋu seɖoƒe le bliboe me.
onion.h1_c: Sabala ƒe subɔsubɔdɔwo dze egɔme tso Tor 2004 (v1) me. Wogbugbɔe tu abe v3 sabala subɔsubɔdɔwo le ƒe 2017 me kple Ed25519 safuiwo. SecureDrop, New York Times, Facebook, ProPublica, habɔbɔ gã siwo katã nya nu tso crypto ŋue zãnɛ. Signal tsɔ onion-service delivery kpe ɖe eŋu le ƒe 2022 me.
onion.h1_f:
adrɛs = base32 (Ed25519_pubkey ∥ ɖaseɖigbalẽ ∥ tɔtrɔ_byte) ∥ ".sabala".
          = ŋɔŋlɔdzesi 56 le v3 sabala dzi
onion.h2_a: `/etc/tor/torrc` le `deploy/` me, wota to dziɖula `/v1/mirrors` dzi.
onion.h3_a: Tor, Snowflake, BMP, ʋuɖoɖo si woate ŋu atsɔ aƒo ka na

prekey.title: Prekey ƒe ŋgɔdonya
prekey.subtitle: Ephemeral pubkey ta do ŋgɔ na bootstrap ƒe DM yeyewo.
prekey.intro: Prekey nye X25519 keypair si wota ɖe node la me do ŋgɔ na hiahiã ale be kadodo yeyewo ateŋu adze dzeɖoɖo siwo wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ gɔme mɔzɔzɔ yiyi kple gbɔgbɔ manɔmee. Zãla ɖesiaɖe tsɔa batch (10 prekeys le gɔmedzedzea me); server subɔa wo le woƒe didi nu; client uploads geɖe wu ne ebɔbɔ.
prekey.h1_a: Prekey nye X25519 keypair si wota ɖe node la me do ŋgɔ na hiahiã ale be kadodo yeyewo ateŋu adze dzeɖoɖo siwo wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ gɔme mɔzɔzɔ yiyi kple gbɔgbɔ manɔmee. Zãla ɖesiaɖe tsɔa batch (10 prekeys le gɔmedzedzea me); server subɔa wo le woƒe didi nu; client uploads geɖe wu ne ebɔbɔ.
prekey.h1_b: Vortex ƒe prekey bundle la dea asi to mɔ̃a ƒe ɣeyiɣi didi ƒe dzeside safui dzi ale be amedzidzela mate ŋu aɖɔli aʋatso prekeys ne node-level access gɔ̃ hã o. DM yeyewo zãa Diffie-Hellman si ƒoa xlãe ɖeka ɖe prekey yeye ŋu hafi Double Ratchet la dzea egɔme.
prekey.h1_c: Prekeys tso Signal ƒe ƒe 2013 ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ (X3DH) me. Do ŋgɔ na X3DH la, bootstrap si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ la hiã na mɔzɔzɔ yiyi kple gbɔgbɔ le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me — vɔ̃ɖi na gbedasi siwo mewɔ ɖeka o. Egbegbe dɔla ɖesiaɖe si le dedie zãa prekey-style bootstrap.
prekey.h1_f:
bundle = { .
  dzesideŋkɔ_pk, .
  wode asi_prekey_pk te, .
  de asi_prekey_sig = Ed25519-De asi (dzesidede_priv, de asi_prekey_pk),
  zi ɖeka_ƒe_safuiwo: [pk_0, pk_1, ..., pk_9].
} .
prekey.h3_a: X25519, Double Ratchet, X3DH, safui ƒe asitɔtrɔ

reality.title: Nu ŋutɔŋutɔ
reality.subtitle: TLS-le-TLS masquerade adzame ʋuɖoɖo.
reality.intro: Nyateƒe nye ʋuɖoɖo le adzame si wɔa eɖokui abe TLS ene yi mɔ̃ɖaŋununya gã ŋutɔŋutɔ ƒe dzɔtsoƒe (zi geɖe la, www.microsoft.com). Asiléle ƒe taɖodzinuwo le gota Microsoft; asiléle ememetɔ nye Vortex. Probes siwo le dɔ wɔm siwo woɖo ɖe gota gome la ɖoa ŋgɔ yia afisi wotso ŋutɔŋutɔ eyata probing meɖea naneke fiana o.
reality.h1_a: Nyateƒe nye ʋuɖoɖo le adzame si wɔa eɖokui abe TLS ene yi mɔ̃ɖaŋununya gã ŋutɔŋutɔ ƒe dzɔtsoƒe (zi geɖe la, www.microsoft.com). Asiléle ƒe taɖodzinuwo le gota Microsoft; asiléle ememetɔ nye Vortex. Probes siwo le dɔ wɔm siwo woɖo ɖe gota gome la ɖoa ŋgɔ yia afisi wotso ŋutɔŋutɔ eyata probing meɖea naneke fiana o.
reality.h1_b: Vortex doa alɔ Nyateƒenya abe Level-4 ʋuɖoɖo si woate ŋu atsɔ aƒo ka na ene. Config gblɔa masquerade taɖodzinu, ID kpuiwo, kple Vortex X25519 dutoƒo safui. Server ɖoa kpe asisi siwo va la dzi to short-ID match me; probes siwo mewɔ ɖeka o xɔa ŋuɖoɖo siwo tso gɔmedzedze ŋutɔŋutɔ.
reality.h1_c: Wota nyateƒe le ƒe 2022 me abe ŋuɖoɖo na China ƒe Dzodoƒe Gã la de dzesi ʋuɖoɖo siwo wotu ɖe TLS dzi va yi (V2Ray ƒe VMess, Trojan). XrayCore xɔe le ƒe 2023. Vortex tsɔ kpekpeɖeŋu kpee le v0.0.9 me.
reality.h1_f:
asiléle le gota: TLS va ɖo Microsoft, SNI=www.microsoft.com
ememe (ne auth ok): Vortex ʋuɖoɖo to nyatakaka mɔnu aɖe dzi
probe response: microsoft.com ƒe ŋuɖoɖo ŋutɔŋutɔ si woɖo ɖe amedzidzela
                    ⇒ ŋkuléla kpɔa "ɛ̃, microsoft.com" koe.
reality.h3_a: adzame, ʋuɖoɖo si woate ŋu atsɔ aƒo ka, Trojan, VMess

rbac.title: RBAC ƒe .
rbac.subtitle: Mɔnukpɔkpɔ Siwo Wotu Ðe Akpa Si Wowɔna Dzi.
rbac.intro: RBAC nye mɔɖeɖe-dzikpɔkpɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu si me woɖea mɔ na akpawo eye wodea dɔ asi na zãlawo. Vortex zãa RBAC si le xɔ etɔ̃ me le xɔ ɖeka me: aƒetɔ > admin > me tɔ.
rbac.h1_a: RBAC nye mɔɖeɖe-dzikpɔkpɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu si me woɖea mɔ na akpawo eye wodea dɔ asi na zãlawo. Vortex zãa RBAC si le xɔ etɔ̃ me le xɔ ɖeka me: aƒetɔ > admin > me tɔ.
rbac.h1_b: Cascade: aƒetɔwo si admin ŋusẽ ɖesiaɖe kpe ɖe ŋutete tɔxɛ si le wo si be woatutu xɔa alo atsɔ aƒetɔnyenye ana ame bubu. Admins kpea ame, ƒoa afɔkpodzi, mute, trɔa asi le xɔa ƒe ɖoɖowo ŋu. Hameviwo ɖoa gbedasiwo ɖa, wɔa nu ɖe ​​wo ŋu, trɔa asi le woawo ŋutɔ ƒe gbedasiwo ŋu. Woŋlɔa akpa ƒe tɔtrɔwo ɖi abe ɖoɖoa ƒe gbedasiwo ene ale be hamevi ɖesiaɖe nakpɔ wo.
rbac.h1_c: RBAC abe kpɔɖeŋu si wowɔ le se nu ene la, edze egɔme tso NIST ƒe ƒe 1992 ƒe agbalẽ si Ferraiolo & Kuhn ŋlɔ dzi. Eva zu ame vevitɔ le dɔwɔƒe IAM (AWS, Azure) le ƒe 2010-awo me. Xɔ-dzidzenu RBAC nye dzidzenu le dzeɖoɖo nuwɔna — IRC ƒe ops / gbe / zãla (1988), Discord ƒe akpawo (2015), Slack ƒe admin / hamevi / amedzro.
rbac.h1_f:
akpa siwo wowɔna: aƒetɔ ⊃ admin ⊃ me tɔ
transfer: aƒetɔ ɖo new_owner_id → aƒetɔ xoxo si woɖe ɖe anyi wòzu admin
revoke: admin ateŋu aɖe hamevi aɖe ɖe anyi; aƒetɔ ate ŋu aɖe admin aɖe dzi akpɔtɔ
rbac.h2_a: `room_members.role`, wokpɔe le nuŋɔŋlɔmɔ ɖesiaɖe me to `app/chats/permissions.py` dzi.

sfu.title: SFU ƒe .
sfu.subtitle: Selective Forwarding Dɔwɔƒe si Kpɔa Nuwo Gbɔ.
sfu.intro: SFU nye titinaɖaka si tsakaa nyadzɔdzɔgblɔmɔnuwo le ƒuƒoƒo ƒe kaƒoƒo me. Gomenɔla ɖesiaɖe tsɔa tɔsisi ɖeka dana ɖe Internet dzi; SFU la ɖonɛ ɖe ame mamlɛawo. Eɖɔlia full-mesh topology (hati ɖesiaɖe ŋlɔa N-1 tɔsisiwo) afisi scaling nye O(N2).
sfu.h1_a: SFU nye titinaɖaka si tsakaa nyadzɔdzɔgblɔmɔnuwo le ƒuƒoƒo ƒe kaƒoƒo me. Gomenɔla ɖesiaɖe tsɔa tɔsisi ɖeka dana ɖe Internet dzi; SFU la ɖonɛ ɖe ame mamlɛawo. Eɖɔlia full-mesh topology (hati ɖesiaɖe ŋlɔa N-1 tɔsisiwo) afisi scaling nye O(N2).
sfu.h1_b: Wowɔa Vortex ƒe SFU ŋudɔ le Rust me hena dɔwɔwɔ. Simulcast-aware: yɔla ɖesiaɖe ŋlɔa tameɖoɖo kplikpaa etɔ̃ le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me; SFU la tiaa esi sɔ na nukpɔla ɖesiaɖe ƒe downlink si ŋu woka nya ta le. Odio ɖeɖeko ƒe ƒuƒoƒo siwo ade gomekpɔla 100; video ƒe ƒuƒoƒo siwo ade 32 (v0.3 ƒe mɔfiame).
sfu.h1_c: SFU xɔtuɖaŋu dze egɔme tso Jitsi ƒe Videobridge (ƒe 2013). Do ŋgɔ na SFU la, WebRTC ƒuƒoƒo ƒe kaƒoƒo nye full-mesh. Zoom, Google Do go, Jitsi, Dzesi ƒuƒoƒo yɔyɔwo katã zã SFU. Vortex odio-ko ƒuƒoƒo siwo woɖo ɖe v0.0.8.
sfu.h1_f:
full mesh (N hatiwo): wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ɖoa N-1 tɔsisiwo → O(N2) uplink
SFU (N hatiwo): wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ɖoa 1 stream → O(N) uplink ɖe hati ɖesiaɖe
simulcast: L1 (bɔbɔe) + L2 (titina) + L3 (kɔkɔ) ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me nuŋɔŋlɔwo
SFU tiaa layer ɖe nukpɔla ɖesiaɖe dzi le BWE-ka nya ta le downlink dzi
sfu.h3_a: WebRTC, ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me, ICE, TURN

snowflake.title: Snowflake ƒe ʋuʋudedi
snowflake.subtitle: Tor lɔlɔ̃nu faa-relay ʋuɖoɖo wu WebRTC.
snowflake.intro: Snowflake nye Tor Project ƒe ʋu si woate ŋu atsɔ aƒo ka na afisi lɔlɔ̃nu faa nyatakakadzraɖoƒewo wɔa dɔ abe WebRTC relays ene. Zãlawo dea browser extension eye woƒe browser zua relay esime tab aɖe le wo si.
snowflake.h1_a: Snowflake nye Tor Project ƒe ʋu si woate ŋu atsɔ aƒo ka na afisi lɔlɔ̃nu faa nyatakakadzraɖoƒewo wɔa dɔ abe WebRTC relays ene. Zãlawo dea browser extension eye woƒe browser zua relay esime tab aɖe le wo si.
snowflake.h1_b: Vortex xɔa Snowflake abe Layer-4 ƒe megbedede ne woxe mɔ na TLS kple ʋuɖoɖo gbãtɔwo. No infra required on our side — ɖeko míehiã Snowflake tɔdzisasrã siwo wota ɖe teƒe nyanyɛwo. Lɔlɔ̃nu faa dɔwɔla siwo le kekeɖenudɔa dzi kpɔm naa nutsyɔnu.
snowflake.h1_c: Snowflake dze dɔ gɔme le ƒe 2020 me abe Tor Project ƒe teƒenɔla na obfs4 (si va zu asibidɛ ƒe dzesi-teŋu). Esesẽ be woaxe mɔ ɖe WebRTC ʋuɖoɖoa nu elabena esia wɔwɔ agblẽ video kaƒoƒo geɖe siwo le se nu me. Vortex tsɔ kpekpeɖeŋu kpe ɖe eŋu le v0.0.9 me.
snowflake.h1_f:
client → Snowflake broker: "Mehiã na teƒenɔla".
broker sɔ kple lɔlɔ̃nu faa browser si le du dzi ƒe kekeɖenudɔ
lɔlɔ̃nu faa dɔwɔla → Tor ƒe gege ɖe eme: ɖoa asisiwo ƒe ʋuɖoɖo ɖe WebRTC dzi.
viɖe: WebRTC ʋuwo ƒe zɔzɔ le afisiafi; mɔxexe ɖe enu gblẽa video kaƒoƒo me
snowflake.h3_a: Tor, ʋuɖoɖo si woate ŋu atsɔ aƒo ka, WebRTC, obfs4

tls13.title: TLS 1.3
tls13.subtitle: Ʋuɖoɖo ƒe Dɔwɔƒe ƒe Dedienɔnɔ, tɔtrɔ 1.3 (RFC 8446).
tls13.intro: TLS 1.3 nye TLS ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe tɔtrɔ yeye. Eɖea primitives siwo mele dedie o ɖa (RSA key exchange, CBC MACs, static ECDH), enaa asiléle nɔa bɔbɔe va ɖoa mɔzɔzɔ ɖeka dzi yiyi kple gbɔgbɔ, dea se be woawɔ adzamenyawo ayi ŋgɔ.
tls13.h1_a: TLS 1.3 nye TLS ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe tɔtrɔ yeye. Eɖea primitives siwo mele dedie o ɖa (RSA key exchange, CBC MACs, static ECDH), enaa asiléle nɔa bɔbɔe va ɖoa mɔzɔzɔ ɖeka dzi yiyi kple gbɔgbɔ, dea se be woawɔ adzamenyawo ayi ŋgɔ.
tls13.h1_b: HTTPS + WSS + dukɔwo dome kadodo ɖesiaɖe le Vortex me zãa TLS 1.3. Míewɔa ɖeka kple Chrome 120 ƒe ClientHello byte-ɖe-byte ale be DPI mate ŋu atsɔ asibidɛ awɔ dzesi na mí abe amesiwo menye web-browser o ene o. ECH (si wotsɔ nya ɣaɣlawo ŋlɔ SNI) nye tiatia to gotagome-SNI ɖoɖowɔɖia dzi.
tls13.h1_c: Woɖo TLS 1.3 ɖe ɖoɖo nu be RFC 8446 le August 2018 me le ƒe 4 kple ame 28 ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ megbe. Chrome, Firefox, Safari ɖo kpekpeɖeŋu ɖa le ƒe 2018. Microsoft tsɔe kpe ɖe Windows ŋu le ƒe 2020. Kaka ƒe 2022 naɖo la, enye web traffic ƒe akpa gãtɔ.
tls13.h1_f:
asiléle (1-RTT): .
  Asitsaha → Dɔdzikpɔla: AsitsalawoHello (safui_mamã, SNI?, ALPN, ...)
  Server → Client: ServerHello + EncryptedExtensions + Ðaseɖigbalẽ + ÐaseɖigbalẽVerify + Wowu enu
  Client → Server: Wowu enu + Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe Nyatakakawo
tls13.h2_a: TLS ƒe kadodo ɖesiaɖe. Asibidɛ ƒe dzesi ƒe sɔsɔ le `app/transport/stealth_level1.py` me.
tls13.h3_a: ECH, TLS asibidɛ ƒe dzesi, JA4, ŋgɔdonya ɣaɣla

totp.title: TOTP ƒe .
totp.subtitle: Ɣeyiɣi Ðeka ƒe Nyagbe si Wozãna (RFC 6238).
totp.intro: TOTP nye nyagbe si wozãna zi ɖeka si woɖe tso nya ɣaɣla si woama kple ɣeyiɣi si li fifia me. Nusiwo woɖo ɖi: sɛkɛnd 30 ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe afɔɖeɖe, xexlẽdzesi 6 ƒe kɔda, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_a: TOTP nye nyagbe si wozãna zi ɖeka si woɖe tso nya ɣaɣla si woama kple ɣeyiɣi si li fifia me. Nusiwo woɖo ɖi: sɛkɛnd 30 ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe afɔɖeɖe, xexlẽdzesi 6 ƒe kɔda, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_b: Vortex ƒe 2FA zãa TOTP kple RFC ƒe gɔmedzedze. Zãlawo skan QR le ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ me; kɔda si wowɔ tso woƒe Authenticator dɔwɔnua me sɔ kple kɔda si server la kpɔ mɔ na. Rate-limited na agbagbadzedze 5 le miniti 5 ɖesiaɖe me na zãla ɖesiaɖe.
totp.h1_c: TOTP (RFC 6238, 2011) si Mark Pei ŋlɔ si wotu ɖe HOTP (RFC 4226, 2005) dzi. Do ŋgɔ na ema la, RSA SecurID zãa mɔnu si nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ. Google Dzesidela (ƒe 2010) na TOTP xɔ ŋkɔ; 2FA app ɖesiaɖe zãnɛ fifia.
totp.h1_f:
TOTP(k, t) = HOTP(k, ⌊t / 30⌋) .
HOTP(k, c) = lãɖeɖe( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106
fesre: ±1 afɔɖeɖe si woɖe mɔ na na gaƒoɖokui ƒe skew
totp.h3_a: HMAC, 2FA, ɖaseɖiɖila, kɔpi siwo wotsɔ dzraa nu ɖo

turn.title: TURN ƒe .
turn.subtitle: Traversal Zã Relays ƒo xlã NAT (RFC 8656).
turn.intro: TURN nye ɖoɖowɔɖi si wotsɔ ɖoa ​​UDP / TCP ʋuwo to dutoƒo dɔwɔƒe ne hatiwo ƒe mɔ tẽwo do kpo nu. Wozãnɛ abe fallback mɔ ene ne ICE ƒe host kple server-reflexive candidates mewɔ dɔ o.
turn.h1_a: TURN nye ɖoɖowɔɖi si wotsɔ ɖoa ​​UDP / TCP ʋuwo to dutoƒo dɔwɔƒe ne hatiwo ƒe mɔ tẽwo do kpo nu. Wozãnɛ abe fallback mɔ ene ne ICE ƒe host kple server-reflexive candidates mewɔ dɔ o.
turn.h1_b: Vortex ɖoa coturn kpɔɖeŋu ɖe node ɖesiaɖe. Wonɔa ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko ƒe ɖaseɖigbalẽwo (24 h), wodea asi HMAC te, wonaa wo le kaƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe me. Ne NAT traversal do kpo nu — zi geɖe le symmetric NAT alo strict firewall megbe — yɔyɔ nyadzɔdzɔgblɔmɔnuwo katã sina to TURN me.
turn.h1_c: Woɖo TURN zi gbãtɔ be RFC 5766 (2010), wowɔ yeyee wòzu RFC 8656 (2020). Wozãnɛ to WebRTC dɔwɔwɔ ɖesiaɖe me na ~15 % yɔyɔ siwo me mɔ tẽwo do kpo nu le. coturn nye nufiame si le ʋuʋu ɖi ƒe dɔwɔwɔ.
turn.h1_f:
username = "{nux_wu enu}:{zãla_dzesi}".
nyagbegbɔgblɔ = base64 (HMAC-SHA1 (server_nya ɣaɣla, zãla ƒe ŋkɔ))
TTL = 24 gaƒoƒo
coturn ɖoa kpe HMAC dzi le AUTH ɖesiaɖe dzi; gbea le eƒe nuwuwu megbe
turn.h2_a: `deploy/coturn/`, si woɖe ɖe go to `/api/calls/{id}/turn` dzi.

vapid.title: VAPID ƒe .
vapid.subtitle: Lɔlɔ̃nu Faa Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe Dɔwɔƒe ƒe Dzesidede (RFC 8292).
vapid.intro: VAPID nye Ed25519 safui eve siwo dɔwɔɖoɖo ƒe dɔwɔƒe zãna tsɔ dea dzesi eɖokui na Web Push dɔwɔƒewo. Eɖea "amekae woɖe mɔ na be wòaɖo push" biabia ɖa na Web Push ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo.
vapid.h1_a: VAPID nye Ed25519 safui eve siwo dɔwɔɖoɖo ƒe dɔwɔƒe zãna tsɔ dea dzesi eɖokui na Web Push dɔwɔƒewo. Eɖea "amekae woɖe mɔ na be wòaɖo push" biabia ɖa na Web Push ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo.
vapid.h1_b: Vortex ƒe web client ŋlɔa ŋkɔ ɖe Web Push ŋu to node la ƒe VAPID dutoƒo safui zazã me. Wotsɔa sealed-push key (p256dh) si le vovo la ɣlaa payloads le nudɔdɔ ɖesiaɖe me. Trɔtrɔ: VAPID safuia nɔa anyi didi gake payload siwo wode asi ete la ƒe ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe koe nye JWT-style.
vapid.h1_c: Woɖo VAPID ɖe ɖoɖo nu be RFC 8292 le ƒe 2017. Do ŋgɔ na VAPID la, Web Push bia be woawɔ nudɔdɔ siwo FCM-brokered alo auth mechanism si le vovo. VAPID naa ɖokuitɔdidi ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nɔa bɔbɔe — Firebase dɔ aɖeke mehiã o.
vapid.h2_a: `app/services/sealed_push.py::web_push`, wota to dziɖula `/v1/health` dzi hena dɔléle didi.
vapid.h3_a: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe Tutu, nutrenu tutu, Ed25519, JWT .

waf.title: WAF ƒe .
waf.subtitle: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe Dɔwɔɖoɖo ƒe Dzodoƒe.
waf.intro: WAF nye titinamɔ̃ si léa ŋku ɖe HTTP biabia ŋu eye wòxea mɔ na nɔnɔme vɔ̃ɖi siwo wonya (SQL atikekui, mɔ zɔzɔ, template dodo) hafi woɖoa dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kɔpi gbɔ.
waf.h1_a: WAF nye titinamɔ̃ si léa ŋku ɖe HTTP biabia ŋu eye wòxea mɔ na nɔnɔme vɔ̃ɖi siwo wonya (SQL atikekui, mɔ zɔzɔ, template dodo) hafi woɖoa dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kɔpi gbɔ.
waf.h1_b: Vortex ƒe WAF zɔna abe `app/dedienɔnɔ/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware` ene. ~50 regex léa ŋku ɖe URL, biabia, ŋutilã. Block `UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$afika`, XSS kpɔɖeŋu siwo wonya. Azɔ hã, ewɔa xexeame katã ƒe seɖoƒe siwo woɖo na ga home (1000 req/s), mɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe seɖoƒe (ge ɖe eme 10/min, ŋlɔ ŋkɔ 5/min), zãla ɖesiaɖe ƒe seɖoƒewo.
waf.h1_c: WAFwo dze egɔme tso mod_security (ƒe 2002). Cloudflare ƒe WAF (2014) tsɔ kpɔɖeŋua wɔ adzɔnuwoe. Egbegbe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ɖesiaɖe ɖoa ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe hatsotso si woɖo ɖi la ɖa. Woƒo Vortex ƒe regex xexlẽdzesiwo nu ƒu tso OWASP Top 10 ƒe asidede agbalẽ te me.
waf.h1_f:
le biabia ɖesiaɖe me:
  na kpɔɖeŋu le SQLI_PATTERNS: ne kpɔɖeŋu.di (url + biabia + ŋutilã): gbe
  na kpɔɖeŋu le TRAVERSAL: ne kpɔɖeŋu.di(url): gbe
  na kpɔɖeŋu le TEMPLATE: ne kpɔɖeŋu.di(ŋutilã): gbe
rate-limit keyed by (IP, mɔ, zãla_id) .
waf.h3_a: seɖoƒeɖoɖo na agbɔsɔsɔme, agbalẽdzikpɔkpɔ ŋuti nuŋlɔɖi, OWASP, SQL atike dodo

x25519.title: X25519 ƒe .
x25519.subtitle: Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman ɖe Curve25519 dzi (RFC 7748).
x25519.intro: X25519 nye elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman ɖe Curve25519 dzi le eƒe Montgomery nɔnɔme me. 32-byte ame ŋutɔ kple dutoƒo safuiwo, 32-byte nya ɣaɣla si woama. Wozãnɛ hena nubabla veviwo.
x25519.h1_a: X25519 nye elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman ɖe Curve25519 dzi le eƒe Montgomery nɔnɔme me. 32-byte ame ŋutɔ kple dutoƒo safuiwo, 32-byte nya ɣaɣla si woama. Wozãnɛ hena nubabla veviwo.
x25519.h1_b: Static device identity ɖesiaɖe, ephemeral session key ɖesiaɖe, sealed-push subscription ɖesiaɖe le Vortex me zãa X25519. Montgomery-atrakpui ƒe dɔwɔwɔ nye ɣeyiɣi si nɔa anyi ɖaa eye mete ŋu ɖua axadzimɔ dzi amedzidzedze ƒe hatsotso si ɖea fu na ʋuʋudedi siwo do ŋgɔ o.
x25519.h1_c: Curve25519 nye esi Bernstein (ƒe 2005) ta; woɖoe ɖe ɖoɖo nu abe RFC 7748 (2016) kple ŋkɔ X25519 na DH ƒe tɔtrɔ. Woxɔe to Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard, Apple iMessage, Chrome (quantum megbe tsakatsaka) dzi. Ebɔ ɖe afisiafi le egbegbe nya ɣaɣlawo ŋɔŋlɔ si wozãna me.
x25519.h1_f:
ame ŋutɔ ƒe safui: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 bytes little-endian, clamped) .
dutoƒo safui: A = a · G (32-byte ƒe teƒe si woƒo ƒu) .
woama: s = a · B = b · A (32 bytes, → HKDF nyawo tsɔtsɔ yi eme)
dɔwɔwɔ: ~100 μs ɖe DH ɖeka dzi le iPhone 11 dzi
x25519.h3_a: Ed25519, HKDF, Curve25519, Dzesi ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi

websocketFanout.title: WebSocket fan-out ememenuwo
websocketFanout.subtitle: Alesi node ɖeka tsɔa wɔna aɖe yina na nudɔla akpe geɖe.
websocketFanout.what: WebSocket fan-out nye Python-native set of subscriber handles le xɔ ɖesiaɖe me. Ne wotsɔ gbedasi aɖe ɖo POST la, fan-out dispatcher la gbugbɔa set la eye wòɖoa serialized frame ɖe subscriber ɖesiaɖe ƒe send queue dzi.
websocketFanout.why: Fan-out ƒoa asa na N-kɔpi ƒe gazazã le nyadzɔdzɔwo kaka me: nya ɣaɣlawo ɖeɖeɖa ɖeka le amedɔdɔ ƒe akpa dzi, frame ɖeka si woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu, N send-queue pushes. Tutu ɖesiaɖe nye O(1); wotua kɔpi ƒe asi ɖe kernel la dzi le `send()` ɣeyiɣi me to zero-copy buffers dzi ne OS do alɔ wo.
websocketFanout.where: Wowɔe le `app/chats/fanout.py` me. `FanoutRegistry` ƒe ɖoƒe si le etame la lé `dict [xɔ_id, ɖo [WebSocket]]`. Wokpɔa ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo dzi to `asyncio.Lock`; nuxexlẽwo nye foto siwo me wotu nu ɖo o.
websocketFanout.how: Le gbedasi POST dzi la, mɔfiala la yɔa `lala fanout.broadcast(xɔme_id, payload_bytes)`. Mɔnu la kɔpi ƒuƒoƒoa le gaxɔa te, ɖea asi le eŋu, emegbe egbugbɔa kɔpi si le lalam `ws.send_bytes(payload)` kple sɛkɛnd 1 ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu le socket ɖesiaɖe me. Wodea dzesi socket siwo ƒe ɣeyiɣia wu enu la be womegblẽ o eye woɖea wo ɖa.
websocketFanout.when: Gbedasi ɖesiaɖe, nuwɔna, nuxexlẽ-xɔxlɔ̃, nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dzesi, kaƒoƒo ƒe dzesi, kple xɔa ƒe safui ƒe tɔtrɔ ɖesiaɖe sina toa fesre sia ke me. Woɖo seɖoƒe na xɔtunu ƒe lolome be enye 64 KiB; wogbea payload siwo lolo wu eye wogbugbɔa wo naa yɔla to HTTP dzi.
websocketFanout.cfg1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE=256` — nudɔla ɖesiaɖe ɖo fli ƒe goglome ɖa. Overflow ɖiɖia xɔtunu xoxotɔ kekeake.
websocketFanout.cfg2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS=1000` — dzigbe liƒo le `ɖoɖo_bytes` dzi. Ne ègbɔ eme la, efia be socket la gblẽ.
websocketFanout.cfg3: `FANOUT_MAX_ROOM_SIZE=10000` — gbe fan-out le xɔ siwo lolo wu esia dzi. Xɔ gãwo zãa channel mode kple pull pattern ɖe eteƒe.
websocketFanout.fail1: Blewu nuƒlela — ɖesiaɖe-socket fli yɔ fũ. Frame xoxotɔwo kekeake dze anyi. Client léa to `tso esime` le reconnect dzi.
websocketFanout.fail2: Socket kuku — `ɖo_bytes` fɔ `Kadodo si wotu` ɖe dzi. Dispatcher ɖea ɖa le set dzi eye wòyia edzi.
websocketFanout.fail3: Bursty producer — ne producer nye > 5× kabakaba wu aggregate consumer bandwidth, megbe-nyaƒoɖeamenu kicks in via `lala` suspending the sender.
websocketFanout.fail4: Memory blow-up — fli si woɖo na nudɔla ɖesiaɖe si ƒe seɖoƒe nye 256 frames; le 64 KiB ɖesiaɖe si nye 16 MiB max ɖesiaɖe blewu nuƒlela. Nuƒlela si si dzo la atso kadodoa me to liveness check la dzi hafi aƒo dzisasrã ma.
websocketFanout.mon1: Prometheus gauge `vortex_fanout_queue_depth{xɔ,zãla}` — fli ƒe goglome le socket ɖesiaɖe me.
websocketFanout.mon2: Xexlẽdzesi `vortex_fanout_drops_total{reason}` — woɖe framewo ɖa le susu nu (overflow, timeout, closed).
websocketFanout.mon3: Histogram `vortex_fanout_send_duration_seconds` — ɖo ɣeyiɣi didi ƒe mama ɖa.
websocketFanout.tune1: Do `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE` ɖe dzi na asisiwo le network siwo le blewu gake woli ke dzi.
websocketFanout.tune2: Ðe `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS` ɖe anyi le dzrehehe gã ƒe ƒuƒoƒo siwo me socket blewuwo naa dɔ wua ame bubuwo le.
websocketFanout.tune3: Ma xɔ gãwo ɖe xɔ suewo me alo trɔ wo ɖe channel mode me kple pull-based updates.
websocketFanout.edge1: Woɖoa xɔ ƒe tɔtrɔ ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo (`type:"k"`) kple s 2 ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu ɖe 1 s teƒe elabena ele be asisiwo nagbugbɔ safuiwo ade eme hafi axɔ gbedasi geɖe.
websocketFanout.edge2: Womegatea nudzɔdzɔwo ŋɔŋlɔ kpɔ o — "zãla dzudzɔ ŋɔŋlɔ" ƒe bu la megblẽa nu le ame ŋu o.
websocketFanout.edge3: Woƒoa anyinɔnɔ ƒe yeyewo nu ƒu ɖe hatsotsowo me: woƒoa zãla ƒe anyinɔnɔ ƒe tɔtrɔ geɖe nu ƒu le 250 ms fesre ɖeka me ɖe nɔnɔmetata ɖeka me.
websocketFanout.mig1: v0.0 zã ɖe xɔ ɖesiaɖe me `asyncio.Queue`s — wotsɔ lock-copy-iterate ƒe kpɔɖeŋu ɖɔ li le v0.0.5 me na gbedasi ɖesiaɖe si bɔbɔ ɖe anyi wu CPU.
websocketFanout.mig2: Etsɔme: ne Redis li la, fan-out alɔ̃ pub/sub ale be multi-node clusters gbugbɔa nudzɔdzɔwo wɔ mesh fan-out manɔmee.
websocketFanout.ts1: High drop rate: lé ŋku ɖe network ŋu na nuƒlela si le blewu; bump fli ƒe lolome; ku nu me le amesiwo ŋu wole dɔ wɔm le ƒe nuwɔna ŋu.
websocketFanout.ts2: Ɣeyiɣi didi si woatsɔ aɖoe ɖa: anɔ eme be TLS gbugbɔgadzraɖo si le edzi yim alo NAT ƒe mɔzɔzɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe nuwuwu; kpɔ kernel logs hena TCP gbugbɔgaɖoɖowo.
websocketFanout.ts3: Memory creep: lé ŋku ɖe `vortex_fanout_queue_depth` ŋu le zãla ɖesiaɖe me; de dzesi zãla ɖesiaɖe si ƒe goglome madzudzɔmadzudzɔe > 200 be wòanya wɔ blewu alo asisi vɔ̃ɖi.
websocketFanout.faq1: Q: Nukae dzɔna ne asisi aɖe to framewo ŋu le kadodoa ƒe ɖeɖeɖa me? A: Ega doa ka kple `since=<last_seen_id>` eye dɔdzikpɔla la gbugbɔa ƒoƒo tso DB gbɔ. Fan-out la nye agbagbadzedze nyuitɔ kekeake le ɣeyiɣi ŋutɔŋutɔ me; nusiwo nɔa anyi didina nɔa agbe le DB me.
websocketFanout.faq2: Q: Ðe nudɔla vɔ̃ɖi aɖe ate ŋu aɖe fan-out dzi akpɔtɔa? A: Woɖea woawo ŋutɔ ƒe fli dzi kpɔtɔna, si yɔa wo me, tsɔa framewo ƒua gbe, eye wòtsoa kadodoa me. Cross-subscriber ƒe nudede nyawo me aɖeke meli o.
websocketFanout.faq3: Q: Aleke mawɔ debug zãla aɖe koŋ ƒe delivery? A: `GET /api/admin/debug/fanout/{user_id}` tsɔa woƒe fli ƒe goglome, ɣeyiɣi ƒe dzesi mamlɛtɔ si woɖo ɖa, kple esiwo woɖe nyitsɔ laa la ƒua gbe.

nonceManagement.title: Nonce dzikpɔkpɔ
nonceManagement.subtitle: Alesi Vortex nana AES-GCM nonces nɔa etɔxɛ le mɔ̃wo, xɔwo, kple gbugbɔgadzedzewo katã me.
nonceManagement.what: AES-GCM dɔwɔwɔ ɖesiaɖe xɔa 12-byte nonce be MUST nanye etɔxɛ na safui si wona. Nonce si me safui ɖeka le zazã ake gblẽa nya ɣaɣla kple nyateƒetoto siaa dome — amedzidzela si si ciphertext eve le ɖeka te (key, nonce) ateŋu axɔ plaintext XOR.
nonceManagement.why: Vortex wɔa xɔ ƒe safui ɖeka eye wòzãnɛ na gbedasi akpe geɖe. Nonce si ŋu woda asi ɖo le gbedasi eve dzi ana nuŋɔŋlɔ siwo me kɔ o la nado. Eyata wowɔa nonces katã kple OS CSPRNG le 96 bits — dzigbezã-bound-safe nuto la anɔ abe 2^32 gbedasiwo le safui ɖeka me, si sɔ gbɔ sã wu safui ɖeka ɖesiaɖe si aɣla.
nonceManagement.where: Asitsalawo ƒe akpa dzi nonce dzidzime nɔa agbe le `VortexCrypto` (iOS), `crypto/aead` module (Android), `app.dedienɔnɔ.crypto.aes_gcm_encrypt` (node). Node la hã wɔa ametakpɔkpɔ ƒe duplicate-nonce check.
nonceManagement.how: Afɔɖeɖe ɖesiaɖe: asitsala wɔa byte 12 le vome, toa AES-GCM encrypt me, tsɔa ciphertext la ɖoa ɖoɖo nu abe `{ciphertext, nonce}` kple POSTs ene. Node ŋlɔa `(room_id, nonce)` ɖe ŋkuɖodzinu me LRU cache si ƒe lolome nye 10^6 nyawo me. Le POST dzi la, node léa ŋku ɖe cache la ŋu — evelia ⇒ 400 `duplicate_nonce`. Le zazã si sɔ me la, esia meɖea dzo gbeɖe o (P(collision) le 10^9 gbedasiwo me nye ~10^-19).
nonceManagement.when: Le dɔdɔ ɖesiaɖe me. Xɔla-kpa dzi: nonce check — AES-GCM ƒe tag kpɔa fɔmaɖimaɖi gbɔ. Ne wogbugbɔ nonce aɖe wɔ le mɔ aɖe nu la, decrypt evelia akpɔ dzidzedze kokoko gake nya ɣaɣlawo ya agblẽ.
nonceManagement.cfg1: `NONCE_CACHE_SIZE=1000000` — nonce siwo wowɔ nyitsɔ laa ƒe xexlẽme si wokplɔ ɖo le node ɖesiaɖe me.
nonceManagement.cfg2: `NONCE_CACHE_TTL_S=86400` — nya xoxowo nya le 24 h megbe (safui akpa gãtɔ trɔna le gaƒoƒo me le mɔ sia mɔ nu).
nonceManagement.fail1: RNG kpododonu le asisi — si mebɔ kura o kple OS-na CSPRNG. Míegatrɔna ɖe RNG siwo menye nya ɣaɣlawo o ŋu gbeɖe o.
nonceManagement.fail2: Cache miss on node restart — woda asi ɖe edzi elabena cache nye ametakpɔkpɔ-le-gogloƒe; asisiwo megazãa nonces le se nu gbeɖe o ale be miss meʋua amedzidzedze ƒe fesre o.
nonceManagement.mon2: Gauge `vortex_nonce_cache_size` — ele be wòanɔ te sesĩe ƒo xlã cache cap.
nonceManagement.tune1: Xɔ gãwo: dzi cache ƒe lolome ɖe edzi be wòaxe fesre siwo trɔna didi wu.
nonceManagement.tune2: Multi-node clusters: ma cache la to Redis dzi ne ele.
nonceManagement.edge1: Offline client gbugbɔ do ka kple gbedasi siwo le fli me: gbedasi ɖesiaɖe si le fli me tsɔa eya ŋutɔ ƒe random nonce. Mehiã be woawɔ ɖeka o.
nonceManagement.edge2: Multi-device send: mɔ̃ eveawo siaa wɔa nonces siwo le wo ɖokui si le vome. P(gododo) le 2 mɔ̃wo × 10 ^ 4 gbedasiwo = ɖekematsɔleme.
nonceManagement.mig1: v0.0 zã counter-based nonces kpuie si woƒã kple device id — woɖe asi le eŋu le esi pepa aɖe ɖe cross-device collisions fia le clock-skew te vɔ megbe. Random-96 koe nye mɔ si dzi yayra le fifia.
nonceManagement.ts1: Kpɔ `duplicate_nonce` gbegbewo: lé ŋku ɖe asisi la ŋu be buggy RNG; kpɔ mɔ̃a ƒe entropy dzɔtsoƒe ɖa.
nonceManagement.ts2: Cache OOM: lé ŋku ɖe cache ƒe lolome ŋu le xɔme nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔme nu; alo nàdo lolome ɖe dzi alo aɖiɖi TTL ɖe anyi.
nonceManagement.faq1: Q: Ke ne asisi eve tia nonce ɖeka ma ke le vome ya ɖe? A: Le 96 bits ƒe randomness, mɔkpɔkpɔ gbãtɔ ƒoƒo le zãlawo katã dome le ~ 2 ^ 48 gbedasiwo — agbe geɖe Vortex zazã. Ne edzɔ gbeɖeka la, node la agbe evelia.
nonceManagement.faq2: Q: Nukatae 96 bits eye menye 128 o? A: AES-GCM ƒe dzidzenu nonce didime. 96 bits hã dzraa byte 4 ɖo ɖe gbedasi ɖesiaɖe me.

keyRotation.title: Safuiwo ƒe tɔtrɔ
keyRotation.subtitle: Ɣekaɣie xɔ, mɔ̃, kple asiɖeɖe le nu ŋu ƒe safuiwo aʋuʋu kple alesi woawɔe.
keyRotation.what: Safui ɖesiaɖe si nɔa anyi didi le Vortex me trɔna le ɖoɖowɔɖi aɖe dzi alo le trigger dzi. Xɔa ƒe safuiwo trɔna ne hameviwo trɔ alo ɣeaɖewoɣi (kwasiɖa sia kwasiɖa). Mɔ̃a ƒe safuiwo trɔna le zãla ƒe tiatia ɖesiaɖe me. Asiɖeɖe le safuiwo ŋu trɔna ne wosusu be nugblẽfexexe aɖe li.
keyRotation.why: Trɔtrɔ ɖoa ​​seɖoƒe na nugblẽfexexe ƒe blast radius. Xɔme safui aɖe si wofi tso etsɔ la dzudzɔ egbe ƒe gbedasiwo ɖeɖeɖa. Safui aɖe si wofi tso ƒe 2024 me la dzudzɔa ɖaseɖiɖi le ƒe 2026 ƒe asiɖeɖe le eŋu ŋu.
keyRotation.where: `app/keys/` xɔ server-afã ƒe tɔtrɔ ƒe susuŋudɔwɔwɔ. Asitsalawo ƒe akpa: `ios/.../Safuiwo/impl/RoomKeyProvider.swift`, `android/.../safuiwo/impl/RoomKeyProvider.kt`.
keyRotation.how: Xɔa ƒe tɔtrɔ: admin ɖesiaɖe ate ŋu aʋã; tɔtrɔ dzro ko le mɔkeke me nye nusi dzɔna le eɖokui si. Rotator la xɔa ke yeye si ƒe lolome nye byte 32, gbugbɔa agbalẽkotokuwo naa hamevi susɔeawo, ɖoa `POST /api/rooms/{id}/rotate` ɖe agbalẽkotoku yeyeawo me. Node trɔa asi le `room_keys` ŋu le atɔm me eye wòkakaa `{type:"k"}`.
keyRotation.when: Xɔ: le mɔkeke, le admin trigger, ŋkeke 7 ɖesiaɖe le eɖokui si. Mɔ̃: ŋkeke 90 ɖesiaɖe le gɔmedzedzea me (woate ŋu atrɔ asi le eŋu). Asiɖeɖe le eŋu: ad-hoc le nusi wosusu be wowɔ nugblẽfexexe ŋu.
keyRotation.cfg1: `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS=7` — ɣeyiɣi ƒe tɔtrɔ si woɖo ɖi.
keyRotation.cfg3: `ROTATE_ON_LEAVE=nyateƒe` — tsi be nàdzo le tɔtrɔ dzi le mɔkeke (ɖea dedienɔnɔ dzi kpɔtɔna na CPU si bɔbɔ ɖe anyi).
keyRotation.fail1: Client offline le tɔtrɔɣi: léa kadodo si kplɔe ɖo. Node dzraa 5 mamlɛawo ƒe tɔtrɔwo eyata reconnects ɣesiaɣi dia woƒe agbalẽkotoku.
keyRotation.fail2: Envelope minting race: admin eve trɔna le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me. Node xɔ gbãtɔ eye wòtrɔ 409 Masɔmasɔ ɖe evelia ŋu.
keyRotation.mon2: Histogram `vortex_rotation_duration_seconds` — gli-gaƒoɖokui le tɔtrɔ ɖesiaɖe me.
keyRotation.tune1: Dutoƒoxɔ siwo me hamevi > 1000 le: trɔ ɖe Variant-B key publish ŋu. Mɔkeke ƒe tɔtrɔ va zua no-op; hameviwo ka ɖe pubkey ƒe asidede agbalẽ te si woda ɖe afima dzi.
keyRotation.tune2: Xɔ siwo bua ɣeyiɣi ŋu (e.g. nyadzɔdzɔŋlɔlawo ƒe dzɔtsoƒe mɔnuwo): tɔtrɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi kpuitɔ (gbesiagbe alo gaƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe).
keyRotation.edge1: Xɔ si me ame ɖeka koe nɔna le ame bubuwo katã ƒe dzodzo megbe: tɔtrɔ mehiã o gake wogaʋãnɛ kokoko be wòawɔ ɖeka; lone member xɔa agbalẽkotoku yeye na wo ɖokui.
keyRotation.edge2: Aƒetɔ dzona: nutɔnyenye trɔna yia admin si va kpe ɖe eŋu ɣeyiɣi didi wu la gbɔ; woɖe asi le aƒetɔ ƒe agbalẽkotoku xoxoa ŋu.
keyRotation.mig1: v0.0 trɔna le mɔkeke dzi ko. v0.2 tsɔ ɣeyiɣi ƒe tɔtrɔ si dzi `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS` kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖo kpee.
keyRotation.ts1: Asitsalawo tsi nya ɣaɣlawo ɖeɖeɖa me: lé ŋku ɖe agbalẽkotoku ƒe kplɔ̃ ŋu; kpɔ egbɔ be woɖe gbeƒã tɔtrɔ ƒe wɔnaa.
keyRotation.ts2: Trɔtrɔ ƒe kpododonuwo: zi geɖe la, network na hamevi si le blewu. Gbugbɔ te xexlẽme si woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽdzikpɔkpɔ ƒe mɔzɔzɔa me kpɔ.
keyRotation.faq1: Q: Ðe tɔtrɔ ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu gbugbɔa gbedasi xoxowo ɣlanaa? A: Ao, nya ɣaɣla xoxoa nɔa safui xoxoa te; asisiwo dzraa safui xoxowo ɖo ɖe woƒe nutoa me cache me hena ŋutinya me nya ɣaɣlawo ɖeɖeɖa.
keyRotation.faq2: Q: Ke ne ezãla aɖe va kpe ɖe eŋu eye wòdzo kabakaba zi gbɔ zi 100 ya ɖe? A: Nuwɔna ɖesiaɖe trɔna. Le xɔ gãwo me la, esia xɔ asi ŋutɔ — míeɖoa seɖoƒe na hamevinyenye ƒe wɔnawo va ɖo 1/min na zãla ɖesiaɖe.

rateLimiting.title: Seɖoƒeɖoɖo na agbɔsɔsɔme si woatsɔ awɔ dɔe
rateLimiting.subtitle: Per- IP, ame ɖeka zãla, mɔ ɖesiaɖe token-bucket seɖoƒewo.
rateLimiting.what: Seɖoƒe siwo woɖo na ga home nye ametakpɔnu vevitɔ tso ame gbogbowo zazã le mɔ gbegblẽ nu: brute-force gege ɖe eme, ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ ƒe tsiɖɔɖɔ, gbedasiwo ƒe spam, file-upload ƒe ɖeɖiteameŋu.
rateLimiting.why: Seɖoƒe manɔmee la, ŋlɔmiwɔla ɖesiaɖe si ŋu woɖo kpee ate ŋu aɖe disk, ayɔ fan-out, alo brute-force a 4-digit 2FA. Seɖoƒewo mexɔ asi o (~10 ns le check ɖeka me) eye wotrɔa amedzidzedze siwo mehiã o ne menye nenema o la wozua esiwo xɔ asi.
rateLimiting.where: `app/security/limits.py` lé seɖoƒefianu la ɖe asi. `app/authentication/_helpers.py::_check_auth_rate` nye agbalẽ xatsaxatsa tsɛ aɖe na ɖaseɖiɖimɔwo.
rateLimiting.how: Token-bucket algorithm ɖesiaɖe (kekeme, safui). Bucket refills le rate R, capacity C. Biabia xɔa dzesi 1. Bucket ƒuƒlu ⇒ 429. Tracker ƒe nudzraɖoƒe: in-memory dict le node ɖeka dzi; Redis ne `REDIS_URL=...`.
rateLimiting.when: Nubiabia ɖesiaɖe to WAF titinamɔ̃a dzi. Skip list for static assets kple lãmesẽnyawo me dzodzro.
rateLimiting.cfg1: `_AUTH_RATE_LOGIN=10` le s 60 ɖesiaɖe me le IP ɖesiaɖe me.
rateLimiting.cfg2: `_AUTH_RATE_REGISTER=5` le s 60 ɖesiaɖe me le IP ɖesiaɖe me.
rateLimiting.cfg3: `MSG_RATE_PER_USER=30` le miniti ɖeka me le zãla ɖeka me.
rateLimiting.cfg4: `FILE_UPLOAD_RATE=10` le miniti ɖeka me le zãla ɖesiaɖe me.
rateLimiting.fail1: Sedzizãla si le megbe na NAT si woama (ɔfis, suku) ƒoa seɖoƒe ɖesiaɖe — zãla si dze ŋgɔ 429 kple gbedasi bubutɔe.
rateLimiting.fail2: Memory blow-up le gã gbagbã — capped le 100k safui vovovowo; LRU nyanya le aƒea me.
rateLimiting.mon2: Histogram `vortex_rate_limit_check_duration_seconds` — ele be wòanɔ 100 μs te.
rateLimiting.tune1: Le CDN si le IP ŋutɔŋutɔ ɖem megbe: ɖo `TRUSTED_PROXIES` ale be míaxlẽ `X-Forwarded-For`. Ne menye nenema o la, ʋuwo katã ƒoa seɖoƒe si le CDN ƒe dodo IP te.
rateLimiting.tune2: Bot siwo ƒe lolome lolo: na API safui kple `BOT_RATE_OVERRIDE=1000`.
rateLimiting.edge1: IPv6: míeɖo seɖoƒe na /64 ɖesiaɖe tsɔ wu be míaɖo seɖoƒe na adrɛs ɖesiaɖe be míabu akɔnta le ISP mama gãwo ŋu.
rateLimiting.edge2: Tor ƒe dodo: míewɔa seɖoƒe si le gbadzaa wu (`TOR_RATE_MULTIPLIER=5`) ŋudɔ be míaƒo asa na tohehe na Tor zãlawo le dodo siwo woama me.
rateLimiting.mig1: v0.0 zã `slowapi` kple decorator-per-route — woɖe asi le eŋu le v0.0.5 me na titina dɔwɔnu siwo le titina.
rateLimiting.ts1: False-positive 429: kpɔ proxy config si dzi woka ɖo, kpɔ shared-NAT setups, bump scope limit ne ʋuɖoɖo si le se nu le eƒom.
rateLimiting.ts2: Bypassed: lé ŋku ɖe mɔɖeɖe ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo ŋu be IP si wɔa ŋlɔmi le ame ŋu hã; tsɔ kpe ɖe `BLACKLIST_IP=` env var na mɔxexe sesẽ.
rateLimiting.faq1: Q: Ðe woma seɖoƒewo ɖe nodewo dzia? A: Le node ɖeka ƒe nɔnɔme me la, seɖoƒewo nyea node ɖesiaɖe. Le Redis gome la, seɖoƒewo nye xexeame katã le ƒuƒoƒoa katã me.
rateLimiting.faq2: Q: Aleke mawɔ ana nu geɖe wu na ɖokuinye? A: Zãla siwo ŋu woɖo kpee ateŋu abia be woana xexlẽme si lolo wu to `/api/admin/quota` dzi. Admins da asi ɖe nya ɖesiaɖe dzi.

emojiCatalog.title: Emoji ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe
emojiCatalog.subtitle: 1500-emoji dataset la ma le asisiwo katã dome.
emojiCatalog.what: Vortex ɖoa eya ŋutɔ ƒe emoji ƒuƒoƒo ɖe amewo tsɔ wu be wòaɖo ŋu ɖe Unicode-version ƒe anyinɔnɔ ŋu. Emojis 1500 siwo woɖo ɖe hatsotso 9 me (smileys, amewo, lãwo, nuɖuɖu, mɔzɔzɔ, dɔwɔnawo, nuwo, dzesiwo, aflagawo). JSON ma ke si wozãna le iOS (`Emoji/Dɔwɔnuwo/emoji.json`), Android (`android/app/src/main/assets/emoji.json`), kple web client (`static/assets/emoji.json`).
emojiCatalog.why: Nusiwo sɔ: ele be zãla si le 🥹 ɖom ɖa le iOS 17 dzi la naɖe egɔme abe 🥹 le Android 9. Native system emoji diverge across OS versions by 1-3 years, eyata míeɖoa mía ŋutɔwo tɔ ɖa be anyigbatata la nali ke.
emojiCatalog.where: `android / app / src / vevitɔwo / nunɔamesiwo / emoji.json`, `ios / Modules / Dzɔtsoƒewo / Emoji / Dɔwɔnuwo / emoji.json`, `static / js / dzeɖoɖo / emoji-ticker.js`.
emojiCatalog.how: JSON wɔwɔme: `{ƒomevi: [emoji_char, ...]}`. Asitsalawo tsɔa agba le gɔmedzedzea me, wowɔa wo gbadzaa ɖe didiƒe ƒe dzesi me, eye woɖea nu to LazyVGrid / LazyGrid / CSS grid dzi.
emojiCatalog.when: Le app gɔmedzedze kple ɣesiaɣi si zãla la ʋu picker la. MRU xexlẽdzesiwo gakpɔtɔ le Zãla ƒe Defaults / SharedPreferences / localStorage me.
emojiCatalog.cfg1: Nyitsɔ laa ƒe cap: 30 le iOS, 30 le Android, 20 le web.
emojiCatalog.cfg2: Woɖo hatsotsowo ɖe ɖoɖo nu — tɔtrɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu gblẽa tiatiawɔla ƒe ɖoɖoa me.
emojiCatalog.fail1: Zãla ƒe OS mateŋu aɖe emoji gɔme o: edze anyi ɖe `?` ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo me. Míeɖea codepoints tso Unicode ≤ 15.0 si egbegbe OS ɖesiaɖe doa alɔe me.
emojiCatalog.mon1: Ɖeke o. Asitsalawo ƒe akpa dzi ɖeɖeko.
emojiCatalog.tune1: Emoji packs tɔxɛwo: ezãlawo ate ŋu ade sticker packs siwo wɔa nu nenema ke gake woɖea raster nɔnɔmetatawo fiana.
emojiCatalog.edge1: Skin-tone variants: míaƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒea dzraa emojis siwo wotu ɖe gɔmeɖoanyi dzi ko; wowɔa vovototowo le asitsalawo ƒe akpa dzi to ZWJ ƒe ɖoɖowo dzi.
emojiCatalog.edge2: Aflaga ƒe nɔnɔmetatawo: nutome-fiadzesi ƒe dzesi eve; iOS ɖea aflaga la fiana, Android tɔ aɖewo ɖea ŋɔŋlɔdzesi eve fiana.
emojiCatalog.mig1: v0.0 zã emoji.json tso emoji-mart dzi. v0.0.5 forked be pin catalog la eye woatsoe ɖe 1500 le bundle-size susuwo ta.
emojiCatalog.ts1: Emoji si bu: gbugbɔ nunɔamesiwo tutu; kpɔ egbɔ be JSON la sɔ; mɔ̃ aɖewo dzraa xoxoawo ɖo dzikutɔe — kɔ app cache me.
emojiCatalog.faq1: Q: Ðe mate ŋu atsɔ emoji siwo wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu akpe ɖe eŋua? A: Menye to agbalẽdzraɖoƒea dzi o. Zã nusiwo wotsɔna ƒoa nu ɖe ​​nu ŋu ƒe agbawo.
emojiCatalog.faq2: Q: Nukata màzã Twemoji o? A: Mɔɖegbalẽ + bundle ƒe lolome. Twemoji nye CC-BY-4.0 gake PNG ƒuƒoƒoa tsɔa 20 MB kpena ɖe asisi ɖesiaɖe ŋu.

smartReply.title: Smartreply — nufiame
smartReply.subtitle: Subsystem ƒe kpukpui.
smartReply.what: smartReply nye Vortex ƒe ɖoɖo sue aɖe. Ekpɔa gome le dɔla ƒe nuwuwu vaseɖe nuwuwu ɖoɖowɔɖi me eye woŋlɔe ɖe subsystem bubu siwo le nufiame sia me la xa.
smartReply.why: Subsystem la li elabena ɖoɖowɔɖia ƒe slot si woɖe nyuie le esi. Eɖeɖe ɖa agblẽ dometsotso aɖe ɖi le dɔwɔwɔ me si dzi ezãlawo ɖoa ŋu ɖo.

intro.p1: Architex nye gbeƒãɖeɖe UI gbe si wotu na Vortex Mini Apps. Le esi teƒe be nàŋlɔ JavaScript si trɔa DOM la, èɖɔa screen si nèdi eye runtime la nana pixels nɔa ɖekawɔwɔ me kple nɔnɔme le eɖokui si.
intro.p2: Gbea le sue ŋutɔ: gbeƒãɖeɖe ene (@screen, @theme, @import, @for), ŋgɔdonya ɖeka na reactive variables (~), kple operator chain ɖeka na atsyãwɔwɔ (::).
intro.p3: Ne èŋlɔ HTML + CSS + JS kpɔ la, Architex ase le eɖokui me be yenyae gake boilerplate si mede 10× o. Ne mèkpɔe o la, Architex hã nye ŋgɔdonya fafɛ aɖe na reactive programming elabena gbea le sue ale gbegbe be àte ŋu alé wo katã ɖe ta me.
intro.p4: Numekugbalẽ sia ƒe akpa ɖesiaɖe tu esiwo do ŋgɔ dzi. Ti kpo ge ɖe afisiafi si nèdi ne ènya gbeƒãɖeɖe UI ƒe ɖoɖo bubu xoxo; xlẽe tso dzi va anyi ne èle egɔme dzem yeyee.
intro.li1: Gbeƒãɖeɖe — ɖɔ UI ƒe nɔnɔme, ke menye afɔɖeɖe siwo woatsɔ atue o
intro.li2: Reactive — dɔdasi ɖeka trɔa asi le label, klass, alo node ɖesiaɖe si dzi woanɔ te ɖo ŋu
intro.li3: Portable — .arx ma ke zɔna le web, iOS, kple Android hostwo dzi
intro.li4: Tiny — parser + gɔmeɖela meli le 30 te KB gzipped
intro.ct1: Architex nye domenyiŋusẽfianu tɔxɛ aɖe. Maxɔ ɖe gbegbɔgblɔ si wozãna le mɔ gbadza nu teƒe o — gake le screen ɖoɖo ɖe dzeɖoɖo me ta la, ewɔa dɔ kabakaba wu ɖoɖo ɖesiaɖe si míedzidze.
intro.ct2: Construct ɖesiaɖe le gbea me wɔa map ɖe runtime primitive ɖeka dzi. Akunyawɔwɔ aɖeke meli si me màte ŋu aɖe o.

syntax.p1: Wotu Architex ƒe ɖoɖowɔɖi ɖesiaɖe tso gbeƒãɖeɖe ene siwo le dziƒo me: @screen, @theme, @import, @component, tsɔ kpe ɖe @for loop ŋutilã ŋu. Wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe dzea egɔme tso sɔti 0 me; nusianu si woŋlɔ ɖe ete la nye block ma tɔ.
syntax.p2: Woŋlɔa reactive variables ~name — tilde ƒe ŋgɔdonya dea dzesi wo be wonye lãmenugbagbevi siwo wokplɔ ɖo. Xlẽ nu kple ~name, de dɔ asi kple =, bu akɔnta kple :=.
syntax.p3: Kpeɖodzinuwo nye dzesidenu ƒuƒluwo le woawo ŋutɔ ƒe fli dzi: text, button, image, col, row, kple bubuawo. Woƒe ɖoƒe ŋuti nyaʋiʋlia va le: text ~message, button "Save" megbe teti.
syntax.p4: Trɔtrɔlawo kpena ɖe eŋu le :: megbe. Àte ŋu abla kɔsɔkɔsɔ alesi nèdi: :: pad(24) gap(16) center color(#4f8ef7) bold size(20).
syntax.p5: Nuwɔnawo nɔa agbe le => megbe. Nuwɔna ɖeka le aŋutrɔ ɖesiaɖe me; aŋutrɔ geɖe ƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔ: button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false.

variables.h2: Trɔtrɔ siwo ŋu wobu akɔnta le
variables.p1: Reactive variable léa asixɔxɔ aɖe ɖe asi eye wònana amesiame si xlẽe nanya le eɖokui si ne èŋlɔ asixɔxɔ yeye. Ðe gbeƒãe kple =, gbugbɔ de dɔ asi na kple =, tsɔ += / -= / *= / /= yeyee.
variables.p2: Trɔtrɔnu siwo wobu akɔntae la xɔa woƒe asixɔxɔ tso nyagbɔgblɔ si gbugbɔ bua eŋu ɣesiaɣi si nya ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ de eme trɔ. Ðe gbeƒãe kple := ɖe = teƒe. Asi ƒe nudɔdɔ aɖeke meli o, nugblẽfexeɖoɖo siwo ƒe asixɔxɔ xoxo aɖeke meli o.
variables.p3: De dzesi ƒomevia kple : Type le ŋkɔa megbe. Wodo alɔ ƒomeviwo: number, string, boolean, array, object. Nuŋlɔɖiwo nye nusiwo woate ŋu awɔ le wo ɖokui si; woƒoa nya ta le ƒomevi la ŋu tso asixɔxɔ gbãtɔa me.
variables.p4: Zã lowerCamelCase alo da_case; Architex hã mewɔa se dzi o. Na ŋkɔwo nanɔ kpuie: screen si dzi ŋkɔ didi gbogbo aɖewo le gblẽa nu siwo wotsɔ de eme la dome.
variables.p5: Scope: reactive variable si woɖe gbeƒãe le @screen me la dzena le screen ma ƒe ŋutilã me ko. @theme dzesiwo dzena le xexeame katã.
variables.p6: Agbenɔƒe: dukɔa nɔa agbe zi alesi woɖo screen la ɖe edzi. Ƒudzimɔzɔzɔ yi didiƒe gblẽa nu le eŋu; yiyi megbe gbugbɔ wɔe le asixɔxɔ gbãtɔa nu.
variables.p7: Kutrikuku: be nànɔ agbe didi wu screen la, yɔ send(action: "save", data: ~state) eye nàna bot host la nayi edzi.
variables.cc4: ~total := ~count * ~step // computed — egawɔa dɔ ne wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe trɔ
variables.cc5: ~gbedoname := "Mido gbe nam, {~ŋkɔ}!"  // wobu akɔnta le template string dzi
variables.li1: Ele be woadze egɔme kple ~ na lãmenugbagbevi siwo wɔa dɔ.
variables.li2: Le ~ megbe la, ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo, xexlẽdzesiwo, tete ɖe ete: ~user_count, ~page2.
variables.li3: Nu suesuesuewo ƒe vovototo: ~count kple ~Count to vovo.
variables.li4: Wodzra nya veviwo (on, in, if) ɖo le ~ megbe gɔ̃ hã.

state.p1: Lãmenugbagbevi ɖesiaɖe si wɔa dɔ la nɔa agbe zi alesi wotsɔ eƒe @screen si ƒo xlãe la ɖo edzi. Opening a screen runs its declarations top-to-bottom; dzodzo to back() alo goto() dzi tsrɔ̃a wo.
state.p2: Ne èhiã na nɔnɔme be nàtsi agbe le mɔzɔzɔ me la, xɔe tso amedzroxɔla gbɔ: alo POST yi bot la gbɔ kple send() eye nàgbugbɔ axɔ ɖe ʋuʋu dzi, alo nàyi edzi le nutoa me to store(key, value) yɔyɔ dzi.
state.p3: Gbugbɔɖoɖo: gbugbɔ de asi na asixɔxɔ gbãtɔa. reset nya vevi aɖeke meli o elabena re-assignment wɔa dɔa xoxo; the runtime diffs and re-renders only what changed.
state.p4: Wobua nɔnɔme si wokpɔ tso eme to := dzi. Architex léa ŋku ɖe nusiwo dzi woanɔ te ɖo ŋu le eɖokui si, eyata mèŋlɔa wo kple asi o. Dependency tracking nye nusi sɔ pɛpɛpɛ le nunɔamesi ɖesiaɖe me, ke menye ɖe nu ɖesiaɖe ŋu o.
state.p5: Wotsɔa ƒuƒoƒo kple nuwo sɔna kple wo nɔewo to nufiame dzi. To force a re-render, assign a new array / object. Mutation of the old one is ignored — an intentional trade for predictable update semantics.
state.cc1: ~list = [...~list, newItem]  // force re-render with a new array reference
state.cc2: ~obj = {...~obj, ŋkɔ: "x"}  // kpɔɖeŋu ɖeka ma ke na nuwo
state.li1: Afisi wòakeke ɖo: nutoa me tɔ na @screen si ƒo xlãe.
state.li2: Agbenɔƒe: tso @screen ge ɖe eme vaseɖe dodo.

types.p1: Architex ƒe ƒomevi atɔ̃ gbãtɔwo le esi: number, string, boolean, null, kple object / array si wotsɔ ƒo ƒui. Wotoa ŋkekewo me abe ka (ISO 8601) alo xexlẽdzesiwo (unix ms).
types.p2: Xexlẽdzesiwo nye 64-bit eve (IEEE 754). Xexlẽdzesi blibo ƒe akɔntabubu vaseɖe 2^53 sɔ pɛpɛpɛ.
types.p3: Kaawo nye UTF-8; didime xlẽa kɔda teƒewo, ke menye bytes o. Interpolation zãa akɔtaɖonu siwo le fli me.
types.p4: Booleans nye true / false. Trɔtrɔ si me kɔ tso kawo me aɖeke meli o.
types.p5: Woɖo ƒuƒoƒoawo ɖe ɖoɖo nu, 0-indexed. Mɔɖeɖe to ~arr[0] dzi; didime to ~arr.length dzi.
types.p6: Nuwo nye safui→asixɔxɔ ƒe anyigbatata siwo womeɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu o. Mɔɖeɖe to ~obj.name alo ~obj["name"] dzi.
types.p7: Zitɔtɔ: akɔntabubu dɔwɔlawo zia kawo dzi ɖe xexlẽdzesiwo ŋu ne ka la dze abe xexlẽdzesi ene; ne menye nenema o la, nyagbɔgblɔ ƒe vodada aɖe atɔ dzo le dɔwɔwɔɣi.
types.p8: Nyateƒenya: alakpa asixɔxɔwo nye false, 0, "", null, kple ƒuƒoƒo / nu ƒuƒluwo. Nu bubu ɖesiaɖe nye nyateƒe.

types.td12: dzesi si fia be ame aɖeke meli o; alakpanyawo gbɔgblɔ

layout.h4: Alesi wowɔa nu ɖe ɖoɖo nu
layout.p1: Nugoe eve tututu siwo woate ŋu aƒo ƒu le Architex si: col (tsi tre) kple row (si le tsia dzi). Nu bubu ɖesiaɖe nye aŋgba ƒe akpa aɖe.
layout.p2: Indent ɖeviwo dzidzenu ɖeka goglo wu woƒe nugoe. Nuwuwu ƒe dzesi aɖeke meli o — parser zãa indentation ɖeɖeko.
layout.p3: Nugoewo xɔa gap(px) na teƒe si le ɖeviwo dome, pad(px) na ememe nutrenu, center na titina le atitsoga ƒe axadzi, grow be wòayɔ teƒe si susɔ le axa gã la dzi.
layout.p4: Alignment modifiers nye nugoe-dzidzenu: center le a col titina le tsia dzi; le row me la, eƒe titina le tsitrenu. align(left) / align(right) / align(top) / align(bottom) nye nusiwo woɖe ɖe aga tẽ.
layout.p5: Agbɔsɔsɔme: le gɔmedzedzea me la, akpa ɖesiaɖe dzi ɖena kpɔtɔna be wòasɔ ɖe emenyawo nu. Zã w(px), h(px), grow, alo maxW(px) / maxH(px) si dze ƒã nàtsɔ ablae.
layout.cc3: col :: tsi // xɔ teƒe si susɔ le tsitrenu
layout.cc4: row :: grow // xɔ teƒe si susɔ le tsia dzi

components.h3: Nugoe ƒe akpa siwo le eme
components.p1: Agba ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe akpawo: text (ŋutilã ƒe kɔpi), header (tanya), label (nyatakaka). Woxɔa ka ŋutɔŋutɔ alo lãmenugbagbevi si wɔa dɔ.
components.p2: Nusiwo wɔa dɔ kple wo nɔewo: button, input, toggle, slider, select, tabs. Wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe blana ɖe lãmenugbagbevi si wɔa nu ŋu kple asixɔxɔ ƒe nyaʋiʋli le akpaa ƒe ŋkɔ megbe.
components.p3: Nusiwo le nugoe me: col, row, card, scroll, sheet, tabs. Wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe kple eƒe ŋutilã si wobla ɖe eme.

modifiers.p1: Modifiers va le :: megbe eye woate ŋu atsɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ abla wo ɣesiaɣi. Gbeƒãɖeɖe ƒe sedede aɖeke meli si dzi woaɖo ŋkui o; masɔmasɔwo kpɔa agbalẽŋlɔla mamlɛtɔ ƒe dziɖuɖu le ƒome aɖe me gbɔ.
modifiers.p2: Ƒome si dome didi: pad(n) (axawo katã), pad(x, y) (le tsia dzi, le tsitrenu), pad(t, r, b, l) (CSS ɖoɖo), gap(n) (le ɖeviwo dome), margin(n) (gota gome).
modifiers.p4: Amadede ƒome: color(#rrggbb) (ŋgɔgbe), bg(#rrggbb) (megbe). Wo ame evea siaa xɔa tanya ƒe dzesiwo (color(~primary)) kple xexlẽdzesi 8 ƒe hex na alfa (#00000080).
modifiers.p6: Nukpɔkpɔ ƒe ƒome: hidden(~flag) ɖea node la ɖa ne aflaga la nye nyateƒe; visible(~flag) nye nusi trɔ ɖe megbe. Unmounted nodes shed woƒe DOM — nɔnɔme UI nye asi bɔbɔe.
modifiers.p7: Nuwɔna ƒome: debounce(ms) le input throttles yeyewo; placeholder("…") fia dzesi aɖe; format(kind, arg) le text dzi wɔa xexlẽdzesi aɖe ("currency", "percent", "compact").
modifiers.p8: Liƒo / didime: radius(px) ƒo xlã dzogoewo; border(#rrggbb) ta 1 px ƒe ʋuʋudedi; border(px, #rrggbb) ɖoa titrime hã.

handlers.p3: Nuwɔnawo ateŋu ade dɔ asi na lãmenugbagbevi siwo wɔa dɔ, ayɔ host built-ins, azɔ mɔ, alo send() gbedasi aɖe atrɔ ayi bot la gbɔ.

control_flow.p1: Architex mekpɔ if nyagbɔgblɔ aɖeke le nyagɔmeɖegbalẽa ƒe ɖoƒe si le etame o. Woɖea nɔnɔme UI fiana to hidden(~flag) / visible(~flag) tɔtrɔlawo alo to nyagbɔgblɔ etɔ̃ siwo le akpa ƒe asixɔxɔwo me.
control_flow.p2: Ternary wɔa dɔ le afisiafi si woxɔ asixɔxɔ aɖe le: component argument, modifier argument, computed value.
control_flow.p3: Ne alɔ siwo wu eve la, wɔ atɔ na alɔ etɔ̃awo. Architex parses tso ɖusime yi miame ale be nesting xlẽa nu le dzɔdzɔme nu.
control_flow.p4: Ne èdi susuŋudɔwɔwɔ si le abe switch ene ɖe nu dzi la, zã akɔntabubu ƒe didi: ~labels := {home: "Home", settings: "Settings"}; text ~labels[~active].
control_flow.cc1: text "Woge ɖe eme" :: visible(~zãla.woɖo kpe edzi)
control_flow.cc2: ƒe dzesi si nye "Gbugbɔ dze agbagba" :: ɣaɣla(~ agbatsɔtsɔ)
control_flow.li1: if block aɖeke meli o — zã modifier alo ternary.
control_flow.li2: No else if kɔsɔkɔsɔ — zã nested ternary.

loops.p1: Gbugbɔ wɔ block si nye UI le element ɖesiaɖe me kple @for item in ~list. Indent ŋutilãa; ɖevi ɖesiaɖe ɖea egɔme zi ɖeka le element ɖesiaɖe me.
loops.p2: Ble nufiame si wotu ɖe zero dzi la kple ŋkɔ eve ƒe nɔnɔme: @for item, idx in ~list.
loops.p3: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia léa ŋku ɖe dzedzeme ŋu to element la ŋutɔ dzi le gɔmedzedzea me. Do ŋgɔ na fli 10 000 ƒe xexlẽdzesi xɔa O(1) DOM dɔwɔwɔ — gɔmeɖela diffs to nufiame, ke menye le ɖoƒe o.
loops.p4: Atɔ @for faa. Ememe kawo kpɔa gotagome kaƒoƒo ƒe kadodowo.
loops.p5: Iteration order nye ɖoɖo si wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu. Be nàtrɔ megbe la, gbugbɔ akɔntabubu si wotsɔ trɔ asi le eŋu: ~reversed := [...].reverse().

loops.li2: Ŋutilã ate ŋu anye akpa ɖesiaɖe, si me @for bubu hã le.
loops.li3: Tsɔtsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu / ɖeɖeɖa le nuwuwu nye femaxee; diffing nye nusi wotu ɖe amenyenye dzi.

theme.p1: @theme block si le faɛl tame ɖea gbeƒã design tokens be wonye reactive variables. Trɔla alo akpa ɖesiaɖe ateŋu ayɔ wo kple ~tokenName.
theme.p2: Tokenwo va zua nusiwo trɔna dzro siwo wɔa nu ɖe ​​wo nɔewo ŋu. Duƒuƒu ƒe viviti-nɔnɔme ƒe tɔtrɔ nye fli etɔ̃: track ~isDark, na tanya la naɖe dzesiwo gɔme abe ternaries ene, eye toggle ƒe akpa ɖeka trɔa tɔtrɔa.
theme.p3: Tanya siwo wotsɔ ƒo ƒui: @screen ateŋu atrɔ asi le dzesi tɔxɛwo ŋu le nutoa me @theme block me. Dzesi siwo womegblɔ o la nyi dome tso gotagome nukpɔkpɔa me.

reactivity.p1: Nuxexlẽ ɖesiaɖe si wowɔ le akɔntabubu me nyagbɔgblɔ alo tɔtrɔɖenu ƒe nyaʋiʋli me ŋlɔa nusi dzi woanɔ te ɖo. Ne nusiwo dzi woanɔ te ɖo ɖesiaɖe trɔ la, nyagbɔgblɔa gbugbɔ daa asɔ le microtask si kplɔe ɖo me.
reactivity.p2: Writes are batched: dɔdasi geɖewo le event handler ɖeka me doa dzo ɖeka pɛpɛpɛ render pass le nuwuwu. Esia tae => ~a = 1 => ~b = 2 ƒe asi bɔbɔ le nuxlẽla geɖewo gɔ̃ hã gome.
reactivity.p3: Tasɔsɔ sesẽ (===). Asixɔxɔ ma ke ŋɔŋlɔ megawɔa naneke o. Be nàzi ɖɔɖɔɖowo dzi kple nufiame ƒomeviwo la, de asi na ƒuƒoƒo alo nu yeye aɖe.
reactivity.p4: Wodea dzesi tsatsam siwo le akɔntabubu ƒe nusiwo dzi woanɔ te ɖo (~a := ~b + 1 kple ~b := ~a - 1) me le gbeƒãɖeɖeɣi eye wogblɔa wo be wonye vodadawo.
reactivity.p5: Async updates: send() si trɔ asi le asixɔxɔ aɖe ŋu la trɔa asi le cell si nède emetsonua asi ŋu, eye wòwɔa ɖoɖo ɖe render pass ŋu ne Ŋugbedodoa kpɔ egbɔ.

errors.p1: Parse vodadawo dzona le file-load ɣeyiɣi me. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia ka nya ta tso fli, sɔti, kple aɖaŋuɖoɖo aɖe ŋu. Nusiwo gbɔ wòtsona zi geɖe: indent si mesɔ o, = si bu, tɔtrɔwɔla si womenya o, ka si wometu o.
errors.p2: Runtime vodadawo doa dzo le evaluation me. Wo dometɔ akpa gãtɔ nye reactive — nyagbɔgblɔ aɖe fia lãmenugbagbevi si womeɖe gbeƒãe o, alo ƒomevi ƒe masɔmasɔ le akɔntabubu me. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia ŋlɔa nu, ɖea aflaga dzĩ aɖe fiana le ŋgɔdonya la dzi, eye wòdzona le frame ma ƒe yeyewɔwɔ dzi.
errors.p3: Trɔla ƒe vodadawo (trɔtrɔla si womenya o, nyaʋiʋli ƒomevi si mesɔ o) dzo le parse ɣeyiɣi me. Architex sesẽ ɖe tɔtrɔɖenu siwo womenya o ŋu be yeakpɔ ŋgɔgbe ƒe sɔsɔ ta.
errors.p4: Debugging: xatsa nyagbɔgblɔ si ŋu wole ɖi kem le ɖe debug(...) me. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia ŋlɔa dodokpɔ ɖesiaɖe ɖe console la me evɔ metrɔa asixɔxɔa o. Tsɔ kpe ɖe Architex ƒe ŋkutsala ŋu be nàɖe afɔ to dukɔa ƒe tɔtrɔwo me.
errors.p5: Nuŋlɔla ƒe ƒoƒo ɖekae: Architex IDE si le Vortex bot studio la tea gbe ɖe vodadawo dzi le ɣeyiɣi ŋutɔŋutɔ me, hafi woadzra faɛl la ɖo.

examples.p1: Ene canonical Mini Apps meli le Architex/examples/. Wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe le fli 40 te eye wòdoa gbea ƒe akpa vovovo aɖe ƒe nuteɖeamedzi kpɔna.
examples.p2: Counter — nuwɔna ƒe nɔnɔme, akɔntabubu, abɔta dzikpɔlawo, nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe babla. Xlẽe gbã; etoa nyagɔmeɖegbalẽ ƒe wɔwɔme ɖesiaɖe vɛ le fli 30 teti me.
examples.p3: Todo — xexlẽdzesi gɔmeɖeɖe, tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu / ɖee ɖa, ɖɔɖɔɖo le fli me. Fia alesi @for wɔa nu kple reactive arrays kple alesi inline input bindings wɔa dɔe.
examples.p4: Profile — nɔnɔmetata, akɔtagbalẽviwo, nɔnɔme ƒe dzedzeme, mɔzɔzɔ. Fia hidden / visible tɔtrɔwo kple goto tɔtrɔwo.
examples.p5: Killer features — tanyawo, imports, tabs, toasts, xexlẽdzesi siwo woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu, ternaries, typed variables, multi-handler buttons. Nusianu zi ɖeka.

bestpractices.p1: Architex ɖoa eteƒe na nuwɔwɔ bɔbɔe. Anɔ eme be screen ɖesiaɖe si se le eɖokui me be esesẽ be woaxlẽ la ƒe atɔ ƒe dzidzenu ɖeka sɔ gbɔ akpa, inline ternaries ɖeka sɔ gbɔ akpa, alo akpa ɖeka si le dɔ eve wɔm.
bestpractices.p2: Ne ɖikeke le ŋuwò la, ɖe eme. Fli 5 @component ƒe grok le bɔbɔe wu fli 30 @screen block.
bestpractices.p3: Tia tɔtrɔɖenuŋunuwo wu agbalẽ xatsaxatsa. text :: pad(16) nyo wu be woaxatsa ɖe col :: pad(16) me.
bestpractices.p4: Na runtime la nawɔ dɔa. Asi hidden aflagawo na nu ɖesiaɖe si le xexlẽdzesi me nye gbegblẽ — runtime diffs xoxo.
bestpractices.p5: Yɔ nuwo na nuxlẽla, ke menye na nuƒoƒoƒula o. ~isLoading > ~l ƒe xexlẽme.

bestpractices.li2: Mewu 3 atɔ ƒe dzidzenuwo o — refactor ne goglo wu
bestpractices.li3: Megawu ternaries 2 le nyagbɔgblɔ ɖesiaɖe me o — zã akɔntabubu
bestpractices.li4: Megawu screen 1 le faɛl ɖeka me o — negbe ɖe wotsɔe kpe ɖe eŋu sesĩe ko hafi

navigation.p1: Architex zãa mɔzɔzɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu si wotu ɖe stack dzi. goto("Name", arg: val, ...) ƒoa screen aɖe; back() pops le etame; close() ɖea Mini App bliboa ɖa.
navigation.p2: Nyaʋiʋli siwo to goto me va zua reactive variables le target screen la me — ɖe gbeƒã wo le etame kple ŋkɔ ɖeka mawo ke kple default values.
navigation.p3: Kadodo goglowo: openArx(url) zɔa mɔ yia gota Architex Mini App; openUrl(url) ʋu le ɖoɖoa ƒe web-browser me; openChat(room_id) ti kpo yi xɔ aɖe si me Vortex me.
navigation.p4: Modal presentation: present("Name") ɖe goto teƒe la, etutua abe agbalẽvi si zãla ateŋu atsɔ asi aƒoe be yeaɖee ɖa. dismiss() tue.
navigation.p5: Nɔnɔme si le screenwo dome: mɔzɔzɔ gblẽa screen xoxoa ƒe nɔnɔme le gɔmedzedzea me. To nusi nèhiã to goto args me; nɔa nyatakaka siwo nɔa agbe didi wu dzi to store(key, value) dzi.
navigation.cc3: ƒe dzesi si nye "Te fli ɖe eme" => ɖe asi le dɔ ŋu() .
navigation.cc6: ƒe dzesi "Nuŋlɔɖiwo" => openUrl("https://docs.vortexx.sol") Ƒe 1999 ƒe ɣleti gbãtɔ me.
navigation.cc7: ƒe dzesi si nye "Dzeɖoɖo" => openChat (xɔ_dzesi: ~ xɔmeId)

forms.p1: Nusiwo wotsɔ dea eme la blana ɖe lãmenugbagbevi si wɔa dɔ ŋu le mɔ eve nu: input ~email. Ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo naa lãmenugbagbevi la nyona ɖe edzi; cell la ɖɔɖɔɖo naa agblea ɖɔa li.
forms.p2: Validation nye akɔntabubu boolean: ~emailOk := ~email.matches("^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$"). Zã hidden / visible tɔtrɔwo le vodada ƒe dzesiwo dzi.
forms.p3: Submit nye abɔta dzro aɖe si me kɔsɔkɔsɔ ƒe nuwɔnawo le. Xexe mɔ na dɔdɔ esime kpeɖodzinana do kpo nu to disabled(!~formOk) dzi.
forms.p4: Vodada ɖeɖefia: wɔ text alo label kple visible(!~fieldOk) be wòaɖee afia ne mesɔ o ko. Zã color(~danger) hena nukpɔkpɔ ƒe gbeteteɖedzi.
forms.p5: Debouncing: tsɔ :: debounce(300) kpe ɖe eŋu be nàhe network-backed validation ɖe megbe vaseɖe esime zãla la nadzudzɔ ŋɔŋlɔ hena 300 ms.
forms.p6: Teƒeɖoɖo: :: placeholder("...") ɖea dzesi aɖe fiana ne lãmenugbagbevi la le ƒuƒlu. Hint bu le safui gbãtɔ ƒoƒo me.
forms.p7: Nusiwo woŋlɔna ƒe ƒomeviwo: input gbadzaa nye nuŋɔŋlɔ; input.email, input.number, input.password, input.tel, input.date trɔ asi le keyboard kple masking ŋu.
forms.cc3: label "Email si mesɔ o" :: amadede(~afɔku) dzena(!~emailOk && ~email != "")
forms.cc4: ƒe dzesi si nye "Ðoe" :: nuwɔametɔ (!~emailOk) => send(action: "ɖoe ɖa", e-mail: ~email)
forms.li1: Binding nye mɔ eve — ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo trɔa lãmenugbagbevi la eye wòtrɔna ɖe eŋu.
forms.li2: Validation nye boolean cell si wobu akɔnta le ko.
forms.li3: Fia / ɣla vodadawo kple nukpɔkpɔ ƒe tɔtrɔwo.
forms.li4: Trɔ asi le submit button ŋu to disabled dzi.
forms.li5: Debounce network-backed validation be nàƒo asa na spam.

animations.h1: Tɔtrɔ siwo wogblɔna le mɔ si me mekɔ o nu
animations.p1: Architex nɔa agbe le mɔ si me mekɔ o nu ne reactive value ʋu xexlẽdzesi alo amadede trɔla. Trɔtrɔ si woɖo ɖi enye 200 ms bɔbɔe-do go. Tsɔ :: animate(ms, curve) tsɔe ƒu gbe.
animations.p2: Ge ɖe / do le tɔtrɔwo me: node siwo woɖe ɖe nɔnɔme nu (hidden / visible) naa agbe le eme kple egodo. Trɔ asi le eŋu to :: animate.enter(...) kple :: animate.exit(...) dzi.
animations.p3: Kplɔ̃ɖoƒewo: ease-out (si woɖo ɖi), ease-in, ease-in-out, linear, spring. Spring xɔa stiffness kple damping nyaʋiʋli siwo woate ŋu atia.
animations.p4: Asiwɔwɔ ɖe nya dzi: :: draggable kple :: swipeable tsɔa asiwɔwɔ ɖe nya dzi ƒe dzesi siwo sɔ ɖe nuƒolanɔƒea kpena ɖe eŋu. Tsɔe kpe ɖe reactive nɔnɔme ŋu be nànɔ agbe le drag dzi.
animations.p5: Ʋuʋu si dzi ɖe kpɔtɔ: amedzroxɔla la dea bubu zãla ƒe mɔɖeɖe ƒe ɖoɖoa ŋu. Ne reduced-motion le dɔ wɔm la, animations dzi ɖena kpɔtɔna va ɖoa 100 ms te eye spring curves va zua linear.
animations.cc1: col :: animate (300, bɔbɔe-le-do goe) bg (~ te gbe ɖe edzi ? ~ gbãtɔ : ~ bg)
animations.cc2: ƒe dzesi si nye "Agba" :: animate (150, spring) bg (~ vovomanɔameŋu ? ~ afɔku : ~ gbãtɔ)
animations.cc3: text "Míexɔ wò nyuie" :: animate.enter (400, kele) dzena (~ fia)
animations.li1: Ɣeyiɣi didime si woɖo ɖi: 200 ms ease-out.
animations.li2: Spring curves se le wo ɖokui me be dzɔdzɔmenuwo wu na interactive drag.
animations.li3: Host siwo ƒe ʋuʋu dzi ɖe kpɔtɔ la wɔa nusianu kpuie le wo ɖokui si.
animations.li4: Dodo le eme ƒe tɔtrɔwo hea unmount ɖe megbe vaseɖe esime animation la wu enu.
