network.p1: send(action: "name", ...args) nye tɔdzisasrã si yi bot host la gbɔ. Amedzroxɔla xɔa gbedasi JSON RPC, wɔa dɔ, eye wòtrɔa emetsonu aɖe.
network.p2: Wotsɔa emetsonua dea lãmenugbagbevi aɖe me to => ~result = it dzi. it nye kpukpui na tɔtrɔgbɔ ƒe asixɔxɔ.
network.p3: Dodokpɔwo dona abe ~result.error ene. Kpɔe ɖa hafi nàxlẽ ~result.data. Zã nested ternaries na agbatsɔtsɔ / dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ / vodada ƒe nɔnɔmewo.
network.p4: Loading states nye wò ŋutɔ wò boolean: trɔ ~loading cell hafi yɔyɔ, trɔ megbe le emegbe. Fia spinner ƒe akpa aɖe si wotu agbo ɖe ~loading dzi.
network.p5: Duɖimekeke ƒe nɔnɔmewo: ne zãla la ʋu send zi eve hafi gbãtɔa kpɔ egbɔ la, evelia ŋlɔa lãmenugbagbevi la ɖe edzi. Be nàxe mɔ ɖe enu la, agbo kple disabled(~loading).
network.cc1: ƒe dzesi si nye "Agba" => ~agbatsɔtsɔ = nyateƒe => ɖo ɖa (nuwɔna: "xɔ") => ~nyatakaka = esia => ~loading = alakpa
network.cc4: nuŋɔŋlɔ "Vodada: {~nyatakaka.vodada}" :: amadede (~ afɔku) dzena (! ~ agba && ~ nyatakakawo.vodada)
network.cc5: ƒe dzesi si nye "Gbugbɔ dze agbagba" :: nuwɔametɔ (~ agbatsɔtsɔ) => ɖo ɖa(nuwɔna: "xɔ")

a11y.p1: Nuwɔwɔ aduadu ƒe akpa ɖesiaɖe ateŋu atsɔ mɔnukpɔkpɔ ƒe dzesi to :: a11y("label") dzi. Screen readers ɖea gbeƒã ŋkɔa le focus dzi.
a11y.p2: Focus order kplɔa dzɔtsoƒe ƒe ɖoɖo ɖo le gɔmedzedzea me. Tsɔ :: a11yOrder(n) ƒo ɖe edzi hena ɖoɖo tɔxɛwo.
a11y.p3: Dynamic Type: nuŋɔŋlɔ ɖɔlilawo dzidzea kple OS ƒe asiɖoɖoanyi ƒe ŋɔŋlɔdzesi ƒe lolome va ɖo 200 %% lãɖeɖe manɔmee. Duƒuƒu ƒe ɣeyiɣia gbugbɔ ɖoa ​​nugoewo ɖe ɖoɖo nu le dzodzo me.
a11y.p4: High-contrast mode: tɔtrɔwɔla siwo ƒe megbenyawo me kɔ la xɔa opaque fills; liƒowo ƒoa ƒu tso 1 px va ɖo 2 px. Automatic — code aɖeke mehiã wu bubudede tanya ƒe dzesiwo ŋu o.
a11y.p5: Amadede ƒe vovototo: Vortex ƒe tanya si woɖo ɖi la doa go WCAG AA (4.5:1) le kekeli kple viviti siaa ƒe nɔnɔmewo me. Ele be tanya siwo wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu nado vovototodedeameme kpɔ kple amadede-vovototo dɔwɔnu ɖesiaɖe hafi aɖo wo ɖe wo.

performance.h3: Ƒo asa na dɔwɔwɔ le safui ɖesiaɖe ƒoƒo me
performance.p1: Reactivity nye fine-grained: akpa siwo xlẽa cell render si wotrɔ koe. Naneke si nèŋlɔ "femaxee" meʋãa ati blibo ƒe gbugbɔgawɔ o.
performance.p2: Nu akpe geɖe siwo woŋlɔ ɖi la nyo. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia to vovo to element identity nu, eyata prepending nye O(1). Ƒo asa na akɔntabubu nyagbɔgblɔ siwo gbugbɔ daa xexlẽdzesi bliboa kpɔ le tɔtrɔ ɖesiaɖe me — ma dɔa ɖe nu ɖesiaɖe ƒe akɔntabubu lãmenugbagbeviwo me.
performance.p3: High-frequency inputs: zã :: debounce(ms) le input ɖesiaɖe si aʋã network kaƒoƒo. Zi geɖe la, 300 ms nyea nusi sɔ.
performance.p4: Bundle ƒe lolome: Architex parser + renderer le 30 KB gzipped te. Wò .arx faɛl la tsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe lolome kpee — na nɔnɔmetatawo naganɔ babla la me o eye nàda wo ɖe URL dzi.
performance.p5: Profile: Architex inspector la ɖea akpa ɖesiaɖe ƒe render xexlẽdzesiwo kple computed-cell evaluation xexlẽdzesiwo fiana. Lãmenugbagbevi ɖesiaɖe si le ŋku lém ɖe eŋu wu zi ɖeka le zãla ƒe kadodo ɖesiaɖe me nye nɔnɔmetata ƒe taɖodzinu.

runtime.p1: Architex ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi nye TypeScript ƒe agbalẽvi si wota abe architex ene. Module ene le esi: lexer, parser, renderer, reactive.
runtime.p2: Lexer la xlẽa source text eye wòɖea dzesiwo ɖa. Enye akpa ɖeka kolia si tsɔ ɖe le whitespace me — downstream module ɖesiaɖe wɔa dɔ le tokens kple AST nodes dzi.
runtime.p3: Parser la tua AST. AST nodes nye typed kple serialisable ale be woateŋu aɖo wo to process boundaries (viɖe na hot-reload kple remote preview).
runtime.p4: Renderer zɔna AST kple render context si host la na (web DOM / SwiftUI bridge / Compose bridge) eye wòwɔa native views.
runtime.p5: Hostwo wɔa ŋgɔdonya kpui aɖe ŋudɔ: createNode, updateNode, removeNode, kpakple tɔtrɔɖenudɔwɔwɔ. Host yeye tsɔtsɔ kpee bia be woatsɔ glue code si ade fli 500 awɔe.
runtime.li2: Parser: wɔa AST si woŋlɔ ɖe mɔ̃ dzi.
runtime.li3: Gbegɔmeɖela: zɔa AST, amedɔdɔwo na amedzroxɔla.

debugging.p1: Architex inspector nye panel si ɖea lãmenugbagbevi ɖesiaɖe si le dɔ wɔm, eƒe asixɔxɔ si li fifia, kple eƒe ŋuɖoɖo ɖe eŋu ƒe nɔnɔmetata fiana. Zi cell aɖe dzi be nàkpɔ render chain si eƒe tɔtrɔ mamlɛtɔ ʋã.
debugging.p2: debug(expr) ŋlɔa expr ƒe dodokpɔ ɖesiaɖe ɖe console la me evɔ mekpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe asixɔxɔa dzi o. Zãe nàtsɔ adi akɔntabubu ƒe lãmenugbagbevi aɖe si ŋu wole ɖi kem le.
debugging.p3: log("...") taa gbedasi tso nuwɔnadzikpɔla gbɔ. Ewɔa dɔ le ŋgɔdonya me kple le ewɔwɔ me, woɖee to LOG_LEVEL me.
debugging.p4: Dzɔtsoƒe ƒe anyigbatatawo: vodada ɖesiaɖe si wowɔ le parse me kple runtime trace la fia .arx faɛl fli gbãtɔ. Ti kpo tso console la dzi yi IDE la dzi kple asiƒoƒo ɖeka.
debugging.p5: Breakpoints: inspector la doa alɔ breakpoints le cell writes dzi. Dɔwɔwɔ tɔ vie ne lãmenugbagbevi la trɔ ale be nàte ŋu alé ŋku ɖe kaƒoƒo ƒe ƒuƒoƒoa ŋu.

migration.p2: Nusiwo womegazãna o yi edzi le dɔ wɔm le nu suesuesue siwo kplɔ wo nɔewo ɖo bliboa me. Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia ŋlɔa nuxlɔ̃ame si nye be woaɖe asi le eŋu le eŋudɔwɔwɔ zi gbãtɔ me; IDE la tea gbe ɖe kɔda si womegazãna o dzi.

faq.h2: Nuwo tsɔtsɔ sɔ kple wo nɔewo
faq.p1: Q: Ðe mate ŋu aŋlɔ dɔwɔnu blibo aɖe le Architex mea? A: Wotrɔ asi le Architex ŋu na Mini Apps — screen siwo nɔa dzeɖoɖo me. Ne èdi native app blibo la, èdi SwiftUI / Compose / React.
faq.p2: Q: Aleke wòle ne wotsɔe sɔ kple Flutter? A: Flutter keke ta wu sã gake eƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi le esi (Dart VM + Skia). Architex le sue eye wòwɔa dɔ le host primitives dzi. Ne èhiã be woaxe mɔ ɖe nuƒolanɔƒea nu la, Flutter; ne ehiã be nàɖo asi gbɔ la, Architex.
faq.p3: Q: Nukatae if ƒe mɔxexe aɖeke meli o? A: Elabena hidden / visible tɔtrɔwo tsyɔa UI nɔnɔmewo ƒe 95%% dzi dzadzɛ wu. Le 5%% mamlɛawo gome la, nyagbɔgblɔ etɔ̃ wɔa dɔ.
faq.p4: Q: Ðe Architex nye dɔwɔƒe si woate ŋu azãa? A: Ɛ̃ — kpɔ GitHub repo la. MIT-mɔɖegbalẽ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ, patent ka aɖeke meli o.
faq.p5: Q: Ðe mate ŋu ayɔ native code? A: To host-exposed built-ins alo bot send() nuwɔnawo dzi ko. Direct native-bridge nye eɖoɖo koŋ be womedo alɔe o — agbã portability.
faq.p6: Q: Max screen ƒe sesẽme? A: Duƒuƒu ƒe ɣeyiɣia kpɔa 10 k reactive cells kple 100 k list items gbɔ bɔbɔe. Le ema godo la, gbã ɖe screen geɖe me.
faq.p7: Q: Ðe mate ŋu ayi edzi anɔ nu ƒom? A: Ẽ, to store(key, value) (per-Mini-App local) alo send(action: "save") dzi yi bot (server-side).
faq.p8: Q: Ðe wòwɔa dɔ le Internet dzia? A: Ẽ na pure-UI screens. Nusianu si yɔa send() hiã network la.
faq.p9: Q: Aleke mawɔ atsɔ akpa si wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu akpe ɖe eŋu? A: @component le Architex me, alo (ne èhiã native primitives) kpe asi ɖe Architex host package ŋu.
faq.p10: Q: Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ta vs asi-ŋɔŋlɔ native? A: Zi geɖe la, 3-8 %% blewu wu SwiftUI / Compose si woŋlɔ kple asi. Amegbetɔ-si womate ŋu ade dzesii na screen siwo sɔ o.
faq.li1: Max screen: ~ 10 k lãmenugbagbeviwo, ~ 100 k ŋlɔ nu.

gotchas.p1: Architex zãa teƒe 2 le indent level ɖesiaɖe me. Wogbea tabs le parse ɣeyiɣi me. IDE akpa gãtɔ trɔna le wo ɖokui si; ne èkpɔ vodada siwo mèle mɔ kpɔm na le indent me o la, kpɔe ɖa be teƒe ɣi siwo wotsaka hã le eme.
gotchas.p2: Nutsotso siwo le akɔntabubu me nyagbɔgblɔwo me xlẽa lãmenugbagbevi siwo wɔa dɔ le dodokpɔɣi, ke menye le gbeƒãɖeɖeɣi o. ~a := ~b + 1 zãa ~b si li fifia ɣesiaɣi, ke menye asixɔxɔ si le gbeƒãɖeɖe me o.
gotchas.p3: Async send() dea dɔ asi na lãmenugbagbevi la ne Ŋugbedodoa kpɔ egbɔ, si ateŋu anye nusi mele ɖoɖo nu o ne dɔdɔ geɖewo le yameʋu me. Dzɔla kple ~loading aflaga alo xexlẽdzesi si woɖo ɖe wo nɔewo yome.
gotchas.p4: Ƒomedzizizi: "5" + 1 daa asɔ be "51", ke menye 6 o. Zã Number("5") alo nàŋlɔ lãmenugbagbevi la be : number.
gotchas.p5: Deeply nested reactive objects: tɔtrɔ ɖe nɔnɔme aɖe ŋu (~obj.x = 5) meʋãa yeyewo ɖe ~obj xlẽlawo dzi o. Gbugbɔ de nu bliboa asi na wo ɖe eteƒe.
gotchas.p6: Trɔla ƒe ɖoɖo le ƒome aɖe me: amadede tɔtrɔwo kpɔa agbalẽŋlɔla mamlɛtɔ-dziɖuɖuwo gbɔ. Mègatsɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ color(...) eve anɔ mɔ kpɔm na tsakatsaka o.
gotchas.p7: Ele be woatsɔ @for ŋutilã ade eme dzidzenu ɖeka pɛpɛpɛ wòade to wu. Ðevi si le dzidzenu eve me menye parse vodada o ke boŋ gɔmesese ƒe atɔ si mesɔ o — runtime la wɔa nu ɖe ​​eŋu abe @for nɔvi ene.
